Title: Hugo 2
review: With the recent developments within the British gambling industry in mind, we can't help to feel that this game really has the worst possible timing. The UK Gambling Commission, or the UKGC, is the regulator that issues licenses for casinos to operate in the UK, and they recently decided that cartoonish characters are not allowed to be used as a promotion tool.Let's start off by stating the obvious and what many are probably thinking. It can without a doubt be regarded as a bit distasteful to go this far in an attempt to reach for the gamblers inner child subconsciously leading us to believe gambling is fun and careless. Even more so by actually using characters from our childhood.But we're not here to moralize, we really aren't. We love slots and we enjoy the artistic freedom expressed by all the various providers. It's actually quite fascinating to see famous brands, even Hugo, being translated into slots. So, distasteful? Maybe. Does it pay? Now, that's more interesting to discuss...Hugo 2 is a 5-reel video slots with 10 fixed paylines. The game includes a wild symbol (Hugo), a freespin scatter symbol (Beaver) and a bonus scatter symbol (Evil Witch Afskylia). The wild symbol substitutes for any other reel symbol (except the scatter and bonus symbols) to help comprise winning combinations.Base GameThe base game doesn't really have much potential and in all honestly won't bring much excitement in the long run. The volatility level is listed as "very high" by the provider and does have a max win potential of 5000x, but it plays more like a low to medium volatile slot in our opinion.Since there is both a picking bonus and a free spins feature available there will be a whole lot of teasing and heartstoppers which somewhat helps compensate for the dullness of the base game. The picking bonus will land quite frequently, but it's likely due to it being cheap on the wins most of the times and not having too much of the payouts allocated to it.Picking BonusThree or more Evil Witch Afskylia scatter symbols appearing on any reels will trigger the Skull Cavern bonus game where you choose paths inside the cave. Your objective is to reach the treasure chamber unharmed to unlock the treasure of Afskylia by picking the correct treasure key. Each chosen path can award monetary price, and finding the treasure at the end will award a total win multiplier depending how many lives you have left. 2x, 3x, 4x, or 5x of total win for 0, 1, 2, or 3 remaining lives.Watch out for dangers that can lead into fatal end. However, after failing, you still have extra lives to try again, as 3, 4, or 5 scatters will give you 1, 2, or 3 extra lives respectively.Free Spins FeatureThree Beaver scatter symbols appearing on reels 1, 3, and 5 will trigger the Troll Race free spin feature. 10 initial free spins will be awarded, but 5 or 10 additional free spins can be won during feature. After reaching the maximum 20 free spins, there is a chance to enter into the Skull Cavern bonus game with 3 initial lives. All bets and lines are the same as the game that started the feature.In each free spin round, after reels have stopped, but before wins are presented, there is a chance to collect 0 to 2 wild items (the bag marked "W"). When 4 or more are collected, 4 wilds will be applied to the reels, replacing any 4 symbols, while 4 wild items are removed from the collected wild items.In each free spin round, after reels have stopped, but before wins are presented, there is a chance to collect 0 to 2 multiplier items (the coin marked "x2"). If 4 or more are collected, 4 x2 win multipliers will be applied to any 4 symbols on the reels, while 4 multiplier items are removed from the collected multiplier items.ConclusionThe default RTP on Hugo 2 is 96.53% but may be much lower playing on a non Maltese license. It's already publicly known that PnG allows operators to set their own RTP within certain parameters and they are not likely the only ones to do so. As upsetting as this may seem, we should also give PnG some credit for being transparent about it when other's are not. This really is no issue as long as your playing the game licensed within the Maltese jurisdiction.We're not huge fans of this slot, not because of the theme or anything, but because of the utterly boring base game and picking bonus which doesn't seem to have much potential at all. The Free Spins feature is the only interesting part of the game and where all the potential is.The game itself is very well designed and looks great. It also plays smoothly with no annoying delays between the spins. Hugo 2 is definately a step up from the first Hugo slot and the potential is quite good with a max win of 5000x.The original Hugo slot was surprisingly popular amongst many of the viewers and some of the streamers within the casino streaming community. Some likely didn't want to admit it either. It's going to be interesting to see where this slot lands.

Title: Mighty Masks
review: Mighty Masks: Slot OverviewDon't want to get too deep from the outset, but like author Marie Lu said, 'The irony of life is that those who wear masks often tell us more truths than those with open faces.' If that's true, then developer Hacksaw Gaming's Mighty Masks is doing the online slot version of getting on Freud's couch and spilling its internal beans. Mighty Masks is an African nature-themed slot based around Mystery Mask reveals, in conjunction with the newly introduced Nudgereels mechanic, a multiplier wheel, free spins and three bonus modes for playing the game in.With references to the Serengeti, it appears players have been flung to a wilder, rawer part of the planet than they might ordinarily be used to. A place where Deliveroo, UberEATS, or any sort of food delivery service is non-existent. Here, you gotta grow your calories or out-wit the local fauna when you've got a hunger on. Speaking of fauna, Mighty Masks is jam-packed with animals of various descriptions, but Hacksaw Gaming has refrained from making this any sort of wildlife documentary. Instead, the studio has used a sort of Disney/DreamWorks/Madagascar-type event where the animals look like they're more likely to bust out a rib-tickling joke or two than battle over territory. Then again, some of them don't look super happy to see humans on their patch.Mighty Masks slot - main gamePlayed on a 5x4 gaming panel with 20 paylines, one of the main focuses is landing winning combinations of matching symbols, at least three of them, from the leftmost side of the grid onwards. Rated as 4 out of 5, Matching Masks is a medium-high volatile slot with a range of RTP settings, so if you want the highest, that would be the 96.3% version, depending on the market. With three options from the bonus buy menu covered below, base bets begin at 10 p/c and go as high as $/€100.Time to meet the crew, which as the high pays, includes a bird, rhino, monkey, crocodile, and lion as the premium picture symbols, complemented by 10-A glowing green card ranks as the low pays. A line of 5 premiums will award 10 to 20 times the bet, while the same with low pays is worth 1x the bet. The wilds, which substitute for any pay symbol, appear on all reels will dish out 20 times the bet should you land a full line.Mighty Masks: Slot FeaturesMighty Masks slot - free spinsNow we get to the features section, the masks part will become clearer via the Mighty Mystery Masks extra, which is accompanied by NudgeReels, the Multiplier Wheel, Serengeti Sunset Bonus, and thebonus buy.Mighty Mystery MasksThe Mystery Mask symbol reveals either a regular pay symbol or a wild symbol. All landed Mystery Masks in view will reveal the same type of symbol. When Mystery Masks land on three reels or more, they spread downward to cover all positions on their respective reels. Mystery Masks do their reveal after any regular line wins have been awarded.Nudge Reels and Multiplier WheelLanding the Nudge Wild symbol triggers the NudgeReels and nudges the Multiplier Wheel up to 50 times. If the Nudge Wild lands with at least one winning combo in view, it activates the Multiplier Wheel sitting next to the grid. The wheel produces a multiplier value which is applied to all wins on the current spin. The Nudge Wild can also land with a nudge value. If so, then the Multiplier Wheel will nudge the number of times shown on the symbol, all the while adding each multiplier value it nudges through, creating a total multiplier above the wheel before applying it to the current total win. The Nudge Wild can have values of 1 to 50, while the values on the Multiplier Wheel can be x2 to x100.Serengeti Sunset Bonus FeatureHitting 3 or more scatter symbols in the base game triggers the Serengeti Sunset bonus. During the feature, more Mystery Masks and Nudge Wild symbols are present compared to the base game. Landing 3, 4, or 5 scatters in the base game awards 10, 12, or 14 free spins. Get 2 scatters in the feature, and you're awarded +2 free spins, or get 3 scatters, then 4 extra free spins are coming your way.Bonus BuyMighty Masks provides players with three ways of playing the game from the bonus buy menu. The choices are:BonusHunt FeatureSpins – each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger the bonus game for the cost of 3x the bet. Max RTP 96.38%, very highly volatile.Masked FeatureSpins – 40x the bet for a spin guaranteeing at least 3 Mystery Masks hit. Max RTP 96.28%, extremely volatile.Serengeti Sunset – 120x the bet to buy the Serengeti Sunset bonus. Max RTP 96.28%, very highly volatile.Mighty Masks slot - feature buy optionsMighty Masks: Slot VerdictPlaying Mighty Masks was like meeting a person at a party and could swear you've met before but can't quite pinpoint where exactly. Actually, to be more accurate, it was like meeting someone who reminds you of a bunch of different people. A subjective reaction, of course, yet Mighty Masks awakened memories of slots as diverse as Mega Moolah, Big Bamboo, and Pragmatic Play's Aztec Gems. The good news is that since Hacksaw Gaming is one of the most creative teams out there, Mighty Masks avoids coming across simply as a patchwork quilt of prior ideas, morphing instead into its own beast altogether.It's pretty staggering, really. How many ways of incorporating a multiplier system into a game can there be? If Hacksaw Gaming is anything to go by, the answer seems to be… infinite. The studio has wowed the gambling community on countless occasions with its ingenuity, and Mighty Masks is another fine example. In another studio's hands, perhaps, the Multiplier Wheel on its own could have been potent enough, and some might have left it there. Not so Hacksaw Gaming, which seriously ups the ante by incorporating a Nudge element into the wheel. At a quick glance at the word 'Nudge', you'd be forgiven for thinking the team was trying to muscle in on Nolimit City and its nudging wizardry, but no. This is something entirely different, and while the test run came nowhere close, being able to nudge the wheel up to 50 times is a crazy thought. Shoot, even just nudging the wheel several times can be a rush.Hacksaw Gaming's math team has found a way of keeping a lid on all the nudging and multiplying, to an extent, by operating Mighty Masks within a 10,000x the bet win cap. You might have thought the max win could have been higher with so much theoretical nudging possible. Still, 10K is a solid figure and a nice old mask for Mighty Masks' clever gameplay to hide behind, and maybe even peek out of if you're lucky. In short, with the ability to stack mystery symbols and stack the win multiplier, Mighty Masks possesses the sort of one-two combo that would make a pugilist specialist like Floyd Mayweather Jr. proud.

Title: Book of Sam
review: Book of Sam: Slot OverviewELK Studios are a creative bunch, and one thing the team excels at is coming up with quirky, interesting, or amiable characters and then using them to pad out a series of games. Past examples have included the pups in Nitropolis, the bull and matador in the Toro range, and of course, Kane in his epic lineup of Gold slots. Another adorable crew is the troll family of Sam, his wife Sandra, and their daughter Maggie. This is one family that likes to have a neon-lit, fun time, as seen in games like Electric Sam and Sam on the Beach. However, so far, they haven't made quite the same level of impact as the three previously mentioned series of slots. This could be about to change with the third release – Book of Sam. Yes, it's another 'Book of' slot, yet the ELK team has successfully mixed old and new to make this one a memorable event.Right from the word go, Book of Sam gets off to a clever start. Sam and the fam haven't travelled back in time, nor have they taken a plane ride to Egypt, but Book of Sam is chock full of Egyptian imagery. It achieves this by jet-setting the family to a faux Las Vegas spot, where the game is played in a Luxor Hotel-like location surrounded by parodic things such as a 'Welcome to Sam Vegas' sign and what looks like 'Sandras Palace'. The icing on the cake is a funky as-blazes soundtrack that makes you want to bust a move, and it's easy to imagine Sam and the gang strutting into Vegas, checking in before seeing what the establishment has to offer.Book of Sam slot - base gamePlayers can join Sam's clan in trying their luck on any device in two different modes – Normal or Bonus mode. Normal mode means picking a stake of 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin and banging away on the play button. Bonus mode is enacted by clicking the X-iter button and choosing one of the five options. Both modes have a theoretical return value of 94% and are highly volatile. While packed with more features than a regular 'Book of' slot has, Book of Sam's grid setup is completely standard, consisting of 5 reels, 3 rows, and 10 paylines.Regular wins begin on the leftmost reel, paying left to right on consecutive reels. At least three are needed for the low pay 10-A card rank symbols, or at least two for the higher value cat, Maggie, Sandra, or Sam symbols. Hitting a five-of-a-kind win awards 5-9x the bet for the lows, increasing to 10 to 500 times the stake for the premium symbols. Book of Sam comes with a book symbol, and as you might have guessed, it is the wild and the scatter. In its task as wild, the book can replace any pay symbol, or if making a winning line of only wilds, it is worth the same as Sam.Book of Sam: Slot FeaturesBook of Sam slot - free spinsJoining the long ranks of 'Book of' slots with a twist or two, Book of Sam comes with free spins where chosen symbols expand, plus three varieties of Electric Treats and five options from the X-iter menu to cover.Electric TreatsElectric Treats are available in the base and bonus game. They are triggered when one of the troll family members creates a win, like so:Sam – a win on two or more Sam tiles triggers the Sam Electric Treat. Respins with a sticky book symbol are awarded. If this occurs in the bonus round, the added book symbol is an expanding wild symbol.Sandra - a win on two or more Sandra tiles triggers the Sandra Electric Treat. Respins with a multiplier is awarded.Maggie - a win on two or more Maggie tiles triggers the Maggie Electric Treat. A symbol redrop occurs after first removing any low pays, cats, or Maggie symbols. Expanding symbols are not removed.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 book scatters in normal mode awards 8 free spins with 1, 2, or 3 expanding symbols, respectively. Pay symbols are randomly chosen to be expanding symbols. After regular win evaluations, expanding symbols spread to cover all positions on their reel. You'll need at least two high-pay or three low-pay expanding symbols on individual reels to do so. Once expanded, these symbols pay all ways from any position.Should 3 or more book symbols land during free spins, extra free spins are awarded plus 1 more expanding symbol, up to 5 expanding symbols at the most. Electric Treats can be activated in free spins, too. Sandra's multiplier is persistent through free spins but is only active during an Electric Treat. It deactivates when the Treat ends but is reactivated by a new Electric Treat. If Electric Sam triggers, the book symbol is also an expanding wild during the respins.X-iterIf present within the game, players can click the X-iter button to enter feature buy mode, where they can choose one of these options.Bonus Hunt – 2x the bet for a spin with double the chance of triggering the bonus game.Electric Treat – 10x the bet for one spin with a guaranteed Electric Treat.Expanding Symbols – 50x the bet for one spin where all symbols are expanding symbols.Bonus Game – 100x the bet to buy one spin, guaranteeing entry to free spins.Super Bonus – 500x the bet for one spin guaranteeing entry to free spins where all symbols are expanding symbols.Book of Sam slot - feature buy menuBook of Sam: Slot VerdictElk Studios showed it was more than capable of delivering a creative 'Book of' alternative when the team designed Book of Toro and have followed up with one that is just as good if not better. The base game has a pacey flow; its Electric Treat modifiers unobtrusively entered the fray when they fired, though they did highlight how infrequent premium symbol wins could be. When Electric Treats did trigger, they generally went down quite positively, from piling on a few respins with a win multiplier to even activating free spins off the Electric Sam.Once into the bonus round, the Treats tended to trigger more frequently, and when they did, they had the ability to integrate with the expanding symbols feature rather well. Expanding symbols are the heart and soul of any 'Book of' slot, and here they get the chance to sparkle with up to five expanding symbols at once. Title: Jumbo Safari

Title: Raven's Eye
review: Raven's Eye (Thunderkick): ReviewThunderkick's release schedule is one of the more inconsistent. Sometimes we don't hear anything in months, and other times we get a couple of games in quick succession. Merely a month has passed since we published our review of Dragon Horn, and as it turns out, Thunderkick has decided to keep us in the fantasy world. Instead of mythical dragons, however, we head north to explore the supernatural powers of the mysterious druid and her magic raven.In this 5-reel, 30-payline slot, which you can play from 10 cents to 100€ per spin across all devices, you will come across Raven Mystery Symbols where you'll see these symbol transform into other symbols for enhanced winning combinations. In the Bonus Game, collecting Raven Orbs will turn lower value symbols into Mystery Symbols as you progress through the levels, leading to potentially bigger payouts.Set in an enchanted forest with the reels encased within an old crypt, you'll hear birds chirping and a calm, yet electrifying soundtrack playing in the background. Though largely just a wallpaper, there are some dynamic elements in the backdrop where you'll see fireflies floating around peacefully, as well as vines swaying gently in the breeze. While it all comes together nicely, it's not quite as vivid and colourful as Thunderkick slots often tend to be, even if there is some improvement in the bonus scenery where you get to perceive the game with the ultraviolet sensitivity of a bird's vision.Raven's Eye comes with a set of 10 regular symbols. These are made up of the usual A, K, Q, J and 10 royal values, followed by a representation of the 4 elements of nature, namely air, earth, fire and water. The most lucrative, however, is the druid woman who will give you 12.5 times your stake if you land 5 of a kind. There's a wild symbol included in the package as well which replaces all symbols except the scatter. The wild offers the same payouts as the druid woman.Raven's Eye (Thunderkick): FeaturesRaven's Eye free spin feature in actionIn the main game, it's mainly about the Raven Mystery Symbols feature. When the raven symbol, which appears stacked on the reels, lands on the reels, it will transform to a random symbol, including the wild. Being a medium variance slot, winning combinations of around 1-7 times your stake are quite frequent, but you need the bonus for more substantial payouts. This is triggered when you get Raven Mystery symbols on 3 or more reels.The number of free spins granted during the Bonus Game is relative to the number of Raven Mystery symbols present when triggered with the minimum being 9 spins. The objective here is to collect Raven Orbs in order to fill the symbol meters. As you fill the meter, lower-value symbols are successively transformed into mystery symbols, while also giving you 3 additional spins every time the meter is filled. If you managed to unlock all levels, you will play your remaining spins with only high paying symbols and mystery symbols on the reels. This should, in theory, significantly increase your odds of landing the top payout of 375 times your stake per single spin.Raven's Eye (Thunderkick): VerdictGenerally speaking, we have a soft spot for Thunderkick. When it comes to visuals, innovation and maths, the studio usually maintains a high level of quality, delivering intense and entertaining slots. Raven's Eye, however, feels like a rushed release that fails to showcase the potential of Thunderkick's creative team. The game feels basic, both visually and in gameplay, and the payouts are, frankly speaking, dreadful.Moreover, the game seems to have been put together with bits and pieces from other Thunderkick slots. For example, even if there's a bit of a twist to the mystery symbol feature in Raven's Eye, it's something we've already seen come to better use in other Thunderkick slots such as Flame Busters and, just recently, Dragon Horn. We can also see elements of Pink Elephants in the way the level-up bonus game has been designed. It's not necessarily a deal-breaker, but experienced players might feel it's getting a bit old.If you want to feel the thrill of knowing you could land a win to potentially fund a vacation for two on a luxury resort in the Bahamas, this is definitely not your slot. If, on the other hand, you're just looking for something to unwind your mind and to keep you entertained for a while, Raven's Eye might very well satisfy your needs.

Title: Black Bull
review: Black Bull: Slot OverviewOf all the rodeo sports participated in today, bull riding has to be one of the more spectacular. Not many people would want to be in the same pen as one of those nostril-snorting monsters, but brave riders strap themselves on and attempt to last at least 8 seconds without being bucked off. Some of those beasts can buck alright, and it takes a certain kind of person to even think about wanting to ride one. It also takes a certain person to want to fire up Black Bull, an online slot from software developer Pragmatic Play. This is an American nature slot full of wild animals, dreamy landscapes, and a money symbol collection feature.If you've ever played Pragmatic Play's slot Treasure Wild, then you'll have a good handle on the features and mechanics on offer in Black Bull since they are more or less the same. On the theme side of things, Black Bull has a Wild West, US Prairie thing going on. So, if you are accustomed to a game like Wolf Gold, then Black Bull's set-up should feel familiar. A 5-reel, 4-row, 20 payline game grid has been placed out in a prairie/desert destination, where birds caw and the sky blazes as the sun sets (or rises). It's all pretty mainstream stuff, and the most rootin'-tootin' thing about Black Bull is its enjoyably energetic rock-infused soundtrack.Black Bull slot - base gameRiding a bucking bull has got to be something of a volatile experience, and so is Black Bull, Pragmatic Play slapping on a 4 out 5 rating in terms of volatility. The RTP is variable, ranging from a maximum default value of 96.51% moving down to a minimum of 94.24%, market dependent. Stakes of 20 p/c to $/€100 can be selected, and players can cling to the virtual bull on any device they prefer.Collecting money symbols is one of Black Bull's highlights, made more so in free spins due to a progressive element. Until then, the other way of extracting coins is to hit line wins, made up of three to five matching symbols. All pay symbols pay in adjacent reels, left to right, starting from the leftmost reel. Jack to Ace card royals are up first, worth 2x the bet when a five-of-a-kind win lands. These symbols are followed by lizards, a horned creature, an eagle, a wolf, and a black bull as the most valuable of the lot. Hitting a five of a kind premium win is worth a payout of 4-25 times the stake.Black Bull: Slot FeaturesBlack Bull slot - free spinsTwo other key symbols in Black Bull are the wild and the money symbol. When money symbols land, they display a random value of 0.5 to 50 times the total bet. Money symbol values get collected when wild symbols also land. Every money symbol value is collected by each wild symbol in view. Before free spins begin, all values from the triggering money symbols are collected and stored as the starting value for the bonus round's progressive feature.During the round, when money symbols land, they add their value to the collected amount, and when wilds hit, each one awards the current collected value. In addition, for every 6 money symbols that land during the bonus round, +2 free spins are awarded.If you'd prefer not to wait for 6+ money symbols to land on their own, and the opportunity is there, players can elect to buy free spins for the cost of 75 times the stake. The RTP when buying free spins increases to 96.69%.Black Bull: Slot VerdictTaken holistically, Black Bull is a step up from Treasure Wild, which was woefully underwhelming in many regards. Black Bull has a lot more life to it, and not just because of its high-paying animal symbols. The theme, if cliched, has been handled well, which is to be expected, really, given Pragmatic Play's expertise in designing North American outdoor slots. Visually it ticks the right box, but it's the music that really brought the game to life. Close your eyes, and you can literally imagine steaks sizzling on a BBQ, a neighbour tossing out cans of root beer from an ice box, fireworks exploding in the distance, while Old Glory flutters in a warm July breeze. Yeah, it sounds like the US of A.Mute the game, and Black Bull starts to wilt as its gameplay just isn't all that strong. The base game follows a standard money symbol collection formula, but things can heat up in free spins thanks to the progressive aspect. It could be interesting having a decent chunk of change sitting in the pot, getting doled out whenever a wild symbol hits. Like the previous slot, Treasure Wild, Black Bull has the same win cap of 4,500x the bet. However, Black Bull does have a much more favourable max win probability, though, of 1 in 1,140,698.Compared to much of the competition, those aren't bad odds, all things considered. Black Bull's other stats, such as RTP, are solid as well. When factoring in the head-bobbing tunes and the comforting visuals, there should be a certain level of entertainment value for the right person here. Pragmatic Play has put the features to better use this time around, and Black Bull might appeal to players keen on a Big Bass Bonanza alternative or have had it up to here with fish.

Title: Leprechaun's Magic
review: Leprechaun’s Magic Slot: OverviewRoll up leprechaun fans for another dose of shamrocks and Guinness courtesy of developer Max Win Gaming, a rather low-key developer with just a couple of releases since their inception in 2015. The last one was a one-line fruit slot, so the team clearly like to take a simplistic approach to gaming. Their latest, Leprechaun’s Magic, is yet another Irish themed slot powered by Red Tiger’s platform. It’s a simple game with an old school feel where the magic has been heavily inspired by older classic slots. There has been a slight addition to the central feature, so it’s not a straight copy; a dose of originality has been injected, however small.The funny thing about the Irish/leprechaun theme is that developers are never subtle when using it. They all seem to believe that you need to feel like you’ve knocked over a shelf in a Dublin tourist shop and been showered in green and gold trinkets. Leprechaun’s Magic manages all of that, and fans of the theme will be happy knowing that the game is packing in the Irish clichés department. Interestingly, Ra fans might also be intrigued by what else Leprechaun’s Magic is packing which we will cover in the features.There are no surprises when it comes to the location of where the action takes place. Set deep in the Irish countryside, in an old forest where the grass is lush and overgrown, clovers grow in abundance, and a couple of hanging lanterns provides ambient lighting. The scenery is pleasant, and exactly what we have come to expect from these sorts of games. On the technical side of things, the game runs on a 5-reel, 3-row, 10-payline layout. Paylines light up on wins in a way that nods respectfully to its slot forbears, especially with expanding symbols. Volatility has come out at a raging 5/5 on Red Tiger’s meter and is matched by a decent default RTP rating of 95.95%.A rundown of the paytable is a mandatory step in any review, but you will probably already know what is coming up. Max Win has included 9 base game pay symbols - 5 low and 4 high. Low pays are 10-A royals that have been decorated with a cute wee Celtic pattern carved into them. The high pays start with a pipe, a top hat, and a horseshoe. The table wouldn’t be complete without a leprechaun somewhere. Here he takes pride of place as the game’s highest paying symbol worth a hefty 500 times the stake for five of a kind. All hackneyed symbols to be sure, but what is a little irregular is the exclusion of a wild symbol. Max Win has filled that gap by adding a couple of features that will feel very familiar to a lot of players.Leprechaun’s Magic Slot: FeaturesFree spins round in actionExpanding Symbols is the most common feature and appears in both the base and bonus game. The first thing to be aware of is that above the reels is a bar that displays all of the game’s pay symbols. When a win occurs, the winning symbol is lit up on the bar and turned into a Golden Symbol. On the very next spin, if 3 or more Golden Symbols land they expand to cover their respective reel.What’s good, and 'Ra-like', is that they create winning lines no matter which reels they are on. For example, if Golden Symbols cover reels 1, 2, and 5, that’s good enough for a bunch of three of a kind wins. The win lines light up when this happens and wins are paid. During base game spins, Golden Symbols last for one spin and return to normal once concluded.Golden Symbols get a significant expansion during the Magic Spins Free Spins feature. To gain entry, you need the pot of gold scatter symbols to land. They can land anywhere, and at least 3 in view triggers a spin on the Magic Wheel. The Wheel is split into segments with different values with a chance to score up to 16 free spins. However, if 4 or 5 scatters triggered the round, then they add an extra 4 or 8 free spins to the Magic Wheel’s result. The free spins round is similar to the base game, except that when winning symbols are turned into Golden Symbols, they stay that way for the full duration of the feature.Leprechaun’s Magic Slot: VerdictEndless reams of Irish themed slots roll off the production line so let’s do our best to be objective here. It would be easy, and somewhat enjoyable, to hack Leprechaun’s Magic into tiny pieces, and then hack each of those tiny pieces into more tiny pieces, but it’s not so bad. The lack of originality in both theme and features doesn’t exactly garner it points, but the true test comes with gameplay and rewards which can be quite enjoyable at times.Fair dues, expanding symbols that pay anywhere are so last decade - and beyond, but Max Win Gaming has conjured up the obligatory twist to freshen up the old device. The twist is a small one, but quite nifty when it works your way, and that is the inclusion of expanding Golden Symbols during the base game. It’s a nice touch and improves the game’s appeal.The real magic is in its potential though. Wins of 5,000 times the stake might not create headlines, but they do raise an eyebrow when you realise that figure is technically possible on one spin with a grid of the leprechaun symbols. Sure, that is bound to be a very rare occurrence, but the possibility increases the appeal all the same.So yes, Leprechaun’s Magic is one more nauseatingly generic leprechaun slot with all the clichés and a borrowed feature. But, it might still appeal to fans of the genre, and possibly other players interested in experiencing Ra dynamics in a different setting.

Title: Release the Kraken Megaways

Title: Play With the Devil

During free spins, the Devil Wild symbol locks in place in the middle position and throws fireballs at the chests on each spin for the chance to win +6 free spins if 1 chest activates or +12 free spins if both chests activate.Feature BuyFrom the feature buy, players can guarantee to land the Devil Wild and at least one Devil Coin for 6x the bet or a free spins trigger for 66x the bet. The RTP for the feature buy is 95.7%.Play With the Devil slot - free spinsPlay With the Devil: Slot VerdictIt seems as though the hellishly styled slots category is heating up, pun intended. Title: Opal Fruits

The end product is a simple, fast-paced, explosive and mindless slot that, along with staggering potential and with a large dose of nostalgia thrown in, sends a strong signal to remind people of who the true alphas of innovative game design are. As such, it is a much-needed break from the more feature-heavy offerings that we've been fed as of late while at the same time delivering adrenaline-fueled action in its purest form.If you're a fan of Big Time Gaming, but looking for games making use of the Megaways engine we suggest you have a look at Royal Mint Megaways, Kingmaker Megaways or Monopoly Megaways.

Title: Mystic Orbs
review: Mystic Orbs: Slot OverviewSwedish based provider ELK Studios has a few Asian themed slots in the catalogue, but given their propensity to recreate far-flung destinations, you might have thought they had more under their belt. In it, a dragon called Ying Longs guards the entrance to Yu the Great's treasure chamber. It's the player's task to use the tools at their disposal, of which there are many, to bypass the drake and get to the riches inside.Okay, so that's the story, let's get to dissecting the game. It starts with a 5-reel, 5-row grid using dropping symbols and cluster pays wins. The game panel has been jammed onto a rock wall making it one of the least exciting games visually speaking we've seen from ELK in a while. Strangely, it doesn't get much prettier when the bonus game triggers. But hey, at least we're not in one of those red, green, and gold souvenir shops developers often slip into when designing one of these games. There are no major letdowns about the soundtrack, which is another bumping ELK number, mixing traditional Asian with up-tempo modern twists, and plenty of irreverent sampling thrown in for good measure.Getting all exotic is possible no matter what device you favour by selecting an appropriate stake of 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin. Hit the play button to drop 25 symbols into the active game area, scoring a win when at least 5 matching symbols connect vertically or horizontally. Winning clusters are blasted from the grid, triggering an Avalanche where the gaps are filled with existing symbols. A medium-high volatile Asian sojourn, Mystic Orbs generates a theoretical return of 95%, ELK's typical go-to figure.Clusters may be formed of three lower value Asian icons, four animal looking symbols, and a golden wise man looking gentleman as the most valuable. As to pays, clusters max out at 18+, varying in worth from 20x the bet up to 400x the bet for the golden guy. Wild symbols appear anywhere, substituting all symbols except Orbs. If by some chance clusters hit consisting only of wilds, they payout like the highest valued symbol.Mystic Orbs: Slot FeaturesThe only other symbols appearing on the main grid area are the Orbs which land in regular form or charged. Orbs are wild, and if they do not contribute to a win, they explode and remove adjacent symbols. The other important element of Mystic Orbs is the 5-position feature row sitting above the main reels, randomly displaying feature symbols. If Orbs land in a reel beneath a symbol on the feature row, the corresponding feature is awarded. If Orbs land in a charged state, they activate all of the features currently displayed on the feature row. These could be:Bonus – awards entry to the bonus game.Extra life – awards an extra symbol drop when no further winning clusters appear.Orb payout – pays out a multiple of the bet. The value is increased if the win multiplier is active.Multiplier – adds its value to the total win multiplier.Upgrade – upgrades all instances of one symbol type to a higher value type or wilds for up to 3 Avalanches.Orb siege – one of the Orb's adjacent symbols is chosen to surround it. This could be above, below, and/or to its sides.Bonus GameThe bonus game can be bought or triggered by the Bonus symbol on the feature reel or by collecting 5 Orbs in a base game spin. The reward for doing so is 5 free drops where Orbs continue to be collected. For every 5 Orbs collected in the bonus round, additional free spins are awarded. During the bonus game, the win multiplier is persistent, so it does not reset between free spins.X-iterPlayers can attack Mystic Orbs in two modes – normal mode or X-iter mode. In X-iter mode, there are five options:Feature – 5x the bet for one drop with a guaranteed Orb and at least one activated feature.Persistent Multiplier – 25x the bet for 3 drops with a persistent multiplier.Charged Orbs – 50x the bet for one drop with all Orbs in a charged state.Bonus – 100x the bet for guaranteed entry to the free spins bonus round.Super Bonus – 500x the bet for guaranteed entry to free spins where all Orbs are charged.Mystic Orbs - Xiter mode bonus buy optionsMystic Orbs: Slot VerdictMystic Orbs is another highly playable ELK production that may take a little longer for the quality to become apparent, maybe not. A possible reason is the visuals don't instantly massage your eyeballs the way we are accustomed to experiencing from the studio. The pleasantly low-key rock wall background isn't the explosion of colour ELK slots tend to be. No matter, hit spin, and dancing across the reels is an intricately designed game which gets better the more you understand how the individual parts function and how they interact with each other.Mystic Orbs is happy enough firing off the odd win here and there, but the real magic happens when Orbs trigger features from the feature reel, linking them together and entwining them with the win multiplier. ELK are masters of creating slots that come with a bunch of separate parts, which have the ability to weave together, creating something special. As always, this is not a common event as such, yet real fun when it does occur. Also, as always, the X-iter is a major temptation for skipping straight to the better bets, where you are more likely to get the consecutive win, features freight train rolling. The Super Bonus did not disappoint and could be a real blast when we were testing Mystic Orbs. You pay the price to have every cylinder firing, though, and the RTP is the same no matter what mode you choose to play in. What also stays the same is potential, maxing out at 10,000x the bet.Whether Asian slots are your jam or not is somewhat irrelevant. Mystic Orb feels like it would be a fit for any player who goes for ELK's brand of clever gameplay, mixing in features that pop when they get their weave on, while audio-visuals treat the senses. Though in a twist, Mystic Orbs' visuals are a tad less striking than they usually are.

Title: Hustling
review: Hustling: Slot OverviewArtists have flung enough accusations on rap albums to suggest imitation might be just as rife in the hip-hop world as it is in the slots industry. In the case of Hustling, from software provider Red Tiger, if you've been following gaming trends this year, you'll quickly spot where any potential inspiration might have come from. Hustling is a slot built around a pay both ways game system that features a West Coast rapper on one side of the grid facing off an East Coast artiste on the other.Okay, it's all a bit East Coast vs West Coast, and the two sides of the US are used to colour each half of Hustling's background. On the left, we get a palm treed, sunset drenched view of LA, while the graffiti adorned, fire escape covered buildings of New York sit on the right. Not exactly original, but Red Tiger's skilful graphics team has done a good job of the visuals regardless – as has the sound team. However, neither has the same zest or wealth of little touches that were showcased by the playful individuality Nolimit City achieved in their highly acclaimed creation East Coast vs West Coast. Still, Hustling does enough to encourage your finger to click play and see what bops along next.Being a game aimed at general consumption, Hustling is powered by a high volatile math model, producing a default theoretical return value of 95.69%. Offering stakes between c/p 0.20  and €/$20 per spin, the action takes place on a 5-reel, 3-row game grid, paying out wins when three or more matching symbols land left to right or right to left, starting from reel 1 or 5. In total, 10 pay ways line the grid, effectively doubling due to the pay both ways system.Moving onto pay symbols, Hustling makes do with five low pay graffiti styled card royals 10-A, which are worth payouts of 0.4 to 1.2x the bet for a five of a kind win. Premium symbols on the upper side of the table consist of hats, spray cans, a ghetto blaster, some shoes, and a gold dollar sign necklace. Landing a five of a kind premium win will get you a payout of 3 to 20 times your stake.Hustling: Slot FeaturesSuper wild symbols play several critical roles in Hustling, replacing regular pay symbols and triggering free spins. Both appear fully stacked, covering all positions on their respective reels. The West Wild appears only on the leftmost reel, while the East Wild appears only on the rightmost. When a Super Wild lands it locks for one spin.Free SpinsWhen Super Wilds land on both reels simultaneously, 10 free spins are awarded. Before they start, players pick either the West Wild or the East Wild to battle it off. Both wilds remain locked in place for the duration of the bonus round and start with a win multiplier of x1. When a Super Wild participates in a win, its multiplier increases by +1.When free spins run to zero, if the chosen Super Wild has a higher multiplier than the non-chosen Super Wild, +10 additional free spins are awarded. If the two multipliers are the same, +1 extra spin is awarded until one of the Super Wilds has the highest multiplier. If this is the chosen wild, +10 extra spins are awarded. If the chosen Super Wild has a lower multiplier, the round ends. The final piece of small print is when both wilds participate in a line win; their multipliers are multiplied by each other before being applied. Multipliers reset when free spins end.Hustling: Slot VerdictIt's virtually impossible not to compare Hustling with East Coast vs West Coast, yet the two games provide different outlets for players to get all 'gangster.' Both have a great hip-hop, sneakers-and spray-paint look to them, though ECvsWC possesses a bolder more original style, along with a significantly better soundtrack. Hustling is also less volatile but limited as to how far it can go than ECvsWC, possibly making it a better option for players who don't want to go quite so large.As well as the 'dope' looks, which share commonalities with Play'n GO's Nyjah Huston, the gameplay is pretty 'tight' as well. Sorry for the cliches, but it's tough not to adopt an attitude after playing Hustling for a while. The pay both ways system represents the East Coast/West Coast rivalry in a clever manner, leading to the equally clever rap battle happening in free spins. Naturally, your chosen guy doesn't always win, yet there are multipliers on both sides of the grid to enjoy while the two artists bob away at each other. Having locked multiplier wilds led to the most exciting moments during testing – when five if a kind wins hit to attract both multipliers.The low number of pay lines and symbol values prevent Hustling from going nuclear the way all those ways and modifiers can in East Coast vs West Coast. There are no infectious xWays or Drive-By Respins here, for example, making it come across as a slightly generic knockoff when directly compared. Another possible competitor is Relax Gaming's Top Dawg$, a game that also has a lower number of paylines but boasts sticky multipliers in free spins that can absolutely moon when the game is flowing. Hustling just doesn't pack anywhere near as much heat, and at the end of the day, should the two rappers battle each other to a standstill, the most winnable is a more modest 3,151x the bet.Put it this way, if Hustling stopped at a red light blasting crunk and East Coast vs West Coast pulled up alongside, you can imagine it turning the volume down and acting all nonchalant. However, once the light turned green, the volume would be back up as the game went on its way. What we are trying to say with this traffic light metaphor is that Hustling might not be as brutal or rewarding as the slot it appears to be inspired by, but it's still a fun hip-hop themed game for those who don't need the roughest rider to get where they are going.

Title: Dragon Born Megaways

Title: Hong Bao

The number of initial free spins depends on the selected Hyper Bet level accordingly:Bet Level 1: 5 initial spins with a multiplier wild value of 1X.Bet Level 2: 7 initial spins with a multiplier wild value of 2X.Bet Level 3: 8 initial spins with a multiplier wild value of 3X.Bet Level 4: 9 initial spins with a multiplier wild value of 5X (not available in the bonus buy option).The multiplier wilds drop randomly on reels 1, 3 and 5 and lock in position for all remaining spins. Title: Tropical Tiki
review: Tropical Tiki: Slot OverviewSet sail with software provider Pragmatic Play to the sunny Pacific Islands for a Polynesian-themed slot called Tropical Tiki. When the win is no longer improved by the symbol drop or the grid is full, an evaluation takes place. No doubt, due to the win system, Tropical Tiki does not have wild symbols.Tropical Tiki: Slot FeaturesTropical Tiki slot - free spinsDuring the Winning Symbol Tumble mechanic explained above, scatter symbols also remain on the screen when non-winning symbols are removed, and new ones drop in. Hitting at least 4 scatters on reels 2, 3, 4, or 5, triggers the bonus round where players get 8 free spins. Depending on how many scatters trigger the feature, you also get a payout – 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 30x, or 35x the bet for having 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, or 10 scatters in view, respectively.For free spins, the grid expands to a 6-reel, 5-row size. If the Buy Free Spins button is present in your jurisdiction, clicking this gives you the chance to purchase the bonus round for 100x the bet. The number of triggering scatters is always 4, and the triggering spin will not produce any tumbles. Buying free spins lowers RTP by around 0.20%, which players should be aware of.Tropical Tiki slot - bonus buy optionsTropical Tiki: Slot VerdictTropical Tiki combines a couple of popular tropes to create a cheerful slot which may charm players looking for a Pacific Island getaway via the reels. It might be okay for a few laughs, but it wasn't a game that led to a major destination. Paradoxical, perhaps, given that the game is located in such an exotic part of the world. If you need a little pick me up, then Tropical Tiki exudes waves of positivity through its party-time tunes, colourful graphics, and last but not least, its charming tiki characters.After the pick-me-up glow fades, however, what's left over? A pretty average game, really. The Winning Symbol Tumble is a mechanic that arises from the depths every so often, and there's not a whole lot to say about Tropical Tiki's use of it. It's one of those features you sort of go for, or you don't. Players who are partial might be intrigued by the idea of seeing it used in conjunction with ways rather than winlines as it often is paired with. On the bright side, a lot of ways are added in free spins, which perks things up a bit, yet despite what might have been possible with the 6,000+ ways, Tropical Tiki is limited by a win cap of 3,000x the bet. Perhaps if Pragmatic Play had been a bit more freewheeling with the max win, Tropical Tiki might have appealed more. Perhaps.To wrap up, if the Winning Symbol Tumble system isn't your particular cup of tea, then probably just forget about playing Tropical Tiki, as that's pretty much all there is to it. Sure, an expansive element is introduced in free spins, but the repetition of its one-trick wore thin pretty soon, and even the overall affable attitude might not be enough to prevent drifting off to daydream about a different getaway spot.

Title: Money Mouse
