On the other hand, you are much more likely to hit a full screen of inferno jokers here than you are landing a full screen of explorer symbols in Book of Dead.Although we're not huge fans of fruit slots ourselves, they seem to be in high demand - King Spin Deluxe, Burn 'Em Up, Win Win, and Mega Rise are just a few of such slots we've reviewed in the past month. We have to say though; Inferno Joker is one of the better ones. It's fast-paced, smooth to play, looks great, and the potential is better than in most fruit slots. Like most Play'n GO slots as of recent, Inferno Joker is going to be well received, we're sure.

Title: Treasures of Kilauea
review: Treasures of Kilauea: Slot OverviewVolcanic eruptions are one of the most awe-inspiring events in the natural world. They give us a glimpse of the titanic forces bubbling away beneath our feet, capable of great acts of destruction but also of creation. Take the Hawaiian islands, for instance, which were formed by volcanic activity that began over 70 million years ago. At the moment, there are 6 active volcanoes in Hawaii, one of them being Kilauea, the star of Treasures of Kilauea, an online slot from Microgaming associate PearFiction Studios.In Treasures of Kilauea, PearFiction has brought their volcano to life, where it sits on the side of the screen, blinking, chuckling, snoring, bubbling, or coughing, and at regular intervals launching wild symbols onto the game grid. Volcanoes might be pretty scary for some people, so PearFiction has made theirs as amusing as possible to take any potential edge off. The game is not as ominous as Play'n GO's Gold Volcano, for example, since PearFiction has used a light, pacey, brightly coloured approach instead.When making a volcano-themed slot, there's a growing tradition of tinkering with the reel setup to form vaguely volcanic shapes. Gold Volcano had extra rows, Push Gaming's Mount Magmas had it in the bonus game, and now Treasures of Kilauea, to a lesser degree. In Treasures of Kilauea, the grid comprises 5 reels holding four symbols each, plus a 3-symbol horizontal reel on top, giving the game a mini-Megaways look. Bubbling away in the back, the math model is a highly volatile one with four RTP settings, maxing out at 96.35%, before going as low as 86.79%. It can be played on any device, where players may select bets of 10 p/c to $/€50 per spin.While it looks mini-Megaways-ish, Treasures of Kilauea possesses a fraction of the number of winning ways. Making their way across the grid are 40 fixed paylines, blasting out coins when three or more identical symbols land from the leftmost side. Symbol values, well, they're not great, starting with the 0.5-0.6x the bet wins awarded when landing five of the 10-A low symbols. Highs aren't much better, where landing five of the premium mask symbols is worth a payout of 0.9-1.2x the bet. There are wilds and multipliers, but line wins can only do so much in Treasures of Kilauea.Treasures of Kilauea: Slot FeaturesTo reflect the fact Kilauea is one of the most active volcanoes in the world, Treasures of Kilauea uses a system whereby frames are collected and filled with wilds every ten spins. In addition, every 50 spins, the volcano adds even more wilds to the reels. On top of these extras are a couple of less regular features – free spins with added wilds and five jackpots.Lava Spins and Eruption SpinsWhen Volcano Symbols land, they place a frame around the position they were in. Then, on the 10th spin, the symbols in each framed position are transformed into wild symbols. After any win evaluation, these Lava Frames are cleared. Eruption Spins occur every 50 spins. During an Eruption Spin, the Lava Frames turn symbols wild as normal, plus additional wilds are randomly awarded. If a wild lands on another wild, it becomes an x2 wild. Two counters above the reels keep track of how many spins are left before the next Lava Spin or Eruption Spin occurs. Lava Frames and spin counters are saved at each bet level.Free SpinsFree Spins symbols appear in the base and bonus game. Landing at least three of them in the base game triggers the free spins feature where players pick one of these choices:Three scatters – 15 free spins with 5 wilds, 10 free spins with 7 wilds, or 5 free spins with 10 wilds.Four scatters – 30 free spins with 5 wilds, 20 free spins with 7 wilds, or 10 free spins with 10 wilds.Five scatters – 45 free spins with 5 wilds, 30 free spins with 7 wilds, or 15 free spins with 10 wilds.During free spins, wilds are added to random positions on the game board. Retriggers award the corresponding number of free spins initially chosen.JackpotsThe centre position of the top reel has a golden frame around it. Landing an Idol symbol in the frame triggers the Jackpot Wheel, which spins to award 1 of 5 jackpots. These are the Micro, Mini, Minor, Major, and Mega, worth 18x, 30x, 100x, 500x, and 5,000x the bet, respectively.Treasures of Kilauea: Slot VerdictFor the right player, it's not hard to visualise Treasures of Kilauea being just the right slot. It's a game full of features and slot devices that are common, but PearFiction has packaged them in a way that manages to be quite fun. The ten-spin wild cycle system reappears now and then, from games as diverse as IGT's Scarab to Kalamba Game's Caribbean Anne (amongst others). In Treasures of Kilauea, it's back, and has been bolstered by a new 50 spin mechanic as well. When combined, the two accumulation features did a remarkable job of keeping the balance more or less hovering around baseline most of the time. Of course, other results may be wildly different to how they turned out for us during the review.The way PearFiction appears to have achieved a form of balance is by counteracting the added wilds with meagre pay symbol values. This wouldn't be such an issue in a game with a shedload of ways. However, in Treasures of Kilauea, with just 40 paylines, a full screen of the most valuable symbol is worth 48x the bet. Okay, maybe the Eruption Spin spews forth a bunch of x2 Wilds, yet even then, the payout is unlikely to be a major windfall.And so, making major gains is tough without triggering the Jackpot feature. This proved to be rather tricky to accomplish. In free spins, the Idol symbol did tease a lot more than in the base game, so presumably, the bonus round offers better chances of leading to a jackpot. As such, it might be optimal to pick the option with the highest number of free spins when the bonus round triggers? You get fewer wilds, but line wins are pretty pitiful anyway, whereas having more free spins potentially provides more chances to land an Idol. This is all theoretical, by the way, with no official numbers adding weight to the hypothesis.In many ways, Treasures of Kilauea is classic PearFiction. Its bright, colourful, packs mainly standard extras and relies on a jackpot system to reach its full potential. So, if a jackpot slot that keeps you busy in the base game with regular, albeit limited, features in a playful environment sounds neat, Treasures of Kilauea might be a match.

Title: Peter Hunter
review: Peter Hunter: Slot OverviewGrab the old rifle, load up some bullets and come shoot a few critters with software provider Peter & Sons in the online slot Peter Hunter. Being a Peter & Sons slot, this means it is cartoon critters getting whacked rather than spilling the blood of unsuspecting beasts foraging in a forest. Hunting isn't something you see much in a slot, and considering Peter & Sons' reputation for original presentation, it's with suspenseful anticipation we mosey on into nature and prepare to blast some of it.First, a brief conspiracy theory. Due to the name of the company, one wonders if perhaps this game tells the story of someone at Peter & Sons doing a spot of virtual hunting. Maybe not, though, since the studio is based in Armenia, and Peter Hunter, as the game info states, is held in the wild, sprawling lands of Siberia. Although, maybe they're on holiday? Anyway, whatever the case, Siberia it is, and the game presents this part of the planet as a highly wooded area chock full of wild animals just waiting to be hunted. It's a huge plot of land, too. In real life, that is. At 12.8 million square km, according to Wikipedia, Siberia is about 24 times the size of metropolitan France and about 54 times the size of the UK, taking up around 9% of the land on Earth. You can imagine then there'd be a lot of stuff in there to hunt, and in this game, a hunter literally hangs out next to the grid targeting symbols and letting them have it with his rifle.Peter Hunter slot - base gameThe grid in question has 5-reels, 3-rows, and is in possession of 20 paylines. Peter Hunter describes itself as a medium/high volatile slot producing an RTP of 96.3% (three lower levels are available, too). To score a normal line win, you'll need to land at least 3 matching symbols across a payline on adjacent reels beginning from the leftmost side of the grid.Heading deeper into the paytable, we come across Peter Hunter's pay symbols. These include 10-A card ranks as the low pays, and a duck, fox, moose, and bear as the high pays. When winning lines made up of 5 matching symbols land, the rewards are 4 to 6 times the bet for the low pays and 10 to 30 times the bet for the high pays. Wilds assist players by substituting for all regular pay symbols. Wilds are present on all reels and have the same value as the bear if making wins of themselves.Peter Hunter: Slot FeaturesPeter Hunter slot - free spinsPeter Hunter uses a progressive Cash Collect feature that can lead to free spins when it triggers a certain number of times. Alternatively, players may buy free spins from the feature buy.Cash CollectIn the base game, when the scatter symbol lands, high-pay symbols become Cash symbols. Cash symbols move towards the scatter, leaving behind a bet multiplier value on each position they pass through. When Cash symbols reach the scatter, the hunter shoots them, and the values are collected.Free SpinsEach time the scatter lands in the base game, it is collected on a meter above the reels. When 7 scatters have been collected, 3 free spins are awarded. Free spins are played on a 5x5 gaming panel, and extra free spins are awarded when scatter symbols land on the reels. On each spin, 1 scatter and random high-pay symbols land. Each high pay symbol travels to the scatter leaving behind a trail of bet multipliers. When the hunter shoots – if a travelling high pay symbol is hit, its value is multiplied by the hunter's multiplier; if the hunter misses, the symbol randomly changes its position. Whether hit or not, Cash symbols always make it to the scatter where their trail of values is awarded. The hunter multiplier increases when certain numbers of Cash symbols have been shot.Buy Free SpinsPlayers are able to buy the free spins round for the cost of 80 times the bet. Be aware that when buying the bonus, you get 3 free spins rather than 5 when triggering it naturally.Peter Hunter slot - free spinsPeter Hunter: Slot VerdictIn the past, like a while back, Peter & Sons' slots sparkled with graphical singularity but sometimes were not quite as dazzling in terms of creative gameplay. Those days are long gone, and while Peter & Sons' slots continue to stick out like a sore thumb graphically (in a good way), the studio has picked up its feature game, too, so both parts of the puzzle tend to go hand in hand. Peter Hunter delivers sonically, too, making it an all-around interesting package to try out.One of the main standouts is the unique hunter blasting Cash symbols feature. This you can sample in the base game as well as in free spins. Less potent in the main game, naturally, since the Hunter Multiplier is not present and Cash symbols do not get shot at while travelling. The core idea, Cash symbols trotting to a scatter leaving behind bet multiplier values which are awarded when they reach it, might sound simple on paper, but when seen in action in a hunting game, where a chap armed with a rifle blasts critters, it's quite amusing to behold. Free spins were even more amusing, and not just because of the hunter multiplier. Sometimes Cash money symbols would bob and weave, duck and dive all over the place, hopping from one position to another as the hunter shoots but misses them as they travel towards the scatter. If it almost feels cruel in some ways, it might pay to keep telling yourself Peter Hunter is a game, and not real life, like the wacky interplay between Bugs Bunny and Elmer Fudd.It's kind of hard to envisage how this would play out, perhaps, yet Peter Hunter's ultimate trophy is a max win of 10,000x the bet. One can only imagine the hail of bullets required to hit a target like that. However, even if big game hunters don't manage to take home the main prize, Peter Hunter is a clever hunting slot regardless, giving players something that they probably haven't seen before.

Title: Lucky Ryan Gigablox
review: Lucky Ryan Gigablox: Slot OverviewA couple of months before this review, developer Yggdrasil's leprechaun pal Ryan was hiding out in a bar, blasting zombies in Lucky Apocalypse, a much darker take on leprechaun slots than we're used to seeing. Title: Bananaz 10K Ways

Title: All Star Knockout
review: All Star Knockout (Northern Lights Gaming): OverviewThe last time we crossed paths with Northern Lights Gaming was via the slot Rocky’s Gold. There were a number of fun mining themed slots in 2019; sadly, said slot was not one of them. This time around the Swedish/Mancunian developer has ditched the pickaxes in favour of some good old fashioned retro slots action. All Star Knockout is a new fruit-themed slot from Northern Lights Gaming produced and developed in collaboration with the Yggdrasil Masters Program. The name is no random pick out of a hat – it describes what the game is all about. That means collecting stars to trigger bonus features. You don’t need us to tell you that fruit slots are a dime a dozen, but hopefully, All Star Knockout is a tad more fun to play than Rocky’s Gold was. Ugh.Visually, All Star Knockout is basic and in keeping with the theme, but the animations have a decent flow to them. Behind the reels is a simple blue background with a white, explosion type effect. The soundtrack sticks with tradition, and we get a jazzy, 70s inspired, adult movie styled track that is popular with this type of slot. So far the only surprise is the unusual boxes of symbols and stars next to the reels. This is the collection area called the Award Board and plays a key role in the features which we will cover shortly.Northern Lights has expanded the traditional 3x3 format by incorporating 5 reels and 4 rows on which you need to land combos of 3 or more of a kind on any of the 20 fixed paylines. The 8 regular pay symbols that populate the game are classic slot symbols all the way - we get lemons, plums, oranges, cherries, a blue 7, a white 7, and a red 7. The one exception is the game’s logo which is the most lucrative symbol at 5 times the stake for a line of  five. To keep things simpler, we have to assume, Northern Lights has chosen to exclude wilds from the game.The user interface sticks with the retro vibe and bets are controlled by clicking the +/- buttons. There is a large range of betting options available which start at 20 p/c per spin and go up to $/€400. Behind the scenes, the game’s math model throws up an RTP rating of 96.09%. That’s fine, but the low volatility of the math model may be somewhat of a bummer if you're a hardcore gamer despite having quite a decent potential on board. It does mean that wins come around fairly often, however, as do the features, which is a little surprising due to the way they work.All Star Knockout (Northern Lights Gaming): FeaturesBonus featureThere are two main features to cover here – the Random Bonus, and the All Star Knockout Bonus. After a losing spin, the game can activate the Random Bonus which awards up to 3 win spins. Win spins are free spins that are guaranteed to pay something. They will literally keep spinning again and again until a combination lands.As the name suggests, the aim of the game is to use stars to knock out symbols. Whenever a star symbol lands, it's collected and placed randomly next to one of the pay symbols in the Award Board. When a symbol has collected 5 stars next to it, then the All Star Knockout Bonus is triggered and 5 free spins are awarded. Free spins have a multiplier ranging from x2, x3, x4, or x5 applied to every win during the round. This multiplier is randomly selected.Stars continue to show up on the reels during free spins. It's possible to collect five stars next to another symbol which adds 2 more free spins to the tally. Where it gets interesting, is that each time a symbol collects five stars, it is completely removed from the reels. This can work to your advantage if lower value symbols are removed, but it can kind of go against you if the higher value symbols are removed.One final point about the collection system. If you change bet levels mid-way through a session, then the star collections start from scratch. Your progress is saved though, so if you return to the previous bet level then you continue the game where it was left off. Also, the game offers players the chance to short cut to the free spins round. There isn’t a buy option as such, but players can hit Gamble to spin a needle to try their luck. The cost of doing so depends on the bet level and the number of stars that have been collected up till that point.All Star Knockout (Northern Lights Gaming): VerdictWith its basic graphics and overdone theme, it can be quick to write off another average looking fruit slot. But, hear us out; All Star Knockout has a few decent things going for it. Maybe because expectations weren’t exactly sky-high, they were easier to exceed. It did take a while to warm to All Star Knockout due to the generic overdone nature of the theme, but it has a few tricks that might appeal to fans of the genre.First, the way that stars are collected means that it's possible to build up a stash next to several symbols at once. The game can trigger free spins from one of the symbols; then two things can happen. Either more symbols get 5 stars which removes them from the reels and expands the bonus round. Or, you can trigger one bonus game quite quickly after the previous one is finished. No guarantees of course, but it can happen. The second trick is that All Star Knockout has quite a decent potential of 4,500 times the stake up for grabs. Getting anywhere near that is going to require an insane amount of star collecting, but technically it's possible.Overall, All Star Knockout is a more coherent experience than Rocky’s Gold was for sure. It might not be super exciting, but it has its place. Retro fans up for a fruity themed slot with a few extras bolted on and decent potential might be up for a spin or two.Can't get enough of games with 'Knockout' in the title? Have a look at Knockout Diamonds from rivaling developer ELK Studios.

Title: Cake & Ice Cream

This time the gaming's been dressed up in a cotton candy, pastel outer cover. Have we had that before? Perhaps not, so 9 Masks completists might be fired up to knock Cake & Ice Cream off the list. There's nothing new or very special, though, nor is there anything terrible about it. If you really must play every scatter Instant Win game on the market or like the idea of insta-buying scatters, then picking Cake & Ice Cream makes sense. Title: What The Fox Megaways
review: What the Fox Megaways: Slot OverviewIf you can’t get enough materialistic excess in your life, Red Tiger has cloned the extravagant Piggy Riches Megaways to produce a follow-up of sorts titled What the Fox Megaways. Sadly, fans of Ylvis and their baffling attempts to translate what a fox says into words are conspicuously absent. Default RTP, for example, weighs in at 95.71%, while volatility is high, rated 5 out of 5 by Red Tiger. The hit rate is also rated 5 out of 5; whatever that means is not exactly clear.Red Tiger continues the theme of having a good time via the 10 regular pay symbols as well. These are full reel wilds that carry a multiplier of up to x7 each. Up to 3 Wily Wilds may land on a spin, and their multipliers are multiplied together when more than 1 is in view. At most, they can bring a x343 multiplier into play. Wily Wilds substitute for any paying symbol.Gold bar scatters are your ticket to the Foxy Spins bonus round. Having 3 or more on the reels triggers a spin of a bonus wheel which awards up to 20 free spins with a starting multiplier of up to x10. During free spins, the key benefit is a win multiplier which increments by +1 after each winning cascade. A little unusually, the multiplier has a limit and maxes out at x20, though it does not reset between free spins. The bonus round may be extended, as each scatter on the reels adds +1 more free spin to the remaining amount.What the Fox Megaways: Slot VerdictWhat the Fox Megaways is one of those games so unashamedly a clone it ceases to really matter. Sure it offers nothing new from a technical standpoint, yet when the experience is so downright fun, who cares? In this way, the game shares the spirit as well as the stats of Piggy Riches Megaways, where it’s okay to celebrate money and have a bit of fun with it. The best things in life might be free, but sometimes indulging in the materialistic side of life appeals as well. In this regard, What the Fox Megaways steps up to offer its wares.If you liked the predecessor, you’re almost sure to like this one as well. The base game paces along nicely thanks to the upbeat music, flashy lighting, and the way the cascade feature executes. Just like Vegas itself, What the Fox Megaways sucks you into its world of excess and doesn’t let go. Regarding the gameplay, Wily Wilds can be highly effective when they drop from nowhere to boost a bunch of line wins. Since their values multiply each other, then having two or three can be an absolute game-changer. Free spins are free spins, there’s nothing overly new about a progressive win multiplier, though higher starting values always go down well. Potential isn’t astonishing, given the mammon-centric theme, but not even Mr. Foxter would complain about a 10,474 x the bet hit.Here’s a little test. Picture yourself with a cocktail in hand hanging out of the sunroof of a stretched limo as it cruises down The Strip, the wind in your hair, as passers-by point and ask each other ‘Who is that guy?’ (or gal). If that scenario sounds too over the top, then What the Fox Megaways might not be the game for you. On the other hand, if it sounds like a blast, then What the Fox Megaways could be the excuse you’re after to let your hair down to go a bit wild and guilt-free crazy.

Title: Nice Catch DoubleMax

Title: Riddle Reels - A Case of Riches
review: Riddle Reels: A Case of Riches: OverviewBust out your magnifying glasses people, it's time to crack a case with Sherlock Holmes, one of the world's greatest detectives. In this slot from developer Play’n GO, players get to take on the criminal underworld and beat them at their own game in a bonus game chock full of clues. It wouldn't be a crime without a weapon, and if you can bring the elements together, substantial wins are there for the taking.He might not have been the first fictional detective, but Sherlock Holmes is arguably the most well-known. The mysterious pipe smoking, deerstalker hat-wearing sleuth first appeared back in 1887, in A Study in Scarlet. Study being the appropriate word here. The man was famous for deducing someone's life story just by looking at them. Players will need some of these powers of deduction in Play’n GO's atmospheric slot, Riddle Reels: A Case of Riches.Well, not so much, it's more a case of luck, but it's always fun to have a little pretend now and then. The case cracking takes place on a 3x3 grid that uses 9 fixed paylines - a classic fruit slot set up. Despite being set on the crime-ridden streets of 19th Century London, the game feels a little like Charlie Chance in Hell to Pay. It's the same format, the symbols have a similar clear look, and the reels are decorated in some ornate flourishes. They both feel old school while getting more complicated during the bonus game.Playable on any device, from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin, Riddle Reels comes shipped with medium volatility, rated 5/10, and a default RTP of 96.22%. As always from Play’n GO, operators have a certain sway over the RTP which can be configured at a lower level, so make sure to do a bit of detective work first. Although Play'n GO never discloses the hit frequency, it's likely on the lower side of the spectrum due to the fruit slot elements of the game.There are eight pay symbols split into two groups; the low pay weapon symbols and the high pay suspects. Weapons include a noose, a tool, a dagger, and a pistol, worth 0.4 to 1 times the stake. The higher paying suspects are a purple lady, a green glassed man, a golden damsel, and a dastardly looking man holding a cane. Values in this lot range from 2 to 12 times the stake.Wilds are handy here, and the game offers three of them. There is a standard one as well as an x2 and an x3 version - each can substitute for any regular pay symbol. More than one multiplier wild in action sees their values combined up to x27. Because a line of three standard wilds is worth 12x on their own, then a line of x3 wilds pays out 324 times the stake.Riddle Reels: A Case of Riches: FeaturesRiddle Reels - mobileThe main game is pretty straight forward, but a couple of features are on hand to lend some complexity. These are respins, the Mystery Feature, and the Bonus feature. All come into play off the back of the scatter symbol.If there are scatters in view on two reels, then the Respin feature is triggered. The two reels with the scatters are locked while the third is respun in the hopes of landing a third scatter. If another scatters does not land on the respin, then the Mystery feature is triggered instead. Each scatter duplicates to cover their respective reels, revealing either a suspect or weapon symbol.The Free Spins feature is triggered by landing 3 scatter symbols anywhere on the reels. Here's where things get more complicated, so powers of deduction may be required. Players are presented with a game board covered in 14 spaces; each space consists of a clue. The feature provides five clues, one is obtained at the start, while the remaining 4 are obtained as you move around the board. A dice is rolled four times, moving players 1 to 6 spaces. Each clue space awards 1-3 free spins, plus 1 of 4 spin variations. These are:Weapon – all weapon symbols convert to the same weapon.Suspect – all suspect symbols convert to the same suspect.A guaranteed wild reel.Nothing, better luck next time.Players must obtain 1, 2 or 4 winning spins during free spins to complete the clue. This gains clue points to fill a Clue Point Wheel meter. If the meter is fully charged after the 4 dice rolls have been used, the player is awarded a Mega Spin. A Mega Spin is one free spin where a reel is fully wild (or multiplier wild), while the other two reels are a suspect or a weapon. After the Mega Spin, the bonus is retriggered.If the meter is not charged after the 4 dice rolls, the Clue Point Wheel feature comes into play. The meter expands, spins, and if the arrow lands within the charged area, then a Mega Spin is awarded.Riddle Reels: A Case of Riches: VerdictRight, now it's our turn to bust out the pipe and cap for a spot of inductive reasoning. Riddle Reels is a game of two halves. The base game is a 3x3 spot of simplistic gaming, while the features get quite complex, although more so in writing than during actual gameplay. If it was a little bit of a riddle on paper, no worries, the features will make sense in action. Basically, it's a case of moving around a board picking up spins and rewards as you solve clues.Sure, Riddle Reels won't be for everybody, but there are positives. For one, the bonus round can end up lasting quite a while, so you do get a certain amount of entertainment for your coins. The feature can be quite lucrative too, providing wins of up to 5,000 times the stake.Riddle Reels is less a high powered gambling tool, more a fun wee romp along Baker Street, with an in-depth bonus game. The presentation is great, a little simple, but the cartoon handing of the theme works perfectly with the features and the overall feeling of the game.Riddle Reels comes off as gritty, but not too gritty, like a theme park version of a dangerous part of London. This analogy might not appeal to some hardcore gamblers, but that's cool, plenty of people like to get their kicks in a relatively 'safer' environment. At the end of the day, Riddle Reels: A Case of Riches is a modern day fruit slot with a lot of bells and whistles added to enhance the experience. It might not go down in history as a classic, but is yet another solid release from Play'n GO.

Title: Pineapple Crush
review: Pineapple Crush: Slot OverviewSet for a summertime release, Pineapple Crush is a fruity, icy, rising multiplier cocktail of a slot designed by Swedish game studio Quickspin. South Beach, apparently, so a long way from Temple of Paw, that's for sure.Pineapple Crush slot - base gameThe stats, facts, and figures bring Pineapple Crush back to the cat game, though, since none of them have really changed. With a bonus buy button lingering to the left side of the screen, ready to take willing players directly into the free spins feature, down the bottom right is where users can select an appropriate bet of 20 c to $/€100 per base game spin.Pineapple Crush's active symbol area is a 5-reel, 3-row gaming space with 20 bet lines. During gameplay, winning symbols are removed from the grid and new symbols fall downwards to fill the empty spaces. If a new win happens after the symbols fall, the tumble feature repeats again until there are no more wins. Locked in blocks of ice are Pineapple Crush's J to A low pay card ranks, worth 1.25 to 5 times the bet, as are the higher value lemons, grapes, watermelon slices, and cherries, paying 10 to 75 times the sake for a 5-of-a-kind winning combination. Between base game spins, the win multiplier resets to 1. There is no upper limit to the multiplier.Free SpinsManaging to get 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatters triggers 7, 10, 15, or 22 free spins, respectively. Scatters are available on all reels. However, note that it is only possible to get the sixth scatter when successfully progressing with the gamble wheel. During free spins, each winning symbol removed increases the win multiplier by +1, which does not reset between free spins. It is possible to win an additional +3, +5, or +7 free spins by landing 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols, respectively.Gamble WheelBefore free spins start, players can gamble what they have won for the chance to get an extra scatter on a gamble wheel. Players are able to gamble until all 6 scatters have been won or the entire free spins bonus is lost on a losing gamble. It is also possible to not gamble by collecting the awarded number of free spins.Buy FeatureFor 100 times the bet, players may choose to buy the free spins feature. The round is triggered by 3+ scatter symbols when bought, and the feature works the same as if triggered by chance. The buy feature's RTP is 96.51%.Pineapple Crush slot - free spinsPineapple Crush: Slot VerdictLike the game it is built from, Pineapple Crush is a simple, easy-to-grasp, easy-to-follow game with an enticing win multiplier feature as the main event that everything else forks off. The division between base and bonus game is a stark one, and while you get hints of the thrill ride in the main game, free spins are really where Pineapple Crush gets the chance to pull off the breaks and go a bit wild. Increasing the win multiplier after tumbles is nothing whatsoever to write home about. In the end, Pineapple Crush came across as good for more 'casual' gambling, less of a seesaw of emotions than some of the other slots mentioned here, but likely to be a rather refreshing draught if it does manage to cut loose.

Title: Beastwood
review: Beastwood: Slot OverviewHow many people have been sitting at work and thought, 'I can't take this anymore' and had visions of walking off into the sunset to find their dream job? Probably quite a few, yet career changes aren't always so easy. Well, they are to Mr Beastwood. No, not MrBeast, the YouTuber who gives away money in a variety of amusing ways. Mr Beastwood was a sea bandit who heard there was fame and fortune to be had on dry land hunting monsters. So, like a sort of cross between Geralt of Rivia and Captain Ahab, Mr Beastwood is off to trap beasts for cash with a golden harpoon.Beastwood slot - base gameBeastwood is an online slot from Swedish software provider Quickspin that uses a reel-adding mechanic which grows the game grid when winning combinations hit. It's called Endless Reels and if it sounds familiar, just wait until you see it in action. Let's just say, if you've played any Infinity Reels slot like Money Mariachi, Hypernova or Thor, you will have experienced something similar before. The grid starts each spin with 3 reels, holding 4 symbols each, and uses a ways system to create wins. Beastwood has that distinct Quickspin look and feel about it, with cartoon beasts and a dashing lead character in the form of Mr Beastwood. There's a pretty neat cut scene going on, too, as play switches between a base game living room and free spins where Mr Beastwood heads into the forest to do some hunting.Players don't get golden harpoons, but they do get to pick stakes from a menu offering options starting at 20 p/c and rising as high as $/€100 per spin. Any device can be used to play this highly volatile game (rated 5 out of 5), which generates a default theoretical return value of 96.11%. Of this, 67.18% is allocated to base game payouts; the remaining 28.93% goes to free spins. Keep in mind, Beastwood may be found with lower RTPs which have slightly different stats.A total of ten normal pay symbols are used in Beastwood – six low-pay 10 to A card ranks, 4 monster medium wins, and one Mr Beastwood high pay. Symbols have base values of 0.15 to 2.5 times the stake, and at least three in view starting from the left are needed to make a winning way. A golden x-looking symbol is wild, which substitutes for all symbols except the bonus. Wilds land on any reel, except the first 3 reels.Beastwood: Slot Features﻿Let's cover the Endless Reels mechanic first, which functions as these things normally do. When a winning combination forms on the grid, an extra reel is added to the right side. If the new reel extends an existing win, another reel is added. Reels keep being added like this until a reel appears that does not improve any existing wins. Evaluations are made, and the grid resets to its default size for the next spin.Symbol Win MultipliersCalculating payouts is interesting. Each winning combination starts with a Symbol Win Multiplier of x1. When more than one winning symbol of the same type lands on a reel, the number of them multiplies the Symbol Win Multiplier. Also, if more than one wild lands on a reel, the number of wilds on the reel multiplies all Symbol Win Multipliers. At the end of a spin, the payout is determined by multiplying the respective symbol value from the paytable by the Symbol Win Multiplier.Beastwood slot - expanding reels mechanic in actionReel MultiplierIn the base game, an x2 Reel Multiplier appears above reel 5, and on every third reel after that. If a win includes a reel with a Reel Multiplier on it, it multiplies all current Symbol Win Multipliers.Free SpinsLanding 4 or more scatter symbols in a base game spin awards 10 free spins. Any extra Bonus symbols award +3 free spins each. During free spins, x2 Reel Multipliers appear on reel 4 and on every reel after that. Landing a scatter symbol awards +1 free spin.Buy FeaturePlayers may be able to buy free spins from the base game for the cost of 120x the bet. Buying the bonus round has an RTP of 96.38%.Beastwood slot - free spinsBeastwood: Slot VerdictAt its core, Endless Reels is basically the same system ReelPlay uses in its Infinity Reels slots or the NetEnt family in their InfiniReels games, but with a different name. Remember the dust-up between NetEnt and ReelPlay over who came up with the idea first, who copied who, and so on? It was a real chicken and egg situation, yet it ended amicably enough between the two studios who pretty much gentlemen shook on it and went their separate ways. Will either studio give a hootenanny now that Quickspin has 'borrowed' the same idea? We wait with bated breath for the reaction, if any.Setting aside any potential ethical issues, Quickspin, it must be said, has done a fine job with its first Endless Reels outing. Whereas ReelPlay's extensive Infinity Reels experience has given them the confidence to craft intricate games like Money Mariachi, Quickspin has kept things simpler for their debut. Not in a way that gets boring any time soon, though. The high graphical standard, animations, and thick fantasy theme are partly to thank for keeping the game interesting. Swift pace and features pick up the rest.While Mr Beastwood is off tracking beasts, one of the principal tasks is to rack up Winning Symbol Multipliers as high as possible. They can stack surprisingly fast at times, too, when more than one winning symbol is landing on reels, and the reels themselves are contributing Reel Multipliers of their own. In some ways, a similar thing happened with the Doubler symbol found in Quickspin's super hit Cash Truck. Beastwood actually beats Cash Truck in the max win stakes, as the studio recorded a top payout of 29,541.2x the bet during 100 million simulated spins.There's a bit of 'you say infinite, I say endless' going on in Beastwood, though Quickspin has the self-awareness to label the Endless Reels mechanic 'new-to-us' instead of trying to palm it off as brand new like someone else may have done. Endless Reels might not be new at all, really, but Beastwood is immensely playable anyway. The great look, characters, and features make Beastwood a kind of richly told tale, with gambling in it.

Title: Dark King Forbidden Riches
review: Dark King: Forbidden Riches: OverviewDeveloper NetEnt explores a murkier side of life in the richly atmospheric game Dark King: Forbidden Riches, a slot thick with doom and gloom, powered by a math model that's more likely to make you suffer death by a thousand cuts rather than having your head chopped off. It might not sound like an attractive premise, but the result is ideal for a spot of lighter gaming in an intensely dark environment, featuring sticky wilds, multipliers, and free spins.NetEnt has successfully imbued the game with a tangible creep factor. Large credit is due to the Dark King who has a strong Sauron look about him, all suited up in plate armour, glowing menacingly through an eye slit. Unfortunately, there isn't a huge amount of material available to accompany the game. NetEnt relies on the slot itself to fill in the blanks. It would have been nice if they'd expanded on the story, built up a bit more suspense or a sense of purpose. As it stands, players are taken deep inside the lair of an evil entity known as the Dark King. That's pretty much it, so let's fill in the gaps.The action takes place in the King's lair, on a 5-reel, 20-payline grid which looks similar to the Frey's hall room in Game of Thrones. The one where the infamous Red Wedding took place before Arya sorted the backstabbers out. Fortunately, Dark King: Forbidden Riches doesn't reach those depths of depravity, but the game has a rich character all the same. Loads of candles, eerie heads beneath the reels, and the music create quite a scene. Fantasy fans will love it.Dark King: Forbidden Riches is playable on any device with a wide range of bets available. Players spin the waxy old reels from as low as 20 p/c and as high $/€400 a pop. The action is governed by medium to high volatility, which may help players make the most of their time in the lair. Time you will need because free spins don't exactly appear super frequently, though an RTP rating of 96.06% ensures an above-average return rate.On the low side, the paytable starts with 10 to Ace card royals designed in a muscular gothic font. Land five of them on a payline to pick up 2.5 to 5 times the stake. Next are four minions you would not want to cross on a dark and stormy hilltop, plus their leader, the Dark King. Each one could be an epic end of level boss in their own right, and are worth of 12.5 to 25 times the bet.The swirling aqua orb has the same value as the King, but it also substitutes for any symbol except the scatter. The wild ties in with both of the features so we'll cover all you need to know about it next.Dark King: Forbidden Riches: FeaturesDark King - free spinsThe name of the game is sticky wilds and multipliers – if you're lucky, both occurring at the same time. During the base game, whenever 2 or more wilds land in view, a multiplier is activated. The number of visible wilds equates to the size of the multiplier, up to x5 at the most. Wins are evaluated and the multiplier applied to it.Stay alert for the red gem scatter symbols landing anywhere on the reels. Getting 3, 4 or 5 in view triggers 10, 12, or 15 free spins, respectively. Free spins begin by adding a hot spot pattern on top of the reels. This is a fixed area in the shape of a cross that sits on reels 2, 3 and 4.During the feature, any wild landing in the cross-shaped hot spot becomes a sticky wild. Moreover, each new sticky wild adds +1 free spin to the total and will remain stuck in position until the feature comes to an end. Players continue to get multipliers which are calculated by the regular wilds and sticky wilds on the reels. The maximum value remains x5.Dark King: Forbidden Riches: VerdictNetEnt has really gone dark with this one, or in their words 'Something wicked this way comes'. Even though that’s the title of a thriller from Ray Bradbury about a twisted travelling circus, it does apply here. Dark King: Forbidden Riches doesn't have the same polish of Yggdrasil's tour de force Hades Gigablox, nor does it have the streak of humour, but there is an air of intrigue about it. As well as the mouldy old visuals, music plays a huge part, alternating between mystery, intrigue, discovery, through to an almost religious climax. It has a cinematic quality and is a credit to NetEnt's sound team.The action is relatively straight forward most of the time. The base game receives a kick from the wild multiplier feature, every so often producing a satisfying win to keep you in the game. Of course, it's free spins you want, with their one-two combo of Sticky Wilds and multipliers. Get on a lucky run, and wins of up to 2,000 times your stake per spin are theoretically possible. With that said, the game usually produces relatively small wins and you're lucky to get away with around 100x-200x during the free spins realistically speaking. At the end of the day, Dark King: Forbidden Riches turned out to be one of those 'egg-timer' slots, depleting your balance whilst leaving you with the feeling there's little chance for a comeback.Yet if it's a fantasy-themed slot you're after, Dark King: Forbidden Riches has several things to commend it. Yes, the graphics and sounds are a highlight, but there is something deeper going on that makes Dark King a unique game. There's a hidden menace, or a deeper meaning here NetEnt alludes to but doesn't completely give away. Whatever it is, Dark King: Forbidden Riches is a playable slot. It won't smash records, or become required viewing, but the bonus game is fun, and the overall result is worth braving the Dark King's lair for a sinister spin or two. Just don't stay on it chasing wins for too long.

Title: Lucha Legends
review: Lucha Legends IntroductionIf you've seen the 2006 comedy Nacho Libre starring actor Jack Black, then you're probably already familiar with the freestyle wrestling form that was introduced in the early 20th century in Mexico. If, on the other hand, you are a degen gambler like the rest of us, chances are you first became aware of the phenomenon through online slots such as Luca Maniacs (Yggdrasil) and Luchadora (Thunderkick). This peculiar Latin American spectacle is characterised by wrestlers wearing colourful masks, rapid sequences of holds, as well as high-flying manoeuvres, some of which have been picked up by their American colleagues and still used today.The Mexican wrestling theme is a popular choice in the entertainment industry and frequently transposed into movies and video games so we're not surprised to see Microgaming churn out a Lucha slot of its own. Just by looking at it, the slot doesn't appear to stick out in any particular way aside from the 2x button left of the reel set. That's the 'Power Up Mode'. It increased your chances of triggering the Super Wild feature which we will look into further below.The setup is nothing out of the ordinary and pretty much what we've learned to expect from Microgaming by now. It comes with 5-reels, 3-rows and 25 pay lines. As usual, there is no mention of the RTP in the paytable (at least not to non-UK players) which is unacceptable and very unusual these days. Lucha Legends accepts stakes between €0.25 and €37.50 per spin without the Power Up Mode activated and between €0.50 and €75 with the button enabled.Visually, it's a light-hearted, uncomplicated slot with cartoon style graphics involving a lot of colour, crowd cheers, and mariachi music with a training wrestling ring serving as the backdrop.Lucha Legends Symbols & PaytableIn total there are 13 symbols in the game of which 10 are standard symbols. J, Q, K and A royals are used as low-value symbols while the premiums are represented by various characters - Ricco the referee, Violeta the ring girl, and wrestlers Burro, duo Sal and Pepe, Martio, and El Diablo. The red-masked hero El Diablo is the most lucrative out of the Luchadores and gives you 12 times the stake for 5 across a full payline.The wild symbol substitutes for all symbols bar the scatter and only appear on reels 2, 3 and 4.Super Wild Feature & Power Up ModeIncluded in Lucha Legends is the Super Wild feature which may activate randomly in the main game if wilds land to form a winning combination. Title: 777 Rainbow Respins
review: 777 Rainbow Respins: Slot Overview777 Rainbow Respins from the zany guys at Crazy Tooth Studios, is a game of both old and new. When activated, all instances of the winning symbol type create a respin area. Then, all symbols within the respin area except multiplier wilds are respun. If a respin lands a symbol type that matches one or more positions outside the respin area, those matching symbols outside are added to the respin area, and the area is respun. Also, after a respin, there is a chance an x2 wild multiplier is added to the respin area, and a win evaluation takes place. Marginally being the word, since the same pros and cons that came with 777 Mega Deluxe crop up in the sibling slot.Let's start with cons. Another sore point is the ludicrously low symbol values – a phenomenon plaguing a number of Crazy Tooth slots. Technically speaking, it is possible to score decent returns in 777 Rainbow Respins. However, the good points failed to make up for what was a low thrills game, devoid of much creativity. Other studios have released classic slots with a modern twist, which these 777 games feel like they are trying to be. The thing about success stories like the ELK Classic Series is they tend to be clever, grunty games, which drag you in and are good for a few laughs. Title: El Paso Gunfight xNudge
review: El Paso Gunfight xNudge: Slot OverviewIf movies have taught us anything about the Wild West, it's how ruthless, lawless, and downright mean it could be. However, fact can sometimes be stranger than fiction, and nowhere is this maxim more appropriate than in the infamous El Paso Gunfight. The legend’s name was Dallas Stoudenmire, and his claim to fame has been further immortalised by Nolimit City in their slot El Paso Gunfight xNudge.Nolimit City is certainly no stranger to this part of the world, having blown players away with the likes of Tombstone and Deadwood. El Paso Gunfight xNudge is a follow-on of sorts, though not a direct sequel as such. It feels like Nolimit has a real interest in the Old West which they channel into making solid games. Part of that passion is apparent visually, yet music has also been a real highlight. So, while El Paso Gunfight's music doesn't get as frantic as Deadwood's, its upbeat saloon soundtrack is the perfect counterpoint to all the gunfire, bullets, and blood being splashed across the screen.Set against a shelf of liquor bottles, El Paso Gunfight xNudge is played over a 5-reel grid, offering up to 43,334 ways to win when fully expanded. As well as choosing stakes from 25 p/c to $/€50 per spin, players can also choose their stance. If more than one of these wilds is in play, the multiplier values are added together.Deputy and Marshall Raids are trigged when the Deputy Badge or Marshall Badge land in view. If both badges land at the same time, they transform to wilds and increase the reel area to 4-3-3-3-4.8 Gunfight Spins are triggered when 3 scatters land in the base game where you choose the volatility that suits (high or extremely high). Triggering scatter symbols also become jumping wilds and can upgrade Stoudenmire Wilds.What you really want though, is 3 scatters to land with both badges in the base game, or both badges in Gunfight Spins. This leads to 10 Drunken Gundfiguth&r… Spins, played on a 4-3-3-3-4 grid. Here you get 5 jumping wilds and sticky Stoudenmire xNudge Wilds. Stoudenmire Wilds can be upgraded as mentioned above, although now they lock in place for the rest of the round.El Paso Gunfight xNudge also has one more lethal respin feature stuffed up a sleeve. Known as the 4 dead in 5 seconds feature, one respin is awarded where all 5 character symbols (including the Stoudenmire wild) land at once. Stoudenmire Wilds expand to cover all three middle reels for the respin and its multiplier appliers to the respin payout.Lastly, for players who like to fast forward to the best parts, El Paso Gunfight xNudge lets players buy Gunfight Spins, Deputy Gunfight Spins, Marshall Gunfight Spins, Drunken Gundfiguth&r… Spins, a 4 dead in 5 seconds Respin, or a lucky dip for 80x, 400x, 400x, 800x, 300x, or 238x the bet respectively.El Paso Gunfight xNudge: Slot VerdictLet’s just say it from the outset, El Paso Gunfight xNudge is another wild stallion of a ride from Nolimit City. Of their three Westerns to date, El Paso might not be the most immediately attractive one, as its low key saloon doesn't grab you the way Deadwood's grim small-town setting did, or even Tombstone's unusual black, white, and red colour scheme. The brown tones and plinking piano create an almost warm, inviting environment to come in, kick your feet up, maybe sample some moonshine before maybe having a chinwag or round of cards with the locals.That impression quickly fades, however, once you're knee-deep in El Paso Gunfight's action, which is as volatile or extremely volatile as ever - depending on the setting you go for. Then you start to realise how clever the saloon location is. None of the price tags might be as eye-catching as San Quentin xWays perhaps, but 300x for a single respin is not to be trifled with. In many ways, the intensity of the features encapsulates the spirit of the four dead in five seconds story where a crazy amount of action was crammed into a very short space of time.The game might not have a bucking bronco released from the pen feel Deadwood had, yet El Paso Gunfight xNudge gets real close at times and in many ways surpasses its older siblings. Title: The Respinners
review: The Respinners: OverviewThe Respinners is a concert inspired entry into Hacksaw Gaming's Pocketz series of slots. Next are the higher paying band member symbols – the guitarist, drummer, guitar keyboardist, and Wild Mike the lead singer. Land 5 of a kind from this group for payouts of 1x to 4x the bet. It's only mentionable quality is that you hardly ever see it in action.The Respinners: FeaturesThe Respinners - free spinsFeatures during The Respinners occur regularly – after every win in fact. They either don't tend to accomplish much, or they go all the way and trigger free spins. It's all or nothing at this concert. First up, the Crowd Goes Wild feature is awarded arbitrarily in the main game. When active, a random number of up to 12 wild symbols are added to the reels.Next, respins are triggered after every win involving the high pay band member symbols. The corresponding muso is highlighted above the reels to track your progress. Exactly one respin is awarded, and if a new band member combination lands, another respin is awarded. So on, until no new bandmate combos appear, or all 4 are lit up on stage. When that occurs, 12 free spins are awarded.In free spins, each band member comes with their own win multiplier. When you land a band member combo, the respective multiplier is applied to it, then the multiplier is increased by +4.The Respinners: VerdictIt seems Hacksaw Gaming has landed on a formula that works well for them and Respinners is undoubtedly another quality Pocketz slot. More importantly, it works well for a lot of players too, especially the mobile crowd the range is aimed at. Once again, The Respinners is the kind of game commuters hunch over on their way to work, on breaks, then on the return journey. It looks cheerful, it has personality, playability and that recognisable Hacksaw charm. For the icing on top, potential is solid at 5,150 times the stake. Though with the way features work, you might have a better chance of reforming the old high school band and winning a Grammy.As well as the highlights there are some irritants and issues that might put players off. Counterbalancing that is the number of respins you get. They don't often lead to the full band under lights and triggered free spins, but they are frequent enough to keep hopes alive.Funnily enough during testing, the bonus game was triggered after around 10 spins which turned into a double-edged sword. In that regard, The Respinners is as good as any other in the range, plus its soundtrack might inspire you to dust off some old LPs for a nostalgic trip down memory lane.

Title: Lucky Fishing Megaways

The wild transformational ability of the Fishing Boat has the ability to gel well with what can be a large number of ways and the tumble system. Add in a progressive multiplier for free spins, and potential hauls could be quite thrilling. Then again, not too thrilling since, like its predecessor, Lucky Fishing Megaways is governed by a rather stingy for Megaways win cap of 5,000x the bet. In a bubble, Lucky Fishing Megaways is likely to fulfil many of the requirements of an angling-themed Megaways slot. However, since almost every aspect has been seen before in one form or another, a few desirability points are lost, and if originality is a must, then Lucky Fishing Megaways might come across as chum rather than a prime catch.

Title: Plenty O' Fish

Title: Ride the Lightning

Title: Coba
review: Coba: Slot OverviewCoba is a Central American themed cluster paying slot from software developer ELK Studios that is heavy on snake and jungle motifs. Yeah, 'another day, another one of these slots', we can practically hear jaded readers in the audience sigh, yet bear with us for a moment. ELK might have used some of the more common subject matter to dress Coba, but they've also put their thinking caps on to come up with a batch of innovative features to deliver a unique experience. If you're ready to swat mosquitoes, wipe the sweat from your brow, or do whatever else happens when trekking through thick foliage, let's take a little look.Looks are a good place to start because Coba is a striking game both visually and audibly. It's located in a jungle, where a pyramid sits in the background, with statues, trees, and creepers in the foreground. Coba is the name of an actual Mayan city located in the state of Quintana Roo on the Yucatán Peninsula, and ELK has made a stylish representation of it. The sound fits the action like a charm, too, alternating between the sort of drum beat rhythms you expect in a Mayan game before blowing its stack like a possessed synthesizer during big win count ups. If one was to proverbially judge a book by its cover, they'd have high expectations over what Coba would deliver next.Coba slot - base gameOn the nuts 'n bolts side of things, Coba is played on a 7x7 game grid which pays when five or more matching symbols are connecting. Wining clusters are removed by the Avalanche feature, and symbols fall down to fill the gaps. If this creates another cluster, the process repeats. Win frequency has been recorded as 38.9%, while the overall RTP comes in at 95%. Medium/high volatile, Coba can be played on all devices and takes bets of 20 p/c to $/€100 per paid drop.As to payouts, the lower value symbols consist of green, blue, and brown tokens, worth 0.1-0.15x the bet for five of a kind, rising to 4-10x the bet for a 15+ sized cluster. Next are green gems, blue gems, red gems, and golden skulls, paying 0.3-1x the bet for five or 15-500x the stake for a 15+ sized grouping.Coba: Slot FeaturesThis is where the snakes come in. When winning clusters hit, they are collected in the Snake Meter, which has 4 levels. When wins end and players have achieved level 1, 2, 3, or 4, then 1, 2, 3 or 6 snakes are unleashed on the game grid.SnakesA snake is like a walking cluster that slithers along the grid before a win evaluation. Snakes are at least 5 symbols long and can create a winning cluster of their own or become part of a bigger winning cluster. Snakes take on a particular symbol type. When they eat symbols on the reels of the same type, they grow and can create larger winning clusters. When a snake does not eat the same symbol type, it dies and is removed after the win evaluation. Snakes also die if they cross their own body – like the mobile game Snake.Coba slot - Eat & Grow feature in actionMultiplier WildsShould 2 snakes move across each other's bodies, where they cross, becomes an x2 multiplier wild symbol. Any other snake crossing a multiplier wild doubles its multiplier value. When more than one multiplier wild is used in a cluster, their values are multiplied by each other.X-iterThe X-iter feature buy menu lets users play Coba in five different modes:Pray to Quetzalcoatl – costs 2x the bet and releases 3 snakes when reaching Level 1 and Level 2 on the Snake Meter.Viper Active – 10x the bet to start at Level 1 with 1 snake active.Boa Constrictor – 25x the bet to start at Level 1 with longer snakes.Quetzalcoatl – 100x the bet to start at Level 1. Level 1 and Level 2 release 3 snakes.Coba! – 500x to start at Level 4 with 6 snakes released.Coba slot - Level 4 X-iter modeCoba: Slot VerdictIn the realm of online slots, some themes repeatedly reappear, with almost clockwork regularity. One such topic is the ancient cultures of Central America. Developers seem to love this stuff, and so presumably do a lot of players, which is why studios keep coming back to it. Sometimes this can result in overkill. At other times, well, we have no problems with studios reusing the same theme if it leads to games like Coba. ELK has made the most of the Mayan theme to produce a game that is a standout in just about all regards. It looks and sounds like a million bucks; plus, if the topic isn't original, the gameplay sure is. If there is one thing ELK excels at, it's creating deep game worlds, and Coba is a slot drenched in jungle sweat that wraps its vines around you, and then proceeds to pull you in.Coba is another example of ELK pushing in new directions, in a way building on the gravity- mechanic found in games like Bompers, Cygnus, or Io. Some of the bold experimentalism shown in Night Trax is present here, too, though Coba isn't quite as boundary-pushing. Then there are the snakes, and there cant be many times in life when you actually want more reptiles in your zone than less. The effect is a little like Snake Arena, but instead of making wilds, snakes are tasked with creating cluster wins or multiplier wilds - while they live. When they do cross and create useful multiplier wilds, it just gets better. Even without a strictly separate bonus round, Coba is one of ELK's highest paying slots, tipping the scales at 25,000x the bet. Whatever manages to generate those sorts of numbers in Coba would be frighteningly good to witness.Even when Coba isn't pushed to full capacity, it's still a sight to behold. It wouldn't hurt if the RTP was higher, yet the setup is great, the execution top class, and there's something new here to get a handle on. Central America might be a common slot locale, but Coba expertly uses it to take players into new territory.

This is a specific form of wrestling that started in the early 20th century and is a flamboyant display of high-flying manoeuvres, big personalities, and masks. Games Global has squeezed a bunch of these things into Numero Uno. Particularly good are the joyful horn-heavy Mariachi-style tune, the cheering crowds, and the animal superstars in colourful masks. It's quite a rousing combo, so no wonder software providers have developed a soft spot for the theme, and there are a fair few luchador slots kicking around now.Numero Uno slot - base gameIf you're looking for the most potentially lucrative luchador slot, then there are better options than Numero Uno. Despite a so-so max win figure, Numero Uno is a highly volatile slot, and has three RTP models, the highest being a value of 95.22%. At this setting, hits come at a frequency of 31.52% and occur when matching symbols land left to right, from the left most side, in adjacent reels. Any device is suitable for masking up on, and stakes vary in size from 20 p/c to $/€120 per spin.Played on a 5-reel, 3-row, 243 ways to win panel, the game functions with nine regular pay symbols. Four are card royals J-A, paying 1.6 to 2 times the stake for five of a kind, increasing to 3 to 10x the bet when five of the premium animal tiles land. Numero Uno also has more than 40 wild symbols stacked on reels 3, 4, and 5. Wilds can substitute for all symbols except for scatters.Numero Uno: Slot FeaturesNumero Uno slot - Wild Showdown featureWhen it comes to features, they're all classics in Numero Uno, such as Rolling Reels, a Wild Showdown, and free spins with a progressive multiplier.Rolling ReelsWhen a winning way is formed, the symbols that were part of it are removed from the board by the Rolling Reels feature. The symbols left on the reels drop down into the empty spaces, and if another win is formed, Rolling Reels triggers again.Wild ShowdownThe Wild Showdown activates at random in the base game to produce a guaranteed win. Numero Uno faces off against an opponent, turning reel 2, 3, or 4 wild. During the Wild Showdown, Rolling Reels are not active.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatters symbols awards 5, 50, or 250 times the stake, plus 15, 20, or 25 free spins, respectively. In free spins, a progressive win multiplier is used, which increases to x2, x3, x4, 5, or x10, after Rolling Reels. Multipliers reset between free spins.Numero Uno slot - Wild Showdown featureNumero Uno: Slot VerdictFor players who enjoyed Microgaming's sports-themed 'Star' slots, then Numero Uno is something of a homecoming. It should feel familiar right off the bat and perusing the paytable provoked a keen sense of déjà vu. Whether Global Games decided to dust off this specific set of features because of convenience, speed, or fondness, it's not obvious and will probably remain a slot-based mystery. However we arrived in this position, picking Mexican Wrestling was a colourful choice, and going against the grain by populating the game with animals rather than human wrestlers ups the adorability factor.Once past the bright surface level, then Numero Uno's lack of originality in terms of gameplay is hardly exciting stuff. It's basically just Rolling Reels, and Wild Showdown triggers in the base game to keep you going till free spins hit. The game looks quite good while doing so, but enthusiasm did wane fairly quickly. Free spin multipliers do inject a bit more life when they're active, yet don't expect monstrous wins from Numero Uno, as payouts max out at an advertised 2,100x the bet. This might put around the same level as previous 'Star' sports games, though it is weak compared to much of the competition. Cascades, or Rolling Reels, and progressive multipliers are a dime a dozen set up these days, found all over the place. Perhaps back when the 'Star' range came out, expectations weren't as high as they've been elevated to now, but Numero Uno doesn't stack up all that well against its contemporaries, Wild Luchador, for example, being one of them.And yet, these lively Mexican inspired Mariachi, Day of the Dead, and lucha libre slots continue to prove their popularity, so there are likely to be a few armchair wrestlers happy at the thought of going into the ring with Numero Uno. Title: Diamond Mine 2 Megaways

In Diamond Mine 2 Megaways, players not only pick a stake of 10 p/c to $/€10, but they can also choose to activate an extra bet or shell out 100x for the Gold Bet, thereby triggering the bonus round. Helping players decide, perhaps, the default RTP for all three options is exactly the same at 95%. Mathematically, the game is medium to high volatile, indicating a fairly high potential for large swings in outcomes.Each winning combination triggers a reaction feature. When 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 scatters hit, they award 8, 12, 16, 20, or 24 free spins, or the x5, x7, x9, x12, or x15 Golden Guarantee for Gold Spins, respectively. This takes place on a segmented gamble wheel displaying the possible gamble outcomes, so players know what they may or may not receive before taking the plunge.Free SpinsDuring free spins, a win multiplier is added, starting at x1 and increasing by +1 after each cascade. Each scatter that lands increases the Golden Guarantee.Diamond Mine 2 Megaways slot - free spinsDiamond Mine 2 Megaways: Slot VerdictIt was going to be a tall ask for Diamond Mine 2 Megaways to create the same amount of wow factor as the original did. These days, the Megaways floodgate has been well and truly thrown wide open, where it seems like every other studio and its pooch has gotten in on the action. As such, while there might be fool's gold lying around, there are also a lot of Megaways nuggets, too, meaning Diamond Mine 2 Megaways would have to work extra hard to stand out the way its older sibling did.Not meaning to be a downer, but it's not clear Diamond Mine 2 Megaways has done so. Don't get us wrong, the testing session offered a nice trip to the mine, and the environment is as positive as ever. On the other side, once you do hit the guaranteed multiplier, that's it; game over, you've hit the limit. Since the lower multiplier levels aren't enormous (x5, x7, for example), prospective participants might feel like they're selling themselves short. Maybe not, though, because the wins that increment the multiplier could be good ones. Ah, well, it's a gamble and optional, too, so maybe something for curious punters to play around with. Presumably, it's technically possible to achieve Diamond Mine 2 Megaways' win cap of 10,000x the bet.And so while Diamond Mine 2 Megaways wasn't shockingly new compared to the original, its Gold Spins are quite novel and might attract fans of the first in for a look, as well as newer prospectors after a gaming device you can't unearth in any old palace.

Title: HarleCoin
review: HarleCoin: Slot OverviewHarleCoin by Red Tiger sees the coming together of two popular slot tropes. One is coins, the glue holding any game together. The second is harlequins, those amusing yet slightly sinister characters that grace untold numbers of classically themed slots. Red Tiger hints at the darker side of these masked figures in HarleCoin, a game oozing opulence like a Venetian mask party, one hiding something deeper and a bit ominous.Players don't get a chance to scratch much further than the surface in HarleCoin, but the game is richly presented. It has a recognisable Red Tiger shine to it, courtesy of a gold-lined 3-reel grid, shimmering metallic décor, and loads of sparkling gemstones. HarleCoin's enticing vibe is slightly spoiled by a panel of 6 symbols sitting above the game grid. The value panel inclusion might cheapen the affluent environment, yet it is useful in keeping track of symbols' worth – which constantly changes as HarleCoins accrue and wins hit.Simplifying things, HarleCoin uses just 1 payline to land three of a kind winners across. Combinations must sit exactly flush on the line to trigger payouts; otherwise, they don't count. Seven symbols are used in the game - six of them possess monetary values, while the seventh is a free spins bonus symbol. From low to high, we find cherries, clovers, stars, bells, and sevens. There is also a wild symbol that is both the most valuable one of the lot and can substitute the previously mentioned five symbols. Values vary, depending on how many HarleCoins have been collected, but the six paying symbols have starting values of 4x to 125x the bet. Once they have been used in a win, the reset symbol values from then on are 1x to 30x the bet.HarleCoin's Merry Andrew antics are available on desktop, tablet, or mobile devices, supplying a range of stakes from 10 p/c to $/€80 per spin. The volatility is rated 4 out of 5, putting it in the medium-high range, while Red Tiger rate hit frequency as one 1/5. Keep in mind this is Red Tiger's proprietary meter, so you won't get a win 20% of the time, and the win rate proved to be very infrequent during test runs - no big surprise for this format. Potential is low as well, so don't get pumped for some massive one payline heroics.HarleCoin: Slot FeaturesHarleCoin - free spinsCollecting HarleCoins to boost symbol values and triggering free spins are the dual goals of HarleCoin the slot. HarleCoins appear as little overlay icons on random pay symbols or wilds. Whenever they land, regardless of whether they were part of a win, the coin boosts the value of the respective symbol. When wins occur, the combination takes its value from whatever is displayed on the symbol panel above the grid.There are limits to symbol values, so the most you can boost cherries, clovers, stars, bells, sevens, or wilds to is 20x, 30x, 50x, 100x, 250x, or 500x the bet, respectively. When a win occurs in the base game, the symbols reset to the values mentioned above.Land 3 bonus symbols on the line to win up to 25 boost spins – the number is arbitrarily selected for you. During the bonus round, every paying symbol that is not at its maximum level will always land with a HarleCoin. Also, symbol values do not reset after they have been used in a win. Once the feature concludes, the boosted symbols carry over to the base game until claimed in the next win.HarleCoin: Slot VerdictPlaying HarleCoin, you end up walking the knife-edge between wanting more time to collect coins to boost symbol values and wanting free spins to trigger so you can unload them. However, after activating free spins for the first time, you realise HarleCoin is not quite the balancing act this type of mechanic can sometimes be. This is because you generally get a lot of free spins (there was only ever 20+ in testing), and HarleCoins land in abundance – far more so than in the base game. This provides time to seriously improve symbols on the paytable. Don't expect massive results, though; sevens were as good as it got in free spins, and wild wins were extraordinarily scarce.Let's say you fully boost wild symbols and have a dream bonus round; how much cash can you expect to pocket? Well, having such a large max bet in a Red Tiger game is often a clue potential probably isn't going to be spectacular. So it is with HarleCoin, where the calculated max multiplier, as Red Tiger puts it, is 1,076 times the stake. Not an immense sum by any measure of imagination, but if players dig the rest of the game, they will probably be okay with that amount, too.In a nutshell, HarleCoin offers basic gaming in an attractive environment, utilising a straight forward coin collection system to improve symbol values. It's uncomplicated, and you don't have to think too hard about what is going on, giving you the space to admire the view and let your mind wander. Here's a shower thought to ponder while collecting coins - are harlequins actually sinister characters, or do they simply hold up a mirror to reveal our scarred psyches? Whatever the answer, low potential means there are more exciting single payline games elsewhere, lowering HarleCoin's pulling power, unless you are completely enraptured by the theme.

Title: GemPops

The same could be said for slot game maker AvatarUX, which has rolled off so many PopWins or Pop-related slots by now it's hard to keep up. Instead of having a fixed size, reel heights are random. Furthermore, GemPops uses a win-all-ways pay system, which pays both left to right from the leftmost side and right to left from the rightmost side. A dynamic grid is accompanied by a highly volatile math model with an RTP of 96%. Base bets in GemPops are 20 c to $/€100 per spin, and from the Xpress menu, four bonus options are available.Wins are awarded when matching symbols land on 3 adjacent reels from the leftmost reel or the rightmost reel onwards, and when the gaming grid is expanded to its full size, 59,049 ways are available for lining up wins. Several special symbols are present in GemPops to help augment results, but wild symbols are not one of them.GemPops: Slot FeaturesGemPops slot - free spins gambleInterestingly, GemPops isn't an official PopWins slot in the strictest sense of the world, as it uses a variant system known as Popscade when winning ways appear. Joining Popscade on this esoteric journey are reel multipliers, Xpops, Bomb symbols, free spins, gambles, and Xpress bonus buys.Popscade & XpopsWhen a winning combination appears, the winning symbols are replaced by new symbols and the respective reels extend. The Xpops mechanic, meanwhile, allows symbols to pop by a random amount ranging from 1 to 4.Reel MultipliersEach reel has a multiplier assigned to it, which increases every time there is a symbol win (+1 for each symbol win). In the base game, when a reel reaches its maximum height, the multiplier multiplies wins happening on the unlocked reel. In free spins, when a reel reaches its maximum height, the multiplier over the reel is added to the global multiplier, which is applied to any future wins. The reel multiplier is not active unless the reel is fully expanded to its full height.Free SpinsLanding at least 3 scatter symbols in the base game triggers free spins mode. When 3 scatters are in view, players get 5 free spins with an x1 starting multiplier, 4 scatters award 8 free spins with an x3 starting multiplier, while 5 scatter symbols award 12 free spins with an x5 multiplier. Scatter symbols only appear in the base game. When the Bomb symbol drops (only available in free spins), players can get up to 3 additional free spins. The special free spins Bomb symbol instantly unlocks the reel it landed on to its full height, activating the reel multiplier.Gamble WheelBefore free spins start, players have the option of gambling for upgrades on the gamble wheel, though keep in mind that losing the gamble takes you straight back to the main game. When the starting number of free spins is 5, you can gamble to increase it to 8, then gamble again to go to 12 free spins. Or when the wheel lands on a special golden slice, it is possible to get 12 free spins with an x1 multiplier on the first gamble, and 16 free spins with an x3 multiplier on the second gamble.XpressFrom the Xpress menu, users may activate the ante bet, which doubles the chance of entering free spins, thereby increasing the stake by 25%. Other options are buying a spin on the gamble wheel for up to 8 free spins for 75x the bet, buying 5 free spins with an x1 multiplier for 75x the bet, or buying 12 free spins with an x5 multiplier for 300x the bet.GemPops slot - free spinsGemPops: Slot VerdictGemPops might not be an official PopWins slot per se, but in operation, players familiar with AvatarUX's work should be able to slide into the game no problem. In the base game, GemPops functions a little bit like Megaways, meaning you never know how many symbols will appear on each reel on each spin or how many ways to win will be available. Not sure if Popscading is an improvement on the way PopWins games usually flow, but it's something different for the cognoscente to swirl around and savour. The abrupt way winning symbols are replaced by new symbols Popscading in wasn't as satisfying as the way PopWins games usually remove winning symbols and replace their cell (and other cells where possible) with new symbols. It's a bit sudden, a bit disorienting and harder to keep track of by comparison.If there's one thing AvatarUX knows besides popping, it's injecting win multipliers into a game. GemPops is no exception, and this is one game where growing reels to their full height could be critical to how a session unfolds. Also quite critical is how much more effective bonus rounds tend to be the more free spins awarded. Sure, this sounds like a no-brainer that could apply to any slot, but it seems to be especially pertinent in slots from AvatarUX. Perhaps that's why gamble wheel features are so prevalent in its games and may be tempting to boot. Potentially ruthless, though, so don't expect any mercy when tangling with the gamble feature. But yeah, building big multipliers is feasible when GemPops is on a roll, and at 20,000x the bet, eye-opening results are theoretically possible.To sum up, GemPops didn't seem like it did enough to rank up there with its big-name PopWins cousins, CherryPop, for example, but it is still another neatly put-together slot by a team that knows a thing or two about poppin'.

Title: Pirots 2
review: Pirots 2: Slot OverviewMoving on from roaming the seven seas, one squawk at a time, the avian adventures of ELK Studios' slot Pirots have moved onto brand new territory for the sequel. Pirots 2 sees the Fearful Four inhabit a reality where dinosaurs walk the earth and occasionally terrorise the gaming grid. Much of the mechanics of the previous slot return, alongside some new parts, so the experience remains similar in spirit yet different in practice. The original Pirots gave players a wholly unique, if divisive, way to try their luck; one wonders whether the sequel is going to unite or divide the two opposing opinionated parties further.Here's a question: has the Fearful Four gone back in time for the making of Pirots 2 or not?
