Symbol multipliers do not apply to the Infinity Bonus.Also, in the base game, any spin may activate a Frenzy Spin. A Frenzy Spin applies a multiplier of x2, x3, x4, or x5 to prizes for that spin only.The last symbol is the Lightning Bolt, and when a win occurs using this symbol, free spins with a specific feature is offered. This feature may be taken or rejected in order to play on for a better one. A 12 segment wheel spins to award normal, super, or mega free spins. How the feature part plays into this is that the Cerberus, Chimera, and Zeus features have increasing chances of landing better free spins rounds. Based on the level you are on, the segments will be as described below:Cerberus: 11 normal free spins + 1 super free spins segment.Chimera: 6 normal free spins, 5 super free spins + 1 mega free spin.Zeus: 6 super free spins + 6 mega free spins segments.Normal free spins award 8 regular spins, while super free spins have at least one guaranteed wild on reel 2. Or, mega free spins have at least two guaranteed wilds on reel 2. During free spins, the symbol multiplier does not rest, and it increments by +1 to +5. Winning spins increase the increment level, and non-winning spins decrease it. Any lightning bolt win retriggers 8 extra free spins. When free spins conclude, players have the option of collecting their coins or gambling them for up to 5 times their value.Finally, non-UK punters can buy the bonus game for the cost of 83.33x the total bet. This spins the 12 segment wheel to award normal, super, or mega free spins.Olympus Infinity Reels: Slot VerdictThere is a feeling of having seen it all before when playing Olympus Infinity Reels, or most of it at least. The game follows Royal Dragon Infinity Reels closely, which in turn mirrored ReelPlay's Egyptian themed slot Giza Infinity Reels. From the varying symbol multiplier increments to the gamble feature, not a heck of a lot is new, if anything. Okay, the setting has shifted, but Olympus and the Greek Gods aren't exactly new kids on the iGaming block. On the whole, Olympus Infinity Reels is so lacking in genuine originality you start to wonder what the point was. Perhaps for players absolutely rapt by all things Infinity Reels it'll be a hit, yet others may question its very existence.Gaming-wise, it's business as usual, meaning Olympus IR makes use of Infinity Reels to an acceptable level and is content to leave things there. The question of potential is an interesting one. The most you can win during the base or bonus game is 1,845x your stake, though the gamble feature opens this up to 10,000x the bet. It doesn't offer much we haven't experienced before, making it all seem like an attractive copy and paste job.

Title: Golden Fish Tank 2 Gigablox
review: Golden Fish Tank 2 Gigablox: Slot OverviewSome people like to get out amongst nature, wrestle fish, show 'em who's boss and maybe haul a few on to land. Others prefer to bring nature to them and watch fish do laps in a fishbowl, maybe swim in and out of little, tiny shipwrecks or plastic weeds. Any players in the latter group might be tempted by the sequel to Yggdrasil's classic 2016 piscine-themed slot Golden Fish Tank. The newer version, Golden Fish Tank 2 Gigablox, has been modernised in many ways while keeping the bubbly aquatic feel that helped make the first one a hit.It's funny, despite having the words 'Fish Tank' in the title, neither game looks like they are actually set in a fish tank. There's just too much sand, weeds, and bubbles going on. If anything, Golden Fish Tank 2 looks older than the original, more basic from a visual perspective. The game has plenty of charm though, the masses of fish lining the game's transparent grid have a dose of Pixar-like loveable goofiness about them. Waves of relaxation are intensified by the aquatic inspired music, as a similar set of pleasant popping sounds play when reels stop spinning or wins count-up.One of the main changes is the use of Yggdrasil's Gigablox mechanic. The studio has leant this out to a number of its partners, for better or worse, yet it works like a charm in Golden Fish Tank 2. Basically, the game has 6 reels. However, reels merge on every spin to create Gigablox symbols sized 2x2, 3x3, or 4x4 – in the base game. When part of a win, Gigablox symbols break down into regular 1x1 sized symbols for the payout evaluation.Mathematically, things have moved on as well. Volatility, for starters, has been increased from medium to medium-high, though RTP has remained about the same at 96%. As before, the game is available to play on any device, and bets range from 25 p/c to $/€100 per spin. This is playing normally, though. If you engage the Golden Bet feature, bets increase by 20%. The benefit of doing this is you get an extra feature pick when free spins trigger.On the default 4-row grid, players get 25 paylines to hit winning combinations of three to six of a kind on. Low pay symbols are made up of the four card suits, while the four high pays look like really bewildered versions of the four fish that appeared in the original. Landing six premium symbols on a winning line is worth a payout of 6 to 12 times the stake. Coming in at 20x the bet for a line of six is the wild symbol - it lands anywhere to replace any other pay symbol.Golden Fish Tank 2 Gigablox: Slot FeaturesFeatures are a nice mix of old and new, where as well as Gigablox plus the Golden Bet, we find free spins, a treasure chest feature, and a buy bonus.Treasure ChestTreasure chests appear on the last reel and always award a prize even if they are only partially in view. A bunch of bubbles waft across the screen, popping one at a time until just one remains to award its prize. In the base game, this could be 2-500x the bet or 5-16 free spins. In free spins, it is possible to win 2-500x the bet or 1-5 extra free spins. The bigger the chest, the better the average prize.Free SpinsLanding at least 5 scatter symbols in the base game triggers the free spins feature. The number of free spins symbols in view is the number of awarded spins. Next, players receive a random number of feature picks. If you are using the Golden Bet, you always get 1 extra feature pick here.However, if you are not happy with the number of feature picks, you can gamble for more. To do so, 3 starfish appear on screen. Players pick one, and if it reveals gold, you win another feature pick. If it reveals a black starfish, you are sent back to the base game.A bunch of undersea items appear on the screen for the feature pick. Players click the objects one at a time to reveal these modifiers:Wild Fish – one of the fish symbols is turned wild.x2 Multiplier – is applied to all wins in free spins.Expanded Reels – 2 rows are added to the reels. This allows Gigablox up to 6x6.Extra Wild – 1 to 2 wilds are added in random positions on each free spin.Fish Stacks – one fish symbol type can land stacked on the reels.Extra Free Spins – 1 to 5 free spins are added to the total.Buy BonusPlayers get 2 options for buying their way to the bonus round. The first is the standard bet option which awards 5-16 free spins for 60x the total stake. The second is with the Golden Bet switched on, so players get the +1 pick; this costs 100x the stake.Golden Fish Tank 2 Gigablox: Slot VerdictYou could say Gigablox has taken to Yggdrasil's classic like a fish to water. Sorry, that was terrible, but it does describe Golden Fish Tank 2 quite well. Yggdrasil hasn't tinkered with the wrapper much, so players who liked the simple underwater scene of the first game will be chuffed that the studio has largely left it alone. If anything, they've simplified it even further, so if nothing particularly exciting is happening on the reels, it might be tempting to zone out for a bit to just watch the fish do their thing.Fortunately, Yggdrasil has programmed the game to avoid experiencing a lot of downtime. Gigablox keeps you second-guessing, intermittently linking up into something decent, and free spins seemed to trigger quite frequently on their own, without the need for activating the bonus buy. Like real-life fishing, the pick feature can be torturous, though, especially when you've maxed the number of picks and not collecting anything interesting from them. Without a combo made up of wilds, the x2 multiplier and the reel expanding modifier, chances are your wins are not going to be all that impressive.When compared to other Gigablox games Yggdrasil has done, Golden Fish Tank 2 isn't as exhilarating as, say, Hades Gigablox, but it goes for a different angle. Golden Fish Tank 2 offers a nice balance between chilling with nature and finely tuned mathematics. It's certainly a much higher performer than the first one. If you haven't played the original or haven't played it for a while, it'll be a shock to see the game advertising wins of up to x300. Perhaps this was no big deal back in 2016 when Golden Fish Tank was first released, but it seems bizarrely quaint when compared to Golden Fish Tank 2's stated 5,000x max win figure.The original was a huge success with its, at the time, cutting edge technology, design and features, so our expectations were high. Golden Fish Tank 2 is a neatly designed sequel, which integrates Gigablox like it was meant to be, yet there is a lingering feeling that the producers could have tried a wee bit harder.

Title: Crystal Prince
review: Crystal Prince: Slot OverviewPlayers after a slot to celebrate the festive season, but who aren't into the religious thing, nor the Coca Cola rep in the red suit, can thank Quickspin for coming up with an alternative option. The Swedish developer has dug deep into its Nordic roots to find inspiration for Crystal Prince, a wintery slot based on Scandinavian folklore that avoids the narrower band of appeal most Christmas slots find themselves wedged into. Don't be too caught up in the gentle charm though. This rather volatile cracker can pop at any moment. Fortunately, its potential rewards aren’t the cheap plastic knickknack kind that breaks 3 seconds later.Crystal Prince - free spins with expanded win waysThe action takes place on a 6x8 sized grid made up of 48 individual tiles onto which 4 rows of symbols are dropped into play on each new spin. There are plenty of empty positions above the rows though, indicating the game’s ability to expand quite drastically as you will learn. At first glance, Crystal Prince is not one of Quickspin's most intricate-looking games. The sparse visuals mix well with the soundtrack though, which is one of the most soothing you'll come across - like an auditory representation of a snowflake falling gently to the ground. The mix sets a relaxed and almost magical atmosphere. Gameplay wise, Crystal Prince sort of falls into the same category as Quickspin's Glyph slots, namely Golden Glyph and Ghost Glyph.Players can enter the frozen realms of the Crystal Prince on any device by selecting stakes starting at 20 p/c, rising to $/€100 per spin. Try not to let the soundtrack pacify you into a false sense of security because the rather high (4/5) volatility can bite like a northerly wind. It can also potentially lead to surprisingly massive hits too which we'll cover in the verdict. In the meantime, a slightly above average RTP rating of 96.04% will have to tie us over until then.It might look a little like a grid slot, but Crystal Prince actually uses a left to right, pay-all-ways system providing a default 4,096 ways to win. Of course, when rows expand, so does the number of win ways. As for the paytable, symbols are split into three types. The low pays consist of four snowflakes in blue, green, yellow, and pink. Mids use the same colour scheme but are crafted as gems, capped by the Prince who makes up the sole high pay symbol. Six of a kind wins are valued at 0.25-0.3x for the lows, 0.5-0.8x for the mids, and up to 2x the bet for six princes.Wilds come in two forms – a standard Wild Frost Wild or Wild Frost Multiplier Wilds. Both substitute for any normal pay symbol while multipliers come with modifiers of x2 or x3. If more than one multiplier is used in a winning combination, the values are multiplied together, rather than added. They also fall in abundance during free spins, covered below.Crystal Prince: Slot Features﻿Crystal Prince has several features to enhance the miniscule value of its symbols. The list includes a snowfall mechanic, a Blizzard Seal, Blizzard Mode, and Free Spins. Each win triggers the snowfall feature, adding a row of new symbols to the grid. Extra rows continue to be awarded as long as new winning combinations land – up to 8. At this height, players get 262,144 ways to win.When the grid reaches 8 rows high in a sequence, the Blizzard Seal is broken. When this happens, 1-3 Wild Frost Multiplier Wilds are randomly added, also activating Blizzard Mode.In Blizzard Mode, winning symbols, plus any wilds, scatters, or high symbols are kept, while all others are removed, letting the remaining symbols tumble to the bottom of the grid. Extra symbols cascade down to fill the gaps, possibly leading to more wins. Blizzard Mode remains in effect as long as there are extra winning combinations.The final symbol of note is the oversized blue snowflake scatter. It lands anywhere, awarding 8, 10, 15, or 20 free spins when 3, 4, 5, or 6 are in view respectively. Before each free spin, 1 to 4 Wild Frost Multiplier Wilds or Wild Frost Wilds are added to the grid. Moreover, during the feature, two scatters on the board awards 3 extra free spins.The final extra, which is jurisdiction dependent, is the bonus buy feature. For the relatively reasonable cost of 60 times the bet, 3 to 6 scatter symbols land on the next spin. Accessing the bonus this way also attracts a higher RTP rating of 96.52%.Crystal Prince: Slot VerdictQuickspin's stated aim when designing Crystal Prince was to 'create a winter game for everyone, whether you celebrate Christmas or not', and it has certainly met that objective - a decision, both open minded and business savvy. Title: Mount M

Expanded reels do not reset between free spins.Mount M slot - free spinsMount M: Slot VerdictThere must be something about wild beasts which motivates Play'n GO to go large, as Mount M follows in the footsteps of 24K Dragon, a slot that shares a lot of the same characteristics. They're different enough not to be a straight reskin, but much of 24K Dragon's structure has been dusted off and reused in a differently presented game. Presentation is one of Mount M's strong points, too; Play'n GO has captured the precariousness of an icy age through bleak visuals and an exceptionally bleak soundtrack. At times you may well wonder how the blazes homo sapiens survived the elements and all those dangerous creatures. Thankfully they were a hardy, resourceful bunch.The ingenuity of our ancestors might have been passed down to us in many ways, yet Mount M isn't a hugely innovative slot. As mentioned, Shatter Respins are just 24K Dragon Respins, though they are useful in breaking up the base game. Evolution Free Spins are different to what 24K Dragon had, but they borrow a symbol transformation idea from slots like Pink Elephants. How many studios have done that now? Quite a few, and you can see why. When the upgrades are going your way in Mount M, there's a double whammy of having extra ways plus the removal of lower-paying premium symbols from the reels. Title: Xterminate

One life is consumed when a wild is involved in a win (regardless of how many combinations this might have been). When all lives are consumed, the Charged Wild is removed from the reels.Bet+The Bet+ feature allows players to take on Xterminate in three different ways:Win Boost - the odds of winning are 2 times higher on each spin, and each spin costs 2x the bet. One of the first mood killers was the rather disappointing RTP, triggering questions over whether Thunderkick has joined ELK Studios in a race to the bottom. Here's hoping no. The lack of free spins or a bonus game also gave pause. Not saying one is required to complete a slot, but Xterminate did feel it lacked something along those lines to look forward to. Especially when stuck in a dead spin spiral, chipping out wee wins in between. In a moment of cynicism, perhaps Xterminate was done this way to push its Bet+ options. Maybe not. They are completely optional and give gamblers alternative ways to have a punt should they prefer.Xterminate turned into a race to see if it could crank out its Xterminate Multiplier feature. To be clear, you don't hit a scatter win and reap the monetary benefits directly the way a 'normal' slot might do. Instead, a sort of back-and-forth exponential process happens between scatter win values and the Xterminate Multiplier Feature, paying out the total when Avalanching ends. It's different, for sure, and you can imagine the absolute trip a massive win run would instigate. Like the warning sign at the start of the game lays down, though, Xterminate is highly volatile, so the race between scoring a big Xterminate Multiplier value and running out of dough could end in tears. However, it is also quite innovative, and the temptation to try one more spin to see if it'll spark a snowballing process is tangible, making Xterminate an interesting alternative, just a highly volatile one with a weak RTP that might end up causing damage like a well-placed baton strike.

It failed to touch our hearts, though, it must be said. Perhaps if these sorts of games weren't flying off iSoftBet's production line like a hail of ninja stars, it wouldn't be so bad. Whatever the case, 4ThePlayer is undoubtedly a provider we will be keeping an eye on for sure.Don't MissBe sure to check out 90k Yeti Gigablox as well which is powered by Yggdrasil's Gigablox mechanic. Title: Big Bamboo
review: Big Bamboo: Slot OverviewSoftware provider Push Gaming has built a well-deserved reputation for crafting brutal slots, and what could be more brutal than a well-fed, well-rested, big, adorable panda bear? What wait? Don't worry; Push Gaming isn't catering to a gentler corner of the market. Big Bamboo is another ruthless slot with massive risk/reward going on. It just happens to look cute. Beneath the sleepy, meditative outer shell is an unforgiving game full of mystery symbols, instant coin prizes, and free spins with symbol conversions.You know, bamboo can actually get quite big, as some of the tallest specimens reach 30m in height. Those sorts of bamboo trees don't make a panda's diet, though, as the animals prefer to eat leaves, shoots, or stems. However, a game called Averagely Sized Stems probably wouldn't have the same ring. It's to this world of towering bamboo plants we are thrust in Big Bamboo, which has a simple green, glowy background, almost mystical, while a 5-reel, 6-row game grid sits in the middle. There's a minimalist zen quality to the visuals, which feels slightly Hacksaw Gaming-ish, with smatterings of Razor Shark going on in the features.Playable across all devices from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin, Big Bamboo is a highly volatile game that was initially tough to gain much traction with. Four feature buys and a gamble feature means a multitude of RTP values, with the default figure weighing in at 96.13%. When buying features, the respective return values are clearly displayed, so players know what they are signing up for.Snaking their way across the game panel are 50 fixed paylines to land winning combinations on. At least three of a kind are needed to trigger a win, except for the top-paying panda, which needs just two. The panda is joined by boars, monkeys, and birds for the high pays, worth 12-150x the bet for five of a kind. Beneath them are diamonds, spades, hearts, and clubs, all paying 0.4 times the stake for a five-symbol hit. Wilds appear on all reels to substitute any paying symbols, and wild combinations are worth the same as the panda.Big Bamboo: Slot Features﻿Big Bamboo has quite a lot of extra bits to go over, much of them recognisable from elsewhere but brought together and given their own flavour.Mystery Bamboo SymbolsMystery Bamboo symbols can land anywhere on the reels in the base or bonus game. When they hit, they transform to reveal pay symbols, which includes wilds or Golden Bamboo symbols.Golden Bamboo FeatureThis is triggered when mystery symbols reveal Golden Bamboo symbols. Each Golden Bamboo Symbol position spins individually, and the following symbols may land:Instant Prize – a bet multiplier worth 1x to 5,000x the bet.Collector – collects the value of all other instant prize symbols or collector symbols in view. The collector remains in place throughout the Golden Bamboo feature while empty positions spin.Multiplier – multipliers of x2-x10 which increase instant prize symbols or collector symbol values.Scatter symbols and gamble scatter symbols can land naturally or be revealed by the Golden Bamboo feature. In the base game, when there are scatters on reels 2 and 3, a gamble scatter may land on reel 4. Gamble scatters spin to reveal one of these outcomes:A blank space – nothing happens.4 to 9 free spins.7 to 9 free spins with 2 low pay symbols converted to Mystery Bamboo Symbols.8 to 10 free spins with all 4 low pay symbols converted to Mystery Bamboo Symbols.Gamble FeatureIf the gamble scatter awarded one of the two lower free spins bonus games, players may gamble to move up a tier. A successful gamble wheel spin advances players, while an unsuccessful spin results in no prize.Free SpinsDuring free spins, when scatters land, they are collected beside the low symbols on a meter next to the reels – each symbol has 4 dots. Filling all 4 dots converts symbols into Mystery Bamboo symbols. In addition, converting the first symbol awards +4 extra free spins, the second and third add +3 more free spins each, while the fourth gives +2 extra free spins. Each converted symbol also awards a multiplier which is applied to wins from the Golden Bamboo feature. Free spins can also be won via the Golden Bamboo feature when symbols displaying +1, +2, or +3 hit.Buy FeatureHit the star icon to buy one of the four bonuses. There are four choices on offer:99x the bet for 7-9 free spins with no converted symbols.179x the bet for 7-9 free spins with 2 converted symbols.608x the bet to 8-10 free spins with 4 converted symbols.300x the bet for a random allocation of free spins and converted symbols.Big Bamboo: Slot VerdictBig Bamboo was a surprisingly non-zen like experience once we began dissecting it. What started out as calm and relaxing quickly devolved into a bout of mental water torture trying to convey the rules on paper. Rest Assured, Big Bamboo makes more sense in action and isn't as fiddly as it might sound. However, it somehow managed to be simultaneously calming and infuriating. The masses of dead spins didn't help.In a nutshell, you want a couple of things to happen. Hitting instant prizes from the Golden Bamboo feature is one, preferably with a multiple in tow. Here's where Razor Shark sort of creeps in, with a tinge of Fat Drac for good measure. Instant prize wins can be huge, as we have seen in Fat Drac max win clips when the bat munches the top prize. Combine the most lucrative instant prize with the top multiplier in Big Bamboo, and you are looking at massive results.The other goal is triggering free spins and converting as many low pays as possible. This then ties into the previous Golden Bamboo feature, theoretically helping your chances of hitting something special since there are converted Mystery Bamboo symbols going around. There are numerous ways to win in Big Bamboo, each one quite intricate, but it won't be easy, and Big Bamboo often has the last laugh. Landing three scatters but not triggering free spins because the Gamble scatter turns up a blank space can hurt. Of course, there is a positive flipside to the meanness, and Big Bamboo comes with a tremendous win cap of 50,000x the bet.A big number, and there is smart design here for sure, yet it doesn't feel like Big Bamboo is destined for greatness. It has less outrageous replayability than others like Fire Hopper have had, and the compulsion to have one more spin, just to see what will happen, isn't quite as strong. There are no pressing issues, and major wins here would be quite a sight, but it is hard to see Big Bamboo going on to become a Push Gaming classic.

Title: Irish Frenzy

The latter is the most valuable and gives you 200 times your stake for 5 of a kind.Other than landing a line hit of harps, there's nothing much really going on in the base game which is why we'll move on to the only feature included in the game.Irish Frenzy (Blueprint Gaming): FeaturesKeep an eye out for the pot with the rainbow shooting out of it - this is the scatter symbol which will give you 10, 15 or 20 Free Spins if you land 3, 4 or 5 of them respectively. Title: Canine Carnage
review: Canine Carnage: Slot OverviewProving that slots set in dystopian futures are still hot stuff comes Canine Carnage from Swedish software provider Play'n GO. Canine Carnage is set in a world where doggies appear to have taken over and cruise around in souped-up vehicles while listening to throbbing techno. Sounds a little bit (or a lot) like ELK Studios' Nitropolis concept? Yeah, we got that impression, too, along with a bunch of other references as well. That might have been more of an issue if the rest of Canine Carnage hadn't been so well designed. As it stands, Canine Carnage actually has some pretty exciting entertainment to offer the right punter; let's check it out.The game starts with a monstrous vehicle careening through the desert, rolling into a junkyard like the locomotive from Cash Truck or Money Train 3. Play'n GO has gone to town with the pixels to create a bizarro world of canines, some of which look part cyborg, and vehicles cobbled together with whatever parts could be salvaged from the scrap heap. An all-over-the-place dance track makes the perfect accompaniment to the messed-up world players find themselves thrust into, and the game makes the sort of first impression where we kind of couldn't wait to see what happens next.Canine Carnage slot - base gameCanine Carnage is played on a 5-reel, 3-row matrix where ways to win start at 243 but expand when symbols start getting split. It's a medium volatile slot, playable on any device while offering bets of 10 p/c to $/€100 per paid game round. To win, payouts are triggered when adjacent matching symbols land from left to right, starting from the first reel onwards.As for symbols, 10-A card rank tiles appear as the low pay group, all awarding 0.4x the bet for a five-of-a-kind win. Next, we get four futuristic canine characters as the high pays, worth 1.2 to 3 times the bet for five-of-a-kind. Another symbol is the flaming-eyed skull wild, appearing on all five reels. Wilds substitute for all pay symbols and are worth up to 5 times the stake for a five wild symbol winning way.Canine Carnage: Slot FeaturesCanine Carnage slot - Bone Spins splash screenAh, one more thing about the wild. Wilds are sometimes referred to in the game as Splitter Wilds. This is because when they hit, they split certain symbols to the right of them in the same row into two. Royals, characters, Golden Bones, and wilds can be split. Collectors, scatters, or multipliers cannot be split. It is also possible for 1-3 wilds to be added to the grid at random.MultiplierMultiplier symbols can hit on any spin or be randomly added to the grid. They come in values of x2, x3, or x5 and all wins are multiplied when multipliers are in view. If more than one multiplier is present on the reels, the values are added together before they are applied to any wins.Golden Bones and Instant PrizesGolden Bones can land anywhere on the grid and display a cash prize when they do – their maximum value is 5x the bet. Also, 3-6 Golden Bones can randomly be added to the reels. If Golden Bones land at the same time as a Collector symbol, their values are awarded to the player.Bone SpinsLanding 3 flaming petrol can scatters in view triggers 6 Bone Spins. During Bone Spins, regular pay symbols are removed from the reels. Now, when Golden Bones land, their values are instantly awarded, plus they are added to the Cash Pot above the reels. When the Collector symbol lands, whatever is in the Cash Pot is awarded. In addition, on each Bone Spin, 1-3 features can be active, such as 3-6 Golden Bones being added to the grid. Multipliers may appear, and these are accumulated throughout the feature. Whenever the Collector hits and the Cash Pot is awarded, the accumulated multiplier is applied to its value. Lastly, it is possible Splitter symbols land as well. These split any Golden Bones that land on the same row to the right, doubling their value. 1-3 Splitter symbols may be added to the grid.Canine Carnage slot - Bone SpinsCanine Carnage: Slot VerdictCanine Carnage blasted onto the screen and never let up until the review was done. It's a mash-up of series, slots, and features such as the Nitropolis range, the Money Train games, a bit of Top Dawg$, with a sprinkling of Nolimit City's xMechanics chucked in for good measure. Such a melting pot of components might have gotten messy, but Play'n GO has flexed its world-building talents to paint a visual and sonic feast that requires little effort to slip into.What Canine Carnage does with its features and gameplay isn't bad either. There's a fast flow and features trigger quite often, but this is a different sort of ride to those offered by the heavyweight slots it kind of resembles. When you get used to the thrillingly ravaged world of the canine dystopia, the gameplay might not feel quite so hard-hitting by comparison. The base game has a good pace to it, though, with plenty of Golden Bone collects and frequent symbol slicing. Free spins are quite inventive as well, in a way. Nothing paradigm shifting like a Money Train 2 event, but there's more going on in Bone Spins than just a regular hold 'n win sequence of events. The outstanding audio-visuals really save the day because had they been weaker, then the gameplay probably wouldn't have felt half as good. The RTP also seems fairly evenly distributed with frequent decent hits in the base game and with most bonuses paying around 50-150x.That brings us to what is potentially Canine Carnage's biggest bummer. Despite the colossal number of possible ways to win and the multipliers, it was a surprise to see a max win figure of 3,000x the bet. Dunno, it just didn't sit right, what with all the talk of carnage, the ways, the flames, the razor discs, and the overall excellent Mad Max meets doggies presentation. Leaving aside the possibly disappointing max winning potential, Canine Carnage was quite a fun game to play. Play'n GO might have found inspiration in numerous places, but if so, it's picked some excellent things to be inspired by. And Canine Carnage is by no means a copycat slot. Along with the possible inspo, the studio has added a few new ingredients of their own, then wrapped it all up in one outstanding package that looks, sounds, and plays like a charm.

Title: Strawberry Cocktail

If the highlighted cell shows a symbol that is present on the mini reel, a reward is paid.Each diamond, club, heart, spade, green drink, yellow drink, or pink drink is worth 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x, 20x, 30x, or 50x the bet, respectively. In addition, if the highlighted cell symbol is present twice on the mini reel, the win is multiplied by x3, or if it appears on all 3 positions on the mini reel, the win is multiplied by x10. The round also has a general multiplier that applies to all wins, starting on x1. After every 4 spins, the multiplier is doubled. The round continues like this until an Exit sign is highlighted, ending the bonus. If the round started with 3, 4, or 5 scatters on the triggering spin, there are 4, 3, or 1 Exit signs on the board.Buy Free SpinsPlayers may buy free spins from the base game for 60x, 200x, or 600x the bet to trigger the round with 3, 4, or 5 scatters, respectively. The RTP remains the same when buying free spins as when not.Strawberry Cocktail slot - bonus buy menuStrawberry Cocktail: Slot VerdictStrawberry Cocktail is pretty much the definition of a game of two halves. Oftentimes, a Pragmatic Play slot teases with a slot's main feature in the base game before lifting the brakes and letting it really flaunt its stuff when the bonus round has been activated. Not so, Strawberry Cocktail, which does little in the base game except tease with its 1 (2 if you count the wild) mega high pay symbol. Hopefully, you like the beach scene and the beats if you're going to grind your way through the main game till the bonus round trips the on switch.Or you can buy it, of course, but the upper, more desirable option is quite steep for a Pragmatic Play release. Hitting 5 scatters instead of 3 makes a big difference, though, since there is one-quarter the number of Exit signs on the board. Also, an internal debate raged over whether it would have been better to have a regular set number of free spins instead of using Exit signs to shut the round down. Theoretically, using Exit signs is better if the round drags on longer, but a pain if the highlighter jumps quickly to an Exit. Swings and roundabouts, sure. Still, the action gets pretty tense when the highlighter moves near an Exit sign. It's like playing Monopoly where your opponent has hotels on the two dark blue streets (Mayfair and Park Lane on the UK version, e.g.), and clenching your butt as you either safely roll past them with your bankroll intact or land on one and take a hit.Monopoly can go the other way, though, and if the dice are playing ball, it could be you who ends up with hotels on the swanky streets. Certainly, it's a number which adds heft to a game that might be a little too weird or swingy for some tastes, or the ideal fantasy destination for others.

Title: Plenty of Presents

The four higher value symbols are worth payouts of 3 to 8 times the stake for landing a full winning line of matching symbols. Lastly, we've got a wild symbol, landing on reels 2, 3, or 4 to substitute for anything except special money symbols, covered below.Bounty Gold: Slot FeaturesWell, there's nothing in the base game to raise Bounty Gold's tempo, and the only feature is a money respin round. Landing 6 or more money symbols triggers this feature which moves the action away from the base game to a screen covered in four 5x3 matrices. One is active, while the other three are locked to start with.Once underway, 3 respins are awarded, and money symbols stick in position when they land while resetting the number of spins back to 3. Opening up the other grid matrices is a case of landing as many money symbols as possible. If a total of 9, 18, or 26 money symbols hit, then the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th matrices are unlocked.As another sweetener, filling all positions on a single matrix awards a jackpot. So, filling grid numbers 1, 2, 3, or 4 awards a jackpot worth 25x, 50x, 500x, or 5,000x the bet, respectively. Wait, there's more; grids 2, 3, and 4 also have a multiplier of x2, x3, and x4. All values collected on these grids are increased by the applicable multiplier. However, if a total of 44 money symbols hit, a x5 multiplier is applied to all money symbols, but the other multipliers will not be applied.Bounty Gold: Slot VerdictGoing West often signifies one of two things. Either a developer has fallen for the romance of the Wild West and wants to contribute something of themselves to the illustrious genre, or they've just plum run out of ideas. Bounty Gold feels like the second scenario applies as it really hasn't stretched Pragmatic Play's design capabilities. It looks average, plays average, and any theme could have been used to colour the action, activity, or whatever you want to call the gameplay. The Wild West is one of the most popular go-to's in slot development. Like a favourite hoodie, it pretty much goes with anything, it's reassuringly comforting, yet it can also come across as a beat-up, baggy, safe option.The West remains a strong crowd-pleaser, and if a studio has got something special to offer, by all means, bring it on, but Bounty Gold is not one of those slots. The base game is a literal placeholder to slap players around a bit until free spins trigger, which happened at a surprisingly low frequency. Once you're in, the bonus game is a basic streak respin feature, just one played out on up to four matrices, Eye of Horus Power 4 Slots style. There are no special symbols, yet admittedly, the jackpots are something, as are multipliers if you can unlock them. During the review, opening 2 matrices was pretty much a given; getting to three or the mythical four-level will require a healthy dose of luck. More than what we were allotted, sad to say, pardner. However, if luck is running hot, players can collect payouts up to a win cap of 5,000x the bet. This amount is instantly awarded when filling the fourth bonus matrix; hard to see it happening otherwise.If you've played every other Western-themed slot or streak respin powered game out there and are hankering for an acceptable, though far from great, fix, Bounty Gold might be alright for wiling away some time before something better comes along. That probably won't take too long since Bounty Gold is a pretty bland slot all told and far from Pragmatic Play's best work.

Title: Royal Dragon Infinity Reels
review: Royal Dragon Infinity Reels: Slot OverviewAsian themed slot Royal Dragon Infinity Reels comes courtesy of GamesLab, an independent Australian outfit that’s been churning out slots since 2002. They have largely avoided making major ripples in the industry, but are things about to change? They’ve leapt into bed with fellow countrymen ReelPlay, licensing their Infinity Reels mechanic which has been utilised by several studios as of recent. GamesLab has taken the cautious road by choosing a safe theme and recycled many of the standard features typically associated with the mechanic. It’s a move unlikely to break it out of relative obscurity and make a bigger impact, though the game might appeal to certain fans of this style.A rather handsome mountainous image has been used to colour the scene, the background scrolling as Infinity Reels are added to the grid. The more reels you add, the more of the scenery you get to enjoy as wins build up. Play starts on a 3-reel, 4-row default mode, where five matching symbols left to right trigger a win. If for whatever reason the mountains at sunset image, or the clichéd symbols weren’t big enough clues, the guzheng heavy soundtrack leaves no doubt you are in the heart of Asia. It’s all rather pretty, if a bit generic at the same time.Royal Dragon Infinity Reels is released via Yggdrasil’s Masters Program which is a collaborative program that allows smaller independent studios to release games via their platform, and which gives them greater reach. As is usually the case with Yggdrasil, we get quite a comprehensive game sheet. First on the block is RTP where the default value is 95.85%, rising to 96.2% when the feature buy is engaged. Volatility has been tuned to a high setting, coupled with unexciting non-gamble potential. Despite there being a jackpot in the main game, it’s free spins where best wins are possible, and triggering them occurs once every 150 spins, theoretically. Regular wins, meanwhile, occur around one in three spins, or 33.48% of the time.They might have a bit more shimmer than usual, but the symbols used are all classic icons. The first four on the table are card suits – spades, clubs, hearts, and diamonds. Asian culture steps in for the higher paying lotus, lantern, frog, koi, lion, and phoenix symbols. Winning combinations are calculated by the number of participating symbols multiplied by their value. As in indication, five of the picture symbols are worth payouts of 0.33 to 1.33x the stake. A golden glowing dragon wild completes the table, substituting for all symbols except the gong.Royal Dragon Infinity Reels: Slot FeaturesRoyal Dragon Infinity Reels - free spinsAs mentioned previously, five or more matching symbols from the leftmost reel constitute a winning combination. If the third reel is used in the win, a new reel is added to the right-hand side. If any new symbols improve the current win, another reel is added – until new symbols do not add to the win. Then, the reels reset for the next spin. This is the core function of the Infinity Reels mechanic.While this is going on, a symbol multiplier is in play. It starts at x1 and increases when a new reel is added, with no upper limit. In the base game the symbol multiplier increments by 1, in free spins it may be more.To keep things spicy, any base game spin may randomly activate a frenzy spin. When active, a multiplier of x2, x3, x4, or x5 is added to the symbol multiplier and applied to that spin.Adding reels to the grid doesn’t just happen for your health, there is an added incentive for doing so. Should 12 or more reels be added in a sequence, a jackpot prize of 200x the total bet is awarded on top of any regular symbol win. Symbol multipliers are not applied to jackpot wins, but frenzy spin multipliers are.To trigger free spins you’ll need the gong symbol. Gongs pay from any position, and any five or more of a kind gong win triggers 7 free spins – plus 1 free spin for every triggering symbol above 5. During free spins, any gong win awards an extra 2 free spins. During this round, the same multiplier increment system found in Giza Infinity Reels is used here as well. On a winning spin, the symbol multiplier increment increases by 1, up to 5 at the most. Consequently, non-winning spins drop the increment by 1 to a minimum of 1. Symbol multipliers do not reset between free spins.When free spins conclude, it doesn’t mean the thrills are necessarily over. If you’re feeling lucky, you can gamble your winnings - up to 5x the original value. The minimum you’ll walk away with if things don’t go your way is half of the free spins winnings.Lastly, Royal Dragon Infinity Reels may offer a feature buy. It costs 66.67x the total stake, and for that you get 9 free spins plus a starting symbol multiplier of 1x to 5x.Royal Dragon Infinity Reels: Slot VerdictDespite being a fairly good looking game, Royal Dragon Infinity Reels is very much a paint by numbers exercise. ReelPlay has supplied the machinery and much of the features, GamesLab supplies the artwork - everyone’s happy. Well, players heavily invested in the Asian thing will be at least. Others will be a little nonplussed at getting the same old features and setup, not to mention a set of unappealing numbers.Potential could have swooped in to restore Royal Dragon Infinity Reels from the recycle bin, but unless you’re willing to lay it all on the line, payouts are meagre. During regular play, the most you can win is 2,652x the stake. This can technically be boosted to 10,000x via the gamble feature, yet this is asking a lot of players. Not everyone wants to risk a decent win to get the most out of a game, so the modest potential doesn’t do any favours.Royal Dragon Infinity Reels might be an okay game for hardcore gamers on the Asian scene, provided they are willing to overlook mediocre potential. Other than that, Royal Dragon Infinity Reels doesn’t advance the mechanic or offer anything new so is unlikely to make much of an impression.

Title: Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster
review: Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster: Slot OverviewYear-round riches… What a thought, if only we could click our fingers like Thanos wiping out half of all life in the universe and make it so. Back to reality now, where Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster is the name of an online slot from software provider Red Tiger. This mouthful of a titled game is the fourth in Red Tiger's Clusterbuster series of slots, which have so far revolved around busting or activating positions at the centre of their large grids to trigger various goodies. Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster keeps this tradition going and is accompanied by 4 season-related reel modifiers, free spins, and a duo of feature buys.Of the four games in the range so far, Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster is arguably the most relaxingly meditative. The background artwork is tastefully designed, all four seasons blending into one, bringing to mind a soothing Japanese woodblock print or the art of Alphonse Mucha. This got the game off to a positive start, boosted after finding out the four seasons concept had been incorporated with the features, as well. It's rather artistically original. Will the good will continue once the reels start spinning?Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster slot - base gameSpeaking of reels, Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster has a colossal 10 by 10 grid setup, with 91 active symbols landing on the board with each press of the spin button. The reason 100 symbols don't hit is that an inactive 3x3 block sits in the middle of the grid, which can trigger features when wins occur next to it in certain ways. To form a win, at least 5 matching symbols must land, connected to each other in horizontal or vertical directions. The cascade mechanic then removes winning symbols, replacing them with symbols tumbling from above. Tumbles will continue to occur like this until no new win is created. Driving the action behind the scenes is a medium volatile math model with a theoretical return to player of 95.74%, or 95.73%, when buying the features. When choosing a stake, the options are 10 p/c to $/€4 per spin.Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster splits the pay table into low-pay 10-A card royals and high-pay season symbols – winter, autumn, spring, and summer. Hitting a 5 OAK cluster pays out 0.1 to 1.5 times the bet, rising as high as 10 to 250 times the bet for a 35+ size cluster. Wilds, when they appear on the board, are used to substitute for any regular paying symbol.Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster: Slot FeaturesYear-Round Riches Clusterbuster slot - free spinsThe Clusterbuster is a 3x3 inactive block in the middle of the reels. Wins next to the Clusterbuster destroy the adjacent outer positions. The outer positions on the Clusterbuster are divided into 4 sectors representing the 4 seasons of the year – Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter. During spins, one of those sectors may become active. Then, breaking all the outer positions belonging to the active season triggers its corresponding feature:Spring – reveals a random multiplier of x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20, x25, x30, x50, x80, or x100. Multipliers are applied to all wins on the current spin.Summer – releases a wave over the reels, which transforms random non-winning symbols into the same random symbol.Autumn – causes leaves to fall over the symbols. The leaves transform into wilds.Winter – snowballs are pelted at the gaming grid, hitting random symbols. Then, an ice crack moves across the grid, starting from the hit symbols over a random number of non-winning symbols. All symbols the crack passes over transform into the initially hit symbols.Free SpinsWhenever all outer positions on the Clusterbuster are broken, 10 free spins are granted. On each free spin, at least one random season will be active on the Clusterbuster and up to 4 seasons can be active initially at the start of the same spin. If more than one Season feature is activated, they play in this order – Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter. Destroying all positions on the Clusterbuster triggers +7 additional free spins.Bonus BuyYear-Round Riches Clusterbuster's feature buy menu offers two options. These are a spin with a random Season feature for 15x the bet or free spins for 50x the bet.Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster slot - free spinsYear-Round Riches Clusterbuster: Slot VerdictIf you've played one of the previous Clusterbuster slots, you'll have a fair idea of how Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster functions too. All are played on massive gaming grids and have destroying or activating the Clusterbuster positions in the centre as one of their main objectives. Around this idea, each game has a variety of side features or modifiers, presented using a diverse range of themes. Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster is one of if not the most originally presented of the current quartet of Clusterbuster slots giving players a unique environment to inhabit while trying their fortune. Equally clever is the way the game's maker has paired a feature with each of the year's four seasons.Triggering one of the four features in the base game was by no means an every-spin event but did occur quite frequently. Leaves and snowballs seemed to be the most common, followed by Summer's tidal wave, then multipliers. Those multipliers might come in handy, too, since clusters don't have the greatest values until reaching the higher tiers. For example, a 15-19 symbol cluster made up of the highest paying symbol is worth a measly 5 times the bet. Still, Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster can bring its seasons and symbols together to turn out shocking results, as attested by its 20,482.1x the bet max win.What's up with Red Tiger of late? This one's got big potential, Judgement Day stunned with a 100,000x max win, and not long before that, Sugar Monster came along with another 10k+ top prize. It's like the studio is leaning more heavily on the higher potential segment of the market at the moment, though it still drops slots like Here Kitty Kitty, which cater for the opposite end of the spectrum. All in all, Year-Round Riches Clusterbuster adds weight to the Clusterbuster range while doing so in a stylishly artistic way.

Title: Chronicles of Olympus II
review: Chronicles of Olympus II - Hades: Slot OverviewGames Global partner Alchemy Gaming has extended its Chronicles of Olympus series with a third release titled Chronicles of Olympus II – Hades. This one follows closely to the previous one, Chronicles of Olympus II – Zeus, offering a lot of the same features and whatnot, with the exception of a new Diamond X-Up symbol. The rest hasn't changed much, so the aim of the game remains trying to score a multiplier as high as the slot will allow before taking it into free spins, where it can be used to boost wins.Naturally, since we're dealing with Hades instead of Zeus this time, the visuals have had a switch-up. The quality remains high, though, which is reassuring and like its predecessor, Chronicles of Olympus II – Hades is a handsome release. Greek mythology might be as common as it gets in the slot industry, but Alchemy Gaming goes to show it can still be used to make a strong impression when handled just so. Chronicles of Olympus II – Hades' background is a hot, sparking, rocky realm, while the character symbols are like little works of art in their own right. The music is suitably dramatic, helping create a scene that mythology buffs should be well pleased with.Chronicles of Olympus II slot - base gameLittle has changed regarding the statistical and mechanical side of Chronicles of Olympus II – Hades. For one, it's played on the same 5-reel, 1,024 ways to win gaming panel that was used in the previous Chronicle of Olympus slot – the first game made do with a 5x3, 243 ways matrix, for the record. As before, Chronicles of Olympus II - Hades is a highly volatile slot, though the default RTP has decreased slightly to 96.05%. Players may wager 20 c to $/€50 per spin and hits on the default RTP model occur at a rate of 25.33%.Chronicles of Olympus II – Hades uses ways to win, not paylines, so matching symbols landing from the leftmost side of the grid on at least 3 consecutive reels triggers a payout. The value of hitting a 5 symbol low pay 10-A win is 0.8 to 1.2 times the bet, or 1.6 to 4 times the bet for hitting 5 matching high pay character symbols, of which there are 5 kinds. Or, wilds may be used to substitute any regular pay symbol, and individual wilds in a winning combination can each add an x2, x3, or x5 win multiplier.Chronicles of Olympus II - Hades: Slot FeaturesChronicles of Olympus II slot - Diamond XupIn its tool kit of extras, Chronicles of Olympus II – Hades has got the X-Up feature, free spins, Upsizer, and a bonus buy.ScattersRed scatters appear on all reels in the base game, as well as the leftmost and rightmost reels in free spins. Blue scatters appear on the leftmost and rightmost reels in the base game but not in free spins, while diamond scatters appear on the leftmost and rightmost reels in both phases of the game.X-UpNext to the reels is a list of multiplier values on the X-Up Trail, and one of the multipliers will be highlighted as the current one. When 2 red scatters land, players collect 1 X-Up token. Collecting these tokens activates higher multiplier values on the X-Up Trail. Hitting 2 blue scatters in the base game permanently upgrades one X-Up multiplier level, starting from the top of the X-Up Trail. When the X-Up Trail has been entirely turned blue, any 2 blue scatters will finally double the top-level multiplier again to x25. Chronicles of Olympus II – Hades has a new diamond scatter, as well. Hitting 2 diamond scatters in the base game triggers free spins and awards the current highest X-Up multiplier.Free SpinsAlternatively, hitting 3, 4, or 5 red scatters in the base game awards 8 free spins with the active X-Up multiplier – plus a payout of 2x, 20x, or 100x the bet, respectively. During free spins, landing 2 red scatters awards +2 free spins plus 1 X-Up token. Hitting 2 diamond scatters in the round awards the top-level X-Up multiplier plus 2 additional free spins. Collected X-Up tokens are reset at the completion of free spins, and X-Up tokens cannot be collected when the highest free spins multiplier is active.UpsizerWhen free spins trigger, players can elect to activate a higher free spins multiplier for a calculated cost. Any collected X-Up tokens reduce the cost of upgrading the free spins multiplier.Buy BonusPlayers may buy the free spins round with an x25 multiplier for the cost of 200 times the bet. When buying free spins, X-Up tokens cannot be collected.Chronicles of Olympus II slot - free spinsChronicles of Olympus II - Hades: Slot VerdictChronicles of Olympus II - Hades is like one of those business-as-usual slots where the studio has found its groove and is coasting through the sequels. Not to say Chronicles of Olympus II - Hades represents bad coasting. Artwork is an area where Alchemy Gaming is able to shine, and the sounds aren't half bad, either.Chronicles of Olympus II - Hades' gameplay is slightly dimmed shining, though. Not that there is anything untoward here preventing players from having a fun old time if they're into this sort of slot. It's just the features are basically the same as before, stopping innovation junkies from getting a major fix. The new addition is the diamond scatter and being able to win free spins with the current highest multiplier when 2 of them hit. A question mark hangs over how often this might happen, and since the paytable and game docs leave diamond scatter hit frequency information out, the answer is anyone's guess. Ah, well, diamond scatters are there; it's something.Like the last game, what's a little strange about Chronicles of Olympus II - Hades is that the first Chronicles of Olympus X-UP game had an x50 multiplier at the top of its trail and no need for blue scatters to level up. That and winning potential here is 5,000x compared to the original slot's 50,000x, though whether this is pipedream or possibility is a debate for another day. In short, Chronicles of Olympus II - Hades has not hugely progressed beyond the Chronicles of Olympus II - Zeus edition, but when putting niggles aside, it is a fully functioning mythology slot.

Title: Anubis Rising
review: Anubis Rising: Slot OverviewAnubis Rising is an Egyptian-themed online slot from a developer that has shown a lot of love for this part of the world for a while now, Blueprint Gaming. The reason why is that when a wild symbol hits (they appear on reels 2, 3, and 4), they expand to cover the full reel if a winning combination is possible. It is possible to have anywhere from 5 to 0 upgrades active. The possible upgrades include:Tablet Boost – upgrades the lowest value symbol in the order shown on the meter above the grid to the next one along. This can be revealed more than once.Super Wilds – all wilds are converted to Super Wilds. When 1, 2, or 3 Super Wilds hit, players get an extra 2, 6, or 10 free spins, respectively.Extra Wilds – extra wilds are added to the reels for the free spins round.Gold Anubis Wild – these wilds apply multipliers of x2, x3, x4, x5, or x10 to any wins it helps create. If more than one Gold Anubis is part of a win, their multipliers are added.Pyramid – awards 2 to 5 extra free spins.Free SpinsAs well as possibly getting the upgrades already mentioned, when a wild symbol lands on the reels in free spins, it upgrades the symbols on the meter above the grid. This is a slot that echoes a number of games the studio has released in the past, from the Eye of Horus range with the expanding wilds and symbol upgrade dimension to the pre-feature upgrade picks such as, gosh, which one to choose? How about Crabbin' For Cash Megaways, which comes with a similar Pick A Crustacean phase? Such is Blueprint Gaming's way of grafting together bits and bobs from all over the place to create a 'new' release.Quotations were used there since Anubis Rising is hardly a 'new' game in many respects. However, while innovation junkies might be excluded, therein lies the possible appeal for some gamblers, perhaps, those who like to go into a slot with a solid idea of what to expect. In Anubis Rising's case, that means a pretty dull base game but a free spins bonus, which might turn out to be quite neat, depending in part on how many upgrades you can nab at the start of the feature and how much symbol upgrading you can manage when it's in action. Anubis Rising's features are such that should it play ball, the upgrading, expanding, and multiplier concoction has the power to turn out pretty swell results.Not massively chonky results, by Blueprint Gaming standards, as the win cap given in the paytable is 5,000x the bet. Title: Sizzling Spins

Title: Gold Money Frog
review: Gold Money Frog (NetEnt): OverviewBack in 2007, NetEnt released a cute wee slot called Super Lucky Frog which had the distinction of being one of their first progressive jackpots. These are comprised of a kite, a bridge, an owl, and the gold frog which is worth 20 times the stake for five. Of course, it is easy to skip that step sometimes and dive right in. Gold Money Frog is a reminder of why that isn't such a great idea. Case in point, the RTP is a truly awful 92.31% - 92.96%. Gold Money Frog is one that manages to defy this. What situation would suit playing Gold Money Frog? No idea. It is hard to think of one good reason to play it. Title: Santa's Stack Dream Drop
review: Santa's Stack Dream Drop: Slot OverviewRemember the story of King Midas, the guy who turned everything he touched into gold? Sometimes it feels like there's a similar thing going on at Relax Gaming HQ, where instead of turning things to gold, every game they touch winds up with a Dream Drop upgrade. We jest, and in many ways, this process is a lucrative upgrade since Dream Drop is the name for Relax Gaming's progressive Jackpot network with a possible upper limit of €10 million. Some games in the range are new, while others are remakes, such as Santa's Stack Dream Drop, which, as well as having four Jackpots, comes with a Secret Santa Respin feature and free spins with guaranteed wilds.Santa's Stack Dream Drop is a cluster-paying slot played on an 8x8 grid and is quite the 8-Bit winter wonderland. It's set in a quiet town square in the middle of the Christmas period as flakes of snow drift lazily to a cobble-stoned ground. Players get a Santa's sleigh eye view of the surroundings, and when combined with the graphical style, it kind of feels like you're playing something like SimCity or the Sims while bashing away on the play button. The sprites on the reels are equally cute, and the whole scene oozes old-school charm.Santa's Stack Dream Drop slot - base gameNeedless to say, in some cute-looking slots, the cuteness is only skin deep. This assessment applies to Santa's Stack Dream Drop as it is a highly volatile game which can hit pretty lofty highs or lows, even outside the Jackpots. The RTP has taken a hit from the original game due to the Jackpot association, now coming in at an even 94%, which is a typical figure for a Dream Drop slot. As an effect of this, the free spins frequency has been lowered as well. Bigger bets have a greater chance of triggering a Jackpot, and the options are 20 p/c to $/€50 per spin.As a cluster paying slot, regular wins are created when at least five matching symbols land next to each other in vertical or horizontally adjacent spaces. The three low pays are blue, green, and red light bulbs, while the four highs are Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer, an elf, Mrs Claus, and Santa. Hitting a five-of-a-kind cluster pays 0.2x the bet for the bulbs or 0.5-1x the bet for the premiums, rising to a maximum of 750-1,250x for 60+ low pays, or a whopping 2,000-10,000x the bet for 60+ premium symbols. When wild symbols appear, they substitute for all pay symbols on the grid.Santa's Stack Dream Drop: Slot FeaturesSanta’s Stack Dream Drop slot - paytable info free spinsComplimenting the big cluster values is a Secret Santa Re-Spin feature, free spins, and the Dream Drop Jackpots.Secret Santa Re-Spin FeatureWhen a wild symbol is used as part of a winning cluster, the Secret Santa Re-Spin feature is triggered. The winning cluster is converted to mystery symbols, and a re-spin is awarded with the mystery symbols locked in place. Each time a win occurs next to the previously created mystery symbols, the new winning cluster is also converted into mystery symbols. If mystery symbols surround an area where a win cannot land, the area will convert to mystery symbols. When no new winning clusters land next to mystery symbols or with wild symbols, re-spins end and all mystery symbols reveal the same pay symbol.Free SpinsFree spins are awarded when 3 or more scatter symbols land on the reels. A total of 5 free spins are awarded for 3 scatter symbols, plus 1 extra spin for each additional scatter symbol in view. Secret Santa Re-Spins are active in free spins, and wild symbols are guaranteed to hit at the start of each free spin. The number of guaranteed wilds increases by +1 with each spin. On the first spin, one wild hits. When the red, blue, or red and blue scatter symbols land on a free spin, they award either +1 free spin, +1 multiplier, or +1 free spin and +1 multiplier, respectively.Dream Drop BonusBefore any normal spin, the Dream Drop Bonus can trigger randomly. When activated, 15 gift boxes appear on the screen. Players click boxes until 3 of the same Jackpots are revealed, and then its corresponding prize is awarded. This could be the Rapid, Midi, Maxi, Major, or Mega, which has first-time seeds of €1, €5, €100, €25,000, or €500,000, respectively, though the actual amount could be greater than this. Current prize values are clearly displayed on the screen.Santa's Stack Dream Drop slot - jackpot gameSanta's Stack Dream Drop: Slot VerdictThe original non-Jackpot Santa's Stack was a pleasant Xmas surprise that exuded charm while delivering simple yet compelling gameplay. First of all, the game world had a nifty old-school video game of yesteryear look about it that suited the Christmas theme to a tee. Santa's Stack Dream Drop captures a bunch of the season's magic without finding itself located in a more traditional setting, such as inside beside a roaring fire. Instead, Relax Gaming has chosen to invoke the rosy-red cheeked feel of a bracing winter's night. In short, Santa's Stack Dream Drop presents a neat, cosy space to try your luck in.Then there's the gaming side of things, where Santa's Stack Dream Drop does not disappoint either. Secret Santa Re-Spins have been cleverly designed to be rather thrilling when a number of mystery symbols start piling up on the screen. More so than might have been the case since cluster values are absolutely monstrous at the upper echelons of the paytable. Fair dues, you need quite a lot of matching symbols to reach the upper echelons, but they're there regardless. The 10,000x for 60+ Santa symbols is gargantuan, and landing it with at least an x2 multiplier will hit the non-Jackpot win cap of 20,000x the bet. However, with the free spins frequency having been lowered, actually triggering the bonus can be rather frustrating. Unless you're on a jackpot hunt, you're better of playing the original.Not a bad side goal to shoot for, but being a Dream Drop game means the Mega no doubt remains the main focus. In that regard, players in the mood for a Jackpot slot using a cluster-paying dynamic should find Santa's Stack Dream Drop provides an entertaining, all-bleeping 8-Bit vehicle with which to chase wins down, or try to at least.

Title: Rocky's Gold
review: [smartslider3 slider=648]Rocky’s Gold: OverviewWhat is it with the mining theme at the moment? Like a pesky wall of rock stuffed with dynamite, it's blowing up, with several releases over the past few weeks. As more contenders get in the ring, it's getting harder for each new one to stand out from the bunch. Rocky's Gold from Northern Lights Gaming certainly stands out as a singular performance; unfortunately, not exactly for the right reasons.If you had to sum up this game in one word, it would be clunky. The animations have an awkward quality to them, and a slow pace to match. Rocky himself looks like Larry Laffer in a prospecting outfit, and moves like the character in that Tetka falling body game. If you haven't had the pleasure of playing that one, it's an older Flash game that featured weird physics and a main character who bounced over various obstacles flopping and flapping along the way. Such is the dire nature of Rocky's Gold that it forces you to dig deep in search of appropriate metaphors.Rocky's Gold runs on a 5x3 grid with 20 fixed paylines. The game in this make-believe world is brought to us by the Oresome Mining Company. Get it, Oresome, like ore, or gold. That makes sense. So why the heck are there so many crystals? There is a bit of gold floating around, okay, we can give it that. But if you block out the background, and everything but the grid, it looks like an Asian themed slot with all that red/gold styling, crystals, and calligraphy styled royals.The royals, as usual, take up space at the bottom of the paytable, followed by green, blue and red crystal shards, topped off by the RG logo worth 25 times the stake for five. Stakes can be had for 20 p/c a spin up to $/€100 max. The figures are alright, it's a shame about the woeful delivery system serving them up. RTP sits on a solid 96.54%, and the high volatility is paired with pretty decent potential to be fair.Rocky’s Gold: FeaturesFree spins featureFeatures are in theme, and there are several to contend with. First up is the TNT Bonus which is made up of two symbols, a detonator and a box of dynamite which can appear on reels 3 and 4. As you've might have guessed, when they land side by side, they trigger the TNT bonus. This sees Rocky picking a low-value symbol and changing all incidents of it on the reels into a high-value symbol. This process continues until Rocky blows himself and the TNT symbols away.Rocky sure does like to nuke stuff. He also appears during the Wild Bonus which can trigger at any time on a losing spin. He proceeds to throw three types of dynamite onto reels to turn symbols wild. A single dynamite turns one symbol wild, multiple dynamites turn several symbols wild, and the big stick turns a whole section of symbols wild.Finally there is the Pay Dirt Bonus which revolves around the Pick Me scatter symbol. This is what's on offer:2 scatter symbols -  Triggers the Pick Me Bonus. players select one of the 2 scatter symbols to win either cash prizes or 5 free spins. In the majority of cases, of course, you get a cash prize that is just ridiculous and rarely even gives you your money's worth for the spin.3 scatter symbols - Activates the Pay Dirt Bonus round with 10 free spins.4 scatter symbols - Activates the Pay Dirt Bonus round with 15 free spins.5 scatter symbols  - Activates the Pay Dirt Bonus round with 20 free spins.During the Pay Dirt Bonus round, there is a chance for a reel modifier to be applied to each spin. Below the reels you'll see a conveyor belt carrying rocks out of which some have golden nuggets in them - these rocks add various modifiers onto the reels that can come in the form of wild reels, win multipliers and locked modifiers. How about we deconstruct it from the moment it loads. The opening screen is promising and has a nice scrolling effect that leads into the game. That bit has been done quite well and feels welcoming. Then, the game settles in, and it all slides down the mine shaft. With Rocky’s Gold, the first impression doesn’t last, but the second and third risk tainting your interest in future mining themed slots. Sadly, poor execution has devastated whatever potential the game ever had.It goes to show how powerful the details are. On paper, the game's features sound enticing. In action, the implementation is painful. It comes down to annoying animations, ugly charmless looks, and the sluggish pace in which it all takes place. The overall experience is amateurish and old fashioned.This slapdash approach permeates many aspects of the game. Take the auto spin menu, for instance. It brings back images of the late 90s or early 2000s. It wouldn't be out of place next to Free Cell, Hearts, and Minesweeper as part of the Windows 95 package. We mentioned ok features, but scatters and free spins can take an age to trigger, likely due to all the base game extras. It might be quicker, and more convenient, to invent a time machine, head back to 1849, swim to California and start breaking rocks with your hands in the hope of striking the pay dirt free spins.

Title: Twin Spin Megaways
review: Twin Spin Megaways: Slot OverviewIn a landmark moment, developer NetEnt has produced their very first in-house Megaways driven slot. Whilst we've seen other iconic NetEnt titles get the Megaways makeover, perhaps the most noteworthy so far being Gonzo's Quest Megaways, these have been handled by partner studio Red Tiger. As the saying goes, 'History's about to change', and NetEnt landed on one of their most popular releases of all time, Twin Spin, as the ideal candidate.Twin Spin Megaways - synchronized reelsBefore a collective shiver of dread shimmers through the community, know Twin Spin Megaways is nothing like the low thrills whirl Twin Spin Deluxe was. NetEnt learnt the valuable lesson that sequels need to offer something more, not less, than the original, otherwise what's the point? Additional pressure is added by the Megaways license from Big Time Gaming, conveniently included in the Red Tiger acquisition. Jam this versatile engine on an old game and you are left with no choice but to go large. This NetEnt has done, to almost every aspect of Twin Spin Megaways.When the game loads, the new Megaways influence is obvious. The reels look a hundred times glitzier, but the rest of the view is reassuringly familiar. The same ‘going to light speed’ background hangs behind the 6 reel grid recalling an old-school club feel enhanced further by the big band funk soundtrack, making full use of a horn section to recreate the 1970s disco/Sesame Street era vibe. NetEnt has astutely kept enough of the old not to produce too much of a jolt, which goes for both the visual design as well as the way the Megaways engine has been incorporated into the gameplay. Here, 2 - 7 symbols land on each reel during the base game, the number varying on every spin, producing up to 117,649 ways to win.Twin Spin Megaways is playable on any device, offering a wide range of stakes of 10 p/c to $/€200 per spin. The new version produces figures that are similar in some regards, very different in others. One which hasn't changed too much is the RTP, down a tad on a rating of 96.04%, while volatility has been turned up to high. Another major change is the max win capability, and we'll lay out just how drastically shortly.The same symbols as before make their return, meaning 9-A card royals, as well as cherries, bells, bars, sevens, and diamonds as the five premiums. Payout values have taken a hit, to compensate for the Megaways/avalanche feature, so premiums are now worth from 1 to 10 times the stake for six of a kind.Twin Spin Megaways: Slot FeaturesThere are definitely a whole lot more features going on now compared to the original. As well as the namesake Twin Reel feature, players get avalanches, free spins, and multiplier wilds. As is often the case in Megaways slots, every win here triggers the avalanche feature which clears winning symbols from the reels, letting new ones drop into the empty spaces. Avalanches keep happening as long as new wins continue to occur.At the start of each spin, two or more adjacent reels are randomly chosen to be Twin Reels. Twin Reels display identical synchronized symbols, though if part of an avalanche, different symbols cascade down. This feature is present in the base and bonus game.One of the biggest changes is the inclusion of free spins which were absent from the previous two. These are triggered when 5 scatters land on the reels, awarding 15 free spins. Any extra scatter in view adds 1 free spin to the amount. During free spins, players can look forward to two major benefits - the reels are always maxed out at 7 symbols high and wild multipliers also come into play. Wild multipliers have values or x2 or x3, and when used in a win the number of winning symbol occurrences on the reel increases by 2 or 3 respectively. Lastly, the bonus is extended by 15 free spins if 5 scatters land during the feature.Twin Spin Megaways: Slot VerdictThe old sequel, Twin Spin Deluxe, failed to hit the right note so badly NetEnt withdrew it as part of a house cleaning of non-performing slots. Responding to the whims of the market, NetEnt has taken the updated Megaways version of Twin Spin in the complete opposite direction. As expected, everything is bigger now - reels, gameplay, and potential.Starting with the gameplay, the locking reels plus Megaways combo fit like a glove, the only downer being that avalanches on linked reels aren't synced. Not a deal breaker though since solid rolls of wins are still possible without them.The new features are a welcome addition, though don't expect them to affect the game regularly. Free spins aren't common, but that shouldn't phase fans too much since the original didn't have any at all. Another area where there is unlikely to be many complaints is potential. Twin Spin pumped out wins of up to 1,080x, whereas the inclusion of free spins now pushes this figure well over 10,000 times the stake. A testament to how potent having six reels display the full 7 rows throughout the free spins feature is.Perhaps the main concern for fans is the classic gameplay of the older slot has been tossed out the window to a degree. Like Gonzo's Quest devotees reacting to the Red Tiger Megaways version, players who prefer the 'less is more' approach might baulk at what NetEnt has done to their beloved game. Others will no doubt appreciate the modernised result though. The update is a much more polished product with better features and deeper gameplay. Whilst it's a bit scaled down to accommodate old school fans, the execution is flawless, offering a smooth ride from the first to last spin. In other words, it has a nice, relaxing, continuous pulse to it.Add it all up, and there is no reason why Twin Spin Megaways won't be a massive hit like the original. Some have argued NetEnt practically invented the fruit slot with a modern twist genre, and Twin Spin Megaways is another step in its evolution. It isn’t the first to offer a synced reels/Megaways mix, having shown up in Queen of Riches Megaways and Mystery Spin Deluxe Megaways. However, when accounting Twin Spin's pedigree, it is well-positioned to be the biggest.

Title: Double Lucky Line
review: Double Lucky Line (Just For The Win): OverviewGripping on to the Asian reskin bandwagon for dear life comes Double Lucky Line from Microgaming partners Just for the Win. If it’s good enough for NetEnt, it must be good enough for the rest of us was clearly the thinking behind this lacklustre slot. Basically, JFTW has taken the mildly innovative game Tweethearts (which we did not even bother to review) and tarted it up for the Asian market with a palette change and some new symbols. Other than that, the gameplay, maths and features remain bang on the same as before. Testing the game was like experiencing a severe case of déjà vu. If you liked Tweethearts and appreciate Asian themes, you have literally stumbled upon slots nirvana. If that’s not you, well…It may look like a standard 5-reel, 3-row slot, but the setup is officially slightly different. Instead of 5 reels, there are 15 individual reels, with 17 paylines to form winning combinations on. Winners are formed when 3 of a kind or more symbols land, using double or single symbols.
