When it does, a frame of 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, or 6x6 appears over random symbols. If, on that spin, a wild symbol lands within the frame, the wild expands to become the frame's size. If more than one wild lands within a frame, the expanded wild gets a multiplier equal to the number of wilds the frame contains. The multiplier applies to all wins passing through the expanded wild.Free SpinsSky Bounty's free spins round is triggered when at least 3 scatter symbols land in view. As well as receiving 6 free spins. In free spins, a frame remains on the grid for its full duration, moving positions between each spin. It starts at 2x2 in size, and wilds that land within it expand to fill it, as in the base game. When scatter symbols hit, they are collected. Every 3 scatter symbols collected increases the frame size to 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, then 6x6, awarding +2 free spins each time. After the fourth time, scatter symbols do not land on the reels. If the feature was triggered with 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols, the round starts with 1, 2, or 3 scatter symbols already collected.Ante Bet & Buy Free SpinsActivating Sky Bounty's Ante Bet places more scatter symbols on the reels for an increase to the stake of 20%, while free spins can be bought for 100x the bet. Bought free spins land 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols to trigger the feature.Sky Bounty slot - free spinsSky Bounty: Slot VerdictOn the whole, Sky Bounty provided a satisfactory gaming experience, containing many of the pros and cons that often accompany a Pragmatic Play release. Whilst mostly positive, one suspects that with a bit of a prod, extra time spent on development, or more love poured into the creative process, Sky Bounty might have elevated itself from average/above average to something even greater. But whatever the reason, the studio is happy pushing games out at an astonishing speed, though with few slots really blossoming into classics despite the large number of them.However, even if Pragmatic Play does favour quantity, the quality is often quite high. Or, high enough. Sky Bounty is another example, containing interesting ideas such as skyfaring Krakens and swabs of the stratosphere, as well as intriguing gaming devices. The expanding wild feature definitely has merits. There's a mildly Fat Rabbit feel to it, but this is no straightforward expanding wild. It has one or two extra parts that have to synchronise before the feature really goes off. An interesting symbiotic effect is created between the bonus symbol collection and the growing frame since the larger the frame gets, the greater the likelihood of landing a wild within it, potentially leading to a sizable wild symbol - full screen in the best-case scenario. If you're lucky, a multiplier might compound the thrills. The growing frame feature helps balance the reels and ways set-up, which felt a little off in the beginning. It's also good for producing wins of up to 5,000x the bet at the most too, which is Sky Bounty's win cap.So there are positive things to say about Sky Bounty, but again, it's a Pragmatic Play slot that takes you up to a compelling point, then kind of leaves you there wanting more. This is an excellent trait in a storyteller, perhaps, but it can be frustrating when reviewing slots, imagining how a stronger push could have made a game that little bit extra special. Add up everything Sky Bounty has to offer, and you've got a good Kraken game on your hands. Good, but one suspects with a bit of additional time, resources, or love, Sky Bounty could have been more uniquely memorable.

Title: Mystery Spin Deluxe Megaways
review: Mystery Spin Deluxe Megaways (Blueprint Gaming): ReviewThe idea of combining Megaways with linked reels is not a unique concept and is something we've seen already in Big Time Gaming's mega potential monster Queen of Riches. NetEnt's original version meanwhile, which used to be one of its most talked about games back in the days, has died a slow death as players began giving up on it with claims that it had started to behave differently and that it had been modified following the conversion to the html5 format. In fact, lengthy discussions have ensued on forums around the web, debating whether it has been nerfed or not.Some five years after the release of Twin Spin, NetEnt had the chance to make things right and to further build on the success of the brand, but failed utterly. Twin Spin Deluxe, released in 2018, turned out to be a dreadful medium variance 6-reel creation with cluster pays, and a max win of 1000 times your stake. If you're waiting for a caped hero to bring Twin Spin into the modern era, your call has been answered, for Blueprint Gaming has seized the opportunity to fill the void that NetEnt left in the wake of its blunder. Knowing how protective NetEnt is of its intellectual property, however, don't be too surprised if this one gets pulled from the market.Mystery Spin Deluxe Megaways is a 6-reel slot that offers up to 117,649 ways to win. Making use of Big Time Gaming's trendy mechanic in combination with synced reels, it comes with Mystery Symbol feature that randomly transforms all instances of it into one of the regular symbols. There's also a Mystery Spin feature where only Mystery Symbols will appear on the linked reels. You can play Mystery Spin Deluxe Megaways across all devices from 10 cents to 10€ per spin.Those familiar with the original will find similar elements in Blueprint's version. While it's undoubtedly a fresh vision and a fabulous adaptation, you can't disregard the fact that it's so similar in look and feel that it cannot be regarded as anything else other than an attempt to capitalise on Twin Spin's fame. Just like the original, Mystery Spin Deluxe Megaways is a vibrant slot with a retro/classic fruit machine feel, and even the disco background music is basically a cover of Twin Spin's soundtrack.Symbols on the reels include A, K, Q, J and 10 royal values as well as more lucrative cherries, lemons, grapes, oranges, and watermelons. The most rewarding is the lucky seven which yields 10 times your stake for a combination of 6. There's a wild included as well which you don't get to see too often.Mystery Spin Deluxe Megaways (Blueprint Gaming): FeaturesMystery symbols in viewBeing a Megaways slot, the rows vary on each spin and can randomly appear between 2 to 7 symbols high. Unlike other Megaways offerings, however, it comes with a set of fixed win ways (since the reels are linked) that can give you 729, 4096, 15625, 46656 or 117649 ways to win.Blueprint Gaming can't get enough of its Mystery Symbols feature and you can expect more of it in this game as well. When the Mystery Symbols hit, all instances of them will transform into a randomly chosen regular symbol for increased winning potential. The main attraction, of course, is the linked reels feature, or the In Sync feature as Blueprint calls it. When randomly activated, up to 6 reels can spin in synchronisation, showing matching symbols on all linked reels. Moreover, the symbols can also appear super stacked on the reels. In combination with the randomly triggered Mystery Spin feature, where only Mystery Symbols will appear on the linked reels, the outcome can result in a max payout of 10,000 times your total stake.Mystery Spin Deluxe Megaways (Blueprint Gaming): VerdictUsing NetEnt's Twin Spin as a basis, Blueprint doesn't push the limits of the fundamental idea too far and they certainly haven't wasted the gripping premise of the game by over-complicating things. If we were to design a Megaways version of the original ourselves, this is pretty much how it would come out. The only gripe we have with it is, well, that it's essentially a copy of the original, not only in terms of gameplay, but visually as well, something that could very well end up causing some friction between NetEnt and Blueprint.Though an overall entertaining and solid game, it doesn't come without some minor annoying moments. For example, seeing how frequently the game expands to its full 117k win ways setting (more often than what you usually see in Megaways slots), you would expect it to reward bigger wins. You'll soon find yourself rolling your eyes as nothing ever seems to come out of it, or even worse, when symbols fail to connect in spite of the massive number of paylines.When comparing Queen of Riches, Twin Spin and Mystery Spin Deluxe Megaways, three of the most prominent synched reel slots on the market, Queen of Riches comes out as the champion every day of the week as we find it to be much more explosive, volatile, and original. With that said, they're both fantastic games and if you're looking to kill some time playing online slots, you can't go wrong with either. Nevertheless, we'll have to wait and see if slips through NetEnt's team of lawyers.

Title: Egyptian Fortunes

Title: Deco Diamonds Deluxe

Title: Living with Stan

Title: Medallion Megaways

Has the studio we previously praised for being bold and creative suddenly become all comfortable? Is that a pair of dad jeans they're wearing now? Set to find out, we fired up Medallion Megaways and started spinning frantically. First, let's look at the technical details. Title: Worms of Valor

Title: Coba Reborn
review: ﻿Coba Reborn: Slot OverviewLike a snake charmer playing their flute to raise a serpent from a basket, ELK Studios has played a tune of its own with similar results. What this means is the slithering snake in a jungle action found in Coba has returned in the form of Coba Reborn. A game grid covered in snake heads, on the sides as well as the top, lies buried in deep bush, surrounded by thick fauna and what looks like ancient ruins in the background. Standard stuff in some ways, yet the ELK Studios team has made it look good, drawing on the experience gleaned not just from Coba, but games like Pacific Gold and Voodoo Gold.As well as some front-end adjustments, changes have been made on the back end too. One notable difference is that the volatility for Coba Reborn has been dialled up to high, compared to medium in the previous game. Another is that the RTP has dipped to 94%. This return value applies whether you're betting 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin in the regular manner or have activated the bonus mode and are buying features from the X-iter menu. Played on a 7x7-sized gaming panel, Coba Reborn's cluster pays win system means rewards are given when at least 5 matching symbols are connected to each other anywhere on the board.Symbol values, too, have been pruned back, quite significantly in certain areas. When wild symbols appear, they may be used to substitute any regular paying symbol.Coba Reborn: Slot FeaturesCoba Reborn slot - base gameIt's time for snakes and flowers as we go over Coba Reborn's features. Let's start with winning symbols, which are removed from the board when they form and are replaced by symbols dropping from above. Winning symbols are collected by the snake progress meter, and the Avalanche feature continues functioning like this until no new win appears.Snake Progress MeterWhen the snake progress meter is half-filled, wild symbols are randomly placed on the grid after the symbol refill. If the meter is completely filled, snakes are released depending on the level reached. Reach levels 1, 2, or 3 and 3 snakes are released from random entry points on the sides of the grid. Reach level 4, and 6 snakes are released from random entry points.SnakesA snake is a linear cluster of symbols that grows as the snake moves across the grid. Snakes are at least 5 symbols long and always form part of a winning cluster or part of a larger cluster. A yellow body snake means it will survive till the next avalanche; a blue body means it may die. Snakes always start in a yellow survival state, surviving the first avalanche drop. The first symbol a snake moves over becomes the snake's symbol, indicated on its head. Snakes become wild if the first symbol is an orchid. Symbols a snake moves over are transformed into its symbol, except for orchids or wilds.If a snake moves over the same symbol type as itself, it grows in length, and its body becomes yellow – the same applies when snakes eat wild symbols. If a snake does not move over (eat) its symbol type, wild or orchid, during its whole movement, it dies and is removed from the grid before any win evaluations. Snakes with a wild as their symbol turn crossed symbols into wild symbols. These snakes must eat wilds, multiplier wilds, or orchids to grow and survive. Wild wins pay as the highest value symbol.Where snakes cross paths, a multiplier wild symbol is created. They start at x2 and are doubled on each cross at the same position. When more than one multiplier is used in a win, the values are multiplied together first. A snake eating a wild multiplier grows and turns yellow. Lastly, a snake that crosses itself or bites its tail without the ouroboros feature active dies and is removed from the reels.Coba Reborn slot - bonus roundOrchidsCoba Reborn has 4 different orchid symbols, each one possessing its own feature:Blood Orchid – when 2 of these symbols are in view, a snake spawns from each. Or, a blood orchid can drain another type of orchid in view and spawn a snake from its position. A former blood orchid position turns wild once the snake has moved. When a snake eats a blood orchid, a random number of snakes appear from random entry points on the sides of the grid.Hydra Orchid – when a snake eats a hydra orchid, it spawns another snake behind its head with the same symbol type. If the eating snake has the rebirth or ouroboros feature, these are passed on to the new snake.Rebirth Orchid – when a snake eats a rebirth orchid, it can be resurrected from the dead to the same length and keep the ouroboros feature if it had it. The rebirth feature persists across multiple avalanche drops.Ouroboros Orchid – when a snake eats an ouroboros orchid, it can cross itself without dying. The crossing grows the snake which enters the survival state (yellow-bodied). The crossing position becomes a multiplier wild.Snakes may have both rebirth and ouroboros features but cannot eat another rebirth or ouroboros orchid if it already carries them.X-iterA staple ELK Studios addition, the X-iter allows players to take on Coba Reborn in different game modes.Boosted Chance – one drop for 2x the bet with more than double the chance of reaching the first level on the snake meter.Flower Power – 10x the bet for one drop with at least 3 random orchids.All Ouroboros – 25x the bet for a game round with double blood orchids. All snakes can cross themselves.Bali Boost – 100x the bet for a game round guaranteed to reach level 1.Coba – 500x the bet for a game round that starts on level 4 with 6 snakes awarded.Coba Reborn slot - feature buy menuCoba Reborn: Slot VerdictIt took time to form a definitive opinion about Coba Reborn. One reason why it didn't wow right away is because, in some ways, it is close to the original, and sequels often struggle to stand out of the shadow of what preceded them, whether in slots, books, movies, or any creative endeavour. It just didn't have the same shock of being new about it. Following on from the initial reaction was a feeling that with Coba Reborn, ELK Studios giveth on the one hand and taketh on the other. Additions are obvious things like the flower features and higher volatility, which some players may favour (others may not), so in this regard, the gameplay has received a reboot, or rebirth, as the case may be.On the other hand, ELK has sliced the RTP back, which never feels great, while taking an axe to the pay symbols and decimating the larger cluster values. So while the extra features are doing their best to augment the Coba Reborn experience, reductions are there, holding them back from getting too wild and crazy. On an eyeball level, this balancing act seemed to mean lengthy chain of events can occur in Coba Reborn with, at times, surprisingly limited results. Of course, Coba Reborn has the guns to produce big results, satisfyingly so, too, when the snakes are slithering around doing their thing aided by orchids, which are stunning flowers, BTW. The game has the same impressive 25,000x the bet max win as before, which would be insane to see hit using this particular system.Still, it was hard to call Coba Reborn a major improvement over the original. At best, it felt about the same as Coba, maybe slightly more elaborate, though when factoring in things like the RTP drop, some might see it as inferior. However, interest in the new orchids and their abilities did grow as the review progressed, as they provided a new slant on how the action in Coba Reborn unfolds. By the end, the reaction was positive enough to recommend Coba Reborn to those who enjoyed the slithering goodness possible in the original Coba slot, with one or two reservations.

Title: Reactoonz 2

All other wilds substitute for any pay symbol, covered in the next section.Reactoonz 2: FeaturesThis bit might not make much sense after one read through, though the gist is straightforward – winning clusters fill charge meters to trigger bigger and better features. Let’s look at the details.The key to it all is the cascade feature. Winning clusters are removed to let new symbols fall into the gaps, resulting in potential more wins. Cascades continue to pop and fill meters until no new winners appear.On each spin, one of the one-eyed symbols is randomly chosen to fluctuate. If fluctuating symbols win, then an electric wild appears in one of the newly vacated spaces while also filling the Fluctometer. When this meter is totally full, 1-3 electric wilds are added to the grid. The Fluctometer can be recharged more than once, but is disabled if the Gargantoon is released.Electric wilds substitute for any pay symbol and zap Reactoonz as well. Any non-wild symbols removed by the electric wild charge the Quantumeter. Each symbol is worth one charge. Each level releases a different wild:Level 1 unleashes four 1x1 Energoon wilds.Level 2 unleashes a single 2x2 Energoon wild.Level 3 unleashes a single 3x3 Gargantoon wild.Level 4 adds an x2 multiplier for all wins including the Gargantoon wilds.After a 3x3 Gargantoon triggers a cascade, it breaks into two 2x2 Gargantoon wilds. After they trigger a cascade, they are replaced by nine 1x1 Gargantoon wilds.Wait, we’re not finished yet. When all features are done, and there are 2 or more Electric wilds remaining in view, the Wild Pair Explosion feature is triggered. If there are 2 electric wilds adjacent to each other, all symbols, except wilds, are removed from the grid. If the wilds are not adjacent, the symbols between two of them as well as the surrounding symbols are destroyed (not including wilds). Any symbols removed do not payout, but they do charge the Quantumeter.Reactoonz 2: VerdictIt’s a pretty safe bet that fans of the original Reactoonz slot, or grid slots enthusiasts in general, will be pretty excited about what Play’n GO has designed for the follow-up. Reading the rules will quite possibly confuse you more than just winding Reactoonz 2 up and having a bash. As before, consecutive cluster wins build up ever more impressive features as they tick along. This time around its electric wilds you want to charge the four-level Quantumeter. The more levels, the more beneficial things will be. Have a crack in demo, and all should become clear enough.It’s not a paradigm shift, but enough has been changed to give Reactoonz 2 a different feel. The potential has been given a slight increase as well, now maxing out at 5,083 times the stake. Not a massive upgrade compared to the first one, but hey, an epic win should you get the critters performing to that level. The game is still all about its critters too, which remain super personable. The way they shimmy and shake when hit by lightning is amusing, ensuring the sequel is as charming as ever. More importantly, Reactoonz 2 has the same highly compelling gameplay - once you’ve figured out what the heck is going on.All up, Reactoonz 2 is just as mental, if not more so, than the original. When features are firing it’s like you’ve lit all your fireworks at once. Reactoonz 2 is a worthy follow up to one of Play’n GO’s most popular slots but unlikely to have quite the same impact. It’s a bit too similar to the first to make the same tidal wave impression perhaps but is still immense fun to play regardless.Don't MissDid you know Play'n GO have created a backstory to the Reactoonz universe? The War in Heaven idea did pique interest, yet the follow-through tended to flounder, the gameplay feeling eclipsed by the lofty heights set by the back story.There are moments to be had in Clash of the Seraphim, though. More so during free spins since there the drop areas could get quite large. There was a noticeable difference between the two free spins options, too, and Dark Free Games could be ridiculously punishing. Title: Shadow Strike
review: Shadow Strike: Slot OverviewHacksaw Gaming partner Backseat Gaming busts out the 'hi-yahs!' for its martial arts-themed online slot Shadow Strike. We're out in the middle of nature for this one; perhaps quiet solitude is conducive to practising katas or something. A myriad of special features and a connection to Hacksaw Gaming, in general, mean Shadow Strike probably won't stay quiet for long, though. The busier the better, really, from a gambler's point of view.Shadow Strike slot - base gamePlayed on a 5-reel gaming grid, you'll notice that for much of the time, the top two rows are locked, while the main 4-row grid is active. The two outer rows are Ninja Reels, and we'll get to them shortly. Before then, know that Shadow Strike has 14 paylines evaluating wins, and it takes wagers of 10 cents to $/€100 per spin, selectable on the recognisably Hacksaw UI. Five ways to play are available at the bonus buy, as well, while the general volatility is in the medium-high range (4.5 out of 5).The 4 low pay symbols depict 4 kinds of weapons, whereas the high pays show 4 different warrior symbols. When wilds are in view on the grid, they're able to substitute for all of the regular paying symbols. Wild symbols that land or are created on the main grid have a chance of getting a multiplier of x2 to x50. When a MultiSplit appears, it multiplies the multiplier value of all wild symbols on its corresponding reel on the main grid. If a MultiSplit passes over a wild that does not have a multiplier value, the MultiSplit's multiplier value is added to the wild.The Mysteries of the Dojo Bonus GamePlayers get 10, 12, or 14 free Mysteries of the Dojo free spins by landing 3, 4, or 5 Dojo Bonus scatters in the base game, respectively. During this bonus, both Ninja Reels are unlocked on every spin. Wild symbols that land or are created on the main grid remain sticky. Landing a +FS symbol on a Ninja Reels grants +1-3 free spins per symbol.The Secrets of the Scroll Bonus GameHitting 3, 4, or 5 Scroll scatters in the base game awards 10, 12, or 14 free spins as part of this feature, respectively. Both Ninja Reels are unlocked for the entirety as well, but here, wilds on the main grid expand to become full reel wilds. landing a +FS symbol on a Ninja Reels grants +1-3 free spins per symbol.The Wisdom of the Koi Bonus GameTriggered by landing 3 Koi scatter symbols in the base game, this bonus is played in 2 phases. First is the Collection Phase, which starts with 3 lives, and only non-winning, wild, multiplier, or MultiSplit symbols appear on the main grid. Lives reset when a new wild, multiplier, or MultiSplit symbol lands. Following 3 non-winning spins, the phase ends. Above each reel is a multiplier starting on x1. By landing multiplier symbols, the reel multipliers above them are increased. Also, below the main grid is a Ninja Reel which is initially locked. Each locked position can be unlocked for the Payout Phase by landing a MultiSplit on the main grid's corresponding reel.Next is the Payout Phase, where 3 final spins are awarded. All collected wilds land randomly on the main grid on each spin. Each wild has a multiplier corresponding to its reel multiplier. Unlocked positions on the bottom Ninja Reel can also reveal MultiSplit symbols to boost the multipliers of wild symbols.Bonus BuySpecial features can be bought from the bonus buy, such as the following, which are all highly volatile:BonusHunt FeatureSpins - 2x the bet, each spin is 3 times more likely to trigger a bonus game. RTP 96.27%.Ninja Power FeatureSpins - 50x the bet, where 2-5 wilds are guaranteed on the top Ninja Reel and at least 1 MultiSplit on the bottom Ninja Reel. RTP 96.31%.The Mysteries of the Dojo Bonus Game - 100x the bet. RTP 96.34%.The Secrets of the Scroll Bonus Game - 150x the bet. RTP 96.32%.The Wisdom of the Koi Bonus Game - 200x the bet. RTP 96.27%.Shadow Strike slot - The Wisdom of the Koi featureShadow Strike: Slot VerdictWhat is up with the Hacksaw Gaming studio family at the moment, huh? Backseat is dropping fighty games like this one, and Blademaster, Bullshark released Wild Dojo Strike not long back, and Hacksaw, cripes, they've been slinging out fight slots such as Fist of Destruction and Gladiator Legends. Shadow Strike's third bonus round, The Wisdom of the Koi bonus game, for instance, branches off from something like Alpha Eagle's Eagle Link round, where the feature is split into two parts - the Collection Phase and the Payout Phase. The familiarity of the features was cool, and they've got the juice to really pop, but at times, Shadow Strike felt as much a Hacksaw Gaming production as a Backseat Gaming one, though this is not exactly a criticism, more of an observation.

Title: Cashed in Stone
review: Cashed in Stone: OverviewSG Digital developer Core Gaming has a thing about the past. This time they have gone all the way back to the dawn of humanity. When it comes to human history, it doesn’t get much older than the Stone Age where Cashed in Stone is set. This is a cartoon world of knuckle draggers with sloping foreheads bashing each other with dinosaur bones. The previous Core Gaming title to come our way was Viking Hoard, which was a real test of patience and fortitude. So it was with some trepidation that we fired up Cashed in Stone.Visually, prehistoric isn’t a bad word to describe the game, particularly the UI. The graphic standard isn’t high, though the rolling hills of the background are pleasant. Cashed in Stone comes with its own mascot. A cute wee caveman, who looks a little like Animal from the Muppets. He adds a much-needed dose of humour to lighten what could have been a starchy slot. The setup uses a 6 reel, 4 row format with 4,096 ways to win. As with Viking Hoard, the symbols fall into place and are part of a cascading win system. Winners are removed to let new symbols tumble to create chains of wins from one spin. Players choose bets from 25 p/c up to $/€100 per spin on virtually any device.Winning combinations are formed by matching 3 or more of a kind. The paytable is made up of 10 – A royals and a bunch of high pays. This includes a bone with meat, a stone axe, a necklace, and a BAR symbol. The most valuable is the Logo which only needs two of a kind and pays 40 times the stake for a six of a kind combo. Due key factors that we will look at, RTP ranges from 96% down to an unusually low 91.95%. Volatility is in the low/medium region but plays and feels quite high at times - although nothing like the dull uneventful slogs that Viking Hoard could produce. Rounding off the paytable is the wild symbol which can substitute for any of the regular pay symbols.Cashed in Stone: FeaturesCashed in Stone comes with a surprising amount of features, some of which require player input. These come in the form of reel modifiers, collectable free spins, and a bonus game for good measure. To the modifiers first and there are four of them which can randomly appear on any base game spin. We have:Stackin’ Wilds: a random number of reels turn completely wild. If used as part of a winning combination, they are removed in a cascade.Multiplyin’ Times: a win multiplier is introduced which increases with winning cascade for one spin.Cashin’ Drop: the game selects one pay symbol and drops it in the game at extra-large 3x3 size.Smashin’ Wilds: the caveman bashes symbols turning them wild.The caveman symbol is the scatter and three in view trigger the Big Money Wheel Bonus game. During this round, a two-tier prize wheel is spun. The first wheel is split into segments containing multipliers of x1 – x5. If the wheel stops on a multiplier segment, it is applied to the total bet and can turn into a red cross. The wheel keeps spinning and adding up wins unless the wheel stops on a red cross then the game is over. There is one other segment though, which is a green arrow. If the wheel stops on this, then it unlocks the second tier wheel which has the same rules but multipliers of x10 – x250.The last feature of note are the Free Spins which are little more complicated than normal. When players land a free spins symbol, it moves the spins trail up one notch. The spins trail has three sections; The lower section has 1-5 free spins with 2 guaranteed wilds each. The middle section is 5-10 free spins with three wilds. The final section is 10 free spins with a 2x2 wild on each spin. Players can choose to activate their accumulated free spins at any time by hitting the green button beneath the trail. The only exception is the final section which triggers automatically when it is reached. One interesting aspect of free spins is that when they are activated, the bet level used is an average of all stakes in the game up until that point. Free spins cannot be retriggered.Cashed in Stone: VerdictAfter a few initial spins, memories of Viking Hoard came flooding in like a Nam flashback. Remembering what it took to land features in that slot a question arose – are we up to this again? Fortunately, features drop more frequently with Cashed in Stone. The math model has had the ‘ruthlessness’ setting turned down which is appreciated. In saying that, patience is still needed. It can take a lot of spins to reach the end of the free spins trail. The free spins option is a little controversial.Triggering lower amounts of free spins drastically reduces the RTP rate. It can go as diabolically low as 91.95%. Then again, if you commit to going all the way, you need to be prepared for the investment in time and coins to get there. So it is worth it? Potentially the game is capped at 250,000 from one spin which is high. Realistically, players are likely looking at max returns of around 5,000 times the stake.Cashed in Stone is not a copy of Viking Hoard, but they have a lot in common. The main problem is that what was annoying about Viking Hoard remains just as annoying this time around. Graphics are clunky, and the base game can be glacial. To its credit, you will probably experience more features with Cashed in Stone than with Viking Hoard. Despite the wee caveman’s best efforts, Cashed in Stone just isn’t all that fun to play. Fans of prehistory might find value, and it is an improvement from Core Gaming. In summation, Cashed in Stone is more enjoyable than Viking Hoard was, but still about as fun as being smacked over the head with a dinosaur bone.

Title: Thoro
review: Thoro: Slot OverviewThe online slot Wild Toro was one of ELK Studios' popular earlier releases, and after lying fallow for 5 years, was brought bucking back to life in 2021 with a 3 slot world tour, which kicked off with the release of Wild Toro 2. Activating the Mjolnir feature awards a respin as long as Thoro Thunder Strike is not pending. Thoro may randomly upgrade the Lightning paytable or increase his own multiplier on each respin while the Mjolnir feature is active. Thoro pulls Mjolnir towards him, triggering the Mjolnir feature before the Thoro Thunder Strike if Mjolnir and Loki symbols are both on the reels.Bonus GameScatter symbols appear on reels 2, 3, and 4. Hitting 3 scatters triggers the free spins round. Free spins are not decreased by Loki Respins or Thoro respins, and the rules are the same as in the base game. For the super free spins bonus, the Lightning paytable starts at the highest payout level, and Thoro has both Mjolnir and a multiplier.X-iterThoro's X-iter bonus buy menu includes: Bonus Hunt - get more than triple the chance of triggering the bonus game for 3x the bet. Loki Respin - 10x the bet to guarantee a Loki Respin. Mjolnir Feature - 25x the bet guaranteeing walking Thoro carrying Mjolnir. Free Spins (100x the bet). Super Free Spins (500x the bet).Thoro slot - free spinsThoro: Slot VerdictFunny, there was a five-year hiatus between Wild Toro the original and The Wild Toro World Tour. Since then, Toro has been busy showing up in a wide range of follow-up slots. While the main character might have stayed more or less the same, cosplaying various roles, the gameplay and features are usually quite diverse. From 'book of' mechanics to a hold 'n win, and now an instant prize-winning 9 Masks of Fire game. However, while some things change, some stay the same, and players who got a tickle out of Toro chasing the Matador, leaving wilds about the place, get a repeat in Thoro, so there is a definite feel of familiarity to cosy up to.In saying that, Lightning symbols and Lightning paytable prizes have shaken things up. For example, when Toro, sorry, Thoro is moving across the reels triggering respins, added wilds, and even Thoro himself can take a backseat to the Lightning symbol collection. Just as Mjolnir helps Thor defeat his foes, Mjolnir in this game is helpful for boosting Thoro's multiplier and upgrading the Lightning paytable. Default prize values aren't bad already, but upgraded Lightning paytable values are obviously a lot hotter.No matter the paytable's level, Thoro's max win is 10,000x and is collectable by hitting 12 Lightning symbols on the reels - at any stage. While all this is going on, players can enjoy a high audiovisual standard, the likes of which ELK Studios typically cram into its games. There is something rather satisfying about the concatenation of Norse mythology and thundering heavy metal music, which Thoro delivers, along with an equally satisfying blending of gaming components.

Title: Planet Fortune
review: Planet Fortune: IntroductionIt just happens to be so, that about a month ago we actually reached out to Play'N Go and demanded a slot with sticky wilds. Being great fans of this type of feature, our argument was that every great slot provider must have at least one slot featuring sticky wilds.We certainly got our hopes up when we read the information sheet which stated; "During free spins, all wild symbols that appear will be "sticky" on the reels." At this point the excitement was real and we couldn't wait for the test run. If the wild is on reel 1, it will walk off the reel and disappear."Play'n GO, how in the world can that be concidered sticky wilds? Those are "walking wilds". The bet size range from 0.20 to 100 and max win is 2500x. According to information from PnG, Planet Fortune is a high volatile game, but it has to be put into perspective. It is certainly no Dead or Alive in comparison.If playing on a casino using a Malta license for the game, you can expect an RTP of either 96.50% or 94.49%. Any other type of license may offer an RTP much lower than this. If uncertain, check the help file of the game. If RTP is not stated, you're not playing on a Malta license.There are 6 premium symbols which are all placed on stacks of 2, 3 or 4 symbols. The low value symbols are not stacked and are represented by A, K, Q, J and 10. The game also includes a wild symbol, which is represented by a robot, and of course, substitutes for any other symbol.Planet Fortune: Main Game & Free SpinsUnlike many of the other slots released by PnG in recent times, Planet Fortune is straight forward and easy to learn. It has a classic reel setup and no crazy combinations or features that will give you headaches. There are pretty much two objectives in the main game - to land as many stacked reels with premium symbols as possible and to land 3 robot wilds to trigger the free spins.To add more action, there's something called the Magnetic Mayhem. When this random feature is triggered, two or three reels stick together by 2x2 or 3x3 sized symbols. In other words, you will not get fully stacked reels. Unfortunately, wilds can not appear on the attached Mayhem reels.Three or more robots appearing on any reels will award you 10 free spins, or Robot Revolution Free Spins, as PnG likes to call it. Everytime a wild symbol lands during the free spins, it will stay on the screen, but walk move to the left by 1 for every spin. This is a feature better known as "walking wilds". The free spins feature cannot be re-triggered.Planet Fortune: ConclusionPlanet Fortune is not a revolutionary game and it offers nothing new or innovative. It's one of those games that people will try a few times when they see it in the new slots category, but will eventually fall into oblivion. There are so many slots being produced these days that game providers needs something extra to win the player over - be it innovative features or, even better, crazy high potential. To be frank, this game has none of those.

Title: Gladiator Ways
review: Gladiator Ways: Slot OverviewJust the other day, we'd oiled up and grabbed a trident to tangle with Yggdrasil Gaming's slot 3 Gladiators vs Caesar; now here we are for round two. This time, the slot is Gladiator Ways and comes from software provider Red Tiger. The game has a progressively unlockable set of features, a collection system which Red Tiger (for better or worse) likes to use, which become available in the base game as well as in bonus rounds where two wilds are guaranteed on each free spin.Make a gladiator game, and there aren't a huge number of different settings to locate the action in. Coliseum-type arenas are about it, and Red Tiger has made a good-looking one to host Gladiator Ways. There is something a bit strange about the audience, though. Sonically, the crowd gets a bit rowdy at times, but visually, they stay stock still. Sure, Gladiator Ways is no EA Sports Triple-A video game production, so no one is expecting a dynamic crowd, yet there is something unsettling about how realistic they've been drawn yet how unmoving they are.Gladiator Ways slot - base gameThe title is certainly no misnomer since, as well as gladiators, Gladiator Ways is a ways to win slot. Winning combinations are paid left to right, starting from the leftmost reel, and there are 4,096 ways to win. Players get just one approach, with no bonus buy option in sight, which is picking a stake of 10 c to $/€40 and thrashing the spin button. At its highest setting, the default RTP in Gladiator Ways is 95.72%, while the volatility is medium-high.SPQR style ten to ace card ranks make up Gladiator Ways' lower value symbols, while its higher paying group are spears, spiked balls, swords, and tigers. A winning way consisting of 6 identical royals pays 0.4-0.5 times the bet or a 6 OAK premium win awards 1 to 5 times the bet.Gladiator Ways: Slot FeaturesGladiator Ways slot - free spinsGladiator Ways possesses one of those progress collection mechanics that Red Tiger likes to use. At the start of a session, only one gladiator is unlocked. The other 3 gladiators are unlocked by collecting golden shields when they land. After collecting 10 shields, the second gladiator is unlocked. A further 10 collected shields unlocks the third gladiator, while the fourth gladiator is unlocked another 10 collected shields after that. Once the last gladiator is unlocked, shields are removed from the game. All gladiators are wild, so they count for any regular pay symbol.Gladiator 1 - a wild of 1x2 in size that is present on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5. May land fully or partially in view.Gladiator 2 - a wild of 1x4 in size that may land on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5. Always lands fully in view.Gladiator 3 - a wild of size 2x2 that is present on reels 2 and 3, 3 and 4, as well as 4 and 5. May land fully or partially in view.Gladiator 4 - a wild of size 2x4, present on reels 2 and 3, 3 and 4, as well as 4 and 5. Always lands fully in view.Free SpinsScatter symbols hit on all but the leftmost reel. Landing 3 or 4 scatter symbols triggers 7 or 14 free spins, respectively. On each free spin, 2 wild gladiators are guaranteed to land. A random gladiator is guaranteed to land on reels 2 and/or 3, and a random gladiator on reels 4 and/or 5. Additional gladiators may also land, though only unlocked gladiators are available in free spins. Each landed scatter awards +1 free spin.Gladiator Ways slot - free spinsGladiator Ways: Slot VerdictIt seems as though the Red Tiger team might be gearing up for a collection mechanic binge since the last game of theirs we reviewed, The Good, The Bad, and The Rich, had a similar unlocking of features mechanic. That one was a Western, where the features it unlocked had more variety, such as a royal symbol removal effect and a winning combination formation method flip from paylines to ways. Gladiator Ways by comparison, unlocks only wild symbols of various dimensions, so the game does suffer to a degree from a lack of variety.However, Gladiator Ways does have a ways to win pay system from start to finish, which works well when adding wild symbols to the reels. Why players don't just get all of the different symbols from start to finish can feel like a mystery, but that's Red Tiger's prerogative, and it's totally up to players whether they want to embark upon a journey of unlocking things or not. On an eyeball, non-official stat level, these sorts of games from Red Tiger in the past have not tended to take masses of time to get through everything, though there are no timing guarantees either.Maybe don't be expecting the riches of Rome's 12 Caesars to come raining down on you if you manage to unlock everything and use it all to full capacity. Gladiator Ways' max multiplier is 2,176.2x the bet, which is dunno; some may have thought it would have been higher considering all those ways and wilds the game tosses about the place. And that's Gladiator Ways. It's no Gladiator Legends, and a reliance on wild symbols means the action is somewhat one-dimensional, but it's got a certain battling in an arena atmosphere, so gamblers without massive hopes or expectations might possibly enjoy the action it is able to throw together.

Title: Diamond Empire

Title: Retro Galaxy

As such, it comes across as a rather bland and unoriginal creation that piggybacks off of old Microgaming merits.Besides features, Retro Galaxy’s potential is its trump card. At full stretch, the game is capable of hitting wins of up to 7,300 times the stake. Potential like this helps make Retro Galaxy a viable option for those looking for dependable gameplay along with solid payouts.Despite the positive stats and mechanics, Retro Galaxy isn’t exactly an unmissable slot. Retro Galaxy comes across as a slot Microgaming has tested their partner with making before setting them a more ambitious project. This is pure speculation, of course, just an impression Retro Galaxy gives off.If Retro Galaxy was a test, then Half Pixel has probably passed it - just barely. You won’t find much new here, either in terms of gameplay or theme, although that probably won't stop some from thinking it's an okay slot.

Title: Rise of Samurai 3

Yet, don't expect too many big payouts during the base game when they do. PopWins slots are notorious for being highly volatile and CherryPop is certainly that.The primary rule is that three or more adjacent matching symbols from the first or fifth reel trigger a payout. Technically there are 243 ways to win in default mode, but in essence, this is doubled to 486 since the game pays both ways. Some designers might have left a fruit slot at that, but Avatar UX isn't a studio which does things by halves.Before finding out what CherryPop is capable of when its foot is on the gas, let's take a quick look at the paytable. There are a lot of pay symbols, 13 to be precise, which can crowd the slot in smaller configurations. At the bottom end of the paytable are 10-A royals, followed by grapes, melons, oranges, horseshoes, clovers, bells, diamonds, and cherries. Non-royal values are worth up to 15 times the stake for five cherries. Keep in mind cherries only appear from pops or free spins.CherryPop: FeaturesIt might look like quite an average, albeit shiny, classic fruit slot in a screenshot, but the features ensure this is no ordinary fruity game. As you'd expect if you've played the previous two, the PopWins function is the central feature, complemented by free spins, and the bonus buy.Every hit triggers the PopWins feature. When so happens, winning symbols are cleared from the screen, and each empty position is replaced with two new symbols. Since there are more symbols than there was before, reels are expanded to accommodate them – up to 6 rows high in the base game. Consecutive wins are possible using the new symbols, and the process continues until no new winners appear. Then the reels are reset.If all 5 reels expand to 6 rows in height, 5 free spins are triggered. However, before the bonus game starts, players get the chance to gamble their spins on the Gamble Wheel. Successful gambles award up to 16 free spins, or you can lose the lot - then it's back to the main game empty-handed.Free spins up the ante by introducing a progressive win multiplier starting at x2. Each PopWin increases the multiplier by +1, without limit. PopWins also expand the reels like they do in the base game. The difference now is reels can reach 9 rows in height.When all reels are 9 rows high, the win multiplier gets a +3 boost. Also, each subsequent PopWin from then on increases the multiplier by +4 rather than +1. On a full 9 row grid, there are 59,049 ways to win in play – double when you factor in the pay both ways. When a spin without a PopWin occurs, reels return to the height of the shortest reel, rather than reset completely.Finally, there is one new feature – a bonus buy option. For the cost of 75 times the stake, you'll simply get instant access to the bonus.CherryPop: VerdictOf the three PopWins slots released so far, CherryPop sort of sits in the middle of the other two. What do we mean? Well, the first one was very volatile, either going nowhere or blasting into orbit on very lengthy win sequences. It also has the highest potential. The second one, WildPops, is the less brutal, throwing in random wild lifelines to keep the action flowing, yet decreasing the potential.That brings us to CherryPop, which is more forgiving than the first, yet more brutal than the second. You do miss the random wild feature of WildPops, and to be honest, CherryPop's base game does get a bit repetitive if you struggle to hit free spins. The generic theme doesn't help, yet the game has been attractively presented for a fruit slot. What might make CherryPop more appealing than the others is the buy feature, allowing you to avoid the base game battling altogether.Whether you dig CherryPop comes down to your thoughts on the PopWins mechanic really. Hitting a base game lull can be tiring since there are no other modifiers going on. Yet, get it snowballing and buckle in - the potential for long drawn out sequences is impressive. Expanding reels are as fun as ever, and the inclusion of a pay both ways system only adds to the mayhem. Rewards certainly aren't an issue if you do manage to wind CherryPop up, where wins of up to 20,000 times the stake are possible.If anything, AvatarUX shows there are plenty more twists to be made in the classic/fruit slot genre. Players in the mood for this style with an unusual mechanic and solid stats will do well to give CherryPop a spin. Overall there is a compellingly simple nature to CherryPop, making it easy to spin again, or hit the bonus buy button just one more time.PopWins is an intriguing mechanic with possibilities, and CherryPop comes across as the most mainstream, accessible one so far. Still, despite the enjoyable gaming, it doesn't feel like Avatar UX has quite achieved their breakout performance with the mechanic just yet.

Title: Hyper Star
review: Hyper Star: Slot OverviewMicrogaming associates Gameburger Studios adds to their 'Hyper' range of slots with a brash Vegas wannabe titled Hyper Star. So far, sister slots in the studio's Hyper series have been pretty run of the mill games, often clinging to the coattails of Gameburger's hit 9 Masks of Fire. Hyper Star splits into a different direction, but where it ends up is just as run of the mill really, relying on dazzling visuals to try to jazz up common features such as Rolling Reels, Multiplier Trails, Free Spins, and Jackpots.Hyper Star bills itself as 'an undisclosed fun place of gaming and clubbing at night, hinting Las Vegas.' That's a pretty accurate description as the game certainly is bright, lit by a multitude of lights and reflective surfaces like a rhinestone jacket or the inside of a disco ball. Hyper Star might have worked better if Gameburger had pushed the Vegas concept even further, going completely over the top. There is plenty of sparkle as it is, but when combined with the loungey soundtrack, it kind of felt we were stuck outside the casino queueing up instead of going wild in the middle of a heaving gambling den.Played on a 5x3 sized game area, Hyper Star is available on any device, offering stakes of 20 p/c to $/€40 per spin. With volatility rated as 'Very High', the game is RTP variable, where the most optimal return value is 96.05% - beware, depending on the market, Hyper Star may be set as low as 86.72%. The hit rate, meanwhile, weighs in at 32.88% and occurs when at least three matching symbols land left to right in adjacent reels from the Lefthand side. Keeping track of paylines is irrelevant, meaning players get 243 ways to win.The symbols used throughout Hyper Star further the Las Vegas hinting and consist of clubs, diamonds, hearts, spades, cherries, dice, casino chips, bells, dollar signs, and sevens. From the dice up, rewards for landing a five of a kid win range from 3 to 10 times your stake. Lastly, appearing on reels 2, 3, or 4 are Star wilds, substituting for all symbols, including scatters. Wilds are also needed to trigger the Jackpot Game; let's take a look.Hyper Star: Slot FeaturesHyper Star - jackpot gameWhen playing Hyper Star, the features players can look forward to are made up of Rolling Reels, a Multiplier Trail, Free Spins, and Jackpots.Rolling ReelsRolling Reels are active in both the base game and in free spins. This mechanic removes winning symbols from the reels, making way for new symbols to drop down into the gaps. Rolling Reels can award consecutive wins from a single spin, only ending when no new winning combination is formed from a drop.Multiplier ReelThe Multiplier Reel is tied directly to Rolling Reels, being a win multiplier which increases with each consecutive Roll. During the base game, the trail increases from x1 on the initial land to x2, x3, then x5 on the first, second, and third Roll, respectively. During free spins, the Multiplier Trail increases to x3, x6, x9, then x15.Free SpinsLanding 3 or more scatter symbols in any position awards free spins. Each triggering way awards 8 free spins, up to a possible starting number of 32. Free spins use the higher win multiplier trail going up to x15 as stated above whilst its reels also hold more wild stars. Free spins are retrigged when at least 3 scatter symbols hit.JackpotsJackpots can be won from the base game or free spins. Whenever wild symbols land, they are collected, and when Rolling Reels sequences are complete, there is a chance the Jackpot Bonus triggers. If activated, one of the three jackpots is awarded. Jackpots hold fixed values of 15x, 100x, or 5,000x the bet for the Minor, Major, and Grand prize.Hyper Star: Slot VerdictYeah, nah, don't know, we just weren't feeling this one. Probably because despite all the glitz and glam, Hyper Star's looks and style of gaming has been done so many times before, it felt a bit plasticky. The slot does try hard to overcome the underlying banality with an abundance of flashing lights and faux Las Vegas decor but winds up chilling off the strip like a big-budget travel deal gone awry. No doubt players who like this combination of features will probably be thrilled with a new flashy addition to the fold. Otherwise, Hyper Star delivers quotidian gaming that can be found anywhere and everywhere.There's not much to add about the features since they're the sort of thing players will be well accustomed to. Rolling Reels do play well with the 243 ways to win system, and Multiplier Trails in both phases of play is a bonus too. This sort of setup has been a crowd-pleaser since it was popularized by the likes of Gonzo's Quest back in the day and is still going strong. Players following Gameburger's 'Hyper' range might be happy seeing something that doesn't follow the 9 Masks of Fire script like Hyper Strike or Hyper Joker did. Though at heart, the games all share a similar template of spinning for jackpot prizes. As to top rewards, the Grand jackpot in Hyper Star is more than double what is possible in the two previously mentioned Hyper games, yet the overall potential is about the same, maxing out at 7,250 times the stake.Hyper Star does its thing capably enough, but what it had to offer was just too commonplace to get enthusiastic about. So, after a run-through, there was little to no compunction to cross paths with Hyper Star a second time.

Title: Book of Toro
review: Book of Toro: Slot OverviewIf you missed the news, ELK Studio is celebrating the fifth anniversary of their smash hit Wild Toro with a three-stop world tour. Each event on the calendar sees the release of a new Wild Toro styled game, and Book of Toro is the second on the schedule. The first was Wild Toro 2, which successfully took the characters, gameplay, and features players loved about the original, then significantly expanded it. Speaking of expanding, number two slot on the world tour, Book of Toro, uses the special expanding symbols characteristic of these sorts of games that fans no doubt want to see. However, this isn't a simple matador themed 'book of' slot. ELK has done a number on the format, somehow squeezing in a host of Toro elements to produce a very unique 'book of' game.You might not get this impression at the beginning since the game is located in a generic Egyptian location decorated with sarcophagi and hieroglyph covered pillars. The 10 numbered paylines are even listed on the sides of the 5-reel game grid. This is more a respectful acknowledgement of the classic nature of these games though since the rest is wholly modern. Special mention needs to go out to ELK's sound team, once again providing an indulgent serving of ear candy. The music has an Egyptian touch, but it's not a chilling on the banks of the Nile sketching pyramids vibe, but rather closer to something you'd crank with the ragtop down while cruising the streets of modern Cairo.Book of Toro is playable on any device, offering a range of bets from 20 p/c to $/€100 a pop. As can be expected, volatility is high, yet not the highest, rated as 7 out of 10. The RTP, meanwhile, isn't exactly the highest either on 95%, though the game uses only one universal RTP, so you always know what you get. Regular wins occur when at least two highs or three low pay symbols land from the leftmost side at a frequency of 23% - unfortunately, there is no mention of bonus frequency.Symbols, for the most part, are typical Egyptian icons, but ELK has brought some individual flair to them. From bottom to top are 10-A royals, scarabs, bird adorned jewellery, Eyes of Horus, and the matador as the most valuable symbol. Interestingly, the matador doesn't feature in Book of Toro anywhere near as much as previous games. There is a lot going on in Book of Toro, and as a counterbalance, symbol values aren't as high as they are usually, where five premiums are worth a payout of 20 to 250 times the stake. This doesn't dampen the game's overall potential, it has to be said. Three wilds pop up at various times – a wild book scatter, a walking wild and a regular wild. All substitute any pay symbol to help complete wins.Book of Toro: Slot FeaturesBook of Toro has a lot going on. As well as free spins with expanding symbols are Toro Goes Wild, Mummy Respins, and five X-iter bonus buy options, where available.Toro Goes WildToro the bull is a walking wild, which only appears on the last reel. When Toro hits, he moves one reel to the left until he falls off the grid, generating a respin for each step. If a Mummy Symbol lands at the same time Toro is in view, the Toro Goes Wild feature is triggered. With this one, Toro moves vertically, then horizontally to knock all mummy symbols off, leaving a trail of regular wild symbols behind him. On a side note, book symbols are sticky during Toro Goes Wild.Mummy RespinsLanding 2 or more mummy symbols in view triggers Mummy Respins. Mummy symbols lock into position for the following respin, and any new mummy symbols also lock and award respins. If Toro hits, the Toro Goes Wild feature is immediately triggered.Free SpinsThe book symbol is wild, but it is also the scatter. Landing 3, 4, or 5 books awards 10, 15, or 20 free spins. At the beginning of free spins, a pay symbol is randomly chosen for expansion. If they can create a win, expanding symbols grow to cover all positions on their reels after any regular wins have been paid. Expanded symbols pay all lines and do not have to be adjacent to each other. If at least 3 books land during the feature, free spins are retriggered, and an additional symbol is selected to be an expanding symbol. It is possible to have up to 3 expanding symbols at once.In a twist, Toro substitutes for expanding symbols if he is present on the reels. In addition, if Toro covers an expanding symbol as he walks, it can still expand for a win evaluation. Keep in mind Mummy Respins and Toro Goes Wild can be triggered during free spins as well.X-iterUsers are able to play Book of Toro in regular mode or bonus mode. X-iter is the bonus mode and comes with 5 options:Mummy Respins (5x the bet) - one spin with guaranteed Mummy Respin.Toro (25x the bet) - one spin with a guaranteed Toro. Any book symbols that land on respins become sticky.Mini bonus (50x the bet) - 3 spins with a randomly selected expansion symbol.Bonus (100x the bet) - entry to the regular version of free spins.Super bonus (500x the bet) - gets you the bonus game, plus all book symbols are sticky. Also, expanding symbols are kept sticky as long as one additional expansion symbol lands or until there are expansion symbols on all five reels.Book of Toro - Mummy respins in actionBook of Toro: Slot VerdictBook of Toro's first surprise is that it appears to be the first 'book' slot ELK has done. The studio seems to have gotten by without needing any Ra in their lives up until this point. However, many developers succumb eventually, and the temptation to make their individual stamp on the genre must have proved irresistible. Individual is a good word for Book of Toro which does a bunch of stuff you won't find elsewhere. To squeeze so many features that are capable of blowing the game apart at any moment is a mathematical feat not to be sneered at. The other admirable thing is how Book of Toro retains such strong roots to two different games, and it is tough to think how ELK could have melded Wild Toro with 'book of' gaming any better.Turning to features, it's hard to know where to begin; there is so much going on. Let's start on a positive note by saying if you can get free spins on a good roll, they almost feel unstoppable. Factoring in respins, retriggers, multiple expanding symbol evaluations, plus Toro Goes Wild means bonus games can stretch, elongate, and run for a real long time. Sticky expansion symbols are a stroke of genius, and it's impressive how ELK has managed to incorporate so many different elements while still making everything work. Wild Toro's personality shines through the 'book of' format at all times, and the amalgamation of the two gaming forms is outstanding.Another talent ELK has is letting loose moments of unbridled chaos on the reels. Nitropolis or Nitropolis 2 are prime examples here, and players can get a taste of this in Book of Toro when all cylinders are firing and the game is throwing everything into the mix. Buying the Super Bonus is probably your best bet of experiencing the full-blown roller coaster effect. It's not cheap, yet an offshoot of all this mayhem is that winning potential is double the standard figure at 10,000x the bet.We've gushed on about the highlights but don't get the impression Book of Toro is some sort of cash cannon. ELK also knows how to control the chaos, and not every bonus round was a blinder. There's also the RTP concern, which might irritate some players. Setting that to the side, fans of Wild Toro and 'book of' style games owe it to themselves to give Book of Toro a whirl. It's got everything you might expect from a meeting between Toro and 'book' gaming, plus a whole lot more.

Title: Hyper Burst
review: Hyper Burst: OverviewThe latent power of volcanoes drives the action in Hyper Burst from Yggdrasil Gaming. With streamlined features, Hyper Burst can nevertheless pull in all sorts of modifiers when respins are doing their thing. The result is a game that plays out much like the volcano it portrays. Meaning, Hyper Burst can lie dormant a lot of the time, but every so often blows its stack in an impressive fashion.The first look at Hyper Burst brought the slot Tahiti Gold to mind, yet it's not quite so moody. The volcano in the distance isn't as intimidating as the one found in ELK's version. Hyper Burst is dreamier. You can imagine 'Over the Rainbow' playing on a ukulele as you float over the misty trees and turquoise water into the scene, much like the intro to Coming to America.Hyper Burst - 10x respinWhen Hyper Burst gets going it's a different story. In the beginning, the sounds are menacing enough. When respins build, the drumming and chanting increases, so when big wins occur, it feels like some sort of bizarre island ritual is taking place. It gets pretty intense.Hyper Burst can be played on any device, with bets from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin available. The activity takes place on a game grid consisting of 6 reels, 4 rows, and 25 paylines, producing an RTP rate of 96.02%. The modest number of paylines isn't super effective in pulling in wins a lot of the time - until colossal symbols are created via the features.Wins are fairly regular in theory, officially better than 1 in 5 spins due to a hit frequency of 22.3%. It might not feel like it a lot of the time though. Rounding off the math model is a medium/high volatility, so don't expect to go all the way with Hyper Respins too often.To land a win, you need three to six matching symbols, left to right on a payline. Symbols reinforce the Gold series vibe, well the premiums at least, which are four masks in blue, green, purple and red colours. Premiums are worth 4 to 8 times the stake for combinations of six of a kind. At the lower end of the paytable is Jack to Ace card royals, worth 1 to 2 times the bet for a line of six.The golden wild appears in any position to substitute for all other symbols. It is also by far the most valuable tile in the game - six of a kind is worth 100x, and the likelihood of landing a line of wilds increases when they appear in colossal sizes. That completes the picture when it comes to symbols in Hyper Burst. There are no scatters, yet there is an extensive respins feature generating the game's best moments.Hyper Burst: FeaturesWhile there might technically be only one overarching feature – Hyper Respins, several extras splinter off them to enhance the experience. Every win triggers Respin Mode which comes with additional bonuses. The first respin joins 2 of the middle four reels together to form a 2x2 colossal lava reel. Each consecutive win in Respin Mode triggers another respin and makes the lava reel grow in size. The next increment expands the colossal lava reel to 3x3, and finally to 4x4 in size which is known as the Giga reel – no relation to Giga Blox.When the 4x4 reel is active the game shifts from Respin Mode to Hyper Mode. Here, wins continue to trigger respins, but a win multiplier also comes into play. The multiplier starts at x2, moving up through x3, x5, topping out at x10 if you keep on winning. There is no limit to how many respins will mount up as long as consecutive winners continue to be hit.Hyper Burst: VerdictIt's almost as if Yggdrasil took a page out of their partner Avatar UX's playbook when designing Hyper Burst. Similar to slots in the PopWins range, the aim of Hyper Burst is to get on a massive roll where features build off of each other, getting bigger and more potent as they move forward. In this regard, it's also similar to Yggdrasil's own Valley of the Gods 2. Like the Egyptian themed sequel, when a bunch of Hyper Respins link up, they can be a real treat. The earth-shaking effects amplify the enjoyment too, a nice touch from the Yggdrasil sound team there.They say it only takes a spark to light a volcano, which might be true, but sparks can also burn out quickly on their own without making much of a fuss. Hyper Burst is a game that has to go all the way, or a significant part of the way, to get much out of it. During testing, part of the way meant wins in the 200x+ region, but getting past that amount was a hyper rare occurrence. Interestingly, after a session of ups and downs, the bankroll ended up pretty much where it started.There are loads of single or double respins which don't go anywhere. Yet despite that, Like Valley of the Gods 2, it's easy to hit the play button one more time. Just one good roll is all it would take to hit Hyper Burst's potential of 12,800 times the stake. Okay, it would have to be a pretty epic chain of respins, but still, knowing it is possible makes it easy to justify repeat playing.It can get frustrating if you're caught in a patch of dead spins, or short runs of respins which are more tease than thrill. Still, Hyper Burst is a good example of a game that does perfectly well without a tradition free spins bonus, so if you're into extended cascade sequences and potent respins, it's most definitely worth a look.

Title: Amped

While aesthetically ok, it comes across as somewhat gerneric and the theme hasn’t been expanded on much, nor the math model, making Amped middle of the road type gaming rather than a hedonistic free for all.Like the low key trance soundtrack, Amped’s gameplay doesn’t exactly get you hugely amping either. Amped is unlikely to get too much hype or accolades, as if the team needed something to play around with, in between working on the studio’s potential hits.This lack of major investment shows, but it doesn’t mean playing Amped is a negative experience. Just don’t expect it to hold much interest once you’ve seen the four bonuses do their thing. For the record - Big Bass Sticky Wild Free Spins turned out to offer the best results during testing. Something magical happens if you can accrue a bunch of sticky wilds in strategic places on the grid to produce tidy wins spin after spin. The other bonuses weren’t quite so exciting, though synced reels could be fun when the right symbols were in sync with each other.All together, Amped is an ok game for those after a benign EDM experience. Relax could have easily pushed things harder if they’d had the desire. Then again, there is a time and place for everything, including ravers who prefer to bop quietly in their safe zone rather than get shirtless and manic.

Title: The Dog House Royal Hunt
review: The Dog House Royal Hunt: Slot OverviewOne of the most beloved, scratch-under-the-chin, toss-a-treat-to slot ranges in developer Pragmatic Play's portfolio has got to be its poochie-themed Dog House range. The original slot, The Dog House, was released in 2019, and since then, a number of iterations have followed, including a Megaways version and an experimental quad grid Multihold variant, among others. The return value is generated by a highly volatile math model, so this is no lazing on the couch lap dog of a game.Big, bouncy, adorable imagery is the order of the day on the paytable, which includes 10-A card ranks, a bowl of bikkies, a collar, and 4 aristocratic canines. Five-of-a-kind royal wins pay 1.25x-2.5x, the middle symbols are worth up to 5x-7x, while the canine premiums pay 10 to 37.5 times the bet when landing 5 OAK.The Dog House Royal Hunt: Slot FeaturesThe Dog House Royal Hunt slot - free spinsLike serving up your pet's favourite food, The Dog House Royal Hunt brings back the wild multipliers and free spins features the series is famous for.Wild MultipliersWild symbols are present on the three middle reels. They substitute for all symbols except the scatter. On each spin, all wilds on the same reel have a multiplier of x2 or x3. Wild multipliers apply their value to the wins they are part of, and if more than one wild is part of the same win, the multiplier values are added to each other.Free SpinsHitting 3 scatters triggers the free spins round. Randomly, if the scatter symbols on the screen can move down one position without dropping out of view, a spin triggers where reels with scatters move one position down while the reels without scatters respin. Now, before the bonus round starts, a 3x3 grid spins, and each position reveals 1, 2, or 3 free spins. The figures are added up, and the total number of free spins is awarded. During the feature, all wild symbols that land on the three middle reels remain sticky on the grid for the remainder of the round. Sticky wilds have a random multiplier that is revealed when the wild hits and stays the same till free spins end. Scatter symbols do not land on free spins, so the feature cannot be retriggered.Feature BuyPlayers may spend 100x the bet to buy the free spins feature or pay 500x the bet to buy royal free spins where wild symbols have a multiplier of x10 or x20 when they hit.The Dog House Royal Hunt slot - free spinsThe Dog House Royal Hunt: Slot VerdictAnyone who's played and enjoyed The Dog House should instantly feel at home if they fire up The Dog House Royal Hunt for a crack. The theme shift is a bit of an unusual one, but it actually works quite well. The Arcadian background is just as inviting as the original's suburban bliss, and dogs dressed as humans is just good stuff. As such, The Dog House Royal Hunt rolls out a flea-bitten red carpet to effortlessly invite fans and newcomers in for a punt.In some ways, newcomers might get more out of The Dog House Royal Hunt than old hands since the gameplay hasn't progressed much since the original. Main thrills are triggered by landing abundant wild multiplier symbols to knock out an augmented line win. What's nice is that this effect may occur in the main game, keeping players busy while they attempt to trigger free spins. Like a cartoon dog in a top hat, sticky wilds are just what you want to see. Title: Cash Truck 2

Here are the special modifier symbols:Expander – unlocks 3 random positions from the locked area.Booster – adds its value to all other symbols in the unlocked play area when it lands.Super Booster – adds its value to all other symbols in the unlocked area when it lands and on each following spin.Grabber – adds the values of all other symbols in the unlocked area to itself when it lands.Super Grabber – adds the values of all other symbols in the unlocked area to itself when it lands and on each following spin.Doubler – doubles its value whenever the spin counter resets to 3.Cloner – selects the highest value in the unlocked screen, grabs the amount to itself and clones it to some empty spots.Compressor – adds the values of all cash symbols in the unlocked area to itself, then removes those cash symbols, making space on the board.Super Bonus GameIf one of the triggering symbols was a super bonus symbol, then the Super Bonus Game is awarded instead. The rules are the same, except the Super Bonus symbol carries over to the round, transforming into a Doubler, Super Booster, or Super Grabber for the feature.Cash Truck 2 slot - super free spinsCash Truck 2: Slot VerdictCash Truck 2 isn't technically the second Cash Truck game. That would be Cash Truck Xmas Delivery, which, as the title makes clear, was a Christmassy makeover for players who were keen on some lorry-chasing action during the holiday season. Title: Cursed Treasure
review: Cursed Treasure: Slot OverviewCursed Treasure is an online slot from developer NetEnt that takes players on an adventure in a thick, jungly location where they have the chance to get their hands on treasure via such features as Cash Prize symbols, Mystery Prize symbols, and a hold 'n win bonus round. Across its 5-reel, 4-row grid matrix, 20 paylines are built in for evaluating line wins and, in some instances, Cash Prize symbol wins.The paytable lists 10 to A card ranks as the low-win symbols, then a map, a book, and three further characters as the high-win batch. Now, when the Cursed Treasure feature is activated, a number of Cash Prize symbols equal to the number on the meter are placed on the reels. If the collection number is less than 20 in the main game, the Cash Prize symbols placed on the reels have values of 0.5 to 5 times the bet. If the collection has 20 or more, the values are 0.5 to 20 times the bet. If Cash Prize symbols are added to the same position as another Cash Prize symbol, the values are added together. After placement, wins are awarded, and the meter resets to 5.Mystery Cash Prize SymbolsDuring free spins, Mystery Cash Prize symbols may appear on the reels with a random value of 50 to 5,000 times the bet. Their prize is revealed at the end of free spins.Free SpinsA total of 3 free spins are awarded when 3 or more scatters land in the base game. During free spins, landing Cash Prize symbols (with values of 0.5x to 10x), Cursed Treasure symbols, or Mystery Cash Prize will resets the spin count to 3. These are the only symbols which appear in the free spins bonus round. Cash Prize symbols and Mystery Cash Prize symbols also stick in place when they hit. Cursed Treasure symbols are collected in a new meter that starts at 5, increasing by +1 for each collected symbol. When spins run out, the Cursed Treasure collection places a number of Cash Prize symbols on the reels equal to the number collected on the meter. Cash Prizes cannot be placed on Mystery Cash Prizes. Following this, the total prize value is awarded. Free spins end when the free spins counter goes to 0, all positions are full, or there are 15 Mystery Cash Prize symbols in view.Feature BuyFree spins can be triggered by using the feature buy, which costs 100 times the bet. When bought, free spins are immediately activated.Cursed Treasure slot - free spinsCursed Treasure: Slot VerdictCursed Treasure goes to show that when NetEnt wants to flex its game world construction skills, it can still do a solid job. The Skull Island/Indiana Jones thing is a little cliched, but that's okay; NetEnt has made nice use of it anywhere in a slot which hearkens back to the studio's earlier days. Maybe not quite Relic Raiders days, yet an earlier time when NetEnt was one of the towering powerhouses of slot design. This isn't to say Cursed Treasure is a powerhouse of a game, but for an uncomplicated hold 'n win slot in an exotic location with a lashing of adventure, it's not bad.The gameplay wasn't as striking as the audiovisuals, yet it has its moments. Winning Cash Prize values when they fall along a payline isn't wholly unique; 4ThePlayer, for example, has used this idea in its '4 Fantastic' slots, yet it's not a very common method. Nor is collecting Cursed Treasure symbols, which can end up adding Cash Prize symbols back onto the board at later points. The Cursed Treasure feature is a welcome addition to the base game, and it's able to add a positive end to a free spins bonus, as well, adding tension as the round progresses. Mystery Cash symbols are able to contribute to the anticipation, as well, since a single revealed 5,000x prize gets lucky players well on the way to the game's 5,064x max win.Cursed Treasure probably isn't the sort of slot that's going to thrust NetEnt back into the spotlight and have its competitors shaking in their boots. However, it's one of the better slots the studio has released of late, not only looking and feeling like a wholly NetEnt product (rather than seeming like a joint venture with Red Tiger) but also having a decent level of entertainment to offer the right gambler.

Title: Good Luck & Good Fortune

Like a hormonal teenager ready to rebel but lacking a cause to channel their energy into, so they lash out through 'unruly' behaviour, maybe listen to Rage Against the Machine's 'Killing in the Name' at obnoxious volumes in their bedroom, or pierce their nose to get a reaction out of parents that do care about them but are so busy they don't even notice their darling's minor act of rebellion.As for Good Luck & Good Fortune, you won't find much fortune here, restricted as it is by a 2,100x the bet win cap. Within this boundary, you may encounter some pretty odd stuff, including wild win values that seem wildly out of place, coupled with double scatter prizes of up to 1,000x the bet, which feel like two of Good Luck & Good Fortune's best ways of drumming up sizable results. The free spins round felt as if its main concern was triggering ever more free spins via wilds and scatters rather than actually attempting to land wins on them.And so ends an unusual review of an unusual game. Title: Hercules & Pegasus

Title: Nitro Circus
review:
Nitro Circus IntroductionIf you're not familiar with Nitro Circus, don't worry. It's an American thing like Wrestling or Baseball, so no need to feel like an old fossil. This adrenaline-fuelled slot features some of Nitro Circus’s biggest stars, greatest stunts, and craziest vehicles.
