It is triggered from the base game when at least 6 scatter symbols appear. In this feature, 3 respins are awarded with all scatter symbols held while the remaining positions spin. What may land are scatters, Soldiers, Demon symbols, or blanks. Demons and scatters display prize or bonus prize values. Only a single Soldier may appear on a respin, only if there are Demon symbols on the screen.Demon symbols have life values. The Red, Purple, Green, and Blue Demon have starting lives of 4, 3, 2, and 1, respectively. When a Soldier appears, its value is determined by collecting the prize/bonus values of all Demon symbols in view that have a life value greater than 0. All visible Demon symbols' life values are reduced by 1 to a minimum of 0.When a new prize symbol (scatter, Demon, or Soldier) appears, it is held and respins are reset to 3. When all positions are filled or no more respins remain, the round ends, and each prize symbol awards a prize or bonus prize. Non-bonus prizes on scatters or Demons range from 1x to 100x the bet. The bonus prizes are the Mini, Minor, Major, and Grand, worth 10x, 50x, 250x, or 2,000x the stake, respectively.Armageddon 10k Ways slot - respinsArmageddon 10K Ways: Slot VerdictWe mentioned Armageddon 10K Ways' rich story in the opening paragraph, and while the game world has been well designed, it is a slot which fell flat fairly fast. There's just not a lot going on action-wise for much of the time. The base game is without features or modifiers (aside from cascades if they count), just hit winning ways, and get teased when less than 6 scatter symbols hit about the place. Armageddon 10K Ways inhabits a captivating world of the future, one ripped apart by unbridled scientific ambition and hubris, but there's a lot of sitting around waiting while nothing really happens before getting to the more exciting stuff.That would be Armageddon 10K Ways' respins bonus, and again, it's pretty light-going. Okay, Demon symbols have life countdowns, and Soldiers collect their values, but that's about it. Gamblers can chase the Grand Prize, yet outside this one ray of hope, the rest of the prize values are generally quite meagre. The max win is not, though, marked as 10,338.5x the bet by the ReelPlay team, which was surprising. Clearly, Armageddon 10K Ways has the technical capabilities to perform. One of the game's main highlights is the Soldier collecting symbol values in the bonus respins round, provided there are some juicy Demon values in view for him to collect.ReelPlay's 10K range continues to chug along, and Armageddon 10K Ways was one of the more satisfying examples to review. There are limitations; the lack of secondary features is noticeable, and the bonus respins round is pretty basic, for example. But, the world-building, the thought patterns the theme evoked, and the Soldier collector symbol possesses a level of intrigue that pushes Armageddon 10K Ways above a few of its 10K Ways contemporaries.

Title: Book of Sheba
review: Book of Sheba: OverviewThe cat has long since left the bag when it comes to 'Book of' imitators. How many developers have made their versions of the classic slot now? Who knows, but the figure is bound to be impressive. It's time to chalk up another in a long list of imitators with iSoftBet's historically themed slot Book of Sheba.It's not their first time to do so either, that honour goes to Book of Immortals which they populated with Ancient Egyptian deities. The book symbol that appears during the base game has dual roles of wild and scatter. As a wild, it can replace any other symbol to form winning combinations. As a scatter, 3, 4, or 5 payout 2x, 20x, or 200x the total bet respectively, plus awarding 10 free spins.Before Free Spins begin, a book is flipped open and a special symbol is selected at random. However, players can reject the first symbol in hope to be awarded a more valuable one. However, the second special symbol must be accepted, so it's a gamble.During free spins, if the special symbol appears as part of a win, it expands to cover the full reel. Magically, these symbols do not need to be adjacent to do so. For example, if a special 10 lands on reels 1, 3, and 5, the symbols will still expand to cover those reels and create a payout.Interestingly, there's a twist to this particular book slot. A second book wild known as The Golden Book comes into force during free spins, appearing on reels 2, 3, or 4. Whenever it lands, it turns its respective reel into a golden reel. When a reel is gold, it will transform into a special expanding symbol if a win with that chosen symbol is possible. As a wild, the golden book can substitute for any pay symbol whilst also doubling as a scatter like the other book symbol.Another thing that has made these book slots so popular is the chance of getting one or more retriggers. This is accomplished by landing at least 3 book symbols anywhere on the reels which will then add 10 more spins to your total.The final feature is the Ultra Bet. Hit the Ultra Bet button to play 50 games for a cost of 50 times the stake. During Ultra Bet spins, stars may appear layered on top of regular symbols to be collected. At the end of the 50 spins, if at least 5 stars have been collected a multiplier prize from x5 to 1,000x the individual bet is awarded. Moreover, with the Ultra Bet activated, the RTP goes up from 96.0% to 96.5%.Book of Sheba: VerdictWell, it's another 'Book of' slot, what else is there to say really? If you've played one, you have kind of played them all, to an extent. There are usually one or two tweaks to set them apart, and Book of Sheba has a few to give players something to check out. For the most part, they work pretty well too in setting Book of Sheba somewhat apart from the rest of the Book bunch.First is the Ultra Bet option that debuted in iSoftBet's football-themed slot Hot Shots 2. The peculiar thing about this feature is that it doesn't cost any extra to activate than 50 regular spins, yet it provides an additional chance to win. On the other hand, since players are locked to 50 spins it does help the developer make more predictable calculations in the mathematical model.If you are going to be powering through 50 spins anyway, activating it could be of some benefit since there's a chance to pocket up to 1,000x in extra winnings. The bonus game can still be triggered when the Ultra Bet is in motion, so it's a win-win really.Although not a new feature, the ability to reject the first special symbol offered is a welcomed addition. Better is the gold book, and gold reels, which can come in handy in expanding all 5 reels. Do so using the Queen, and wins of 5,000 times the stake are possible on a single spin.All the new elements don't exactly cover up the fact Book of Sheba is at heart, an attempt to cash in on a hugely popular slot format. However, the new bits are quite good and make Book of Sheba an interesting proposal for 'Book of' fans, or those looking for massive single spin opportunities in an exotic setting.

Title: Mutant Trawlers
review: Mutant Trawlers: Slot OverviewImagine if all the talk of global warming, carbon loading the atmosphere and mass extinctions created a sort of environmental fatigue where human beings as a whole just gave up and said, 'fudge it, let's just do whatever', leading to unbounded pollution, exploitation, and rape of the natural world. Title: The Library
review: The Library: Slot OverviewIn its quest for world domination, or so it might seem, software provider Hacksaw Gaming has added another games studio to the fold. They're often found in amazing buildings as well, and the bookish room Kitsune Studios has set up for The Library looks like a cosy place to sit down, relax, and turn a page or two. Not content with just books, The Library also reinvents several famous names from literature. More on them in the symbol section.The Library slot - base gameThe Library's 5x4 gaming area provides an enormous number of ways to win, from up to 100,000 in the base game to a whopping 3.2 million during free spins. Course, you'll need the Stackways feature to go absolutely bananas to hit those sorts of numbers. Users are able to select a stake of 10 c to $/€100 to play the game, which is highly volatile and has a maximum RTP of 96.34%.The Library's symbols are 10 to A card rank lows, then four what look like AI-generated versions of Lewis Carrol, Dante Alighieri, Edgar Allan Poe, and Beatrix Potter. A 5 OAK royal win pays 0.5-0.6 times the bet, while a 5 OAK premium win is worth 1.5-3 times the bet. Wild symbols are not part of the game.The Library: Slot FeaturesThe Library slot - free spins with special expanding symbolsStackways are The Library's main feature, available in the base game as well as in Stack the Shelves Spins and Super Stack the Shelves Spins.StackwaysA landed Stackways symbol stacks 2 to 10 symbols on its respective reel. There are two types of them. Normal Stackways have values of 2, 3, or 4, while Revealing Stackways reveal values of 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, or 10. The stacked symbol is chosen by the symbol that would give the longest winning combination out of the symbols on the grid when the Stackways symbol activates. If there is more than one option, the choice amongst the possible options is made randomly. Stacking only occurs if the result creates a win.Stack the Shelves SpinsIn the base game, landing 3 book scatters triggers this feature with 10 free spins. Players are randomly assigned 1 symbol to be the Special symbol. The Special symbol stacks and pays if it lands on 3 or more reels. Indicators below the respective reels reveal a number of 2 to 10, indicating the number of symbols that will be stacked.In addition, the Stackways symbol may appear on the grid. When it lands, it acts as the Special symbol, further increasing the stacking on the reel by the value it displays. Stackways merge their displayed value with the value displayed beneath their reel to increase the total stacking amount for that reel. In this way, up to 20 symbols may be stacked on a reel. Stackways symbols only activate when a Special symbol is part of a winning stack on its reel.It is possible to win +2 or +4 extra free spins by landing 2 or 3 scatters, respectively. If 4 scatters hit, the round upgrades to Super Stack the Shelves Spins and grants +4 free spins.Super Stack the Shelves Spins10 Super Stack the Shelves Spins are awarded from the base game when 4 scatters hit. This is the same as the regular Stack the Shelves Spins feature, except players are assigned 2 Special symbols at the start of the round.Bonus BuyClicking the bonus buy button reveals the following options: BonusHunt FeatureSpins mode costs 3x per spin to make each spin 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game, while Stackways FeatureSpins cost 50x, and they guarantee at least 2 Stackways symbols land. Lastly, players can buy Stack the Shelves Spins for 150 times their bet.The Library slot - free spinsThe Library: Slot VerdictHacksaw Gaming is a studio that hammers the daylights out of a feature it likes, bending, moulding, and reshaping it into various forms for use in various slots. Is it telling, then, that the studio hasn't put a ton of effort into reshaping its Stackways mechanic? Mayan Stackways wasn't bad, nor was Ronin Stackways, but Hacksaw Gaming, for whatever reason, hasn't done a lot else with the idea since then. On its first outing, Kitsune Studios has picked up the feature and created a game with eye-catching figures, predominantly the huge number of possible ways to win, though winning potential of 10,000x is enticing, too.Obviously, numbers aren't everything, and The Library is able to deliver positive moments which aren't solely figures-based. Stackways do their stacking thing as they have done in the past, though their application on the reels might have been better if the associated animation sequence had been more in keeping with the theme. The glass tube and electricity effect felt out of place in a library. Small detail, sure, and it's the reel modifying abilities which really count, fair enough. In that regard, Stacking Stackways symbols on top of Special symbols in free spins is a clever move, and The Library is able to put a lot of symbols on the board, if this sort of effect blows your hair back.For a first-up slot, The Library is pretty solid. It lacks a certain polish that comes with experience, and the AI-esque artwork on the pay symbols is a little odd. Brave of Kitsune Studios to take on a mechanic Hacksaw Gaming hasn't shown a ton of love for, but it's put it to pretty good use, and if this thing ever hits 3.2 million ways, then hopefully it's caught on film as doing so would give The Library some serious clout.

Title: Book of Power

Title: Splendour Forest

Title: Space Stacks
review: ﻿﻿Space Stacks: Slot OverviewTo push boundaries in any walk of life, it pays to be bold, and one studio which has displayed the sort of chutzpah needed to shake the gambling industry up is Push Gaming. If you are ready to go where gamblers are unlikely to have been before, let's take a trip.If you are going to design a far-out game, what better place to locate it than far out in the universe where there are still plenty of mysteries that science is yet to solve. Here's one. Assuming the Big Bang actually happened, our greatest scientific minds can't explain why it happened. Makes you wonder, is it better we don't know? Imagine it was a cosmic booboo like some advanced being accidentally dropped a beaker of experimental goo on the floor, and to avoid getting told off for making a mess, pricked a hole in the fabric of reality, squidged the goo through with their toe, which then festered into the three-dimensional realm we find ourselves in.Space Stacks - bet optionsAnd so, how to play Space Stacks. Firstly, the base game has 10 reels out of which 7 award Instant Prizes; the other 3 lead to bonus games. A bit like playing roulette, players pick the size of the bet they would like to make by selecting chips and then clicking the reels they would like to bet on. The first six Instant Prize Block reels start with bet multiplier values of 2, 2, 3, 5, 10, and 50, whereas the three Bonus Block reels are the Astro, Flip, and Apex. The Max Block is an Instant Prize of 5,000x. Players are free to bet on as many reels as they would like, and the minimum stake for all choices is 0.01 credits – max bets range from 10 to 100 credits depending on the reel.Once the bets are set, hitting the spin button starts a game round. First, there is a chance that the first six Instant Prize values are increased by the Enhancement feature. This can add values of +2 to +1,000 or activate multipliers of x2 to x100. Then, a number of symbols and blocker tiles start dropping onto the reels. Symbols fall to the bottom of the reels while blocker tiles are removed. Symbols/blockers continue to be dropped onto the grid until one or more of the reels are filled with 10 active symbols. If players bet on the successful reel/reels, they win the respective prize.Space Stacks: Slot FeaturesSpace Stacks - game boardWhen players bet on the Astro, Flip, or Apex reels and win, the corresponding bonus game is triggered.Astro - Astro triggers an Instant Prize wheel with 32 segments. The segments on the wheel contain Instant Prizes of +2 to +1,000, multipliers of x2 to x100, and a Collect segment. Players collect Instant Prizes and multipliers until the wheel lands on the collect segment.Flip -  A 6x6-sized board is displayed on the screen, and players pick 3 of the down-turned tiles. Each picked tile reveals an Instant Prize of 1x to 1,000x or a Rocket Symbol. The first Rocket Symbol activates an x2 multiplier, then each Rocket after that increases the value of the total win multiplier. The win multipliers possible are x2, x5, x10, or x100. When a Rocket is picked, it does not reduce the number of remaining picks.Apex - Apex is similar to the base game, but with a few different rules. This time it has six Instant Prize reels with starting values of 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, and 20. The Enhancement feature runs with possible enhancements of x2 to x20. When a column has been filled, its respective prize is collected. When a second column is filled, its prize multiplies the already collected prize. Each Instant Prize won multiplies the already collected prize. When 2 columns have been filled, the game activates three lives. Landing one or more symbols resets the life count back to 3. When no symbols land, one life is removed, and when all lives are gone, the feature ends. Alternatively, the feature will end when all columns are filled. The total win is multiplied by the bet on the Feature Block, which is displayed on the screen during the feature.Space Stacks - Astro feature in actionSpace Stacks: Slot VerdictPush Gaming set out to do something different with Space Stacks, and they've certainly accomplished that objective. When anyone deviates from the norm to this degree, be it Space Stacks, Pragmatic Play's Spaceman, or much of what Crazy Tooth Studio has done, it won't be everyone's cup of tea. It might well take a good few spins, or game rounds, to get to grips with what Space Stacks is trying to achieve and see if you actually like what it offers. Here, the top payout is 5,000x the bet.One thing that takes more thought than usual is how to place bets. It's not a case of picking a stake and smashing the play button. It might have been handy to have the hit frequency as well, but maybe that would be asking a bit too much. Title: 3 Clown Monty

If the Multiplier Meter is active, then the extra added wilds can be Multiplier Wilds.3 or more scatters kick off the bonus round via a pick-me style bonus feature where you win 5 to 12 free spins. During free spins, the Multiplier Meter is always active, and wilds are always Multiplier Wilds.Play'n GO has also buried another feature within free spins called Monty Spins. Once again, a pick-me feature is triggered when 2 or more scatters are in view, awarding 4 to 9 Monty Spins. In Monty Spins, the active Multiplier Meter is fixed for the duration, and all Multiplier Wilds are sticky. At the end of Monty Spins, there is a chance to win +3 extra Monty Spins or return to regular free spins.3 Clown Monty: Slot VerdictPlay'n GO's special free spins within regular free spins concept has been pushed to its limit in 3 Card Monty producing larger than normal results. Play'n GO has a few of these sorts of games under their belt now, with the Russian Doll effect appearing in slots like The Green Knight or Cat Wilde and the Lost Chapter. However, neither of those two games used it as effectively as 3 Clown Monty does. Needless to say, if you can make it all the way to trigger Monty Spins, then there is a good chance a solid return is coming your way.Until reaching that level, like a few of these simply designed Play'n GO slots we've reviewed recently, there can be a fair amount of waiting around during the warm-up act for something to happen. However, if patience is paired with good fortune, then 3 Clown Monty is capable of blowing right up during free spins – especially if the sticky Multiplier Wild feature comes into play. Nesting of features has been used to good effect in previous Play'n GO slots, yet not quite as good as it can get in 3 Clown Monty, where wins as impressive as 20,000 times the stake are up for grabs.While the features are not brand spanking new, 3 Clown Monty thrusts them to levels not typically seen from this studio. The theme is a little on the creepy side, and if you fail to get a positive financial result, the morose looks on some of the clown's faces aren't exactly conciliatory. Title: Wild Trigger
review: Wild Trigger: Slot OverviewAy caramba players - looks like we're heading out West in a shoot 'em up styled slot from developer Play'n GO called Wild Trigger. The West was indeed a pretty wild place, hence the name, but that doesn’t mean it couldn’t produce comedic moments. Actually, in Wild Trigger, ironic might be a better word than comedic. In this Western, a couple of bandits called Clint McGraw and Dottie Fields have ripped off a bank in one of the biggest heists ever seen in the West. However, now they've got their hands on the loot, they don't want to share it. To settle the matter, the two criminals face off across the reels alongside features such as Walkdown Re-spins and Duel Free Spins.Birds circle ominously overheard when Wild Trigger loads, before the camera pans down to rest on a dusty middle of nowhere town, characteristic of the Wild West. Whatever your thoughts on the rest of the game are, Play'n GO has designed what has got to be one of the hottest looking slots on the market. Now, we don't mean hot the way Paris Hilton uses the word, but in regard to temperature. Thanks to the heat haze effect, the sepia tones, the sheer amount of dust, the screen fair sizzles when Wild Trigger lights it up.Melting in the middle of it all is Wild Trigger's 5x4 game panel, which has 20 paylines that usually pay left to right, though occasionally they pay both ways. If you look to the side of the reels, arrows are handily provided to alert you to the active direction. Slight overkill since they only pay both ways when respins or free spins are active, but still, handy. A medium volatile game, Wild Trigger's most optimal return to player value is the 96.2% version, offering a real range of stakes from a minimum of 2 p/c per spin up to a maximum of $/€100.Lining up the paytable, we come across 10-A symbols as the lower value symbols, paying out a reward of 5-7.5x the bet for a five-symbol line. Next are bourbon bottles, hats' n boots, pistols, dynamite, and sacks of gold, worth 12.5 to 50 times the stake for five of a kind. Two wild symbols make their way onto the reels as well, substituting for all symbols, and are integral to Wild Trigger's features.Wild Trigger: Slot FeaturesWilds appear on reels 1 and/or 5 only and always land stacked, covering all positions on their respective reel. Landing 1 of them triggers a Walkdown Respin where the wild is sticky, and paylines shift to paying both ways. When both of the wilds hit at the same time, then 10 Duel Free Spins are awarded. For the full duration of the free spins bonus round, both wilds are sticky, and the grid pays both ways.Wild Trigger: Slot VerdictWild Trigger takes place in one of the most desolate locations ever seen in an online Western-themed slot. The heat haze, the dust, the confrontation between two former partners, the buzzards, it all adds up to a pretty bleak scene. However, this is a bit of a front, in a way, because when drilling down into the details, Wild Trigger is actually one of the 'softer' Westerns we've come across in a while. This by no means makes it a bad game, as such, but if you're gunning for legendary status, it's unlikely to happen in these parts, muchacho.The reason is that while a lot of other developers are arming their Western slots with the biggest sidearms they can find, Wild Trigger takes aim at a different batch of gunslingers. Supposedly, players who like their Western slots a little more laid back, who aren't too fussed about chasing down the biggest rewards out there. Anyone in this group might be cool with what Wild Trigger does then. Actually, what it does is quite close to a Red Tiger's rap slot, Hustling. The two games share a pay both ways, wilds at both ends dynamic, though if anything, Wild Trigger is the simpler choice. It's is not a massively lucrative slot either, as its max win figure stretches to 2,000x the bet at most. Hardly the level of swag you'd want to stiff a partner out of, surely.Well, it doesn't get much shorter or sweeter than that, really. Wild Trigger is not a game which comes out guns blazing from the get-go, nor does it ever really do so. The features are pretty sparse, with just sticky wilds to look out for, so the action does get a bit repetitive after a while. Maybe if wilds walked during respins, or a multiplier feature was introduced at some point, or anything really, the game might have found it easier to shift up a gear. The 2c bets might be useful, but it's almost as if the onscreen heat has induced a level of lethargy Wild Trigger struggles to shake off.

Title: Genie's Arabian Riches
review: Genie's Arabian Riches: Slot OverviewAh, the old question: what would you ask for if you rubbed a lamp and a genie popped out to grant 3 wishes? Eternal life, riches, health, peace, Don Juan-level powers of seduction, infinite wishes? It's fun to fantasise but pointless, too, since, you know, genies don't exist and all. Or do they…? A question for another day as we turn to Genie's Arabian Riches, a slot by Games Global partner Neon Valley Studios. If a genie-themed scatter-paying slot would be one of your wishes, then consider it granted. For this is what Genie's Arabian Riches is in a nutshell, and if multiplier symbols and Rolling Reels are further wishes, then this really is your lucky day.When you think scatter pays these days (at least, when Genie's Arabian Riches was reviewed), it's often nigh on impossible not to draw comparisons to Pragmatic Play's hit Gates of Olympus. It would appear that Neon Valley Studios might have been thinking the same thing because Genie's Arabian Riches has a number of commonalities. For one, we're dealing with a powerful entity, this time a genie, who, like Zeus in Gates, hovers in the air next to the gaming grid. For two, Genie's Arabian Riches has multiplier symbols here, too, tied to the MultiChase element. For the view, Genie's Arabian Riches puts on a sparkling, golden-hued, enchanting vision of its Arabian setting. Even the gold bars framing the 6x5 gaming grid are Arabian influenced, and instead of using paylines or ways, it uses a scatter pays mechanic to land wins. When 8 or more matching symbols are on the grid in any position, a winning scatter combination is formed. The winning symbols are taken off the board, and others drop down to replace them. The hit rate on all models, including the default 96% RTP model, is 24%, and the volatility is high. Players may choose a stake of 20 c up to $/€120 per spin and are also able to buy the free spins round if they so choose.A moon and 4 other gem-like shapes are the lower-value symbols, while the higher-value ones are a cup, a pair of shoes, a dagger, and a carpet. Hitting a winning scatter containing 8 identical symbols pays 0.2 to 3 times the bet, going up to 2 to 50 times the bet when 12+ identical symbols are in view. One thing to say, Genie's Arabian Riches doesn't offer up wilds in the base game or in free spins. The Rolling Reels mechanic removes winning symbols from the grid and drops symbols down to replace them. As long as a new win appears after symbols have dropped, this feature will continue to consecutively trigger.Genie's Arabian Riches: Slot FeaturesGenie's Arabian Riches slot - free spinsThe lineup of features in Genie's Arabian Riches are Rolling Reels, MultiChase Rolling Multipliers, free spins, a Rising Rewards free spins multiplier, and feature buys.MultiChase Rolling MultipliersA multiplier of x2 to x100 is randomly awarded for each multiplier symbol that lands on a winning spin. Multiplier symbols remain on the grid until the Rolling Reels process has finished and may randomly be upgraded. In the base game, all present multiplier symbols are added together, and the total is used to multiply the spin's win.ScattersLanding 3 scatter symbols in the base game increases the free spins multiplier by +1, up to a maximum of x20. When 4, 5, or 6 scatters hit, they award 10 free spins plus a prize of 1x, 20x, or 200x the bet. While free spins are active, hitting 3 scatters triggers an additional +5 free spins. The free spins multiplier does not apply to scatter retrigger wins.Free SpinsWhen free spins are triggered, the current value on the free spins multiplier is carried over, which persists till the round ends. However, when a win occurs, and there is at least one multiplier symbol in view, the multiplier value is added to the total multiplier and applied to the win on that spin. The total multiplier keeps the updated value. Note that the total multiplier does not apply to wins if a multiplier symbol is not in view on the spin, and a multiplier symbol will not add its value to the total multiplier unless a win occurs on the spin. At the end of the round, the free spins multiplier resets to x1, though it can randomly reset to x2, x3, or x4.Feature BuyIt is possible to buy free spins with an x1 multiplier for 50x the bet. Alternatively, if the free spins multiplier is higher than x1, then players can buy free spins with the higher multiplier value at the cost indicated on the screen.Genie's Arabian Riches slot - feature buy optionsGenie's Arabian Riches: Slot VerdictOfficially, we haven't seen much of the MultiChase feature since Thunderstruck Stormchaser and Sugar Craze Bonanza from Stormcraft Studios and Hammertime, respectively. In reality, since MultiChase appears to boil down to multiplier symbols hitting the reels, pssh, that happens all the time. It's a bit odd when studios give names to a general feature or mechanic, like the Nobleways thing All For One used once upon a time to name the 15,625 ways to win system in Mayan Eagle, for example. Nah, multiplier symbols in scatter-paying slots are common stuff, having reared up in, well, Pragmatic Play's Gates of Olympus as an obvious example, which seems to have served as a template for Genie's Arabian Riches in general.In other words, if you like what Pragmatic Play's been doing in the scatter-paying space, there's a chance you'll like Neon Valley Studios' effort as well – provided raging originality isn't a key marker of a good slot. Genie's Arabian Riches advertises a max win potential of up to 15,000x the bet and uses many of the same tools as the previously mentioned slot to try and crack it or attempt to at any rate. Scatter wins, Rolling Reels, multipliers, it's a combo that's hard to beat and, apparently, hard to improve on.That might not be completely fair, actually. Neon Valley Studio has spiced up the mix, added an extra squeeze of lemon juice to the hummus, if you will, by adding a growable starting free spins multiplier, fed when hitting exactly 3 scatters in the main game. Plus, the base free spins buy is quite cheap (relatively speaking), so when tallying up all the parts, Genie's Arabian Riches is pretty decent as far as copycat wannabes with a couple of tweaks go.

Title: Pilgrim of Dead
review: Pilgrim of Dead: Slot OverviewThe abundance of 'book of' slots is pretty common knowledge, but there is also a significant number of 'of Dead' games as well. The vast majority have come off the Play'n GO production line with Book of Dead being perhaps the best-known and most beloved of the lot. Here's another to add to the growing list going by the name of Pilgrim of Dead. Like a lot of its kin, Pilgrim of Dead largely sticks to a well-used blueprint while injecting one or two tweaks to give fans something a little different to try out. In Pilgrim of Dead, that means free spins where a randomly chosen symbol expands and pays from anywhere with an unusual sticky element.While some people have looked at cryonics to provide a possible future resurrection, for the Ancient Egyptians, death was simply a temporary event on an eternal journey. For them, when the physical body ceased to be, it wasn't the end but the beginning of the next phase of a person's voyage through immortality. There's something deeply reassuring about that viewpoint, and the culture it came from also created some of the most striking art, architecture, and literature the world has ever seen. Some of it manages to work its way into Pilgrim of Dead, which has a heavy vibe, not quite Hand of Anubis heavy, yet thick with a Pharaonic/temple/tomb atmosphere. It still retains clear visual links to Book of Dead, so fans of Play'n GO's 'book of' style should feel right at home.Pilgrim of Dead slot - base gameAnother one of the links is Pilgrim of Dead's set-up, as it's played on a 5-reel game grid, each reel holding 3 symbols and crossed with 10 fixed paylines. Players can expect a highly volatile session with a maximum theoretical return to player maxing out at 96%. Just like in the old days of Play'n GO, the provider insists on using coins to represent a lot of its values; which is either quirkily old school or kinda annoying. This means users can pick coin values and coin numbers when it comes to stake selection, with monetary values of 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin.Along the 10 paylines, if at least two premiums or three low pays land left to right from the first reel onwards, wins are formed. For five symbol winning lines, payouts equate to 4 to 6 times the bet for the 10-A card ranks or 12.5 to 100 times the stake for the scarab, scales, Anubis statue, or Pharaoh symbols. Lower than normal, perhaps, though the sticky symbol aspect in free spins helps tip the scales back.Pilgrim of Dead: Slot FeaturesPilgrim of Dead slot - free spins with special expanding symbolPilgrim of Dead doesn't have a book as its wild/scatter symbol (the book was removed from Book of Dead, likely due to legal reasons), but a tomb instead. The tomb symbol lands anywhere and can replace all paying symbols to help complete winning lines – with the exception of expanding symbols. It also pays out, having the same value as the Pharaoh top premium. When 3 or more tomb scatters land, 5 free spins are awarded.The first part of the bonus round involves a pay symbol randomly being selected to be the special expanding symbol. When the symbol is revealed, players can reject it, and another one will randomly be picked. Players must accept the second symbol; it cannot be rejected.In free spins, when the chosen symbol lands on at least two reels if it's a high pay, or three reels if it's a low pay, it expands to cover all positions on its reel. This occurs after any regular line wins have been awarded. Expanded symbols pay all lines from any position. What's different is that the first chosen symbol to land on each reel becomes sticky. So after it has expanded and paid, it reverts to 1x1 size and is locked in position until the round ends, capable of creating another win on the next spin. Should 3 tomb scatters hit, additional spins are granted, up to 30 at the most.Pilgrim of Dead slot - free spinsPilgrim of Dead: Slot VerdictIf anyone knows how to pull off one of these 'book of' type slots with a twist, it's the team over at Play'n GO. The studio has a good number of them stashed away under its belt already, and they don't seem keen to quit any time soon. For fans of this style of play, that's a positive thing because Play'n GO are pretty darn good at making them. Pilgrim of Dead is a prime example. It looks the business, comes from a respectable line of previous slots, and most importantly, its twist is a good one.There is a case of checks and balances going on, however, which may not sit right with some. You can take quite a beating trying to trigger free spins, and to make sure the sticky symbols don't go too wild and crazy during the bonus, Play'n GO has reigned in the symbol values and decimated the number of initially awarded free spins. This tightens the bonus round-up, making it a tad more frantic than usual, as the race is on to get as many sticky expanders in place before the free spins run out. Retriggers are a technical possibility, of course. Being able to reject the first chosen symbol can be a blessing or a curse depending on what the second one might be. Great when it's an upgrade but you gotta laugh when turning down the King to get the Queen instead, as happened in one of the earlier triggers.Then there's the other side of the coin. When Pilgrim of Dead is on a repeat win run, with sticky symbols in place, expanding on every spin from then on out, it can be hella fun. Add everything together, and it's time to chalk up another entertaining Play'n GO 'book of' style slot. Pilgrim of Dead is probably different enough to put off some fans as much as it excites others, but well worth investigating if this style of gameplay is of interest.

Title: Chicken Drop
review: Chicken Drop: Slot OverviewPlayers, bust out your denim overalls and plaid shirts for Chicken Drop, a farmyard themed slot designed by provider Pragmatic Play. Chicken Drop is set in the sort of place where chicken wings and drumsticks are grown in Petri dishes rather than off animals themselves. This final symbol is the most profitable, and if you can land a cluster of 37+ strawberries, a coin win worth a massive 1,000x the stake is coming your way.Chicken Drop: Slot FeaturesOne thing Pragmatic Play is to be commended on in regards to their grid slots is they generally fork off in their own direction rather than use a standard collect winning clusters to trigger features approach. What you want to look out for here are tumbles, a couple of progressive modifiers, free spins, and a feature buy option.Central to the action is the tumble feature which removes winning clusters from the game board, dropping new symbols down into the gaps. This can lead to repeat wins from single spins, only ending when no new winning clusters hit.The progressive features launch when the watering can or 4 leaf clover symbols appear. Watering cans land first, highlighting an area of the grid. The more cans, the bigger the area can be from 2x2 to 6x6. When 4 Leaf Clovers hit, they accrue a multiplier starting at x2, rising to x10. When there are no more upgrades or clusters in view, an egg symbols is dropped on the grid, turning all symbols in the highlighted area into the same matching pay symbol – triggering the tumble mechanic again.The main event is a round of free games, triggered when 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols land to award 10, 15, or 20 free spins. On every single free spin, when tumbles have completed, a new symbols type and space is selected on the grid for an egg drop to occur - functioning in the same way as described above, including size upgrades and progressive multipliers. The feature may be retriggered indefinitely as well, when 4 or 5 scatter symbols land, adding +5 additional spins to the remaining total.As mentioned, Chicken Drop ships with a feature buy button, in jurisdictions where available. Paying 100x the total stake guarantees entrance to free spins.Chicken Drop: Slot VerdictLike an actual chicken farm, Chicken Drop gets pretty manic at times, fuelled by features that help boost each other to produce exciting moments. There are no qualms with what Chicken Drop does. Pragmatic Play has come up with an interesting interplay of egg drops and progressive features to ramp up potential wins. It's nice to get a taste of them in the base game occasionally, but knowing an egg drop will land on each free spin provides extra incentive to stick it out for the bonus round.Where Chicken Drop falls a little flat is in its generic nature. The concern is that it looks and feels a lot like other grid slots Pragmatic Play has done, such as the Fruit Party duo - though features are completely different. In regards to extras, Chicken Drop has more in common with Fat Santa in some ways though it is far from being an imitator as such. Chicken Drop also shares the same win cap as the two Fruit Party games as well, maxing out at 5,000 times the stake. For players interested in the odds, Chicken Drop compares quite favourably in general but is by far the least likely of the three to hit its top payout with a likelihood of 1 in 4,166,667.Chicken Drop ends up being another Pragmatic Play game with the means of delivering gaming that does get the pulse racing at times. However, it lacks an unnameable something to make it really stick in your mind and stand out from the dozens of other grid slots out there. There is an enjoyable lightness to it; the big-eyed rubber chicken thing is always good for a laugh or two, yet once the gaming's done, it lacks a killer dynamic to have you rushing back to the farmyard for more.

Title: Volatile Egypt Dream Drop

These are:6 free spins with Multiplier Wild values of x6, x7, and x8 on reels 2, 3, and 4, respectively, for a possible max value of x336.9 free spins with Multiplier Wild values of x5, x6, and x7 on reels 2, 3, and 4, respectively, for a possible max value of x210.12 free spins with Multiplier Wild values of x4, x5, and x6 on reels 2, 3, and 4, respectively, for a possible max value of x120.15 free spins with Multiplier Wild values of x3, x4, and x5 on reels 2, 3, and 4, respectively, for a possible max value of x60.Jackpot Spin & Dream Drop BonusThe Jackpot Spin may trigger randomly before a normal spin, where only DD symbols and blanks land. Title: Bison Bonanza
review: Bison Bonanza: Slot OverviewOne age-old division splitting people into opposing groups is the salty vs sweet question. Title: Diamond Duke

Each pick awards a prize of 0.25x to 100x the bet.Both WaysReach this level, and winning combinations can be formed of matching symbols landing left to right, as well as right to left.Flower Fortunes Supreme slot - bonus gameFlower Fortunes Supreme: Slot VerdictFlower Fortunes Supreme is quite a puzzling release. For a sequel, let alone a supposed 'supreme' sequel, it's tough to think of why players might want to select this one over the original. Flower Fortunes Supreme is not a badly made game, but there's just so much less to it than Flower Fortunes Megaways. Wherever you look, practically everything has been dropped to a lower setting as if this was the actual beta version that should have come out before Flower Fortunes Megaways. The fact you need to level up in order to benefit from higher RTP is a bit strange too although, to be fair, the default RTP is not terrible.It can be enjoyable for sure, collecting orbs, activating extra features and so on, though the voice that used to commentate the action is conspicuous by its absence. The levelling up idea is a clever one, and the combination of bigger reels with extra features can blow up the tension. There is a feeling you're missing out when playing Flower Fortunes Supreme, though, and one of the main reasons is the severe drop in potential. Now, the most to be had is 5,000x the bet, which is less than a third of the 18,480x found in the Megaways version (we're yet to see proof of that potential though). Fantasma no doubt has its reasons, but they will probably be hard-pressed to find many players who would call that number slash 'supreme'.If we were to speculate, it feels like the hushing up of Megaways is in some way a motivating factor for Flower Fortunes Supreme's existence – though we could be way off the mark, of course. Whether you want to class this release as a sideways step or a backwards stumble, Flower Fortunes Supreme doesn't feel like forward progression. Since the first one was such a positive step-up for Fantasma, it is a shame. Unless Flower Fortunes Megaways is phased out, so there is no other option; there aren't many other reasons to pick Flower Fortunes Supreme instead of the chunkier version that preceded it.

Title: Nightmaker
review: Nightmaker: Slot OverviewPeople tend to naturally find their tolerable sector of the broad spectrum of horror, from light, giggle-inducing nothingness to catatonic terror, turning away from topics which are just a little too much. So it is in slots, which are very rarely, if ever, actually scary but do occasionally dip into darker subject material. One studio that's not particularly famous for picking spooky topics is Swedish software provider ELK Studios, but the team has, for whatever reason, thrown on thick, heavy robes to have a dabble via the online slot Nightmaker.An Iron Throne without all the swords greets players as the game loads before plunging them into a rather creepy place. If, when you hear the words 'ELK Studios', you think of pirate birds or snorting cartoon bulls, you might need to make a perception adjustment because Nightmaker is a dark place indeed. The gaming grid sits within a bizarre tunnel of ridged objects, like something H. R. Giger might have designed to use in an Alien movie while possessing a number of fiendish references. The music is just as eerie, too, forlorn even, as if a battle has been lost before it's even begun, and vultures are already circling overhead.Nightmaker slot - base gameNightmaker's gaming area is pretty interesting too. It consists of 5 columns of symbols, landing by default in a 3-5-5-5-3 configuration with a feature row sitting on the top. This alignment produces 1,125 ways to win, rising to 3,125 when the four corner positions are unlocked and even higher when symbols are split - up to 25,000. A monster potential slot is driven by a highly volatile math model pushing out ELK Studios' go-to RTP of 94%. If that's not an issue, players are able to wager 20 c to $/€100 on each base game round.Four esoteric markings are Nightmaker's low pay symbols, awarding 0.4x the bet for 5 OAK, and its high pays are three odd objects and a skull face symbol, paying 0.8x to 10x the bet for 5-of-a-kind. Wild symbols substitute any paying symbol, and a winning combination of only wilds has the same value as the top-paying symbol. Wilds are indestructible till they reach the bottom of the grid, then they are moved with the next win, including any wilds stacked on top of them. Winning symbols are removed from the grid after they have paid. Gravity drops symbols down to fill the gaps, and any used feature symbols respin. The game will repeat this process as long as new wins appear.Nightmaker: Slot FeaturesNightmaker slot - free spinsThe features to spin for in Nightmaker are cascades, big symbols, a feature row, a bonus game, a super bonus game, Beast Spins, and X-iter bonus buys.Big SymbolsAny pay symbol can appear as a big 3x5 symbol on the middle three reels. Big symbols split into 15 1x1 symbols, and features apply to their respective columns. The rattle feature can trigger on any initial base game spin, awarding 1 to 3 big symbols.Feature RowFeatures on the feature row activate immediately and affect symbols in the affected column.Wild Spirit - effects 1-3 symbol positions, which can result in 1-6 wild symbols on the top positions of the affected columns. If there are already wilds or scatters in top positions, wilds are added to the next available positions from the top and spawned wilds get the multiplier of the symbol they replace. Wild Spirit keeps wild symbols indestructible for 1 additional win.Symbol Multiplier - adds a multiplier value to all symbols of the indicated type in the affected column. Wild symbol multipliers do not affect the jumping wild.Wildfire - triggers if there is a wild in the affected column, replacing all symbols on the column except scatters with wilds. The highest wild multiplier on the column will be added to all wild symbols on the column. A symbol with a higher multiplier will give that specific wild the higher multiplier value. Wildfire keeps wild symbols indestructible for 1 additional win.Split Symbols - splits all symbols except scatters on the affected column. Symbols can only be split once, and the maximum number of symbols on a column is 10.Bonus GameLanding 3 scatters in the base game awards 8 free spins. In the bonus game, one pay symbol is chosen to have a persistent multiplier attached to it. The four corners of the grid unlock for the round, increasing the number of ways to win. Landing a scatter in one of the corners awards +2 free spins, and the corner turns into a blocker.Super Bonus GameIf one of the 3 triggering scatters is a super scatter, the super bonus is awarded instead. In this feature, the super bonus symbol becomes a jumping wild that moves to a new position after each win and between free spins. The jumping wild temporarily gets the current multiplier of the position it covers. Landing a super bonus symbol in one of the corners in the bonus game or super bonus game generates an extra jumping wild.Beast SpinsBeast Spins are activated when scatters land in all four corners in the bonus game. During Beast Spins, only big symbols spin on the middle three reels.X-iterThe X-iter allows players to buy into different game modes. Bonus Hunt costs 3x the bet and buys a game round with more than triple the chance of triggering the bonus game. Wild Spins at 10x the bet buy a game round landing at least 1 wild symbol, and a game round with guaranteed Beast Spins costs 100x. The bonus can be bought for 100x or the super bonus for 500x.Nightmaker slot - free spinsNightmaker: Slot VerdictA number of studios have produced gloomy, heavy slots such as Print Studios' Darkness, Red Tiger's Judgement Day Megaways, Bullshark Games' Empress of the Shadows, as well as numerous releases from Hacksaw Gaming. Now, ELK Studios has turned its attention to the dark side, and not a bad job it's done either if you like slots grim, heavy, and perilous. Not just thematically either, as the highly volatile math model isn't exactly here to be everyone's best chum, and despite packing a lot of bells and whistles, play can technically go in any direction.This can be a good thing, though, because Nightmaker is a slot which feels like it's been wound tight, as if it's about to unleash at any moment. Any slot can, of course, but the particular combination of features, like splitting symbols and multipliers, combined with a lot of ways to win, produces an explosively on-edge feel. Exacerbating this effect is that lurking back there, in the shadows, getting up to all sorts of eldritch mischief is monstrous winning potential of 50,000x the bet. There are no max coins in this game either, so if, repeat if, the max win is ever achieved, it's going to be when Nightmaker pulls off straight reel-based trickery rather than dropping a jackpot-like symbol onto the board. One assumes Beast Spins have a part to play because of the way they can link so much of the gaming area, a bit like Dreadworks' Big Jack.It all makes for rather compelling viewing, and ELK Studios' foray into bleaker-than-usual subject matter has paid off. Don't want to be that one guy, but it does help that a lot of what's here feels like it might have been inspired by some of Nolimit City's output - the splits, symbol multipliers, jumping wilds, the darkness, etc. Of course, NLC doesn't have a monopoly on that stuff, but blending it together the way Nightmaker has done so made it hard not to draw parallels. If it's not obvious by now, Nightmaker triggered memories of a number of prior slots from a variety of studios. But the positive thing to note is that most memories were from rock solid slots, of which Nightmaker can stand proudly amongst, being a well-made, spookily exciting horror(ish) game that can jump scare with the big, freaky hitters.

Title: That's Rich
review: That’s Rich Slot: OverviewThere are a ton of these ostentatious show of wealth slots floating around that were popular a few years ago. It felt like this style had fallen out of favour, but the genre has just received a reboot from Play’n GO with the That's Rich video slot. The title is a bit of a giveaway of a slot drenched in glam and luxurious consumer goods. It's not quite as in your face as its wealth saturated 2015 predecessor Pimped, with its Snoop Dogg lookalike lead and his ladies, but it's still pretty out there. Where Pimped was aimed at hip gangster wannabes, That's Rich appears aimed at the female gamblers in the house. Or, anyone into fashion mags, high heels, and designer bags, we don't judge. For some gaudy good times, read on.That's Rich - free spins featureThat's Rich uses a transparent grid comprised of 5 reels, 3 rows, and 10 paylines that are fixed this time around. It's a simple setup and one that lets the glowing background shine through. The backdrop looks like the Arabian Gulf, or the Mediterranean sea through drawn hotel curtains. Without doubt, an overpriced room, perfect for posting a few hundred snaps for ‘friends’ back in colder parts of the world to make them jealous. Natch. The UI has been elegantly designed with super-in neutral beige tones, and bets are set there from 10 p/c to $/€100 a pop. Hit the big green button for single spins, or select the mustard hued button for autoplay options. Settle in like a new pair of Manolo Blahniks and enjoy the show.A simple set up gets a simple set of rules and the name of the game is landing combinations of three or more matching symbols left to right. Symbols come with expensive price tags as you'd expect, except the low pays which are a tastefully designed set of 10-A royals. High pays step it up with a bag and shoes, fancy house, yacht, banknotes, and the fashion mag as the most valuable. Land 5 magazines on a line and be rewarded with 40 times the stake for the trouble, though the wild is a bit better at 50 times the stake for five. A busty lady wearing a scrap of a white dress that the game sheet simply refers to as 'Famous Woman' is the wild symbol. The Famous Woman comes in two forms, the common 1x1 tile, and an expanded version we will look at in the features. In both cases the wild substitutes for any of the symbols except the scatter.The glitzy sheen of the game's exterior belies a rougher edged interior. Firstly, the volatility is rated fairly high at 8 out of 10 on Play’n GO's meter. RTP, on the other hand, can vary from 96.27% in best-case scenarios, down to 84.25% at certain non-MGA licensed operators. Clearly makes sense to read the label before diving in.That’s Rich Slot: FeaturesSpeaking of rich, one thing that is not particularity rich is the feature list that only really includes expanding wilds and Win Spins. Speaking of expanding wilds, the wild symbol may expand to fill the whole reel on any spin. During the Win Spins feature, that happens every time the wild symbol lands in view.Win Spins are pretty interesting and are triggered by the golden trophy scatter symbol. What the trophy is for is a little unclear. Supermodel of the year? Best actor/actress? There are no clues so players can make up whatever scenario suits them best. This is a slot all about fantasy lives after all. Well, Instagram fantasy lives at least.Anyway, scatters land anywhere, and when 3 or more are in view they trigger 5 Win Spins. Each Win Spin comes with at least one guaranteed winning combination. Win Spins can also be retriggered up to a maximum of 20 in total - this is achieved when a scatters lands, it awards 2 additional Win Spins. The only exception is if you have 19 Win Spins lined up already, then 1 scatter awards just the one Win Spin.But that's not all; each wild during the feature comes with a win multiplier attached. Every time a wild lands, it increases the Wild Win Multiplier by +1 up to a maximum of x20. The final touch is that x20 Wild Win Multipliers may be activated on the final Win Spin regardless of how many were collected during the round.That’s Rich Slot: VerdictThat's Rich initially stands out due to its cartoony, glam, Club Med feel. It's like reading a Jackie Collins novel by the pool in Corfu before scrubbing up for cocktails with girls and a night of dancing. Apologies for the pigeonholing, but judging by the symbols and imagery it appears that Play’n GO is making a play for the female crowd with this one. It would be interesting to get a females opinion so don't hesitate to leave a comment below! Are all these symbols of glam and wealth fun, or are they just stereotypical?Either way, it’s probably all meant to be good-natured fun from the developers. Besides, it's got a pretty hefty potential of 10,000 times your stake which gives it some bite. The max payout has an exposure probability of less than 1 in 100 million, which is a big number no doubt. But it is a lot less than the billion(s) to one odds that often crop up - when they are mentioned at all, rather than kept secret.That openness is one key to That's Rich's possible appeal. It's a slot that isn't afraid to be what it is and if wealth and shopping is your thing, then join in on the fun. If not, well, ta-ta darling. The math model and potential might be enough to tempt general slots players on board, but the theme is rather polarising. Along with the theme, the other main drawback is the shortlist of features. Aside from win spins, there isn't a whole lot leftover to see and do. In saying that, knowing that every single Win Spin is going to pay something, and in some cases award up to 20 in a row is quite a tempting proposal.To surmise, there are good things here to uncover. That's Rich is a fast-paced, no nonsense slot that will cater to all types of players, from old-school fans of Pimped to the latte-moms just getting into slots.

Title: Dragon Gold 88

However, Dragon Gold 88 appears to be a reskin of Big Bass Splash, so yeah, it is part of the wider fishing family, for good or for ill.Good if your idea of a fun time is collecting money symbols in an elaborate Asian setting. Gone are the bubbles, weed, and water of a fishing game; hello to the dragons and mountains of a classically presented Asian slot. Classically or generically presented, because Dragon Gold 88 does look like a ton of other slots found in this genre. On each spin, Dragon Balls have prize values of 2x to 5,000x the bet, which can be collected in free spins only.ScattersIn the base game, when 2 scatters hit, there is a chance the third one is brought onto the screen by a claw or by respins when the scatters on the screen can move down a position without falling off the grid.Free SpinsWhen 3, 4, or 5 scatters are in view, players win 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. The bonus round also has these modifiers:Randomly, when there are Dragon symbols on screen but no Dragon Balls, at the end of a free spin, Money symbols may appear in random positions.Randomly, when there are Dragon Ball symbols but no Dragons in view, at the end of a spin, a claw may appear to pull Dragon symbols onto the screen.Randomly, when there are Dragon symbols present but no Dragon Balls, at the end of the spin, the firecracker can transform all symbols except Dragons into something else.Buy Free SpinsPaying 100x the bet at the feature buy gets you a game round that lands 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols. Mental images arose of the Reel Kingdom team kicking around ideas to keep the Big Bass train motoring along yet struggling to come up with anything interesting and falling back on a cliched reskin. Has Big Bass Bonanza finally, finally, run out of steam? Some might be tempted to say yes after sampling Dragon Gold 88, but something tells us the bushy, facial-haired fisherman isn't done just yet. The cash cow is just too good to stop squeezing milk from. Also, after playing Big Bass Secrets Of The Golden Lake, there is a galaxy of genres Big Bass can plough into and dominate like an invasive alien fish species.Fair dues, Prag and RK have crossed Dragon Gold 88 over quite well. It's not hard to envisage Asian slot fans in the mood for Money symbol collection action being all over this. Dragon Gold 88 actually looks quite attractive for a Reel Kingdom slot, not trying to be mean, and it has, after all, proven features. Proven on many, many occasions, in fact. Coupling the pleasant Asian-inspired graphics with a 5,000x win cap and well-oiled gameplay means Dragon Gold 88 might be a hit in certain sectors. In other sectors, well, the slot industry already overflows with traditional Asian slots and Big Bass iterations, so the hooking up of the two might be formidably hard to bear.

Title: Crabbin for Christmas

Title: Sleeping Dragon
review: Sleeping Dragon: Slot OverviewMonsters guarding treasure is a motif that has been with us for a long, long time, and one of the most pervasive and visually arresting is the idea of a big ol' dragon jealously guarding its horde. Helping complete winning combinations, wilds are present on all reels except the leftmost reel to substitute all symbols except scatters or Money symbols.Sleeping Dragon: Slot FeaturesSleeping Dragon slot - free spinsStirring the dragon may occur when features trigger, where the possibilities include a Respin Bonus, free spins with giant symbols, and a feature buy section.Respin BonusMoney symbols appear on all reels with values of 1x to 80x the bet, or displaying the 20x Mini, 100x Minor, or 300x Major prize. Hitting at least 6 Money symbols triggers the Respin Bonus. However, if at least one Money symbol hits, there is a random chance the dragon wakes up, and 5 Money symbols are added to the grid to trigger the feature.3 respins are awarded, and only the triggering Money symbols remain stuck on the screen. The round ends when there are no more respins, or all positions are filled, then the values of all Money symbols in view are awarded. If a mega Money symbol hits, the Bonus Respin feature activates, where the mega Money symbol counts as one symbol, awarding its value once. During free spins, the 10-A card ranks pay 0.6x-0.8x for 5 OAK, while the four premiums award 1x to 4x for 5 OAK.Feature BuysIn Sleeping Dragon, players are able to buy the Respin Bonus or the free spins round, each costing 100 times the bet.Sleeping Dragon slot - respin featureSleeping Dragon: Slot VerdictAt the time of writing, Pragmatic Play had been on a bit of a local jackpot binge, and adding a touch of weirdness is the way Sleeping Dragon is, in many ways, a dragon version of Fiesta Fortune, reviewed mere days before. Fair enough, the two games are not bang on the same, but they both centre on a Respin Bonus, free spins where respins can trigger from, and local jackpots. Perhaps the developer threw the design team a set of features it wanted to see used, and half of them wanted a dragon slot, while the other half wanted a Latin America slot, so they split up to make competing games. Or, still thinking out loud here, maybe saturation of the local jackpot market was simply the overriding goal, so the more, the merrier? Whatever the case, here we are with another very similar game.However, while there are similarities, arguably more similarities than differences, Sleeping Dragon forks away from Fiesta Fortune in a number of ways, too.
