Lows are five rings worth 0.5-1x the bet for five, mediums are four masked robbers paying 2.5x to 5x for five of a kind, and the one high pay is a diamond symbol worth 12.5x for a line of five. Symbols can land stacked, and the last tile for this section is the gold bar wild, which substitutes for anything on the reels.High Street Heist: Slot FeaturesStep one in High Street Heist is clearing the pesky glass from the grid. When a full stack of the same symbol type lands, it removes the glass from its reel and awards a respin. If a full stack lands on the respin, the process is repeated. If you manage to break the glass on all reels on a single spin/respin sequence, 10 Heist Free Spins are awarded.Once in, landing a full stack of the same symbol type in free spins increases the Heist Meter by +1. When the Meter is full, +2 free spins are awarded and the lowest value robber symbol is converted into the diamond symbol. When all robber symbols have been converted to diamonds, filling the Heist Meter adds a +1 multiplier to diamonds and awards +2 additional free spins.Buy FeatureIf buying features is an option where you reside, you can pay 111x the bet for a spin that triggers free spins. It is possible to collect cash if winning combinations land on this spin.High Street Heist: Slot VerdictHigh Street Heist was a game we thought we'd like more than we did. There are definite good and bad points, plus it is quite original, yet there was something abrasive as well. It's as if Quickspin picked a cool theme but were slightly too timid with it. In the hands of a braver studio, High Street Heist might have made a bigger impact. The gang of hardened robbers seemed at odds with the so-so visuals.A bit unusually, the base game felt more innovative than the bonus round, thanks to the glass smashing feature. It's one of those things that you sort of love or hate, but good on Quickspin for trying something new. On the bright side, the glass smashing does give you a mission to focus on while spinning for wins, and it is satisfying when the glass on all five reels is busted up, gaining you entry to free spins. For the vast majority of the time, this isn't going to happen, so get used to plenty of near misses, or far misses for that matter. During these times, you have to put up with glass taking up much of the usable real estate, eating into win ways.Free spins are pretty regular, really, compared to paid spins. It's a case of collecting stacked reels to convert symbols, build a multiplier and win extra free spins. Compared to the breaking glass task in the base game, it's standard fare. Funny too, we'd just reviewed Eye of Atum before we test drove High Street Heist, and both games have a strong Eye of Horus vibe, what with the premium symbol upgrade dynamic. High Street Heist does up the ante by introducing a multiplier when all premiums have been converted to diamonds. It will most probably be quite a challenge to get to that point, but rewards have been boosted to match - in 100 million simulated spins, Quickspin's best result was a sizeable 21,160x the bet.High Street Heist is a game that is innovative in some ways, familiar (even dated) in others. Positives include a fairly unique experience, fronted by a playful bunch of outlaws getting up to no good, producing impressive numbers. Demoing is definitely the order of the day if the game appeals, though, as the smashing glass to unlock free spins concept and the restrained theme use is an acquired taste.

Title: Great Rhino Deluxe
review: Great Rhino Deluxe: OverviewLook out players, a stampede's a coming courtesy of Pragmatic Play's African wildlife slot Great Rhino Deluxe. That great rhino, he's getting a whole lot of mileage. This is the third iteration in the series which started with the Great Rhino, followed by Great Rhino Megaways, and now, the deluxe version. Don't expect masses of change though. Not a heck of a lot is different between this version and the original. Respins are still there, as are free spins plus the two modest jackpots.Visually, the game has moved on from the original Great Rhino slot. The deluxe version actually looks a lot like the Megaways version, albeit on a reduced grid. Now, we are back to the 5-reel, 20-payline format, set in the majestic African countryside. If you've played one, you'll know the drill - wavy grass, Acacia trees, wide-open vistas, all that sort of thing. Oh and plenty of wildlife on the reels of course.The soundtrack is a lot nicer than you usually find in an African themed slot. When you start to play, it begins with a rhythmical drum track, but when the chorus vocals kick in it gets quite uplifting. It's like when Rafiki held Simba on Pride Rock on the Lion King – it produces tangibly good feelings. Altogether, the visuals and effects give Great Rhino Deluxe a strong physical slot feel.Great Rhino can be played on any device, with stakes from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin available. Default RTP is above average, at 96.5%, but can be found at lower settings, while volatility hovers in the medium spectrum. It's not exactly a rampaging rhino, but the somewhat lenient math model is boosted by a respectable potential.Tapping the game's potential begins by landing combinations of three to five matching symbols. The 9 regular symbols are all the same symbols we found in the Megaways version, minus a couple of royals and a general reshuffle.Now, the line-up starts with Q-A symbols, followed by flamingos, hyenas, crocs, gorillas, and cheetahs. This time the rhino is the most valuable regular symbol (rather than the wild as was the case in Megaways), worth 20 times the stake for five of a kind. He also pays out when just two land on a payline. The golden rhino coin is the wild, paying out on two of a kind, or up to 25x for five of a kind. In addition, the golden rhino substitutes for all other symbols except the scatter.Great Rhino Deluxe: FeaturesGreat Rhino Deluxe - respin featureGreat Rhino Deluxe keeps it simple with just two features to dive into – super respins, and free spins.Super respins are triggered when two stacked reels of rhinos land on the same spin. The two stacks get locked in place, and three respins are awarded. During respins, only rhino symbols appear, and any new ones which land add another respin.New rhino symbols may, or may not, also display an x2 multiplier which gets applied to the line win. More than one multiplier on a line has their values multiplied together. When respins run out, all win combinations are paid. If at the end of respins 14 Rhinos are in view, the Major jackpot worth 375x is paid rather than line wins. If all 15 positions are covered in Rhinos, then players win the 500x Grand jackpot.The highlight is the free spins feature which activates when 3 scatters land on reels 2, 3, and 4, rewarding 10 free spins. During free spins, whenever a rhino symbol lands, it is collected. Then, on the last spin, all rhinos collected are dropped on the reels in random positions. You better make the most of those spins as the feature cannot be retriggeredGreat Rhino Deluxe: VerdictIn many ways Great Rhino Deluxe is the love child of the two slots that preceded it, taking the original's gameplay and marrying it to the graphics of the Megaways version. On paper, that might not sound uber-deluxe, but in practice, the game plays out quite well, for what it is. The Deluxe is certainly a more holistically enjoyable experience than the original.Taking a cynical view, Great Rhino Deluxe could be viewed like the director's cut of a movie where 3.5 seconds of unseen footage has been added. Superfluous fluff for diehard fanatics compelled to buy everything they can to expand their collection. There's no denying the changes are fairly modest - a few graphic upgrades, a different audio track, and a tweak to the features. It's simply riding on the wave of brand awareness. Yet, enough has been changed or altered to warrant the 'Deluxe' label.Then again, for fans of the original it probably won't matter anyway. The game exudes so much positivity it cuts through much of the criticism. A huge factor is the music, combined with the physical slot feels from the graphics and sound effects, to create a game which is easy to like.Potential has certainly increased - Pragmatic Play claims wins of over 6,000 times the stake are now possible. Okay, it's not a third of what Great Rhino Megaways is technically capable of. Still, it's not a bad haul, though with what players get to work with, it does seem a bit of a pipe dream.Great Rhino Deluxe probably won't shake the slots world. It's not a high powered thrill machine or even hugely different to the first, but for an enjoyable African slot packing an outrageous feel-good factor, Great Rhino Deluxe isn't a bad choice for those into this style.

Title: Dead Man's Gold
review: Dead Man's Gold: Slot OverviewYo ho hooo, your boy Kane is back in another one of his missions to find a bit of loot and glory. This one's been dubbed Dead Man's Gold, and it sees the intrepid explorer get all piratical in his attempt to strike it rich. Sticking to form, Dead Man's Gold is an online slot filled to the brim with features, modifiers, gambling options, dynamic reels, and a vibrant atmosphere. If all that's whet your appetite for some cutlass swinging, cannon firing, or any other manner of piraty things, let's get a swashbuckling.Dead Man's Gold's base game takes place in a ludicrously exotic location, a sort of lost village tucked away on an island by a waterfall, before a mountainous area and a background that gets higher and higher whenever the view pans out. It really is an impressive sight, bringing back memories of earlier slots like Tahiti Gold and Pacific Gold, but Dead Man's Gold definitely has its own personality. A strong one at that. The audio is great too; jungle sounds mixed in with a gentle at times, passionate at others, soundtrack which contributes tremendously to the drama. When it comes to building lush game worlds, ELK Studios proves once again why they are one of the best in the business at doing so.Dead Man's Gold slot - base gameOn the one hand, ELK Studios giveth; on the other, it taketh, and Dead Man's Gold's sensory candy is offset by a weak 94% return to player. Winning potential, on the other hand, is high, as is the volatility as well, so a potent mix when its wide range of features is popping. To get the popping going, players pick a stake of 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin and either stick with single spin betting or pick 1 of the 5 options from the feature buy X-iter menu. When playing from the X-iter, the RTP remains the same at 94%.Dead Man's Gold is played on a 6-reel gaming grid which begins each new spin at 4 rows high. At this size, players get 4,096 ways to win, occurring when matching symbols land on at least 3 consecutive reels starting from the leftmost reel. The pay symbols are divided into three groups – low, medium, and high. The lows are J-A symbols, the mediums are a stingray, octopus, anchor, and skull 'n crossbones, while the highs are a moon in a wheel, a star, an eyed pyramid, and Kane. When landing a 6-of-a-kind winning way, the game awards 0.3x the bet for the lows, 0.8-1x the bet for the mids, and 2-5x the bet for the highs. Wild symbols are able to subsite for any pay symbols and may land as big symbols in sizes of 2x2 or 3x3. Pay symbols can also land as big symbols up to 4x4 in size. If gaps appear below big symbols, they are filled with the same symbol type.Dead Man's Gold: Slot FeaturesDead Man's Gold slot - free spinsThe rest of Dead Man's Gold's extras include Avalanches, Treasure Targets, Fire the Cannons!, Multiplier Treasure Targets, Bottomless Chest, the Bonus Game, and X-iter.AvalancheAll winning symbols are removed from the reels, leaving space for symbols to drop down to fill, plus an extra row of symbols is added on top – up to a maximum of 8 rows high. The avalanche feature will keep repeating as long as new winning ways appear.Treasure TargetsCannonball symbols activate the cannons sitting on either side of the reels. Cannons fire when they can hit a Treasure Target symbol. Treasure Targets shot by the cannons reveal wild symbols and remove non-winning symbols around them. When Multiplier Treasure Targets are shot, they also reveal wilds and remove non-winning symbols around them, but they also increase the global win multiplier.Bottomless ChestThe Bottomless Chest is a valueless symbol which generates and fills empty spaces beneath it with high-value, wild or cannonball symbols all the way up to the achieved row height.Bonus GameHitting 3, 4, 5, or 6 bonus symbols awards 10, 15, 20, or 25 free drops, respectively. During free spins, Treasure Targets and Multiplier Treasure Targets are persistent between drops until they are used in a win. The Bottomless Chest is also persistent for the full duration. Landing 3 or more bonus symbols awards additional free spins.X-iterThe X-iter allows players to play Dead Man's Gold in different gaming modes. These are:Big Block – 5x the bet for one spin with a guaranteed big symbol.Chest Plunderer – 10x the bet for one spin with a guaranteed Bottomless Chest.Super Cannon Spin – 25x the bet for one spin where the cannons have unlimited numbers of cannonball shots.Bonus – 100x the bet to trigger the bonus game.Super Bonus – 500x the bet to trigger the Super bonus game with unlimited cannonballs for the cannons.Dead Man's Gold slot - free spinsDead Man's Gold: Slot VerdictBy our count, Dead Man's Gold is no less than the ninth slot in the series, and if anything, the Gold range feels like it's going as strong as ever, if not stronger. It's a real testament to ELK Studios' design talents that it can keep coming up with interesting scenarios for Kane to inhabit, bring them to life with a consistently high quality of art and sound, then populate the world with exciting features. Usually, there's an innovative twist or two in there for good measure. Some of the newer parts to be found in Dead Man's Gold include the cannons shooting Treasure Targets to reveal wilds and clear away a few non-winning symbols and Multiplier Treasure Targets, which increments the win multiplier. A neat in-theme extra that brings something new to the Gold table for fans to experiment with.Other aspects of Dead Man's Gold might not be so innovative, but everything links together nicely, and the game's individual parts can have positive impacts on each other. Few games are able to ratchet themselves up like a good Gold game can, and Dead Man's Gold is no exception. Avalanches lead to extra rows, big symbols pop up for good measure, and when factoring in the Treasure Target/Multiplier Treasure Target, you've got a Gold game that's both familiar and different enough to propel the series into uncharted yet exciting waters.The game's final draw is its 25,000x the bet winning potential which is a ton more than the early games in the range could boast. Of course, RTP might be a sticking point as it often is from ELK Studios these days. Strange when you think about it, where one part of the team is pushing forward, crafting gorgeous-looking and sounding games with excellent playability, while the other is cannonballing themselves in the foot with unenviable numbers.

Title: Bounty Raid
review: Bounty Raid: OverviewDeveloper Red Tiger lines up to release another one of them thar’ Western-themed slots. A perennial favourite, the Wild West’s characters and foibles continue to provide abundant digging ground to colour slots. This time, the focus is on a less popular gaming character – the mysterious bounty hunter.In an even bigger twist, we get a female bounty hunter as the hero of the show. However, other than a slight character shakeup, and an okay feature, there isn’t much else to get super jazzed over. After delving into its world of goodies, baddies, and badasses, we can all be the judge.It has to be said that Bounty Raid is a pleasing game to look at. Whatever else you might think of Red Tiger’s products, they are rarely hard on the eyes. The standard 5-reel, 10-payline reel set is bordered by some nice cowboy styling, all skulls on curved framing which would sit perfectly in any Saloon from here to Santa Fe. The background is an all-action chase scene from a bounty hunter’s eye view. It’s a bit different and coupled with the soundtrack provokes a nice first impression.From there it’s onto bet selection where players can take part in the Western action from 10 p/c to $/€100 a pop. As is often the case in a Red Tiger slot, RTP is down a bit on 95.71%. It’s not a huge dip, but when you consider how many Western slots are available offering better stats, it does give pause. Hit rate and volatility share the same score at 3 out of 5, so when mixing in the low potential, you don’t exactly have a hardcore bounty hunt on your hands.Simplicity is the name of the game when it comes to rules, starting with an easy to follow 10 paylines on which to land winners. Combinations are formed by 3 or more matching symbols on one of the paylines, left to right, from the first reel as you’d probably expect.There is something about the Wild West that makes it ideal for basing slots around, and symbol options are a particularly fertile area. Bounty Raid’s paytable starts with a bunch of steel-rimmed card suits – diamonds, hearts, clubs, and spades leading the paytable off. These are supplemented by the high pays – boots, hats, saddles, pistols, and a big ‘ole chest of gold coins. Five of a kind payouts range from 1x for the clubs, up to 8x for a line of gold chests. Interestingly, Red Tiger has decided to omit a wild symbol, but there are a bunch of special symbols to cover in the next section which help boost payouts.Bounty Raid: FeaturesBounty Raid - free spinsThe rough-riding bounty hunter is the star of Bounty Raid and the key to its only feature. This chesty dame, who you wouldn’t want to mess with, appears as a non-paying 1x2 sized scatter symbol on the third reel only. When she does land, all bandits in view on the reels are locked for the Bounty Hunter respin feature.Now, if a new bandit symbol or gold coin symbol lands, the respin feature is retriggered. Each bandit displays a prize which gets collected as the feature progresses, offering individual values of up to x50 at the most. If no new symbols appear, the combined total of the bandit values are tallied up and paid out.Two more symbols may appear during respins – the Sheriff, and the Gold Coin. Whenever a gold coin lands, it increases the value of all visible bandit symbols. The Sheriff is also useful, because if he lands, he rounds up the bandits, combining all of their values. Only one Sheriff can appear at a time, on any reel, except the middle one.Bounty Raid: VerdictThe initial impression of Bounty Raid was quite good thanks to the decent audio and visuals, an area where Red Tiger often shines. But, a few spins later, Bounty Raid was like swigging too hard on pappy’s moonshine – the situation quickly slid downhill.One of the main issues is a lack of motivation. Other than the pleasant Wild West atmosphere, Bounty Raid lags in just about every other department. Low on features, low on thrills, low on potential. No doubt, there will be players who will sign up for a casual raid, dazzled by the premise. But it is a puzzler when you consider how many more appealing Western-themed slots there are to choose from.Aside from Domino Harvey, you don’t often hear about female bounty hunters, so kudos for the girl power shout out perhaps. Apart from that, there is little else to get excited about when playing Bounty Raid. Potential is a major drawback for one. At 1,000 times the stake, few real-life bounty hunters would bother picking up the contract. It just wouldn’t be worth their while. Especially when there are far bigger prizes in the iGaming West along with higher RTPs and more exciting features. To be fair, the respin bonus can be alright when it gets a good momentum going. But respins are all there is, so when you’ve seen them once, well, that’s all folks as Daffy would say.In summation, perhaps Bounty Raid will suit those dipping a tentative toe in the Western genre for the first time and don’t want too wild a ride. Not everyone wants to bareback the roughest bronco in the stable after all. Still, most want some bang for their buck which will be tough to find playing Bounty Raid.

Title: Gladiator Clash
review: Gladiator Clash: Slot OverviewEver watched a game of football and seen a player take a dive, roll around on the pitch in 'agony' clutching an ankle or whatever, absolutely milking a penalty, then notice they were barely even touched by the opposing player in the replay? One wonders how folk like that would have fared back in the day when armed bruisers hit the arena sand to do battle in some of the most brutal blood sports ever seen on planet Earth. We're talking about gladiatorial battles of Ancient Rome, of course, and the occasion is Gladiator Clash from software provider NetEnt.NetEnt does know how to recreate an attractive scene from antiquity. We saw this recently in Golden Realms or Pandora's Treasure, as well as in further back releases such as Rome The Golden Age and Divine Fortune Megaways. Gladiator Clash is arguably even nicer to look at, set as it is in the middle of a columned arena that brought back memories of ELK Studios' slot Gladiatoro - the bonus round part, at least. Gladiator Clash has a strong do-or-die in front of the Emperor feel to it, like a well-presented museum display depicting the grandeur of Ancient Rome.Gladiator Clash slot - base gameGladiator Clash is an unusual game in that it is played on a 3x3 game grid with 3 paylines, but its pay symbols, such as they are, do not have values in themselves. Instead, when three-of-a-kind combinations land along a payline, they award the prize linked to their row from a prize reel. More on this below. It is also odd in that it combines low winning potential with a highly volatile math model. As for return to player, the default RTP clocks in at 96.1%, and users are able to stake 10 cents to $/€80 per spin.As mentioned, the pay symbols do not have intrinsic values of their own, and they consist of tridents, spiked maces, swords, plus three different types of battle helms. A wild symbol is present on all three reels, as well, substituting for all paying symbol types. Wilds count as a paying symbol variation should 3 of them be in a winning line.Gladiator Clash: Slot FeaturesGladiator Clash slot - base gameThe features in Gladiator Clash mostly revolve around winning prizes from the prize reel and various boosts players can get to do so. There's also a Lion Bonus round, which triggers after a certain number of scatter symbols have been collected, or it can be bought.Base Game FeaturesPrize Reel - The prize reel sits to the left of the 3x3 regular symbol landing grid. Possible prize values which can appear on the prize reel vary from 1x to 500x the bet. When three matching symbols land along a payline, the prize on the prize reel associated with them is awarded.Reel Respin - At random, when 2 reels are filled with 1 paying symbol type, they lock together with the prize reel, and the third reel respins.Prize Respin - At random, when the prize reel contains a value of 50x or higher, there is a chance it locks and a respin is awarded.Prize-Up! - Randomly, when a winning line is formed, the prize for the line is increased, and the winning combination pays again.Lion BonusLanding 1 lion scatter symbol on the reels progresses the collection bar by +1 point. The bar takes 20 points to fill, and when it is filled, the Lion Bonus is awarded. For the Lion Bonus, players pick n' click lion symbols to reveal prizes or Thumbs-Up symbols. Revealing 3 instances of the same prize awards its value. Should a Thumbs-Up symbol be revealed 3 times, the bonus upgrades to the next level. The levels in the Lion Bonus are:Level 1: contains three of each of these - 3x, 5x, 10x, 20x, and the Thumbs-Up symbol.Level 2: contains three of each of these - 5x, 10x, 20x, 50x, and the Thumbs-Up symbol.Level 3: contains three of each of these - 10x, 20x, 100x, 500x, and 1,000x.Feature BuyFor 25 times the total bet, players can buy the Lion Bonus. It plays the same as if triggered organically and has an RTP of 96.16%.Gladiator Clash slot - bonus gameGladiator Clash: Slot VerdictA funny one, this one. Gladiator Clash does a lot of good and/or interesting things that make checking it out a non-waste of time. The game's appearance, for one thing, is a credit, as NetEnt has brought the thrill of the arena to a gambling game really nicely, and its surrounding visuals have a pleasing weight to them. Even so, it's hard to imagine what the roller coaster of emotions triggered by rushing out onto the sand to do battle against trained warriors would have been like. Doing so before thousands of cheering people who probably couldn't care less if you lived or died so long as you put on a good show must have produced a raging cocktail of fear, excitement and adrenaline. And imagine winning; there'd be a whole, different suite of emotions throbbing through your body.Imagine winning in Gladiator Clash, and the emotions will probably be nowhere near extreme. This is because, despite being a highly volatile slot, Gladiator Clash taps out at 1,006x the bet. There are mixed feelings about this. On the one hand, it's not much, is it, especially considering it's a highly volatile game with high risk and low rewards. On the other hand, for a 3x3 slot with limited prizes on offer, 1,006x feels like a fitting amount as well, in some ways.Aside from a possible lack of interest caused by the low max win, the rest of Gladiator Clash has been neatly done. As well as the high-quality artwork, the gameplay is quite unique, which makes a nice change, and the bonus buy is 'cheaply' priced comparatively speaking; as such, certain gamblers may be totally on board with what Gladiator Clash has to offer.

Title: Aquanauts
review: Aquanauts: Slot OverviewAccording to the NOAA Ocean Exploration site, scientists have estimated that the oceans could hold as much as 1 million species (excluding most microorganisms), and two-thirds of them, maybe more, have yet to be discovered or described officially. In other words, there is a lot going on beneath the briny we don't know about. Perhaps some ancient leviathan rests in the depths, inert until woken from aeons of slumber by curious humans with underwater flashlights, before rising to the surface to wreak havoc on humanity like Cthulhu or Godzilla. Or perhaps it's all benign down there?One way of finding out is through the brave efforts of the sort of explorers we find in Alchemy Gaming's online slot Aquanauts. This is a deep-sea adventure that sends players beneath the waves in search of rewards. The base game appears to take place during the descent phase of the voyage, as there is little more than a blank blue screen behind the game's 5x5 grid matrix. At the ocean's deepest point, the Mariana Trench reaches nearly 11 km below the surface, where its dark, cold, pounding pressures make it one of the least hospitable places on Earth. Trigger free spins, and a shipwreck comes into view, so we're probably not quite so deep, but Aquanauts is a murky, mysterious place regardless.Aquanauts slot - base gameIt's also a highly volatile one and comes in four RTP settings, the highest one being 96.26%. Providing 3,125 ways to win, hits come at a rate of nearly 1 in 3 spins by matching symbols left to right, in any row from the leftmost side of the panel. Available on any device, players can select from a stake menu starting at 30 p/c and rising to $/€21 per spin.Ten normal paying symbols appear across the reels. The lower four are animals of the seas, followed by submarines, treasure chests, and four premium character symbols. Landing a five of a kind winning way awards approximately 0.67 to 0.93 times the stake for the non-character tiles and 1.5 to 6.67 times the bet for five of the human symbols. Wilds pay more, up to 10x the bet for a five wild winning way, while they are also useful for substituting any normal paying symbols.Aquanauts: Slot FeaturesAquanauts slot - Echo Roll feature in actionAquanauts has a couple of features common to the base and base game; these are Rolling Reels with a progressive multiplier and Echo Rolls. The other extras include a Bonus Wheel and an Upsizer feature, both available before free spins begin.Rolling ReelsRolling Reels is essentially a cascading win feature. When a winning combination hits, the corresponding symbols are removed from the reels. Existing symbols drop down into the gaps, and new symbols appear up above. If a new win occurs, the Rolling Reels feature triggers again. At the same time, each base game Roll increases a win multiplier by +1. In the base game, when no more wins are formed, the multiplier resets for the next spin.Echo Spins.After any win, there is a chance the Echo Roll feature will randomly trigger. Instead of dropping in arbitrary symbols, the Echo Roll drops in identical random high, low or wild symbols to create a guaranteed win.Free SpinsGetting 3 scatter symbols awards 8 free spins, plus 2 free spins for each additional scatter in view. Before free spins begin, a couple of pre-bonus game events occur. The first is that players spin the Bonus Wheel to win +2 or +4 free spins, x2 or x3 Win Multiplier increments, wild symbols only on Echo Rolls, or no low symbols on Echo Rolls. Next is the Upsizer feature which gives players the chance to buy any of the modifiers they did not win from the Bonus Wheel. The game automatically calculates and displays the extra costs for doing so. The only other rule to mention is that each time a scatter symbol lands in the bonus round, +1 free spin is added to the remaining tally.Aquanauts: Slot VerdictOne thing about Alchemy Gaming is the team does seem to like going large. Being connected with Microgaming means the studio has access to a wide range of popular features, but the good thing about Alchemy Gaming is they tend not to just bolt them to a 9 Masks of Fire style slot and call it a day. In Aquanauts, the team wasn't interested in sticking with the default options and has instead pushed things to a higher setting.One example is Rolling Reels, Microgaming's version of cascades/reactions/avalanches, which is a popular device used by its associate studios. Where most max out the Win Multiplier after like four consecutive wins, Aquanauts not only does away with a ceiling value, but it also comes with the chance of increasing how much the Win Multiplier increments by.It took some time to discover Aquanaut's finer moments, though. The descent stage was pretty uneventful. Few consecutive Rolls occurred, the Echo Roll was largely silent, and the plain, some might say dull, blue background meant that it took time to acclimate. However, when Aquanauts picks up momentum, the game can flip. Free spins might be where this is most likely to occur since the Win Multiplier doesn't reset, and players have the chance of juicing the round to full capacity with the Upsizer feature. The Upsizer is an interesting idea and has been seen before in Chronicles of Olympus X UP. Maxing everything means the bonus round can get hectic, though the addons can add up. In theory, wins of up to 50,000x the bet are possible in Aquanauts, so the temptation to buy everything in sight when free spins trigger could be high.It takes a certain sort of person to brave the hazards that could be lurking far beneath the ocean's surface. In Aquanauts' depths, there are impressive rewards for fortunate players as well, and Alchemy has provided an exciting opportunity for those who'd appreciate the chance to go all-in once free spins trigger with a fistful of addons.

Title: Barbarian Fury
review: Barbarian Fury Slot: OverviewNolimit City is on a roll at the moment, currently crafting some really interesting titles. Before the dust from the frantically good Punk Rocker slot has settled, they've followed up with another edgy release called Barbarian Fury. The design team has taken another great concept and fleshed it out with excellent atmosphere, and a bunch of clever extras. The features list includes their xNudge mechanic, though its xWays cousin has been shelved for now. What remains are features that work best when synchronised to produce some intense gaming and solid rewards when it all comes together.Free spins feature in actionPunks might have thought they were pretty bad-ass, but when it comes to hardness, punks were a pack of weedy whiners compared to the original hard men and ladies – the barbarians. Title: Druids' Dream

Title: Treasures of Ra
review: Treasures of Ra: Slot OverviewHave you ever repeated what was a pleasant activity so many times it ended up losing its lustre? Watching the same beloved movie one too many times, eating too much of your favourite snack, bouncing on the trampoline too long, could be anything. So it was with Stakelogic's online slot Treasure of Ra, which came fairly hot on the heels of another Egyptian-themed game review. Then again, sometimes, when you least expect it, life throws a curveball, turning what you had almost no expectations of into a landmark event. Was Treasure of Ra? Let's find out.First of all, a clarification. Despite the name, Treasures of Ra isn't strictly a 'book of' style game, though it retains a tenuous relation to slot royalty like Book of Ra Deluxe, with a full reel expanding symbol feature. Once that point was realised, curiosity in what Treasures of Ra might actually be was dialled up a notch. On the theme side of things, there were few surprises. Stakelogic is no Egypt newb, having visited the land in games like Gods of Death and Pyramid Strike; therefore, the team knows a thing or two about throwing together statues, hieroglyphs, and stone masonry. Much of this sort of thing we find in Treasures of Ra, which is a handsome enough game, but not the sort of beauty that is likely to halt players in their tracks.Treasures of Ra slot - base gameTreasures of Ra is played on a conventional 5-reel, 3-row gaming panel with 10 fixed betways. Note that switching the Super Stake on does not affect symbol values, nor does it affect the RTP, which remains constant at 96.1%.Across the game's paylines, at least three low pays or at least two high pays are needed to create winning combinations. Hit a five-symbol winning line, and the rewards are 10-15 times the bet for the 10 to A card royals or 30 to 100 times the bet for representations of Bastet, Anubis, a Pharaoh, and a Fedora-wearing adventurer.Treasures of Ra: Slot FeaturesTreasures of Ra slot - splash screenThe serious-looking bird symbol, not sure if it refers to an Ancient Egyptian deity or not, is Treasures of Ra's Countdown Wild, which appears on all reels and have the same value as the adventurer symbol when creating their own line wins. Alternately, Countdown Wilds are able to substitute for any regular paying symbol and also have two special abilities. When they hit, they may display a number overlay. In addition, Countdown Wilds symbols may also land with multiplier values displayed in the lower left to help bolster payouts.Another important symbol to be on the lookout for is the golden question mark symbol, which may land on any reel. Hit a golden question mark on the rightmost reel means the whole grid will be filled with the same pay symbol. However, chosen symbols do not cover any wilds in view.Lastly, scarab scatter symbols offer a way to enter Treasures of Ra's bonus round. This may occur organically, or applicable players can buy 10, 15, or 20 free spins for the cost of 100x, 250x, or 500x the bet. A fourth bonus buy option lets players pay 225x the bet to randomly win 10, 15, or 20 free spins.Treasures of Ra slot - free spinsTreasures of Ra: Slot VerdictLooping back to the first paragraph, while Treasures of Ra might not be one of those unmissable slots that demands to be played at least once, it's still a sturdy Ancient Egypt alternative with one or two tricks up its sleeve to be unleashed. In some ways, Treasures of Ra might make a good stepping-stone slot for those who can't get enough 'book of' action but are looking to try a newer format while still requiring something familiar to ease the transition. The way Treasures of Ra expands its symbols to cover reels and, with luck, lead to a full-screen win is clever and may well appeal to the 'book of' crowd. Especially when factoring in multiplier wilds.Non-modified full-screen wins aren't as impressive here as they are in a traditional 'book' slot, though, where the Indiana Jones lookalike awards 1,000x the bet (without a multiplier) compared to the usual 5,000x. However, stepping back a bit to see the full picture, Treasures of Ra actually boasts a much higher winning potential of up to 20,000x the bet, possibly making it a more tempting proposal for players with a bigger is better mentality. Getting there would be fun, too, not only due to the expanding symbols but chucking in semi-sticky multiplier Countdown Wilds adds a new dimension to the regular expansion procedure.Add it all up, and there is a definite level of entertainment to be uncovered in Treasures of Ra for the right player. It's not a game that is likely to shock prospective users with outrageous visuals nor drag them into highly atmospheric environments like Hand of Anubis did, for example. Instead, it brings together a selection of features which have the ability to be quite potent, while acknowledging the past and looking to the future, a bit like a piece of uncontroversial historical revisionism.

Title: Golden Glyph
review: Golden Glyph (Quickspin): OverviewQuickspin is taking players on another trip back to Ancient Egypt in this feature-rich slot. It’s not the first time Quickspin has used the Egyptian theme, but they haven’t made it as unique or so lucrative as in other Egypt slots previously. Even in stills and thumbnails, the beauty of Golden Glyph is immediately apparent. Quickspin’s graphic design team have done an amazing job both with the symbols, and the magnificent background. Somewhere achingly mystical to spin its 7x7 grid packed with an array of intriguing features that includes power wilds and a collection of power-up modifiers among other things.In a first for Quickspin, winning combinations are formed when similar symbols land in clusters, rather than paylines. Golden Glyph also uses a tumbling reels mechanic where winning clusters are removed from the board to let others tumble into place which can lead to consecutive winners from just one spin - at least five symbols are needed to form a cluster. A popular genre at the moment, and one that works perfectly with the 7x7 grid format. Medium variance, wagers can be had for as low as 20c/p or set as high as $/€100 per spin. For that, players get an above-average RTP of 96.19% and quite decent maximum payout possibilities.In terms of symbols, four Egyptian hieroglyphs make up the lower end of the paytable and offer decent value from 0.1x to 18x the stake for clusters of be between 5 and 15+ symbols. The top three symbols are represented by Tutankhamun, Cleopatra, and Horus the falcon god. The latter is the most rewarding, giving you 250 times your stake for a cluster of 15+ symbols. The golden wild marked by a "W" is the standard wild - it substitutes for all regular symbols.Golden Glyph (Quickspin): FeaturesFree spins bonus in actionQuickspin have paired the 7x7 grid with a suite of extras that complement it nicely. Frequently, players will come across the Power Wild as it appears in one of the empty spaces following a cluster win. Only one is awarded per tumble, and it appears during both the base game and free spins. If it's used as part of a winning cluster, then it also activates one of the Power-Ups.There are also 4 different Power-Up modifiers available in the game. At the start of each spin, five Power-Ups are chosen at random and displayed on the golden wheel to the left of the grid. The fifth will always be the Free Spins Power Up. When a winning cluster contains a Power Wild, it charges these Power-Ups in successive order until Free Spins are triggered, or a tumble results in no win. If that happens, all live Power-Ups are activated in the order of the wheel.Golden Scarab Power Up: distributes 4 – 10 wilds at random over the grid.Eye of Horus Power Up: picks a low pay symbol and removes all occurrences of it from the gird and triggers an additional tumble. Players receive 1/20th of their stake for each symbol removed.Blaze of Fire Power Up: is placed at a random position on the board and incinerates all base game pay symbols horizontally and vertically and also triggers another tumble. As before, each symbol removed is worth 1/20th of the stake.Free Spins Bonus Power Up: awards 9 free spins.Free Spins cannot be re-triggered, but if the Fee Spins Power Up is activated during this round, then 3 more spins are added to the total every time it does. On the first free spin, the fabled Golden Glyph Wild is placed on the reels in a random space. The game’s namesake is the golden method for obtaining some truly epic wins. Not only does it act like a wild, but it also possesses a progressive multiplier that increases by 1 every time it forms part of a winning cluster. It moves to a new location with every spin, and is capable of reaching the top of the pyramid with a 99x multiplier. In other words, the Golden Glyph Wild is the key to the biggest payouts in the game.Golden Glyph: VerdictWe have to say, Quickspin has successfully blended just the right elements to create their best Egyptian themed slot to date. It is the first time they have gone with a cluster pays system, and it works like a charm, particularly with the 7x7 layout. It’s not quite the first time Quickspin have used a tumble mechanic - we saw a similar device used in Big Bad Wolf with swooping reels, but it has certainly been fine-tuned and carried out in a more modern and sophisticated way with Golden Glyph. Along with top gameplay, Golden Glyph deserves a shout out for its looks. It's a truly gorgeous game that makes playing it all the more fun.At the end of the day, what makes Golden Glyph so compelling is the interplay of its extras and the potential chain of events that are possible. The inclusion of Power Wilds after a win is a brilliant concept, and the way Power-Ups play off each other is a joy when it happens – especially when they are unleashed on the grid. Add a free spins feature capable of providing a multiplier of x99 with wins of up to 13,185 times the stake to that and you have one of Quickspin's best releases of 2019.

Title: Guns N' Roses
review: Guns N’ Roses: OverviewIf there was one band that was guaranteed to fill stadiums in the late 80s/90s big hair era, it was LA rockers Guns N' Roses. Swedish developer NetEnt has taken all of the excitement of their tight jeaned music and crammed it into their branded slot of the same name. The result is the most successful title in NetEnt’s popular trilogy of rock series.At the time of writing, the band still tours, but if you can't make it to a gig, why not get a taste of one with the slot version which comes with a bunch of GNR tracks. Ready to be welcomed to the jungle? Let's sample NetEnt's sweet child of a slot and see how hard it rocks.Hey, we didn't use the concert idea just as a metaphor. The Guns N' Roses 5-reel, 3-row game grid is set at a gig with a crowd that literally leaps around and cheers during the game. Flashing lights against a cloudy sky complete the outdoor concert visuals, and if you squint a bit, use some imagination - you're there, sort of. Sounds are as heavy as any fan would hope for, with plenty musical highlights. Get started with stakes that favour a wide variety of betting requirements from 20 p/c up to the rock star level of $/€200 per spin.The game has 20 paylines on which to land combinations of three or more matching symbols for a win. GNR features heavily throughout the paytable with the golden 10-A royals adorned in roses, while the premiums are two album cover guitar picks, Duff, Slash, and frontman Axel Rose.Values for premiums are pretty high and range from 7.5x for the blue pick up to 37.5x for five Axels. The infamous band logo makes an appearance as the wild which substitutes for any of the pay symbols, and can land in 1x1 size or cover full reels which we will see in a moment.Like the wide variety of bets there is a wide variety of RTP settings so make sure to keep an eye out for that before firing up the lads. On the insanely low side it may found at 90.05% all the way up to the insanely high 99.05% depending on the operator settings. GNR will most likely be found at the default RTP of 96.98% which is a pretty generous figure indeed. The math model, meanwhile, has been tuned to a low/medium setting, with a hit rate which varies from 28.33% - 28.49% depending on RTP version.Guns N’ Roses: Features﻿You want features? You'll find plenty here during both the base and bonus game. The main game has three random features - Legend Spins, Appetite for Destruction Wild, and the Solo multiplier to look out for.Legend Spins are activated at random and award 1 stacked wild for the first spin, then 2 respins with 2 stacked wild reels. The Appetite for Destruction Wild feature randomly overlays the reels with the shape of a cross in one of three positions when activated. This cross-shaped wild can substitute for anything except the bonus symbols. Finally, the Solo Multiplier is a random multiplier of x4-x10 that may randomly appear when there is a win on the first three reels.Keeping up with the triple motif, when 3 scatter symbols appear on reels 1, 3, and 5 during the base game, a spin on the Bonus Wheel is awarded which results in one of three things – Encore Free Spins, the Crowd-Pleaser Bonus, or a coin win.Encore Free Spins awards 10 free spins that are not retriggerable. With each free spin, one of the band members lands as a stacked wild on reels 2, 3, or 4. If any matching band member symbols appear on that spin, they also turn wild.The Crowd Pleaser feature is a picking bonus game with three levels. Players choose from 8 musical icons such as instruments, to reveal coin wins, free spins, or +1 pick symbols. On level 1, players start with three picks, with the goal of colleting 60 coins which move them to level 2. On level 2, players get more picks and need to collect 240 more coins to make it to level 3 for more picks. Should players rack up 800 coins or more in level 3, then the total win from the Crowd Pleaser Bonus is doubled. Alternatively, free spins are awarded if players pick at least 3 free spins icons throughout the feature.Last, and kind of least, should the Bonus Wheel stop on the coin win prize, players win from a minimum of 200 up to a maximum of 600 coins.Guns N’ Roses: VerdictSome branded slots can feel like the developer took an old math model, pasted a few familiar images over the top and fired it at players looking for an easy buck. Not so Guns N' Roses, which comes across as a labour of love for fans of the band. The look, vibe and most importantly, the sound has been expertly captured to make players feel like they have standing access at one of GNR's concerts. You can virtually hear every one of Axel's vocals, with Slash's blurred fingers darting across the fretboard.So NetEnt nailed the vibe, how about the gameplay? The good news is that the mechanics and features are just as enjoyable as any other aspect of the game, if not better. The only let down, is the rather truncated potential, though with the lower volatility, wins land theoretically more frequently than a high variance beast which will suit gamblers who like a steady stream of hits.To sum up, NetEnt's Guns N' Roses is a slot that rocks hard. The band's ethos has been captured well and the game overflows with effective features. Guns N' Roses is definitely one for fans of the group, or any player looking for a gentler, feature-rich slot with plenty going on.

Title: Alien Antix
review: Alien Antix (Blueprint Gaming): OverviewCancelledMerely a few weeks have passed since Blueprint Gaming dropped their first-ever grid slot on the betting community. Some saw Dragonfall as a little too close to Jammin' Jars for comfort. Others were happy with the volatile features that could work together and yield substantial wins. Either way, Blueprint Gaming is back with their second grid slot which follows a comparable formula to the first. Theme wise, however, it is miles apart. Alien Antix is set out in space this time around and is full of cute wee monster/aliens. How does it compare to its predecessor? Let’s beam up and find out.Swinging doors open to let players on board the game. What greats them is an 8x8 grid that allows 64 symbols to fall into place. In the background galaxies swirl and energy blasts strike the purple alien planet below. The soundtrack is a sort of futuristic Samuel J Hoffman Theremin sounding tune that fits the visuals nicely. On a side note, Neil Armstrong took a tape of Theremin tunes to listen to on the moon shot. Imagine the crew of Apollo 11 drifting through the void accompanied by those eerie warbling’s. Talk about the ultimate trip. Anyway, back to the game. So, the grid is covered in aliens, but these are aliens of the adorable variety. Players get them tumbling by first choosing a bet levels from 10 p/c all the way up to $/€500. There is something here for all gambling styles though the win caps might make high rollers rethink their approach.Cascading wins complement the cluster pays system. Payouts occur when matching symbols touch horizontally or vertically in clusters of 5 or more. Winning clusters are removed from the grid to let more symbols tumble into place. Chain reactions repeat until no more winners land then it is on to the next fresh spin. Open up the paytable to find 6 regular pay symbols. All are new to the game, and all are cute wee space monsters. They are more Monster Inc. style creatures than HR Geiger. In ascending order is a brown one, purple, green, pink, yellow, and orangey-red. All have varying expressions of happiness or boredom. The one-eyed orangey-red critter is worth 100 times the stake in clusters of 25+.When it comes to stats, RTP sits comfortably on 96.43%. There is no official word on volatility, but expect it to be on the medium/high side. Dragonfall was famously Blueprint’s most volatile slot to date, and the two share similar characteristics. However, a change to the bonus round has shaken up the payout rate and the high intensity rides that Dragonfall could produce. Other than that, the two slots come bundled with familiar features.Alien Antix (Blueprint Gaming): FeaturesLike Dragonfall, the wild symbol is the key to a lot of Alien Antix’s best moments. The wild symbol looks like a swirling atom and can land anywhere on the grid. It can substitute for any other symbol. When it is used to help form a win, it remains on the grid and moves to one of the empty adjacent spaces before the next cascade. Wilds also possess a Win Multiplier that starts at x1. After a win has been processed the win multipliers increases by +1. More than one wild can boost a winning cluster with their combined multiplier for better returns. There is technically no limit to how win multipliers can go.Colossal Symbols is a feature that can appear randomly at any moment of the game. After a tumble, the screen starts to shake, and huge symbols are added to the grid. All of the positions that they cover are converted into the alien on the colossal symbol. The one exception is that they do not convert wild symbols.There is no separate scatter symbol, so this role is also taken up by the wild. When 3 or more appear on the grid, they trigger the Colossal Capers Free Spins feature. This time we get 8 Win Fall free spins. Two more than Dragonfall had and with altered rules. This time there are no sticky wilds for the duration of the feature. Instead, every free spin is guaranteed Colossal Symbols. This change means the free spins round is totally unlike the one seen in Dragonfall.Alien Antix (Blueprint Gaming): VerdictPicture Dragonfall with aliens and nebula's rather than dragons and eggs, and you’ll have a good idea of what to expect. However, the two key changes to the free spins round make them quite different. First off, there are two more of them. Second, wilds are not sticky. You don’t get those endless chains of wandering wilds and multipliers in Alien Antix that are possible with Dragonfall. Nor do you get the frustration when that doesn’t quite happen. On the other hand, Colossal Symbols means wins, of varying sizes, on just about every free spin.These change help separate the two slot. Which is the more preferable comes down to how you would like the free spins to play out. Dragonfall is the more volatile, more all or nothing beast. Alien Antix is a gentler, more rounded slot. Potentially, the game has a win cap of $250,000 or 50,000 times the bet – whichever comes first. Obviously, that’s rather high. But it will be very difficult to threaten that cap unless you are high stakes betting. Realistically, land 25+ of the red guy plus a few wild multipliers and you might crack a 500 – 1,000 times the stake. Without sticky wilds during free spins, it is much harder to build epic chains of multiplying wins than with Dragonfall.All up, Alien Antix may not be as sophisticated and refined as other grid slots on the market, but is nevertheless another decent offering from Blueprint with fun symbols and theme. The overall gaming experience is akin to Dragonfall, yet its differences set it apart from its more volatile sibling.

Title: Starz Megaways
review: Starz Megaways: OverviewHead to the outer rim with Pragmatic Play's slot Starz Megaways, their second to be driven by the popular Megaways engine. If you listen carefully, it even appears the developers have worked in a sound effect from the old Masters of the Universe cartoon. Bonus points for spotting it. Starz Megaways is the kind of riot that Spock, Bones, and Kirk would have indulged in, in a back room of the Starship Enterprise. Whenever a wild hits in the base game, it expands vertically to fill the whole reel. This effect is handy in the main game, yet even better during the bonus.Starz Megaways: FeaturesStarz Megaways - free spins feature with sticky stacked wildsThe saying 'it's not rocket science' seems a rather appropriate way to describe Starz Megaways with just one extra to go over. What you want here is the ball of fire bonus symbol which can appear in any position. Hit 3 or more of these to trigger the Free Spins feature where 3, 4, 5, or 6 in view awards 6, 8, 10, or 15 free spins respectively.During free spins, the only change gets made to the wild symbol. Whenever it lands during the feature, it expands as before, but this time expanded wild symbols remain sticky and locked in place for the full duration. If you've played Desperados Wild Megaways, you sort of know the drill. One slight downer here is that the feature cannot be retriggered.Starz Megaways: VerdictBoy, that Starburst game has a lot to answer for. How many slots has it 'inspired' now? We've lost count, and while Starz Megaways is far from being a straight copy, it shares a similar look, as well as a simplistic approach. This makes Starz absolutely ideal for those who enjoy Starburst but would prefer something with a bit more depth to immerse them in.The name of the game here is pacey play and the key to keeping engagement high is how often the bonus round is triggered. There might not be cascading wins, but free spins popped up a lot more frequently than usual. Far more than you usually find with a highly volatile Pragmatic Play slot which was surprising.It's hard to think of many other slots that cough up so many free spins as Starz Megaways did during testing. More than once we hit the bonus game within a few spins of triggering the previous one. It was insane. Of course, that could just have been an exceptionally lucky run.For balance it has to be stated that Starz Megaways is not a money printing machine though. Although there's a maximum reward of 10,000 times your stake on offer, few bonus rounds turned out to be super profitable this time around. Winning both ways might be an attribute, but the repeated bonus games seemed to be more effective at keeping interest levels, and bankrolls, up in this far-out disco fest.Like Pragmatic's previous Megaways release, Great Rhino Megaways, Starz is also a game which takes its cues from an older slot. That doesn't make it bad though, as Starz does have its entertaining moments. It's not your typical Megaways slot either, making it a viable alternative in a sea of Big Time Gaming licensed titles. For Starburst+ gaming, with a frequent bonus game that might just blast off, it is well worth a spin.

Title: Kiss My Chainsaw
review: ﻿Kiss My Chainsaw: Slot OverviewHitchhiking might be a cheap way of travelling from one place to another, but those doing it are putting a whole lot of trust in people they haven't met before. Should 3 scatters land on different rows, then 8 The Ride free spins are triggered. If 3 scatters land on the same row, then 9 The Last Ride free spins are awarded.The Ride Free SpinsFor The Ride, an extra row of symbols is added, thus expanding the action area into a 5x5 grid. Chainsaw Larry also reveals the enhancer symbol on the row it lands, triggering one of these extras:Smiley – awards +1 spin.xSplit – doubles all multipliers between Chainsaw Larry and the xSplit. Each character symbol split increases the win multiplier by +1.Lucky Feet – makes Chainsaw Larry move to a new position, leaving behind a wild symbol. Title: Reel King Megaways

During the base game, 0 to 6 reels may be lit yellow, accompanied by a familiar ‘Ding!’ sound. One extra reel is lit yellow for each subsequent cascade. The Reel King series is a bona fide classic some may have felt overdue for a bit of Megaways magic. On the other hand, there may be purists baulking at the prospect of their favourite Humpty Dumpty character being violated by such modern nonsense.In some ways, the polarising effect of Reel King Megaways mirrors the range of Reel King slots themselves. For some players, Reel King is it, a classic game that will never die. An extra +2 free spins are awarded when 2 FS symbols hit, or +4 free spins are awarded if 3 FS symbols hit.Bonus BuyThese four choices are present in Donny Dough's bonus buy section:BonusHunt FeatureSpins - 3x the bet, each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game.Ka-Ching FeatureSpins - 50x the bet, each spin guarantees at least 5 Multi-Dough symbols land.Sticky Dough Bonus - 90x the bet.Strike Gold Bonus - 200x the bet.Donny Dough slot - free spinsDonny Dough: Slot VerdictIf Donny Dough was someone's first exposure to a Hacksaw Gaming slot, they might be tempted to wonder what this silly billy dollar sign cartoon verging on childish game is all about. However, gamblers well acquainted with the studio's work will be aware that no matter how cutely Hacksaw tries to dress its games up, serious mathematics lurk beneath the surface, expressing themselves in fiendish ways on the reels. Donny Dough is no exception, possessing gameplay and features that can really shine or annoy, depending on the outcome.Technically, it is possible to achieve Donny Dough's 10,000x max win in any game mode, but bonus rounds arguably offer the best chances for doing so. The two bonus rounds share common elements, but they're actually, on the whole, quite different. Meaning, the game dumping Donny Dough symbols all over reels 2 to 5, then linking them later on with Donny Doughs on the first reel is the ideal scenario. Might happen. The Strike Gold Bonus was the more suspenseful feature. There is nothing quite like knowing something positive is going to occur in the not-too-distant future, and in the Strike Gold Bonus' case, this may occur when having a bunch of lit light bulbs on connected reels before the final spin guarantees a Donny's Hat symbol.If memory serves, one of the highlights of the review was getting 4 lit light bulbs on the leftmost 4 reels and a couple of lit bulbs on the rightmost reel. That was alright. You might have to put in a bit of work or get lucky to find yourself in this sort of situation, though. Hacksaw Gaming slots don't just hand out cash to all, despite an abundance of dollar signs hanging about the place. In Donny Dough, the studio has once again shown why it is one of the masters of making suspenseful slots with cunning features and explosive gameplay.

Title: Boat Bonanza
review: Boat Bonanza: Slot OverviewDust off the rod and tackle and take to the waters in Play'n GO's fishing-themed online slot Boat Bonanza. You don't need us to tell you fishing slots are popular, there are loads of them, and the collection is only getting bigger. Partly due to the saturation, and the stampede by developers to get in on the action, there is quite a lot of crossover going on. What we mean is the copying, borrowing, imitating of ideas, or whatever you would like to call it. Boat Bonanza appears to have a little bit of that going on. Is it enough to toss it back overboard like an undersize minnow, or let it slide?One word used to describe Boat Bonanza that kept cropping up was 'simplicity'. This applied to the gameplay, and it also applied to the visuals. In Boat Bonanza, players get the usual view of a game grid floating beneath the water's surface, with a ribbon of the horizon in the upper part of the screen. Busting out a magnifying glass, or just squinting, reveals a tower, pier, and Ferris wheel, suggesting the game has been set in Blackpool, UK? Darting about above the five reels are a couple of boats which aren't just there for show but play an integral part in the game. It'd be hard to class Boat Bonanza as being an impressive game graphically, though it's not harsh on the eyes, either.Boat Bonanza slot - baseFrom a more technical standpoint, Boat Bonanza is played on a 5-reel, 3-row game board, which supplies 12 paylines for landing winning combinations across. The RTP was not available at the time of testing, yet judging by Play'n GO's usual standards, players can expect a maximum value circa 96.2%, dropping to lower values when playing alternative models. Volatility is high, and players are able to select bets of 20 p/c to $/€50 to bait up and cast out with.Boat Bonanza's main thrills are its Cash Symbol collections, but regular line wins are there too. They occur when matching symbols land across a payline on consecutive reels, starting from the first reel onwards. All pay symbols need at least three to form a win, except for the most valuable symbol, which pays out for two or more. On the lower side are 10-J card symbols, worth 10x the bet for five of a kind, while the higher side has nets, seagulls, reels, and buoys, paying 50 to 200 times the stake for five of a kind. Boat Bonanza does not have a wild.Boat Bonanza: Slot FeaturesBoat Bonanza slot - free spinsWhat it does have, though, is Catch Symbols, which appear on all reels displaying different denizens of the sea and different prize values – up to 1,000x. As an aside, Catch Symbols can also crate winning lines worth up to 40x the bet for five of a kind. To collect Catch Symbols, you'll need the boats above the reels to do so on your behalf. When the boats appear greyed out, they are considered to be inactive; when they are coloured, they are active. When Catch Symbols land on the reels beneath an active boat, the boat will collect all of them and award their values. Should two active boats happen to be above one reel, they trigger the Mega Catch, which collects all Catch Symbols appearing on the reels.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols in the base game triggers 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. In free spins, 2 multiplier boats are always active, catching symbols which award additional free spins, symbols that add multipliers to the boats, or Catch Symbols. Boats with multipliers multiply their catches, and if 2 boats are on the same reel, their multipliers are combined for the Mega Catch.One key difference between the base game and free spins is that when boats collect Cash Symbols in the bonus round, respins are awarded. For the respins, only Catch Symbols appear on the reels and paylines are deactivated. As long as boats collect Cash Symbols, respins will continue. When no catch occurs, play moves back to regular free spins.Boat Bonanza slot - Respin feature activated in free spinsBoat Bonanza: Slot VerdictOkay, we said simple at the start, but Boat Bonanza has a bit more going on than first meets the eye. At least it does when free spins are triggered, which can then branch off into respins, and produce multipliers. When paddling through the main game, Boat Bonanza is about as laid back and undemanding as you could ask for in a fishing slot. Hit spin, land Catch Symbols, and hopefully, activated boats appear above them so they can be collected. Line wins are there too, yet they sort of faded out of the picture after a while, as it was easy to home in on the Catch Symbols and track boats, almost to the exclusion of all else.Free spins are bolstered by two things, multipliers and respins. Whilst we never managed to haul in the catch of the day, you could see how it might be possible, for instance, if both boats had a decent multiplier on board and combined their powers for a Mega Catch or two. Potential is quite respectable for a mid-range fishing slot, coming in at 5,000x the bet, comparing favourably to many games in the Big Bass range, for comparison, when it comes to max win.Gaming-wise, Play'n GO chose not to do the collect symbol accumulation system in free spins that Big Bass Bonanza and its ilk are famous for. However, what it has is not exactly a brand-new experience. Much of it may feel familiar to players who have had a crack at Big Time Gaming's piscine-populated slot Golden Catch. Boat Bonanza uses a similar concept which, on the whole, came across as a 'lighter' game for want of a better word. The potential rewards aren't as impressive as Golden Catch, but it's a game that triggers its features quite often and has a more laid-back feel to it. So, for players who enjoy a spot of fishing on the reels, and there is apparently quite a lot out there; Boat Bonanza is another option to try.

Title: Delicious Candy PopWins
review: Delicious Candy PopWins: Slot OverviewGet your toothbrushes ready, folks, software provider Stakelogic is dipping its choppers into a sugar-coated world named Delicious Candy PopWins - its third slot powered by the PopWins mechanic. Arguably the fourth if you count Mystery Drop. So far, Stakelogic has failed to really wow with its use of the mechanic, which is on licence from AvatarUX. While AvatarUX has gone on a creative bender, Stakelogic has been content bolting PopWins to games which go through the motions yet have lacked that hard-to-articulate 'I don't know what' quality, which might make them really stand out. When picking a theme as well used as candy, Delicious Candy PopWins has to do something pretty special to really pop, too. Does it? Let's find out.Visually, Delicious Candy PopWins crosses the necessary visual ingredients off the list, but little more than that. The action takes place in a sweetie paradise full of cotton candy clouds, swirling lollipops, and various other belt-busting delights. It's a view players who are familiar with the style will be well acquainted with, being neither an exemplary entry nor a drab mood spoiler. Plonked in the middle is a grid which starts the base game at 5-reels, and 3-rows in size, with a default 486 ways to win. This number is achieved because winning combinations pay both left to right from the leftmost side, and right to left, from the rightmost side.Delicious Candy PopWins slot - base gameDigging deeper into this cavity-threatening world, we find a highly volatile math model, cranking out a default return to player value of 96.50%. Regular bets can be selected from the lowest setting of 20 p/c to a max bet level of $/€10, or when activating the Super Stake, stakes are doubled. The benefit of doing so is that multiplier symbols are added to the base game with values of x2 to x100. Multipliers are applied to the win of the spin they appear on, and if more than one is in view, the values are added first.No second guesses for the sort of symbols used in Delicious Candy PopWins. All look like hard candies in various shapes, with values ranging from 1.5x the bet for five of the orange oval one up to 12.5x the bet for the golden crown. Note that five-of-a-kind wins count just once. Not assisting players this time is any form of wild symbols; they are entirely absent from Delicious Candy PopWins.Delicious Candy PopWins: Slot FeaturesDelicious Candy PopWins slot - feature buy optionsThe first feature to get a handle on is the PopWins mechanic. When a winning way hits, the symbols involved in it pop from the board and are replaced by 2 new ones. If a new win is formed, the process is repeated again. In the base game, each reel has a maximum height of 6 positions high, while in free spins, they can grow to 9 high. When at full height, winning symbols are replaced by just 1 new symbol.Free SpinsShould all reels reach 6 rows high in the base game, then free spins are triggered. Before they begin, a number of free spins of 5 to 15 is awarded, and 1 of 3 bonus wheels spins to award the starting win multiplier. The precise wheel is randomly selected. Wheel 1 awards multipliers of x2 to x10, wheel 2 has x5 to x15, and wheel 3 has x10 to x25. During free spins, the grid has a starting size of 6 reels high and a win multiplier, which increases by +1 following each win or +2 if all the reels reach 9 positions in height. Whilst not stated in the rules, it appears if all reels reach 7, 8, or 9 positions high on the same free spin, they start the next spin and onwards from that height. In other words, if all reels make it to 9 rows high, they stay like that for the remainder of the feature, for example.Delicious Candy PopWins slot - free spins wheelBonus BuyDepending on the jurisdiction, some players may be able to buy the free spins bonus round. There are four possible options, where 80x the bet buys up to 15 free spins with up to an x10 starting multiplier, 150x the bet buys up to 15 free spins with up to an x15 starting multiplier, and 400x the bet buys up to 15 free spins with up to an x25 starting multiplier. The fourth option costs 200x the bet to get a totally random outcome within the usual parameters.Gamble FeatureLastly, when winning combinations are awarded, players may be able to gamble the winnings. To do so, picking the correct colour or suit of a face-down card pays x2 or x4 the amount, respectively. Getting the pick wrong loses the lot.Delicious Candy PopWins slot - free spinsDelicious Candy PopWins: Slot VerdictAround the time of this review, there'd been a number of candy-related releases, as if some game makers could not get sweet stuff off their minds. Naturally, there's no issue with fads and preferences, but repeated use of the same imagery and atmosphere can blunt the impact after a while. So it was with Delicious Candy PopWins. It didn't help that the game also came across as somewhat half-baked. Closed-door meetings between Stakelogic and AvatarUX sparked by the copycat slot Mystery Drop resulted in Stakelogic licensing the PopWins mechanic. With Delicious Candy PopWins, it felt like Stakelogic phoned it in due to some sort of contractual obligation rather than desiring to pour its heart and soul into a sugar-coated PopWins wonderland. To be sure, this is pure conjecture, just thinking out loud why Delicious Candy PopWins failed to provoke much excitement.Along with the run-of-the-mill visuals, the studio has done little with the features as well. The PopWins mechanic is there popping away, doing its thing, building rows and ways, but not much else apart from the basics. Free spins benefit from the win multiplier, though it's pretty safe stuff. Add a multiplier to the bonus round, and increase it after wins or reaching max reel height. Job done, paint by numbers, whatever you want to call it. No one's questioning the power this combo of mechanics has; max win tops out at 10,000x the bet, after all, it's just that, in the world of PopWins, there are a number of more enthralling choices to go for.And so concludes Stakelogic's third official PopWins outing, and so far, the results have been fairly uninspiring, paling in comparison to what the originator of the mechanic is doing. This really is AvatarUX's baby, and the studio has clearly fallen for the mechanic, pushing it out with just about every new release, testing new themes, twisting features, and just getting straight-up experimental with the whole concept, so far overshadowing Stakelogic's utilisation of it.

Title: Amazon Island Megaways
review: Amazon Island Megaways: Slot OverviewThe last time we caught up with Red Tiger partner studio Max Win Gaming was in their cash appreciation slot, Dream Destiny - a slot that whisked players off to a beachside destination to kick back and count dollar bills. Amazon Island Megaways is the complete opposite. In this colourful game, players flee the rat race in an idyllic escape to a jungle environment, packing features like cascades and free spins governed by a somewhat uncommon set of rules.The jungle is one of those destinations that's easy to romanticise but which can be exceptionally unforgiving if you're not prepared for what it throws at you. Well, in real life, that is, the one in Amazon Island Megaways is a squeamish friendly zone. There are no creepy crawlies blanketing the jungle floor, and everyone around here has fixed perma-smiles, even the so-called wildlife. Though it is a light one, there's also an Aztec touch, confined mainly to a couple of masks above the game grid and a bit of stonework around it. The game panel itself is standard Megaways stuff, made up of 6 main reels holding 2 to 7 symbols each, plus a 4-position horizontal reel right above it. A different symbol configuration lands on each spin, providing up to 117,649 ways to win.Played offering bets from 20 p/c to $/€8 per spin, Amazon Island Megaways might look cute, yet it's all business behind the toothy grins. A highly volatile math model sees to that, producing a default theoretical return value of 96.07% (though this number can be lower, so be sure to check the paytable).Wins are awarded when matching symbols land left to right, where the first symbol in the combination sits on the leftmost reel. 10 symbols make up the paytable, divided first into 9-A low pay card symbols, paying out up to 1.5x the bet for six of a kind. Next are 4 cheerful high pay character symbols displaying parrots, monkeys, leopards, and an Aztec Chief looking chap. If a six symbol winning combination of high pays hits, players collect a reward worth 2 to 50 times their stake. Another monkey is on hand to help players in their endeavour on the island. This is the wild, which is made out of gold and has blue jewels for eyes. Put simply, the wild substitutes for all paying symbols.Amazon Island Megaways: Slot FeaturesAs expected of a Megaways slot, Amazon Island Megaways utilises cascades. Following each win, the reaction feature comes into play. This removes the successful combo from the reels, and new symbols tumble down to fill the empty spaces. This system allows consecutive reactions to continue accumulating coins until no new wins take place.Amazon Island Megaways' bonus game of free spins with a progressive win multiplier is nothing new, but the number awarded and the way they retrigger is a little different. Free spins are initially awarded when 3 or 4 treasure chest scatter symbols land. Next, a Jungle Wheel spins to set a minimum number of Megaways for the entire free spins bonus. The segments on the Jungle Wheel award anything from 1,000 to 25,000 Megaways.Once that step's complete, the bonus commences. It starts with 3 free spins, and the number remaining is represented by jewels on one of the masks above the reels. Each winning spin resets the counter back to 3, the round ending after three consecutive non-winning spins occur.A win multiplier is used during free spins, starting at x1 if 3 scatters triggered the feature or x5 if 4 scatters activated it. Following each reaction, the win multiplier increases by 1 with no stated limit to its upper value.Amazon Island Megaways: Slot VerdictIf you ever wondered what slots might look like if Walt Disney stepped into the game, Amazon Island Megaways might well be a clue. It's one of the most cheerfully presented Megaways games we've come across in a while, its look bound to delight some players as much as nauseate others. Before Amazon Island Megaways, we'd just reviewed a hardcore Norse mythology driven game, and Amazon Island Megaways brightened up the room as soon as it hit the screen - a sort of palette cleanser of sorts. As always, looks don't always relate to gameplay, and Amazon Island Megaways flips easily from give to take as you'd expect any highly volatile slot to do.While there is a level of innovation going on here, you won't find it in the base game, which relies solely on chain reactions to entertain you. When free spins trigger, Amazon Island Megaways quickly gets real once you realise you've only got three spins to conjure something up. The good thing is bonus rounds, rarely if ever, ended after three measly spins due to wins resetting the counter, adding more time to build up a respectable total. Having a minimum number of Megaways throughout the feature is a nice and, at times, very useful addition, too. Amazon Island Megaways never quite got out of control during testing, but there is a chance of collecting as much as 10,918 times your stake should it come together just so.The way free spins have been set up means they are less mainstream than just winning a set number of them, and away you go. Essentially, free spins are still a case of locking in as many reactions as possible to build the win multiplier, creating a classic Megaways snowball effect. However, by designing the game in this manner, Max Win has given players a slightly different way of attacking the game. Like the ultra-cute characters that inhabit it, Amazon Island Megaways free spins won't be to everyone's taste, but they are interesting, and it won't be a major shock if this system pops up again in future releases.

Title: BountyPop
review: BountyPop: Slot OverviewYggdrasil Gaming partners Avatar UX sure know when they are onto a good thing.
