In addition, if 2 wild symbols land on a single reel, they turn into x2 wilds, or if 3 wilds land on a single reel, they turn into x3 wilds. Wins involving sticky wild multipliers are multiplied by the combined value from all sticky wild multipliers contributing to the win. A maximum combined multiplier value of x81 is possible.Big Top Terror slot - free spinsBig Top Terror: Slot VerdictSome circus shows pile on the performance, layering spectacle after spectacle in a staggering crescendo of events in order to overwhelm the audience. Big Top Terror is, and it isn't like that. It's not in the sense that there isn't much going on a lot of the time. The base game gets exceedingly repetitive as it spins around and around, going nowhere, dropping zilch in the way of extra features. The theme has been dealt with fairly lacklusterly, too, which didn't help, though the characters and the music are somewhat amusing for a while. The biggest motivator and attention-grabbing hook was the thought of gaining entrance to the free spins arena, where Big Top Terror is finally able to arm itself with extra, potentially devastating, firepower.Sticky wild multipliers have proven their worth time and time again in the slot biz, showing up in heavies like Dead or Alive 2 or Top Dawg$, and it's no different in Big Top Terror. Where Big Top Terror differs from those two games is that it uses a ways-to-win system, which is an excellent match for a sticky wild game, especially one where multipliers can technically reach combined totals of x81. Hungry Bear hasn't been stingy with the winning potential either, which adds an extra helping of allure to the pot, as Big Top Terror's win cap is an eyebrow-raising 50,000x the bet.Not everyone is going to get even remotely close to achieving that massive 50,000x win, and chasing the dream hit on a highly volatile slot with a max RTP of 94% can be painful, so it wouldn't have hurt if there was more to Big Top Terror to see along the way, wherever the journey might end up. Perhaps if Hungry Bear had gone a little wilder with the visuals, prodded more out of the scary circus theme while adding extras to the base game, maybe even dropped the odd wild multiplier in there as a tease, or something, Big Top Terror might have been the greater spectacle.

Title: Treasures of Lion City
review: Treasures of Lion City (Pulse 8 Studios): OverviewThe real-life Lion City has a pretty interesting story behind it. The bet defaults to $/€2.50, but this can be lowered to 25 c/p or raised as high as $/€50 per spin. Not a huge amount, but enough to satisfy a good range of bankrolls and betting styles.With the exception of the low pay J – A royals, the symbols follow the theme. Can the extra features can do anything to negate that?Treasures of Lion City (Pulse 8 Studios): FeaturesTreasures of Lion City is missing a bonus game, so there is no scatter, but there are several wilds. The standard wild has the appearance of a golden lion and can substitute for any other symbol to create a winning combination. It will also pay out when it least two of a kind land, from 0.4x – 20x the stake making it the most valuable symbol in the game.Any sort of adrenaline rush in Treasures of Lion City comes courtesy of the Rolling Reels mechanic. Title: Sails of Fortune

Title: Riches of Robin
review: Riches of Robin (Play'n GO): OverviewEveryone’s favourite hooded man is back to rob the rich and share the wealth with the needy. It’s a popular theme, and Robin Hood constantly pops back up from time to time. We even got a female version from Bally recently called Lady Robin Hood. Acts of charity like that in the Middle Ages could mean the difference between life and death. Play'n GO took on the fantastical past with The Sword and the Grail not long ago which was a cracking take on the Arthurian legends. Now it’s Robin Hood’s turn on the reels, and the question is, will it be as successful?Officially, the game comes with 15 reels laid out in 5 columns and 3 rows. Each position, or tile if you will, spins independently, a concept similar to that seen in Double Lucky Line from Just For The Win. In practice, it boils down to a 5x3 slot with 20 fixed paylines. Wannabe knights select bets from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin – manual or auto. Wins come from landing 3 or more similar symbols in a combination while waiting for features to drop of which there are several. RTP swings from a chivalrous 96.65% to a dastardly 94.43% or even lower. This can be adjusted according to the operator’s whims, so make sure to double-check the setting before piling in coins. Volatility has been given a 10 rating which is Play'n GO’s highest level so prepare for some all or nothing sessions. With a solid potential up for grabs, this stat will either be a good or bad thing.Graphically the game is a bit of a knock out with bright symbols full of personality bursting off the reels. The background is set in ‘ye olde’ Nottingham. Spires poke out above reels and dwellings, with Sherwood Forest off in the distance. The soundtrack is suitably Middle-Aged, and the audio/visual effect is of a high standard. When it comes to symbols, there are 9 regulars joined by several special symbols. The low pay ones start with card suits - diamonds, hearts, clubs, and spades fashioned in a stone and gem design. The premiums are made up of five famous characters from the story. We get Friar Tuck, Alan A Dale, Little John, King Richard and Maid Marian who is worth the most at 20 times the stake for five across a full payline. Robin Hood, who looks strikingly similar to Cary Elwes in Mel Brooks comedy hit Robin Hood: Men in Tights, is wild and substitutes for any regular pay symbol. He too is worth 20 times the stake for a five of a kind combination.Riches of Robin (Play'n GO): FeaturesWhen it comes to features, Riches of Robin has several quivers in its bow such as free spins, a Heist Respins bonus, and Quick Hit feature.The Quick Hit feature revolves around money bags which are instant prize symbols. If a spin occurs which does not have a winner, then the Quick Hit may be triggered. Here, instant prize symbols on any reel will be awarded. Each money bag can contain prizes of 20x, 100x, or 1,000x the bet.If four money bags are in view on the reels then they trigger the Heist Respins feature. This feature starts with 3 respins and money bags are the only symbols that can appear on the reels. When a money bag lands, it resets spins back to 3. The feature ends when respins run to zero, or the reels are filled with Money Bags. Either way, all instant prizes get totaled up and paid out at the end.The target symbol is the scatter which only appears on the middle row of columns 2 and 4. Just two are needed to trigger the Free Spins bonus round. There is no standard number of spins. Instead, a random amount is awarded that could be 8, 10, 12, 14, or 20 free spins. There is also a random multiplier of x2, x3, x4, or x5 applied to all wins during the bonus round. The Heist Respins, as well as the Quick Hit, can still be triggered during free spins. Not just that, but if 2 scatters land they award 2 more free spins and increase the multiplier by +1. If the multiplier reaches x10, then each new retrigger awards 4 more free spins.Players are technically able to trigger Heist Respins and Free spins on the same spin. If this happens, then Heist Respins are played first, followed by a round of free spins.Riches of Robin (Play'n GO): VerdictPlay'n GO has done a great job of bringing the Robin Hood story to life through attractive graphics and amiable characters used for symbols. Throw in some great features and the result is a very playable slot. The free spins round is a highlight, but plenty can still happen during the base game to keep players on their toes. After Free spins, the standout is the Quick Hit which can drop that 1,000x prize at any moment, with Heist Respins a close second.What is more, during free spins, a full grid of wilds and Marian symbols, along with the 10x multiplier will result in a payout of 4,000 times the stake from a single spin. Max payouts are capped at a respectable 10,000 times the stake which matches what we got with The Sword and the Grail.Overall, Riches of Robin hasn’t quite pushed The Sword and the Grail off the podium as Play'n GO’s best fantasy-themed slot of the year. But, that doesn’t stop it from being a highly entertaining slot. Riches of Robin provides plenty of excitement during base and bonus games, high volatility and potential, all bundled up in an appealing wrapper. It is certainly one of the better Robin Hood themed slots out there.

Title: Into The Storm
review: Into the Storm: Slot OverviewBoard a Viking Longship and find fortune on the seas (hopefully) in a feature fest of a game titled Into the Storm from developer SG Digital. Even landlubbers are well aware of the need to avoid storms when traipsing about the ocean, especially so in a boat built in the days of yore. Not to worry, if lightning and bad weather strike in Into the Storm, it generally hails the approach of features such as respins with walking wilds and streak respins with a clever Kraken Hot Zone element.However the rest of the session might turn out, SG Digital has picked a stellar day to set sail. The sky is mostly blue, a hale wind fills the sails, and the sea is slight, making it an ideal day for some virtual pillaging. Set aboard a sturdy wooden ship sits a 5-reel, 3-row game panel armed with 20 fixed paylines. Sonically, there isn't a whole lot going on, but the occasional effects do enhance the action when they fire, so all in all, a pleasant beginning, a touch plain, though with just a hint of the potential cyclogenesis to come.Matching both the weather and the Viking temperament, Into the Storm is a highly volatile game that can switch moods in a moment. The game comes in three RTP settings, maxing out at 96% before dropping to 94% or even 90%, depending on the jurisdiction. It offers a range of stakes, starting at 20 p/c, going as high as $/€20 per spin, and there is a suspicion the max bet has been kept fairly modest to account for the solid potential on tap for lucky raiders.The looting begins when at least three matching symbols land in view, starting from the grid's left most side. A collection of five runes have been used for the low pays, firing off wins of 1-2x the bet when a line of five of them is formed. Next up, high pays consist of three Viking characters and a random helmet, paying 4-20x the bet for a five of a kind win line. Wilds perform a variety of functions, as covered in the features section, but their core duty is to substitute for all of the normal pay tiles and only appear in the base game or during respins.Into the Storm: Slot FeaturesSG Digital has packed plenty of features for this voyage, so settle in as we cover Walking Wild Respins, Krakens, and the Into the Storm Bonus.Wild RespinsThe respins feature triggers at random on any base game spin. When activated, 2, 3, or 4 Walking Wilds appear on the reels and move one position to the left or right (they stick to the same direction) on each respin. If a Walking Wild lands over a regular wild symbol, a +1 multiplier is added for the rest of the feature. When no more Walking Wilds are in view, respins end.Into the Storm BonusKraken Bonus symbols land on regular base game spins, and 3, 4, or 5 of them in view triggers the bonus game with 1, 2, or 3 Kraken Hot Zones, respectively. The Into the Storm Bonus is played on a 9x5 sized grid with 3 starting spins. Each position spins to reveal blank spaces, multipliers of x1-x3, or modifier symbols, and if any of the latter two hits, the spin counter resets to 3. Multiplier or modifier symbols lock in place and reset the spins count. Three of the modifiers act like so:Hammer – lightning doubles a random number of multipliers.Treasure Chest – collects the values of all current gold multipliers.Viking Coin – increases the number of lives to 4.The fourth modifier is the Kraken Hot Zone. Kraken symbols either land or are awarded at the start of the feature, depending on the number of triggering scatters. Each Kraken creates a Hot Zone by placing multipliers of x2-x5 in all of the adjacent spaces. These are not multiplier symbols, by the way. If Hot Zones overlap, their multipliers are multiplied together. When an actual multiplier symbol lands in a Hot Zone position, it is multiplied by the current multiplier value it lands on. When spins run out, the total of all multiplier symbols is awarded, or, if the grid is filled, players win 10,000x their stake.Buy PassThe Buy Pass feature allows players to buy direct access to the bonus round. It is possible to buy 3+, 4+, or 5 scatters for the cost of 105x, 145x, or 185x the bet.Into the Storm: Slot VerdictSo are we dealing with the Viking Money Train 2 here? Well, not quite, but Into the Storm is a sturdy streak respin game with one or two intriguing innovations. It kind of feels like it was designed by the division of SG Digital that came up with Rise of the Mountain King or made in the same spirit, which is highly positive. It might remind you a bit of Relax Gaming's Sails of Fortune at first glance, yet Into the Storm has more than enough going to stand on its own two feet and thrill players keen on the streak respin format.It's not all calm sailing in the base game, either, thanks to the walking wilds respin feature. A sideshow to the main event, to be sure, but an appreciated one, regardless. The storm doesn't reach full force till the three (or more) required Krakens hit, thereby triggering the central bonus game. There's some good stuff going on here; the Kraken Hot Zone idea, for one. Hot Zone's ability to increase standard multiplier symbols is critical to scoring decent returns for the simple reason that without them, multiplier symbols are only worth 1-3x the bet. Still, Kraken Hot Zone multipliers aren't massive either, and the best case, really, is two x5s overlapping to create an x25. This led to some furious calculator tapping and the realisation that one of Into the Storm's weaker points is that outside of full-grid wins, runners up are highly unlikely to get anywhere near 10,000x. Once clocked, a slight feeling of limited constriction did settle in - there certainly isn't the same anything-goes feeling of a Money Train 2 bonus round when a special symbol can drop from nowhere and blast the game into orbit.With the right frame of mind though, Into the Storm offers some nice hold & win gaming with a Viking twist. It might help to tone down expectations of scoring runaway bonus rounds, aside from full grid hits, that is. Into the Storm might not be vying for the top spot, but there is plenty here for streak respinners to attempt plundering.

Title: Reign of Rome
review: Reign of Rome: Slot OverviewThe reign of the Western Roman Empire may have ended in the year 476, but its legacy continues to cast a long, illustrious shadow down to the present day. But, it has enhanced Tribute symbols compared to the base game, and LootLines are technically able to titillate no matter the phase.It's tough to decide whether the LootBar idea trumps the sticky/respin elements of Donny Dough, so let's just say both methods have their pros and cons. Title: Rick and Morty Megaways

Title: Cash Chips

Title: Bugsy's Bar

It's a game full of drinks, daggers, and dastardly do-no-gooders as they seek to make a buck by barely legal means. Hopefully, you like the theme because until free spins trigger, there ain't a whole lot else happening in this bar. Once activated, however, Bugsy goes to work with the pours, serving up a selection of Small-Time Symbol removals, Bonus Spins, Locked Wilds, Super Wilds, and Wins Multipliers.Bugsy's Bar might glamorise an earlier age of crime, but it also displays some of its less alluring aspects as well. The less savoury parts are the bullet holes and blood spatters all over the jukebox (or whatever it is) housing the game's grid. Scattered around the rest of the screen are classic drinking establishment accoutrements such as liquor bottles, liquor glasses, a smouldering cigar, intimate lampshades, and an equally smouldering gentleman, enigmatically sitting on one side of the room during free spins. Bugsy's Bar caps it all off with a soundtrack that plods through the base game before launching into swing mode when free spins trigger. Fairly dense atmospherically, all things considered, without doing anything exceptional or particularly non-cliched with the theme.Bugsy's Bar slot - base gameTo gain entrance to Bugsy's Bar, players pick a stake of 10 p/c to $/€2 per spin and may use any device to play the game. Once in, users will find a highly volatile math model running the show, firing off solid winning potential and a maximum return to player value of 96%. The action occurs on a game panel of 5 reels and 4 rows of symbols, where 30 paylines cross the grid to land winning combinations on.Three, four or five-of-a-kind winning lines can land in Bugsy's Bar, made up of J-A Art Deco fonted card royals, then a cash bag, and three nefarious-looking characters as the four high pay symbols. Hitting a five-of-a-kind royal win pays 1 to 2.5 times the stake, increasing to 3 to 10 times the bet for five of the premiums. Lending a helpful hand, wild symbols appear on all reels to substitute any regular pay symbol. Should five wilds land along a payline, they award 10 times the bet for doing so.Bugsy's Bar: Slot FeaturesBugsy's Bar slot - pre bonus feature spinsBugsy's Bar's got nothing in the base game aside from line wins, so it's not until free spins are triggered that the action gets the chance of really hotting up. This occurs when 3 scatter symbols land on reels 1, 3, and 5, awarding 7 free spins. Before free spins start, the Bugsy's Special feature spins a mini-slot consisting of 3 shot glasses. This lands a combination of three of these modifiers:Bonus Spins – 1, 2, or 3 additional free spins are added to the awarded tally.Remove Small-Time Symbol – J, Q, K or A symbols are removed from the reels for free spins.Locked Wilds – all wilds that land during the round remain locked until the feature ends.Super Wild – up to two 1x4-sized Super Wilds can possibly land on a free spin on reels 2 and 4.Wins Multiplier – awards a multiplier of x2, x3, or x5. Multipliers apply to all wins during the round.It is possible to win the same modifier more than once, though there are limits which are detailed in the extensive rules section of the paytable. For example, multipliers stack when they are awarded more than once but up to a maximum of x10. Landing 3 scatters on the final free spin of the feature retriggers 7 free spins, and a retrigger of Bugsy's Special. If the Win Multiplier, Locked Wilds, Super Wilds, and Remove Small-Time Symbols have maxed out, Bugsy's Special only awards additional free spins.Bugsy's Bar slot - free spinsBugsy's Bar: Slot VerdictHey ho, there you go, not a bad wee speakeasy, bootleggin', crime in the earlier part of the 20th-century style slot to while away a bit of time on. It's easy, handsomely presented, and potentially lucrative should the shot glasses pour their bounty just so. That probably won't happen in the base game since it's modifier-free. Oh sure, technically, a decent line win or two might trundle along, but no modifiers means it might be a fairly uneventful journey. If you like the theme, though, Bugsy's Bar's main game shouldn't be too dull, thanks to the jazzy looks and sounds. It's all a little livin' on the wrong side of the law and having a bit of fun while doing so spirit of the age thing.Since the base game can be pretty uneventful, making it to the bonus round is that little bit more exciting when it finally does trigger. Then, Bugsy gets the chance to flex his hospitality skills by pouring some modifiers onto the reels. Those on tap: win multipliers, full reel wilds, sticky wilds, and low symbol removals are standard slot extras, but standard for a good reason since they can get pulses racing when they're doing something special. For Bugsy's Bar, this means wins as high as 26,670x the bet, which is quite a haul, a metaphorical full swag bag, if you will.Back in the day, Alan Parker wrote and directed 'Bugsy Malone', a humorous musical gangster film starring Scott Baio and Jodie Foster, where everyone in it was a kid, and the guns fired whipped cream instead of bullets. Sounds bizarre, but it actually made number 353 on Empire's 500 greatest movies of all time list. Perhaps it's a complete coincidence that Bugsy's Bar shares a similar name, perhaps not. What's our point? Not sure, but while the test run went okay, and Bugsy's Bar came across as a textbook Red Tiger release with sizable winning potential, it's arguable how high up any top 500 lists it would make.

Title: Secret of the Stones MAX
review: Secret of the Stones MAX (NetEnt): OverviewAt the time of writing, the new Witcher show is the highest-rated series Netflix has ever created. The mystery, the fantasy, the magic, has struck a nerve with the TV viewing public. In a similar vein comes Secrets of the Stones MAX from NetEnt. Like Witcher, it is set in a fantasy world where magic is the norm and men with long beards and staffs know all sorts of secrets. It is also a re-release of the highly successful original Secret of the Stones slot that NetEnt released in 2013. Like the Victorious remake, it has been given the MAX treatment, which seriously turns up the volatility and rewards. Where Witcher is all about slaying monsters, Secrets of the Stones MAX focuses on the gentle world of the Celtic druids. Well, while druids might have been gentle, Secret of the Stones MAX can be anything but. Time to grab and a wooden staff and get back to nature.The MAX versionSecret of the Stones MAX has a stuck with more or less the same look as the original. Visually, it’s not a stunner, yet the graphics are clean and clear and have a classic NetEnt quality to them. The setup involves 5 reels, and 3 rows, placed within a sacred rock grove. The two pillars flanking the reels have the 25 paylines on them, which lends a classic feel to the game. Paylines are fixed, though players have full control over bet level (1 – 10), and coin value (0.01 – 0.5). This results in total bets of 25 p/c to $/€125 per spin.Aside from stake level, the most important choice is to play the game in Classic or MAX mode. This can be changed at any time, so don’t feel like you are stuck with your choice. Classic is the ‘softer’ option with a low/medium variance and a lower potential. MAX is for the harder gamblers who like it rough. This setting uses a math model with much higher volatility and potential 10 times greater. There are differences in the free spins round too which we will get to. RTP is good with 96.72% in Classic and 96.81% in MAX mode.Symbols on the paytable start with 10 – A royals, carved in stone with little squiggly decorations. Premium symbols are five Celtic style animals - a snake, wolf, bull, owl and deer. The red deer is worth the most at 160 times the stake in MAX or 50x the stake in Classic. There are also five different wilds sprinkled throughout. During the base game, there is just one, a 1x1 tile druid. He can substitute for any of the regular pay symbols. Other wilds turn up during the bonus round.Secret of the Stones MAX (NetEnt): Features﻿The difference between MAX and Classic is also apparent when it comes to features. The Yggdrasil tree of life symbol is the scatter which can land anywhere. When three or more land in view they trigger the bonus game and 10 Free Spins. Before free spins begin, the screen is covered with 20 stones. The number of scatters that triggered the feature is the number of picks the player gets (3-5). Each stone can reveal:An additional 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, or 10 more free spins.Deer, bull, or owl symbols turned wild in MAX. Only deer or owl in Classic.Increases the x1 multiplier by +1, +2, or +3 in MAX. Adds +1 or +2 in Classic.Reels 2 ,3, and/or 4 can turn wild in MAX. Just reels 2 and/or 4 in Classic.Free spins cannot be retriggered so at the end of the round players return to the main game.Secret of the Stones MAX (NetEnt): VerdictFans of the original will certainly enjoy the revamped Secret of the Stones MAX. As will players looking for high volatile, high rewards slot. Be prepared for tough gaming if the symbols aren’t falling your way though. By that, we mean some pretty boring spins while you wait for the scatter to show up as it's short on features.Now we all know that developers calculate stats over a lot of spins, like billions. But it didn’t feel like the Classic mode was hugely easier to win with than the MAX. Every gambler has their personal preference, of course. For our money, it is MAX every time. In spite of its legendary status, you can't help but feel that the Classic version comes across as somewhat outdated with its lowish payouts and not so exciting volatility.The MAX concept is the catalyst that allows Secret of the Stones to remain relevant. When the bonus round does land in MAX mode, you will appreciate the additional benefits, not to mention much more lucrative symbol values all around. The most noticeable difference is in win potential. Classic mode is capable of hitting 2,500 times the stake, while its more volatile sibling can go as high as 25,000 times the stake. That is a significant difference and the key determining factor when it comes to choosing your preferred mode.

Title: The Dog House Muttley Crew
review: The Dog House Muttley Crew: Slot OverviewYou know what's about as far away from staid suburban life as it possibly gets? Piracy, yep, piracy, and the reason these two contrasting ways of life have crossed paths, as it were, is thanks to Pragmatic Play's cluster paying slot, The Dog House Muttley Crew. Experienced slot players are probably well aware of the classic sticky multiplier wild slot The Dog House, released to a warm, fluffy, patting-on-the-head reception in 2019. Since then, Pragmatic Play has expanded the doggie charm with additions such as a Megaways version, a Multihold version, and a Western. Now, a pirate version?Yeah, the theme change is random, but maybe the dogs in this game were lazing about the garden one day and were hit with the thought they were going to be peeing on the same lampposts and sniffing the same butts forever more. Like, that's it, forever. A doggie mid-life crisis, in other words, prompting a drastic life change. So, players catch up with the playful hounds aboard a wooden sailing ship cresting the waves somewhere sunny and warm. The furry characters are back, but this time, they're wearing pirate hats.The Dog House Muttley Crew slot - base gameThe Dog House Muttley Crew is a cluster paying slot, so making winning combinations requires at least 5 matching symbols to be connected to each other in horizontal and/or vertical directions. Highly volatile, players have access to bets of 20 c to $/€240 per base game spin and three bonus buy options. The game's most preferable RTP version is 96.5%, but return values vary slightly when buying the feature.Ten through to Ace symbols are The Dog House Muttley Crew's low pays, then a bone plus 4 character symbols are the higher value bunch. Clusters containing 5 matching symbols award 0.25 to 2.5 times the bet, while the biggest clusters of 20+ pay 7.5 to 50 times the bet.The Dog House Muttley Crew: Slot FeaturesThe Dog House Muttley Crew slot - free spinsWild Multipliers, free spins, and bonus buys are the features players can look out for on this voyage.Wild MultiplierThe chest symbol is wild and lands on all reels, substituting for any symbol except the scatter. Wilds hit with a random multiplier of x2, x3, x5, or x10, which applies to all wins they are part of. If more than one wild is part of the same win, their multipliers are added to each other. A win of 25 clustered wilds pays 50x the bet.Free SpinsScatters also appear on all reels. Hitting 3, 4, or 5 scatters pays 2x the bet and awards 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. During free spins, any wild that lands remains on the reels until the feature ends. Scatter symbol overlays may randomly appear on top of any symbol. Hitting 2, 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards a further +5, +10, +20, or +30 free spins.Bonus BuyThe free spins round can be instantly triggered from the base game for a set cost. Paying 100x, 250x, or 500x the bet triggers free spins with 3, 4, or 5 scatters.The Dog House Muttley Crew slot - bonus buy optionsThe Dog House Muttley Crew: Slot VerdictThe dogs do look cute in their little pirate hats, but it's likely that players are more interested in seeing the return of those sticky wild multipliers hitting the screen. The good news is they can potentially work just as well in a cluster pays slot as they did in the original game. As before, free spins are really where you want to be despite the rough weather on display there. It's the sticky quality that makes it so, and getting a collection of wild multipliers crowding up the play area might come in useful for connecting winning clusters. The base game was okay, though, as mentioned, free spins are where The Dog House Muttley Crew woofed into alive.Perhaps one area where The Dog House Muttley Crew lags is that it didn't feel especially cutting edge or as innovative, let's say, as The Dog House Multihold did, for example. It basically is just The Dog House mashed with a cluster pays mechanic, full stop. In saying that, there are bound to be plenty of players with fond memories of earlier The Dog House games who will lap this one up as well. The game world has an amiable buccaneering quality, it's got history, and it was just a fun wee doggies on the water slot to play. No, The Dog House Muttley Crew doesn't send The Dog House series into blisteringly original territory, yet it's a dependable cluster pays entry into the range.A 7,500x the bet win cap completes the picture, putting it slightly above the original but lower than others in the series. After seeing the doggies transition to a cluster pays game, what are the odds of getting a scatter-paying slot in a future outing? After giving The Dog House Muttley Crew a go, that would be no bad thing.

Title: Taco Brothers Derailed
review: Taco Brothers Derailed: Slot OverviewAs the saying goes, 'during a gold rush, sell shovels', and there is a lot of wisdom to the maxim. However, selling mining supplies can be a time-consuming business, so there are always those, like Evil Captain Diaz, who would rather just steal people's gold – and their freedom. This brings us to Taco Brothers Derailed from software provider ELK Studios, the third slot in the series and the biggest, tacoiest one so far.The original Taco Brothers slot took place in the sleepy village of Santa Maria, which is where we return for Derailed. Only this time, a gold rush is on, bringing 'gold, tacos, and trains for everyone.' Sounds alright, but beware, Captain Diaz also returns with his dastardly ways to ruin the party. It's the player's job to team up with the three brothers and the mysterious Señorita to help out and hopefully win a few coins along the way. Derailed is darker looking than the original sunshiny slot, and Santa Maria doesn't really feel like a town in the middle of a gold boom. It's like a grimmer version of Wild Toro 2, lacking the original game's feel-good visuals, though the soundtrack is a bouncy, upbeat Spanish sensation.Amazingly, Taco Brothers part one came out in 2015, so there's no surprise to see one or two statistical u-turns have taken place. Max win is the most obvious one, but other things like volatility have been increased to 'High' (7 out o 10), while RTP has headed in the opposite direction, coming in at 95%. This value applies whether you play in the regular mode, where paid spins cost 20 p/c to $/€100, or when one of the five X-iter modes is activated.The grid's gown too. Now the game area consists of 6-reels, 4-rows and is crossed by 466 connecting paylines. Winning combinations begin on the leftmost reel and pay left to right on adjacent reels but must be touching either horizontally or diagonally to do so. The three brothers make up the highest paying symbols, worth 5-50x the bet for six of a kind, then below them are shakers, whistles, skulls, lanterns, and safes, slinging wins worth 0.5-2x the bet for a line of six. There is a stack of wild action to be found in Taco Brothers Derailed, including a plain regular one. All of which substitute for any pay symbol.Taco Brothers Derailed: Slot FeaturesSeveral of Derailed's features have direct links to the original slot, though, on the whole, the game has had a major overhaul. Let's start with Walking Wilds and Walking Multiplier Wilds. All Taco Brother pay symbols can land as Walking Wilds. They move one space to the left, and each step triggers a respin. Respins end when Walking Wilds fall off the leftmost side. Walking Wilds also turn any corresponding Taco Brother pay symbol wild. The Walking Multiplier Wild is a little different and appears on the top row only. It carries a multiplier, and all regular wilds in view are given the same multiplier. Like the Brothers, these wilds generate respins for each step left they take.Taco Train HeistBonus symbols are present on reels 2, 3, 4 or 5, and landing exactly 3 of them triggers the Taco Train Heist bonus round. All three Walking Wild Taco Brothers are guaranteed to land during the bonus game. Each brother is added to reel 6 one at a time, and they move left one position per spin, carrying a multiplier that changes on each step.Pico lands first on the bottom row, generating a respin for each step left he takes. When Pico walks off the grid or is imprisoned, the second brother Pepe lands on the right-hand side of the second row. Once Pepe has walked off or been imprisoned, Paso appears on the third row. The bonus round ends when all brothers are locked and/or have fallen off the grid. When a brother walks off the grid, his multiplier is added to the multipliers of remaining Walking Wild Taco Brothers in view.There are two more key symbols. One is Captain Diaz, who lands only on the first reel. When he hits, he imprisons the brother closest to the first reel, turning him into a locked, valueless blocker tile. The second is the Señorita, landing on the rightmost reel. When she hits, she either unlocks a locked Taco Brother or sends the one closest to the first reel back to the sixth reel.Taco Smash N' GrabThis feature is awarded when 4 bonus symbols land in the base game. This feature starts with all three Walking Wild Taco Brothers plus a walking wild symbol stacked on reel 6. They all move in sync, one step left, triggering a respin as they move. In this Super Bonus round, Captain Diaz is wild and cannot lock any of the Walking Wild Taco Brothers. Should the Señorita hit, she pulls a Walking Wild Taco Brother to reel 6. The feature ends when Walking Wild Taco Brothers walk off the grid.X-iterThe second way of playing Taco Brothers Derailed is in feature buy mode by clicking the X-iter button, if present. This provides these five options:Bonus Hunt – 2x the bet to double the chance of triggering the bonus game.Walking Wild Taco Brother – 10x the bet for one spin with a guaranteed Walking Wild Taco Brother.Walking Multiplier Wild – 25x the bet for one spin with a guaranteed Walking Multiplier Wild.Bonus – 100x the bet to trigger the bonus game.Super Bonus – 500x the bet to trigger Taco Smash N' Grab.Taco Brothers Derailed: Slot VerdictAround seven years have passed since the first Taco Brothers game dropped, and some things have changed, some things have stayed the same. ELK has used the time to hone their development chops, and Taco Brothers Derailed is evidence of the studio's willingness to constantly evolve. This is a slot that returns many of the first game's best bits, conducts a set of major feature tweaks, and incorporates a few lessons learned from slots like Wild Toro 2. Derailed is once again about getting those Walking Wild Taco Brothers onto the reels, avoiding the Captain, and looping as many respins together as possible. This time, there are even more incentives to keep the Taco Brothers in view as long as possible.These incentives include multipliers and the way Walking Wilds turn corresponding Taco Brother symbols wild. Both are useful on their own but are something else when combined in the Super Bonus Round. Since all three brothers are active in the Taco Smash N' Grab, they can transform a lot of symbols into wilds. They also can't be imprisoned, which might be irritating when dead symbols are clogging up the grid in the regular bonus round. Interestingly, while the Super Bonus was more exciting, we tended to get better returns relative to the X-iter cost from the regular bonus round. Strange when you consider there's usually just one Walking Wild Taco Brother at a time unless the Señorita steps in to let bros out of prison, blasting extra life into the non-Super round. At max taco-ness, payers can win up to 10,000 times their stake in Taco Brothers Derailed.Taco Brothers Derailed has more dramatic ups downs than the less volatile, less potentially lucrative previous Taco Brothers slots and is an outstanding continuation of the series. It's a demonstration of ELK's onwards and upwards trajectory, as the team brings together the best parts of the original slot while jacking the gameplay, tease, and excitation to more extreme levels.

Title: Book of Dead
review: Book of Dead Slot: OverviewFar be it for us to state that there are many (some may say too many) online slots that centre themselves on the Ancient Egypt theme. Book of Dead is one of the originals when it comes to both this theme and the way it plays out, though. It’s potentially for this reason that it has stood the test of time and remains as a popular Play’n GO offering today. That could also be due to the fact that this developer really brings the theme to life through its use of graphics and inbuilt features. Whatever the case may be, Book of Dead is definitely one of those slots that everyone should try out at least once.Accessing the slot will present you with a layout consisting of 5 reels. This is joined by a total of 3 rows, so you shouldn’t find anything too untoward in terms of the overall interface. As well as this, the game features a total of 10 paylines for you to bet on. However, you do have the option of customising these by using the plus and minus buttons next to the relevant box. At the same time, you can customise the value of the wager that you place as well, with the coin value being the first option to change. This offers a range of between 0.01 and 1 for you to choose from, while the number of coins in action is changeable between one and five. This means that a maximum overall wager of between 10 cents and 50€ per spin.Book of Dead (Play'n GO)Play’n GO is also well-known for its ability to provide intriguing graphics within its games, which is something that Book of Dead definitely proves. The background depicts an underground temple or tomb of some sort, allowing you to experience the adventure from the get-go. Then, upon the reels of the game, you’ll find symbols starting with those running from 10 through to A. Both the K and A icons provide you with maximum rewards of 150x your stake. Next in line is the icon of the phoenix rising, followed by one of the Egyptian god Anubis. A Pharaoh can be seen next, while the explorer Rich Wilde tops these symbols off. He can reward you with a maximum payout of 5,000 times your stake.The slot all sounds great so far, right? Well, be aware that it’s not only the external appeal of the game that will stand out to you, but the inbuilt special features as well. There isn’t a huge amount of these, but they will still provide you with a wonderful gaming experience.Book of Dead Slot: FeaturesWhat would an online slot game about exploring and adventure be without some exciting inbuilt features? Nothing, we’d say, which is why we’re happy with what features the Book of Dead slot game incorporates. The first of these features is the wild symbol, which is that of the book in question itself. This is both a wild and a scatter. In the first instance, it will substitute for all other symbols upon the reels of Book of Dead. This means that it can really assist you with forming winning combinations across the reels.Not only that, but its operational skills as a scatter symbol means that as long as three are more are present anywhere, you’ll receive a pay-out for such. With five of the scattered wild in view, you’ll see your stake multiplied by 200x. Additionally, three or more of the scatter symbol showing up will also activate the game’s free spins round. You’ll be given 10 of these to play through, but there’s a secondary perk to this round, too. A Special Expanding Symbol will also be chosen before the free spins round starts. This is randomly chosen as one of the higher-paying symbols and whenever it comes into view on a reel and forms part of a win, it will expand to cover the entirety of the reel or reels that it is present on. Highly volatile, this could lead to a whopping 5000 times your stake win should you land all 5 Rich Wilde symbols in view.Last but not least, Book of Dead also has its own gamble round to activate, which is done whenever you form a winning combination in the base game. Through this, you will be asked to guess either the colour or suit of the next playing card to be turned over. Get the colour right and your winnings will be doubled, while a correct guess of the suit will quadruple that amount!Book of Dead Slot: VerdictWe couldn’t think of a better game that represents Play’n GO in all its glory. From the wonderful graphics on display through to the inbuilt specialities, Book of Dead is just an impressive game throughout. When you also consider that it provides you with the possibility of landing massive wins, there’s a lot more appeal to it than that which can be seen externally.We’re big fans of the free spins round of course, with the added benefit of the Expanding Symbol to help boost your wins. And then for Play’n GO to also incorporate a gamble round into the proceedings is just the final touch that Book of Dead requires to make it so compelling. On the whole, we’d say that this is one of – if not the – best slots from Play’n GO.Don't Miss...Since the release of Book of Dead, Play'n GO has released several follow-ups such as Legacy of Dead, Rise of Dead, Tome of Madness, and Cat Wilde and the Doom of Dead. If you enjoy slots from Play'n GO, all of these titles are worth checking out.

Title: Beat the Beast: Kraken's Lair
review: Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair (Thunderkick): OverviewSwedish provider Thunderkick is planning to release a collection of five classic slots designed to take players on a thrilling and highly volatile journey. Described by the provider as slots ‘made for the brave’ - that's not only due to the volatile nature of the games, but because each slot also features a terrifying beast. What is more, the volatility is matched by solid potential and coming from Thunderkick, high production values can be expected as well, which certainly helps with the allure.So the first beast to beat in Thunderkick’s series is the mythical Kraken, the octopus-like guardian of the deep. This is the third slot to feature the denizen of the sea so far this year, which has blunted its visceral impact somewhat. Still, the series looks promising, and the Kraken’s Lair online slot has been equipped with a modern twist that Thunderkick claims to set it apart. We'll see about that.Thunderkick describe their Beat the Beast range as a collection of classic slots. First impressions confirm this with a conventional 5 reel, 3 row set up that uses 9 fixed paylines. Thunderkick has quite a knack at making slots that look both basic, yet visually appealing at the same time. Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair keeps up the tradition with functional, yet pleasing visuals. This is pulled off by the high-def symbols, and an atmospheric underwater background replete with sunken ships. No doubt these ships and their crew were dragged to their doom by the beastly hero of the story.Taking on the beast comes with stakes that start at 10 p/c and go up to $/€100 per spin. The rules are simple. Like we got with Sword of Khans, three low pays, or two premiums on a payline award a win. The low pays are made up of 10 – A royals, which have a metallic/stone look to them. The premiums include a trident, a pendant, a chest, and two Kraken symbols. There is a big difference in values of the two. The Gold Mid-Kraken is like the baby version and is worth 50 times the stake for five. The purple daddy Kraken is ten times better at 500 times the stake for a five of a kind combination. There is a Kraken styled wild symbol that also doubles as a scatter so we will go over that in the next section.Mathematically, the game comes with a rock solid RTP rating of 96.12% so no complaints with the key stats. Designed to be highly volatile, there are dry spells to expect during the base game. Offsetting that are decent value combos that crop up now and then as well as feature drops. The good thing is that features can occur during the base game which helps the flow and keeps player engagement up.Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair (Thunderkick): FeaturesFree spins game in actionBeat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair contains some high-value symbols, but the key to the most profitable outcomes is the Kraken Emblem. This golden symbol proves its worth as both the wild and the scatter. As a wild, it can substitute for any other symbol in the base game and the bonus game. When the Kraken Emblem is used as part of a winning combination, it triggers the Expanding Win feature. With this feature, the regular symbols that were used in the combination expand to cover the full reel to create even more winners. This effect is possible in both the base and bonus games.When 3 or more Kraken Emblems land they trigger the bonus game which comes with 10 Free Spins. On top of the feature 3, 4, or 5 Emblems also award 2x, 20x, and 200x the stake respectively. In the bonus game, you will benefit from a Kraken Emblem being placed on the reels at random at the beginning of every spin. If 3 or more scatters land during the bonus game, they trigger 10 more free spins. Excellently, there is no limit to how many times free spins can be retriggered.Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair (Thunderkick): VerdictWith its high volatility and fairly high rewards, Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair is a satisfying introduction to the series. Thunderkick has pretty much fulfilled what they set out to accomplish with it. Namely, to build a classic slot that possesses a modern twist. No, it’s not an entirely original slot, nor does it possess entirely original twists. The scatter/wild combination cropped up in Sword of Khans for one example, as did the expanding symbols mechanism. Though admittedly, the expanding symbol rules here have been changed slightly due to effect of the Kraken Emblem. Then there is the potential, which at 7,777 times the stake is good, but again, that level of potential is not exactly unheard of when it comes to Thunderkick's portfolio of games.Still, the final product might not be completely new or novel, but the overall result is a thrilling and fast-paced slot with good payout potential nonetheless. In addition, it is still early days with the first release in the Beat the Beasts series. With four more follow up monster filled titles to come, the series could go anywhere. The overall impact will become more apparent when we can combine the later releases for a full assessment. For now, players have another solid Kraken driven slot to spin.Be sure to take a look at Thunderkick's second instalment in the Beat the Beast series, Mighty Sphinx - a 5-reel, 9-payline slot with potential for wins of over 4,000 times your stake.

Title: Lure of Fortune
review: Lure of Fortune: Slot OverviewAhoy players, due to the abundance of salty sea themed slots bobbing around, it can sometimes feel like we've seen every possible way of dragging bounties from the water. However, Relax Gaming begs to differ and has come up with Lure of Fortune, which provides a brand new way of trying your luck amongst denizens of the deep. The goal of the base game, aside from hitting scatters, is to land winning clusters made up of 4 or more identical symbols next to each other in vertical or horizontal directions. This sparks a cascade sequence where the winning symbols are removed and replaced with others falling in from up top. Lure of Fortune's base game takes place on a 5x5 gaming grid before shifting to something different when the bonus round is triggered.Nine regular pay symbols appear on the 5 base game reels. These are shell-like items as the 4 low pays, 4 sea creatures as the mids, and a fisherman as the high pay symbol. Landing 4 OAK clusters awards 0.2 to 1 times the bet, increasing to 11 to 30 times the bet for a 25 symbol cluster win. Lure of Fortune does not have a wild symbol, but it has a ton of extra symbols when the bonus round activates.Lure of Fortune: Slot FeaturesLure of Fortune slot - volatility optionsBefore getting to the bonus round, however, there is one more base game feature to cover. This is the Multiplier Upgrade. Each pay symbol has a multiplier associated with it. These are clearly listed next to the grid. Multipliers are applied to wins of the applicable symbol type. Multipliers start at x1 and are doubled after each win on the symbol. The game can assign random upgrades of multipliers to a random number symbol at the start of a new spin. The maximum multiplier values are 32x, 64x, or 128x on the medium, high, or extremely high volatile modes, respectively.Bonus GameThe bonus game is activated when 3 scatter symbols land in the base game. When this occurs, 3 spins are awarded and landing any symbol on reels 1 to 6 resets the counter. It's played on a different grid than the base game, where all of the regular pay symbols are removed. Five symbols are placed along the second row from the bottom of reels 1 to 5, revealing multipliers of the bet. Reel 6 is a ladder of multiplier values which apply to symbols on the rows at the end of the bonus game. Reels 1 to 5 may land these modifier symbols on each spin:Fish – reveals a value and pushes up any symbols which are already on the reel it landed on.Hammer – pushes all symbols on the reel up one spot.Payer – reveals a value that is added to all symbols on its reel.Doubler – doubles the values of all symbols on its reel.Spawner – copies a symbol and its value on the reel, then places the copy one step below the original.On reel 6, the multiplier ladder, these modifier symbols may appear:Golden Hammer – pushes all symbols up by one spot.Payer – increases all multipliers on the ladder by +1.Doubler – doubles all multipliers on the ladder.Bonus – spin counter resets to 4 instead of 3.Persistent Hammer – pushes all symbols on a random reel up one spot at the end of each spin.Persistent Payer – pays its value to all symbols on a random reel at the end of each spin.Persistent Spawner – picks a random reel, then places a copy of a symbol and its value below the original.If symbols reach the top row, they may not get pushed off. If more than one symbol would be on the top row, the values are added. When the spin counter reaches zero, all of the values on the reels are multiplied by the row multiplier they are on, and the total is awarded.Buy FeaturePlayers are able to buy the bonus game for the cost of 50x, 100x, or 150x the bet on the medium, high, or very highly volatile modes, respectively. No matter the mode, the RTP for feature buys is 96.5%.Lure of Fortune slot - free spinsLure of Fortune: Slot VerdictHmm, interesting. While there are smatterings of other games here – the symbol multipliers of Banana Town, the hold 'n win extravaganza of a Money Train slot, and a Mega Heist feel to the bonus round, there is no doubt Lure of Fortune is its own game. One thing that sets it apart is its configurability, and picking modes seriously alters major aspects of the game, so it's maybe not a decision which should be taken too lightly. To sum up the differences between modes, what changes are things like volatility, max win, max base game multiplier, and bonus buy cost. For many, the most important number will be the max win, equating to 5,000x on the medium, 20,000x on the high, and 50,000x on the very high volatile mode. The temptation to play for the biggest potential possible is likely to be great, but there are benefits to picking the other options. Bonus buys of 50x the bet, for example, might win certain gamblers over, plus the medium mode's sunshine is inviting.No matter the mode, Lure of Fortune's mix of gameplay is unique, especially for a slot related to fish and other creatures of the sea. One good thing about the bonus game is that the fish symbols do not have to reach the top of the grid to award their values. Memories (or nightmares) of Mad Cars awoke at the first look at the bonus round, where values big or small were absolutely worthless until they crossed the finish line, or not, which could be devastating. Anyway, this effect is absent from Lure of Fortune, where everything in view is awarded at the end, not to mention boosted by row multipliers.Of course, not every bonus game was a stunner, and the feature didn't have the same immediate paciness to it as Bones & Bounty as a possible comparison, but it is original and more than capable of exciting when the going's good. To conclude, Lure of Fortune is a slot packed with interesting ideas, customizable elements, and fun gameplay. Whether it ultimately frustrates or delights, Lure of Fortune's base and bonus game has the sort of depth that provides high levels of entertaining replayability.

Title: Book of Inferno

Title: Christmas Tree 2

Title: Monopoly Megaways
review: Monopoly Megaways: OverviewTwo of the biggest titles in the entertainment world are set to collide thanks to software house Big Time Gaming. Monopoly, the board game which has sold millions of copies since the 1930s, is the newest slot to get the Megaways treatment. In this way, multiple wins can stack up from just one spin.At the core of Monopoly Megaways is the Reel Adventures mechanic, used only once before in Holy Diver Megaways. Instead of a brave knight, it's Mr Monopoly that plays the key role in this game. The spritely wee chap makes his way around the Monopoly board, and the squares he lands on have a direct effect on the gameplay like so:Landing on ‘Go’ gifts the next spin with the maximum number of Megaways.Landing on utilities and railway stations makes them yours and will come into play during the bonus game.Landing on chance sends you to a random street with 1 to 4 houses added. It can also launch free spins or max out the Megaways on the next spin.Community chest results in being sent to a random street while adding 1 to 4 houses.Landing on streets on consecutive reactions populates them with an additional house.Get 5 houses on a street, or land on chance, and you can trigger the Free Spins feature. The base level is 8 free spins, but this is increased by the number of railway stations or streets with 5 or more houses you own. Additional bonus game triggers result in 3 free spins added to the original 8, and multipliers for utilities owned. Landing on a property will increase the multiplier by 1x for each house vacating the property.Once again, Mr Monopoly continues his travels around the board during free spins with each square contributing multipliers, free spins, max Megaways, and properties. When the free spins round ends, the visited streets lose their houses along with railway stations and utilities, though they can be won back up during the base game.Monopoly Megaways: VerdictThere are several slots on the market that builds on the famous Monopoly board game, but Big Time Gaming's offering is likely to establish itself as the stand out slot of the genre. Several factors contribute to its success.The first is the successful amalgamation of Megaways, the Reaction system, and the Reel Adventure. It doesn’t feel gimmicky; instead, each part works to enhance the positive aspects of the others. Although it can seem complex in writing, the end product is a slot that manages to have a lot going on without being overwhelmingly complicated. An achievement in itself, and the inclusion of the Monopoly board with its myriad extras has been extremely well thought out and executed.The icing on the cake is definitely the bonus game. Once triggered, the sky is the limit when it comes to multipliers and free spins. Well, there is a limit, but with potential for wins of up to 15,000 times the stake, not many players will be complaining. It's not unlikely that Monopoly Megaways will appeal to all sorts of players - from those that are just looking for something to wind down to after work, to the thrill-seekers looking for a high value, high volatility slot. Not to mention those players looking for a more engaging slot experience.With all that having been said, if you felt that Holy Diver and the Reel Adventure concept wasn't your cup of tea, it's unlikely that Monopoly Megaways will win you over, and while we don't expect it to become Big Time Gaming best performing game, it does undoubtedly stand head and shoulders over most other Monopoly titles available on the market.

Title: The Bird House

Title: Kluster Krystals Megaclusters

In that sense, the game is well suited for hardcore gamers.No less than 8 identical symbols are required to form a cluster, which then triggers the avalanche feature. This can lead to consecutive wins off a single spin since the process repeats until no new clusters form. While this is happening, non-winning symbols next to a winning cluster are upgraded. When an avalanche sequence ends, multipliers are added and applied to the total win amount.Helping keep the ball rolling are three random features. They are guaranteed to trigger after a run of 6 avalanches. These are:Krystal Vanish – removes one coloured symbol group from the grid.Krystal Boost – upgrades all visible symbols by one stage.Krystal Kut – removes all single-stage symbols in view.Lastly we get free spins triggered by the bonus symbol. When a bonus symbol is in view, it is upgraded when next to a winning cluster. When it has been fully upgraded (it contains four segments), seven free spins are awarded. Filling a bonus symbol during free spins adds four more spins.Kluster Krystals Megaclusters: Slot VerdictShakespeare famously said a rose by any other name would smell as sweet. Props to the bard, but he never played Kluster Krystals. The initial interest with Kluster Krystals is in another studio’s use of Megaclusters. The funny thing is if it weren't for the name, you'd never know you were playing a Megaclusters title. In which case, the experience and the verdict would have been completely different. There is no doubt Kluster Krystals is a decent, well thought out slot, yet if you went in blindfolded with the title removed from the screen, you probably wouldn't suspect this was a Megaclusters powered slot. It is definitely clever while feeling much removed from what BTG has done so far. Their Megaclusters games have been about getting small, going all microscopic, challenging the belief a Planck length is the smallest unit of measurement.Kluster Krystals goes in another tangent. It does expand individual symbols, technically cramming more of them into an individual position, but it doesn't feel like Megaclusters as we know it. One positive takeaway is that Megaclusters might be more versatile than it originally appeared. Relax certainly deserves credit for being bold and trying something unexpected. On the gaming side of things, Kluster Krystals can be highly entertaining. When clusters chains get moving, they pop and fire, one win leading to another, symbols incrementing, multipliers appearing, it all goes off like a great grid slot. Yet in many ways therein lies the rub. Megaclusters isn't about making a great grid slot; it's about redefining the genre, carving its own niche, and Kluster Krystals kind of falls short in that regard.Then again, if you go into Kluster Krystals with the mind-set of enjoying a well-made grid slot you'll probably have a pretty good time. If on the other hand you want to be dazzled by a fresh new take on Megaclusters, it can come across as a little puzzling.
