If it is, the odds must be astronomical.So there are some downs, some ups, resulting in one or two reservations. For one, Chronicles of Olympus part one already has an x50 multiplier at the top of its X UP Trail, no matter how long someone has been playing the game. There is literally no need to plug away at it. From the very first spin, a bigger multiplier is available in the previous game, which is kind of odd, though this one does provide a lot more ways to win as a counterbalance. Add everything up, and Chronicles of Olympus II – Zeus provided an overall ok experience, and the persistent multiplier idea is promising, but it felt more like mathematical shuffling around rather than a clear-cut advancement over the original.

Title: Miss WildFire
review: Miss Wildfire: Slot OverviewMovie goers take note, Miss Wildfire from ELK Studios bears no relation to the Robin Williams film where he dresses up as a nanny to spend more time with his kids. But, the game wouldn’t be a whole lot stranger even if it was. Fortunately, there is a story, a sad one, to tee up the scene. After a life spent studying the arcane art of alchemy and failing, Edgar Woodart realised he has squandered his time. Somehow, his introspection births the spritely Miss Wildfire from his roaring fireplace – his only friend. Like a good thriller, a question hangs in the air. Is Miss Wildfire real, or the product of a tortured mind teetering on the brink of catatonic despair?What we do know is that Miss Wildfire is played on a setup comprised of 6 reels, 4 rows and 466 ways to win. The alchemical activity occurs in Woodart’s lab, though it’s hard to see much of it. The symbols are huge, taking up most of the view, but we get glimpses of various scientific paraphernalia littered about the place. What provides much of the excitement, especially in free spins, is the audio. It’s a real blend of vocals, metal guitar and banging EDM. For example, to generate anticipation when scatters are landing, the audio switches to a rave buildup effect like when a strobe light is going mental, and punters are frantically huffing nitrous oxide. Free spins are like a Eurovision mash-up between DJ Bobo and Lordi, while respins come across as Bar Mitzvah inspired. Sounds weird but it works.Learning the secrets of alchemy takes place on any device, providing stakes of 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin. Reading the stats would suggest Miss Wildfire leans toward general consumption rather than dedicated gamblers. RTP should satisfy most with its 96.1% value, though perhaps not its medium volatility, rated 6 out of 10. Hits land at a rate of more than 1 in 5 spins (22.9%) - features proved to be far less frequent, though quite effective since that’s where Miss Wildfires disparate elements have a chance to work together.One of those elements is symbols, in particular the smiling log of wood. Interestingly, the wood log is the lowest paying symbol on the table, but as you’ll see in the features section, it plays a critical role. After logs, from low to high are 10-A icons, a prism object, a cuboid holding a flower and a red gem. These latter three symbols are the high pays, delivering rewards of 2.5 to 10x the stake for six of a kind.Miss Wildfire: Slot FeaturesMiss Wildfire - paytable features presentationOne foible in Miss Wildfire is that its lowest paying symbol can also lead to some of its best wins. To explain, the regular wild symbol is a flame which spreads wildfire when it lands. Wildfire spreads horizontally and vertically to adjacent log symbols, thereby turning them wild as well.The Miss Wildfire symbol is also wild and comes with a walking feature. When Miss Wildfire lands in the base game, she triggers a respin and walks one reel to the left. Respins continue to be awarded until Miss Wildfire symbols drop off the left side of the reels. Miss Wildfire symbols also set fire to adjacent log symbols, turning them wild. Be on the lookout for a Super Miss Wildfire variation. This one has the additional benefit of making non-burning log symbols sticky while she is active in respins. In addition, when Miss Wildfires are in view, any reels holding scatter symbols are locked to improve your chance of triggering bonus mode.Landing 3, 4, 5 or 6 scatters in the base game triggers free spins with an extra set of 1, 2, 3, or 4 Miss Wildfires symbols respectively. These symbols start on the rightmost reel and walk one reel to the left on each free spin. Free spins continue to play as long as Miss Wildfires, or Super Miss Wildfire symbols are in view on the reels. Moreover, whenever log symbols land, they are collected in a gauge meter on the right side of the screen. At set levels on the collection gauge, low pay symbols are transformed into log symbols. When upgrades occur, a new set of Miss Wildfire symbols are added to the rightmost reel. Logs stop being collected when the final low pay Ace symbol has been transformed.Miss Wildfire: Slot VerdictMiss Wildfire is a rather idiosyncratic game, having a sort of Quickspin vibe that allows ELK to present a different side. In some ways, it’s like the designers, just for a laugh, mixed a bunch of ideas, sprites and features into a hat, picked a few out at random then ran with the mix. However, Miss Wildfire has an overall coherency (reading the story helps), so it doesn’t feel like ELK was trying to be weird for the sake of it. The game won’t be everyone’s cup of orange mocha Frappuccino, but there are moments during features when good things happen.What will largely determine whether you like the game, aside from theme, is triggering one or more of the features early on. We were fortunate enough to quickly win free spins, thereby getting to experience what Miss Wildfire is capable of which was enjoyable. The collection system fired through symbol transformations, adding more Miss Wildfires to the board, flooding it with logs – that was fun. It led to loads of burning wood wilds, some decent wins and a satisfyingly lengthy bonus round. The second session wasn’t so rosy, and it took an age for even walking wild features to appear. In that case, the game did drag a bit, which can happen in any slot really, it’s not exclusive to Miss Wildfire of course.You can't help but feel that any game utilizing a 6x4 set up should have used a 4096 win-all-ways approach when it's paylines are limited. Why else bother with an extended reel set? Potential is solid though, and upping it to 5,000x from their old 2,500x standard it seems as though ELK has listened to some of the feedback. All up, Miss Wildfire is an oddity worth sampling if you’re longing for something quirky, if nothing else to experience Woodart’s eclectic playlist.

Title: Barbarian Gold
review: Barbarian Gold: OverviewBrighton based developer Iron Dog Studio get all rough and rugged in their fantasy-filled slot Barbarian Gold. Except, not really. Barbarian Gold uses a cartoonish approach, something which Iron Dog often goes for as seen in other games such as Viking Wilds. It’s a lighter look, the opposite tack that Nolimit City went for in their heavy hitter Barbarian Fury, as a comparison.The action takes place on a 5-reel, 20-payline reel set held in place by wooden beams, lashed together to create a makeshift frame. Surrounding the reels, the rest of the view is sparse, with a grassy foreground, a few trees, and some castle turrets in the background. The game is rich in colour and well designed, although not on the level of Nolimit City, if we're going to compare.Playable from 20 p/c up to $/€20 per spin and with a 96.3% RTP, the gameplay is uncomplicated where the main goal is to land 3 or more matching symbols consecutively from left to right. Barbarian Gold has 20 fixed paylines crossing the reels with which to do so, and a bunch of colourful symbols populate them. The symbols have a semi smartphone-style look about them, the kind that pops up in Relax Gaming slots for example.In ascending order the paytable starts with the four card suits - clubs, diamonds, hearts, and clubs. Next, are more theme-based icons such as a morning star, an axe, a sword, an ogre, a snake, and a barbarian. Rewards max out with the barbarian symbol at 12.5 times the stake for five of a kind, while the other two character symbols are worth 2.5x and 3.75x. Not massive values, but they are aided by a progressive multiplier during free spins.Barbarian Gold: FeaturesBarbarian Gold - free spinsExpanding wilds play a central role in the game, appearing in both the base game and on free spins. During the base game, when the 1x1 wild symbol lands, it expands to cover the full reel. The wild can substitute for any other pay symbol, and more than one wild can appear at the same time.Things heat up with the help of the skull scatter which can appear in any position. When 3, 4, or 5 scatters are in view during the base game they award 8, 10, or 12 free spins respectively. The game moves to the Lava Cave level which brings in a multiplier that is applied to every win. The win multiplier starts at x1. The win multiplier can only go up; it does not reset during the feature. Whenever the wild symbol lands on a free spin, it expands as before while also increasing the win multiplier by +1.Scatters remain in free spins, and should 3, 4, or 5 appear they give 4, 5, or 6 extra spins. When this happens, it also moves the game to the Gold Cave level. The benefit of this is when expanding wilds appear in the Gold Cave, they increase the multiplier by +1 and also add one extra free spin each.Where available, the game may come with feature buy functionality that allows you to trigger the free spins on demand. For a cost of 100x, 150x, 0r 200x you get 8, 10, or 12 free spins to play respectively.Barbarian Gold: VerdictAdmittedly, it took a little time to warm to Barbarian Gold. At first, it felt like Disney had rewritten the Norse Sagas for a G release with all the best bits scrubbed away so kiddies could enjoy them and pester their parents to take them on the theme park ride.It didn’t take long to realise the game had a lot more depth than was initially apparent. As is often the case, the real potential came during free spins. That’s where Iron Dog has put together quite an effective game loaded with potential. As often is the case with volatile slots though, some bonus rounds were heartbreakingly weak - even with the bonus buy activated, so beware.As you can imagine, the key is the Gold Cave, with expanding wilds landing in abundance as the other support. This not only boosts the all-important multiplier, which could hit x30+ on a good run, it is also crucial in adding more free spins to the feature. Stretch the game to full capacity and its potential can reach up to 10,000 times the stake (500x max in the base game).Barbarian Gold might not grab you straight away, its light looks may prevent that from happening for some. But if you are willing to invest a bit of time, and manage to break into the bonus game, then it is possible to appreciate what Barbarian Gold has to offer.

Title: Quackin' Reels
review: Quackin' Reels: Slot OverviewWolverine, Deadpool, Ironman, Black Widow, Captain America, the Marvel universe is chock full of big-name, well-known heroes, heroines, and villains. However, one lesser-known character who cameoed in Guardians of the Galaxy and starred in a self-titled movie in 1986 is the feathered extra-terrestrial Howard the Duck. Howard originated on Duckworld, where anthropomorphic birds wear suits, ties, and live lives like us people. Perhaps the Relax Gaming team were flicking through old copies of 'Adventure into Fear' or watching 80s movies when inspiration struck, and the seeds of Quackin' Reels were sown?Like Duckworld, players enter a world populated by birds, kicking back, knocking away a few suds, soaking up the rays, enjoying life. It won't take long to deduce Quackin' Reels is some sort of examination of a segment of American life. Clues include The Stars and Stripes wafting in the breeze on top of a house, one character with 'I ❤ USA' written on his tummy, and an American football lying in the grass in one corner of the screen. There are also loads of guns, bullets, and beers, making up a sort of 'What Europeans think of Americans' scene. It's all done in good humour, presumably.Quackin' Reels slot - base gameQuackin' Reels is a simple medium volatile 3x3 arranged slot with 5 paylines to land wins on. The default RTP comes in at 96.1%, and getting amongst the birds is possible by choosing a stake of 10 c to $/€100 per spin. Only 3 OAK winning combinations are possible on Quackin' Reels game grid, which lands 6 different kinds of pay symbols. They are a liquor bottle and cups, a machine gun, a four-wheeler, plus 3 character symbols. Rewards for hitting a winning combination range from 0.8 to 20 times the bet. Token symbols may land as well, displaying values of 1x to 100x the bet. If token symbols land on every position of a payline, the sum of the paylines is awarded to the player.Quackin' Reels: Slot FeaturesQuackin' Reels slot - respins featureQuackin' Reels has as its extras a Respins feature and a Multiplier Respins feature layered over the top.Respins FeatureLanding a stack of 3 of the same symbol on a reel triggers the Respin feature. For the respin, the triggering symbols plus any of the same symbols become sticky and lock in place for the feature. Respins continue as long as more of the same symbol land on the reels. These new symbols also become sticky. When no new applicable symbols land or all positions are filled, the feature ends.Multiplier Respins FeatureIf at the end of a Respins feature, all positions are filled with the same symbol, the Multiplier Respins feature activates. During this feature, multiplier symbols land on the reels. If a new multiplier symbol lands another respin is awarded. Possible values are x1 to x5. At the end of Multiplier Respins, all multipliers are added together and applied to the total win.Quackin' Reels slot - multiplier respins featureQuackin' Reels: Slot VerdictWhen you're one of the planet's big kahunas, some might say the big kahuna, others are sure to try and take you down a peg or two. This might explain the vignettes of American life that have appeared in online slots like this one, Quackin' Reels, as well as others such as Land of the Free and The Border, at a push. There's something about all the guns and patriotism, which a lot of Europeans just don't get, making it ripe for parody. On the other side of the coin, there are plenty of things Europeans do that Americans don't get, what with all the smoking, narrow twisty streets, paid public toilets, lack of AC, and 'socialised' health care. It would actually be quite interesting to see an American studio take a humorous jab at Europeans via an online slot. All in the spirit of brotherly and sisterly fun, of course, which is probably how one should try to take Quackin' Reels.Was Quackin' Reels fun? It was okay, in parts. The ducks in the USA thing is a bit odd, not exactly derogatory as such, but some might take offence at the stereotyping. The gameplay is rather plain for a Relax Gaming slot. There's not a lot to Quackin' Reels, though that is generally to be expected in a 3x3 slot. Individual line values are not monstrous, so hanging out for landed stacks of identical symbols became the principal activity. Even then, managing to get a full screen of the top symbol at 100x the bet isn't machine gun speed pulse racing stuff. Fortunately, full-screen results are rewarded with the Multiplier Respins phase, where a solid collection of multis might lead to a fist pump or two. Obviously, Relax Gaming didn't have flagship release status in mind when making Quackin' Reels, but for a comical 3-reel game with a couple of decent respin add-ons, it might be good for a chuckle.

Title: Cluster Slide
review: Cluster Slide: Slot OverviewIf there is one thing that the ELK team has a propensity for, it's tinkering with reel setups and the way symbols move across them. The Gold series expands rows and ways, while their gravity mechanics apply the laws of physics to the way symbols cascade. This pioneering spirit blooms in Cluster Slide, which uses an unusual avalanche action located in a cute, feisty, off-world destination.Cluster Slides’ 7-column, 8-row sized grid is set on a planet named Jellyton, inhabited by symbols mostly made up of a bunch of square monsters, some covered in jelly, others covered in fur. They also like to eat - each other. Yeah, it's a pretty wacky world, but it is an attractive one too, where several planets float above the planet's surface. It got us wondering what the effect of having so many planetary bodies so close by would be. Would everything hang in some knife-edge cosmic equilibrium, or would all that gravity cause colossally destructive effects?Players can take their trip to Jellyton on any device where bets from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin may be set. Stats are totally dependable, starting with a theoretical return value of 96%. Volatility is high, as is potential, making for a potent mix where all of a sudden a seemingly endless spin produces something special.The grid is certainly an explosion of colour, largely due to the bright pay symbols of which 4 are lower-value jelly monsters in green, blue, yellow, and red, followed by higher-paying green, purple, orange, and red furry monsters. All animate when used in a win and occasionally display cannibalistic tendencies towards each other. The largest premium clusters are comprised of 15 or more symbols worth 100 to 500 times your stake when they appear. Cluster Slide bulges at the seams with wild symbols, and the pink coloured one is a standard type, landing anywhere to replace regular pay symbols to help form clusters.Cluster Slide: Slot FeaturesCluster Slide - free spinsCluster Slide is all about getting on a roll of wins to trigger wild effects, multipliers, or bonus games. When a winning combination of 5 or more matching symbols hit, the avalanche system removes them, and new symbols either drop into the gaps or slide to the left into them. The grid's slight tilt adds to this effect. Avalanching like this ups the suspense as you mentally calculate optimal positions for new symbols to avalanche into.All winning clusters contribute to a Generator meter located to the top right of the grid. When full, it awards 1 of 5 Feature Wild symbols.Big - expands a random symbol to a 2x2 sized symbol.Random – transforms 2-4 pay symbols into wilds.Multiplier – increase the win multiplier by +1.Upgrading – picks one symbol type and upgrades them to a higher value type.Removing – removes all of one symbol type from the grid.Additionally, Feature Wild symbols land organically, triggering their effect if used in a win. Generating all 5 wild features in a game round adds +5 to the win multiplier.Keep an eye out for the 'B' symbols. Land 3 of them in a spin sequence to be rewarded 3 Wild Drops. The first drop turns all bonus 'B' symbols on the grid into wilds, then adds three 1x1 wild symbols. The second drop adds two 2x2 wild symbols, while the third drop adds one 3x3 sized wild onto the grid. A little like the Gargantoon in reverse.If that all sounds too good to wait for, players may be able to access the X-citer feature. Like Bompers, where this feature debuted, the X-citer offers a menu of feature buy options players can choose from.Cluster Slide: Slot VerdictCluster Slide is further evidence of a studio reviling in producing far-out slots. If you thought Nitropolis was madcap, Cluster Slide takes it to the next level. Then again, Clusters Slide can hardly be called brand new as it leans so heavily on Reactoonz in that it's a grid slot with cute alien characters and similar gameplay. However, Cluster Slide does feel like an evolution, a slight one, over what came before it. Visually, it is certainly a richer experience, the eight cannibalistic critters are just as personable, and the stats are generally better.Any players left a little cold by Reactoonz 2 would do well to take a look at what ELK's done here. Cluster Slide has all the makings of a frenetic grid slot that can blow when just the right combinations of clusters line up. It is definitely a volatile beast, happy to breeze through a stack of low-value drops before getting to the good stuff. On the way, it can be a real tease too, getting ever so close to free drops before resetting again.Sessions weren't tedious though – quirky graphics and a brilliant soundtrack provide a hyperactive setting while there is always something popping on the grid to stave off any boredom. The generator collection system adds a long term goal, while the fact Feature Wilds land organically and don't only show up when triggered is a nice addition. It's also a solid paying game. Get Cluster Slide on an all-time roll and wins as high as 10,000x the stake are possible.In many ways, Cluster Slide is everything Reactoonz 2 should have been. Despite similarities to Play’n GO’s classic, ELK has integrated the new touches with the relentlessly smooth gameplay so well, you kind of shrug off any comparisons and just go with the flow, or slide, as it were.

Title: 4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox
review: 4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox: Slot OverviewCasino game maker 4ThePlayer's '4 Fantastic' range has gone and become a foursome itself due to the release of 4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox. This one is a merger of the first 4 Fantastic Fish slot and the popular Gigablox mechanic designed by partner Yggdrasil Gaming. The crossover is similar in some ways to the one the studio pulled off in 90K Yeti Gigablox, and here, 4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox retains most of the original slot's features with the added dimension Gigablox brings to the party.As far as brightly lit, super positively presented fish slots go, 4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox is up there with the brightest of them. Its stylised sun spreads thick yellow beams of light across the sky above choppy seas as fish swim past. Upbeat reggae music provides the tunes for the angling activity in a world where everything practically smiles, even the fish. The main difference is the game grid has been contorted into a 6x6 space, which now lands Gigablox symbols, and the ways to win have expanded to up to 46,656.4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox slot - base gamePlus and minus buttons next to the big ol' spin button are how you can pick your preferred stake from 10 c to $/€80 per spin, in a game with a default RTP of 96%. Two things are apparent when the reels start to spin. One, there are now seaweed symbols dotted about the place, and like the ice blocks in 90K Yeti Gigablox, they have no value and cannot be used to create wins. Second, Gigablox symbols are formed when reels merge to create symbols of 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5 in size. Fish symbols land as Gigablox, too, breaking down to individual 1x1 size symbols for the purpose of win evaluations.Card royals 10-A with hooks on them are 4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox's low pays, awarding 0.4 to 0.8 times the bet for a 6 symbol win, while the high pays are a tackle box, reel, starfish, crab, seagull, and fisherman, worth 1 to 2.5 times the bet for a 6 OAK hit. The boat symbol is wild, substituting for any other symbols except scatters.4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox: Slot Features4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox slot - Fishing RespinsFantastic Fish slots generally come with a fairly lengthy list of features, and so does 4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox, where we find fish for cash prizes, big game fish, the Giant Squid bonus, a fishing respins bonus, and two feature buys.Fish For Cash PrizesFish symbols can land on any reel, displaying cash prizes of 0.1 to 50 times the bet. If fish symbols land and form a winning way, they award the prizes they display. Be on alert for big game fish as well, which pay as part of fish symbol wins:Big – 2x2 Gigablox where each 1x1 symbol pays 25x the bet up to 100x total.Super – 3x3 Gigablox where each 1x1 symbol pays 50x the bet up to 450x total.Mega – 4x4 Gigablox where each 1x1 symbol pays 125x the bet up to 2,000x total.Big – 5x5 Gigablox where each 1x1 symbol pays 400x the bet up to 10,000x total.Giant Squid BonusThe Giant Squid may appear on any spin to perform one of these modifiers:Squid Reveal – seaweed symbols reveal symbols guaranteeing a win.Giga Summon – calls Gigablox to the reels up to 5x5 in size.Squid Swap – swaps symbols to create wins.Squid Shuffle – shuffles the reels to create wins.Fishing Respins BonusLanding at least 3 respin scatters triggers the respin bonus. Each reel that shows a scatter is unlocked when the bonus begins, while the rest of the reels start the round locked. Locked reels can be unlocked, though, by landing a scatter on them during respins. When fish symbols hit, they lock in place on open reels till the round ends. Gigablox symbols may also land in any position, splitting and locking on any open reels they are present on. The top and bottom rows start locked as well and are unlocked by the shark feature.A total of 3 respins are initially awarded, which resets back to 3 whenever landing a new locked fish or hitting a scatter. At the end of the round, all fish symbol cash prizes are awarded. Lastly, when the shark appears, it eats full reels of fish symbols, combining the prizes into one position and multiplying the total by x2. The shark also unlocks the top and bottom positions on a reel. Landing fish symbols in these positions multiplies their cash prize.Buy FeatureThe buy feature is where players can land scatters to trigger the respin bonus for 80x the bet or buy the Giga Summon, which is a single spin with a Gigablox reel up to 5x5 for 150x the bet.4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox slot - Giga Summon Spin4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox: Slot VerdictFor the most part, the bringing together of 4 Fantastic Fish and Gigablox went off without a hitch. One possible thorn in the side is the seaweed symbols, which, like their icy counterparts in 90K Yeti Gigablox, block the grid with their valueless nothingness, though the Giant Squid bonus can activate them. The rest of the new parts are positive additions, such as having far more ways to win and the big, potentially exciting results large Gigablox symbols are able to carve out.It is handy that fish money symbols can land in larger sizes as well, in the base game and in respins. One caveat is that when big game fish symbols hit, you'll need them to hit fully in view to collect their entire prize value, unlike 4 Fantastic Fish, where a single 1x1 big game fish symbol is enough to win off. Ay, well, it adds to the up-and-down motion of the game. Like in the Yeti one, the Giga Summon bonus buy can be insanely up and down as well, fun in the demo but possibly brutal in real life. Or rewarding, there are a lot of ways a massive Gigablox symbol may link with after all. The respins bonus round isn't hugely different this time, aside from giga-fish symbols floating around the screen. One thing that may give prospective players pause is the 10,000x the bet win cap is a lot less impressive than the 90,000x on offer in 90K Yeti Gigablox, quashing the attractiveness of the Giga Summon feature and buy. If you've seen the outrageous $75,000 result in the Yeti game, you'll know what we mean.Most things considered; 4 Fantastic Fish Gigablox makes a successful entrance into the Gigablox world. If the reduced max win isn't an issue, then the changes here are mainly positive ones, and what made 4 Fantastic Fish enjoyable has mostly been enhanced by the inclusion of Yggdrasil Gaming's popular reel-altering, symbol-engorging mechanic.

Title: Frutz
review: Frutz: Slot OverviewFrutz is another addition to Hacksaw Gaming's Pocketz Series, a range of games designed specifically with mobile players in mind. Pocketz Series games tend to be quite minimalist, a bit low energy, a little 'Zen and the art of slots gaming' in many ways. This assessment doesn't always apply to their gameplay which can be as frustrating or rewarding as any highly volatile slot. All of what we just said applies to Frutz, a deceptively lethal wee game that encapsulates exactly what the Pocketz Series is all about.Frutz is played on a 5x5 sized grid, using a cluster pays mechanism to pull together wins. On a mobile device, all you can see is the game grid, the UI, and the game's logo, which is important as this is where current multiplier values are displayed. Additional visual stimulation is provided on a tablet or desktop where a background depicting a forest scene made up of trees, ferns, and butterflies is shown. It's all very Hacksaw. They've taken fruit and done something a bit different, a bit unique with it using a paper mache technique. When symbols drop, they make a pleasant popping sound, and the game's overall impression is one of gentle relaxation.The game's ride is far from relaxing though as high volatility (rated 4 out of 5) sees to that. Wins hit around once every four spins (26.71%), but smaller cluster values are low and rely heavily on multipliers to juice them up. RTP values are dependent on whether you let the bonus game trigger naturally or buy the feature outright. The lowest it can be is 96.37%, while the highest is 96.79%, so no concerns about return values in all cases.To get your hands on some coins, you'll need 5 or more matching symbols to land adjacent to each other, vertically or horizontally. Unsurprisingly given the name, half of the paytable is made up of fruit which is used as the higher value symbols where we find pears, plums, oranges, lemons, and apples. The most profitable clusters include 11 or more matching symbols and are worth 50 to 100 times the total stake. Lesser value symbols are the 10-A royals, all of which are worth 20x the bet for an 11+ sized cluster. There is also a wild tile, landing anywhere to help complete clusters.Frutz: Slot Features﻿For a grid slot, there aren't a whole lot of features to cover. Along with free spins, the main benefactors are cascades and multipliers, which are awarded by three different multiplier symbols. Cascades trigger after every winning cluster hits, removing the symbols so others can drop into the gaps. Cascades continue to function, causing repeat payouts until no new winning clusters appear.In the base game, if multiplier symbols land at the same time as a cluster win, they reveal a value that is stored in the 'U' letter of the logo. When more than one multiplier lands in a cascade sequence, their values are continually added to the counter. After every win, the winning amount is boasted by whatever has been collected. Light blue symbols reveal multipliers of x1 to x5, dark blue could be x10 to x20, while striped symbols reveal x25 to x100. At the start of each base game spin, the multiplier is reset to 1.One way of triggering the free spins round is when 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols land to award 8, 10, or 12 free spins. In free spins, whenever multiplier symbols land, their value is added to the counter – they do not need to land at the same time as a winning cluster. Also, the win multiplier does not reset between free spins. The odds of triggering free spins naturally is 1 in 210.The other way of activating the bonus round is by buying it. Shelling out 93x, 142x, or 200x the total bet gets your 8, 10, or 12 free spins, respectively.Frutz: Slot VerdictFor a cluster paying grid slot, Frutz is a lot lower key than others tend to be. There's no symbol collection leading to modifiers or free spins while bamboozling players with swirling graphical or flashy effects. The most exciting element is the funky soundtrack, and to be honest, the game was more enjoyable when the music was muted. There's nothing bad as such about it, Hacksaw has a talented audio team, but it just seemed to offset the calming effect of the visuals. Like a fly at a picnic, it often unbalanced the atmosphere.Like most of what Hacksaw Gaming does, Frutz is not your typical grid slot. It doesn't bombard you with features to get where it needs to go; instead, it quietly goes about its business. As a result, the base game can be uneventful for much of the time since smaller clusters aren't worth a heck of a lot. Occasionally a larger multiplier will drop to jolt you out of the slumber, but the game only really wakes up once free spins are in motion.Since Frutz doesn't bend over backwards trying to overwhelm you with theatrics, it might be a surprise to learn wins as high as 10,000 times the bet are possible. Then again, perhaps not, because sizeable multipliers can accrue during free spins (the highest reached in testing was around 70x), which dramatically boosts cluster values. Title: Legacy of Ra Megaways

Title: The Gunman of Goldwood
review: The Gunman Of Goldwood: Slot OverviewSix shooters, Stetsons, and spurs, yup, it's Wild West time, folks, courtesy of developer Thunderkick's online slot, The Gunman Of Goldwood. Thunderkick has been out these ways before in the slot The Wildos, but where that game had a bright cartoonish surface, this time, the studio has gone gravelly realistic, exploring a darker side of the frontier. Maybe not True Grit Redemption or Tombstone RIP dark, but The Gunman Of Goldwood is a seriously minded slot with some seriously good features such as wild multipliers, free spins, and expanding winning symbols.As Western slots often are, The Gunman Of Goldwood is located in a wooden building street-lined, middle-of-nowhere frontier town, oozing lawlessness and danger. The Gunman Of Goldwood wasn't as bleak as Hacksaw Gaming's slot, but things like the ominous ringing bell scatters and moody weather produce an atmosphere of anything goes, where all you can rely on are your wits, intuitions, and shooters.The Gunman of Goldwood slot - base gameThe Gunman Of Goldwood is a 5x3 slot where winning combinations are evaluated on 10 paylines, right to left, from the leftmost reel. It's highly volatile, and not only can players pick a stake of 10 c to $/€100 per spin, there are also four BET+ options to choose from, if desired. The regular max RTP is 94.31%, but this changes depending on whether users buy the feature or activate those BET+ ante bets to change how the game functions.Ornately designed 10-A card ranks are The Gunman Of Goldwood's low pay symbols, awarding 2 to 2.5 times the bet for a 5 OAK winning payline. For premiums, there are gravestones, liquor bottles, knives, pistols, and gunman symbols, paying 5 to 50 times the stake for a 5-symbol winning line.The Gunman Of Goldwood: Slot FeaturesThe Gunman of Goldwood slot - free spinsThe ammo that The Gunman Of Goldwood is able to unleash includes wild symbol multipliers, an expanding Duel feature, a free spins bonus game, a bonus buy, and BET+ ante bets.Wild SymbolThe wild symbol substitutes for all other symbols except the scatter. In addition, any payline with a wild in it gets a multiplier determined by the number of wilds in the payline. When triggered, any symbol in a winning combination will expand to cover the entire reel. All highlighted symbols expand sequentially and pay out only in the expanded state. Wild symbols can expand more than once if they are included in multiple wins with different symbols.Bonus GameThe bonus game is triggered or retriggered by landing 3 or more scatter symbols. Players win 8, 12, or 16 free spins when 3, 4, or 5 scatters, respectively, hit. In the bonus game, a random wild symbol is placed anywhere on reels 2, 3, or 4 at the start of each free spin. Another benefit is that the Duel feature is always active, and any winning combination expands.BET+For an increased cost to the stake, the BET+ options add specific boosts to the game:Bonus Boost - 1.5x the bet, each spin is 2 times more likely to trigger the bonus game.Bonus Boost Plus - 3x the bet, each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger the bonus game.Duel Deal - 5x the bet, all wins expand, even in the base game.Duel Deal & Bonus Boost Plus - 7.5x the bet, each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger the bonus game, and all wins expand, even in the base game.The Gunman of Goldwood slot - free spinsThe Gunman Of Goldwood: Slot VerdictOn the 2002 album 'Blood Money', American musician Tom Waits sang, 'A man must test his mettle, in a crooked old world', and few places offer the chance to test one's mettle like the Wild Wild West. Perhaps that's one reason why casino game makers return to the theme time and time again to colour their slots. After all, no other scenario lets a gambler pretend they're moseying on into a middle-of-nowhere settlement, taking on the locals, and, if lucky, they might make off with loot. Players certainly get a chance to indulge their Wild West fantasies in The Gunman Of Goldwood, where the subject matter has been nicely dealt with, teeing up the scene for some solid features to potentially do their thing.The Gunman Of Goldwood hasn't been produced in a bubble. It's worth acknowledging some of the stepping stone slots which paved the way for its existence, such as Midas Golden Touch's wild multiplier effect and, of course, Book of Dead's expanding symbol feature. Thunderkick has sprinkled this sort of wild multiplier feature in a number of its slots before, and the only downer in The Gunman Of Goldwood about it is that the wild symbol has been nerfed, so players don't get the x32 for a 5 wild winning line anymore. Not necessarily a deal breaker since the Duel feature steps in to pick up any slack, and the max win is capped at 7,500x. It's handy that the Duel may randomly trigger in the base game, but the free spin expansion guarantee is a lot more exciting, where the pinnacle event, four expanded wilds and a chunky premium symbol is the dream scenario.Other than the RTP, The Gunman Of Goldwood raises few major criticisms as it goes about the business of dropping in a handful of exciting features to compliment the core 5x3, 10 payline matrix with wild multiplier system Thunderkick evolves so well. At the end of the day, it doesn't stand out in any particular way but competently delivers a familiar Wild West experience.

Title: Torii Tumble
review: Torii Tumble: Slot OverviewWhen entering a Shinto shrine, there's a good chance you'll pass beneath a torii, which is a gate representing a transition from the regular world to one more focused on the sacred side of life. Maybe it's more than a representation. Perhaps people literally cross from the mundane world to one where spirits reside and where it's possible to experience higher levels of consciousness. Since Shinto is the native belief system of Japan, it's to the Land of the Rising Sun that gamblers are brought to when choosing to play Torii Tumble from software provider Relax Gaming. Torii Tumble builds on the studio's 'Tumble' series of slots, so we've got gaming elements like tumbles, a multiplier ladder, free spins, special symbols, and a bonus buy to look forward to.Torii Tumble is played on a 6x6-sized gaming grid placed beneath a torii which displays a multiplier ladder across its upper beam. Torii not only appear at the entrance to shrines. They can be seen in the water, on top of statues, and in Torii Tumble, a bamboo forest is the setting for this particular torii. The background art is pleasantly not overblown, and Torii Tumble reinforces the theme with some excellently animated symbols, a samurai-populated bonus selection scene, plus Mt Fuji appears in numerous spots, too. With its slashing sound effects and energetically Eastern-inspired soundtrack, Torii Tumble provides Japan-philes with a pretty sweet cultural hit.Torii Tumble slot - base gameHits continue when matching symbols land on at least 3 consecutive reels, from the leftmost reel onwards. Whilst the grid is 6x6 in size, on each spin, some positions will reveal active symbols; some will display value-less stone blocks. Winning symbols and any stone blocks next to them are destroyed, and new symbols fall down to fill the gaps, creating another chance to win. This tumble system is governed by a highly volatile math model, which in the default mode produces a return to player of 96.1%. Stakes from 10 p/c to $/€50 can be selected, and the bonus buy costs 70 times the bet. When buying the bonus round, the RTP increases to 96.5%.For regular low-pay symbols, Torii Tumble's got J-A imprinted blocks, three animal-type faces as the mid-range symbols, and 2 character symbols as the higher pays. Landing a win consisting of 6 low pays is worth 0.2x the bet, 6 mids pay 0.4x the bet, and 6 of the character symbols is worth 0.6-1x the bet. Should all positions on the reels be active, 46,656 ways to win are in play. Lastly, existing on all but the leftmost reel are wild symbols, which substitute for all pay symbols.Torii Tumble: Slot FeaturesTorii Tumble slot - free spins optionsComplementing the tumble mechanic is a multiplier ladder, joined by a Multiplier Booster and Spin Saver stone block. Then we've got free spins, available in three different modes, and a free spins gamble.Multiplier LadderThe multiplier ladder displays its current and possible values above the reels - starting with x1, x2, x3, x4, and x5. Following a win, the multiplier ladder increases by one step, and when a new game round begins, it resets to its leftmost value in Gonzo's Quest fashion. Should all stone blocks be destroyed, the multipliers on the ladder double in value. In addition, special stone blocks can land containing multiplier boosters or spin savers:Multiplier Booster – these red stone blocks increase the multiplier ladder values by +1, +2, or +3 when destroyed.Spin Saver – when destroyed, green spins savers grant a life. When no more wins appear, a collected Spin Saver will remove all pay symbols, causing a tumble.Free SpinsWhen 3 or more scatter symbols land through a game round, 8 free spins are awarded, plus 1 additional free spin for each extra scatter symbol. Special blue stone blocks may land during the bonus, awarding 1-3 extra spins when they are destroyed. When triggered, the multiplier ladder values are transferred to free spins, and then their values are doubled. Should all stone blocks be destroyed, the values on the multiplier ladder are doubled, and +3 free spins are awarded. Also, players get to choose from 3 different free spin modes:Multiplier Mode – special stone blocks contain +1, +2, or +3 multiplier boosters and additional free spins.Spin Saver Mode – special stone blocks contain Spin Savers and additional free spins.Mixed Mode – special stone blocks contain +1, +2, or +3 multipliers, Spins Savers and additional free spins.Free Spins GambleWhen free spins end, a gamble feature is provided, giving players a chance to buy additional free spins or gamble to win them for a fraction of the cost. Multiplier ladder upgrades are kept between free spin sessions, either when winning the gamble or buying extra free spins.Torii Tumble slot - free spinsTorii Tumble: Slot VerdictJust as the kingdoms of Japan eventually unified under one central government, so does Torii Tumble unify a cluster of ideas seen in previous Relax Gaming slots. Naturally, there's a connection to games like Temple Tumble Megaways or Cluster Tumble, but others poke their noses in here too. A few that came to mind were Tiger Kingdom Infinity Reels and Hazakura Ways on account of the theme, TNT Tumble (for one example) due to the bonus round option idea, and Wild Yield due to a link to the post-feature gamble option. Torii Tumble has its own personality and way of doing things, though; we're just reporting back on some possible contributors to the DNA cocktail Relax Gaming mixed when designing the game.Now that we're done examining Torii Tumble's possible family tree, let's take a look at the game itself, which, when the dust from all those destroyed stone blocks cleared, was completely satisfactory. The initial impression was somewhat mild, mainly because Torii Tumble's game world didn't look overly exciting at first. However, Torii Tumble possesses a subtle (and not so subtle at times) depth which revels in a good bit of hacking and slashing when it manages to build momentum. Each part connects to the other like a charm, meaning chains of events can be fairly lengthy and potentially lucrative, as well. For the numbers people, Torii Tumble has a win cap of 20,000x the bet, and a thrilling pathway awaits lucky players who manage to get close to this figure. The multiplier ladder, for example, may be somewhat limited to begin with, but it can be increased, doubled, and used again through the free spins gamble/buy when a round ends.Torii Tumble might not be Relax Gaming's greatest release, or even the best Tumble game, perhaps, but it shows that even when the studio isn't trying to dominate the planet with juggernaut slots, it's unusually skilled at creating highly playable games, polished to a shine, with rich atmosphere and exciting features.

Title: Cash Volt
review: Cash Volt: OverviewCash Volt from developer Red Tiger is a slot that hearkens back to a simpler era of gaming. Back to a time when slots were more or less limited to performing one basic function. That statement alone may seal the deal either way for a lot of players. Cash Volt does basic gaming so uncompromisingly there is no middle ground. You either love the style, or you don’t. But hey, as always, we’ll hold off making judgement until the game has run through its paces.From the minute Cash Volt loads you know you are playing a Red Tiger product. It’s a combination of the user interface, the visible lines when you score wins, and the overall vibe. The classic 5-reel, 20-payline game area is located on what could be a stage, like a jukebox perhaps? It’s a little tricky to grasp exactly what concept Red Tiger went for, other than producing something ’old school’ - in their words.A bass-heavy, and like much else in the game, monotonous funk track accompanies the spinning. Should you need motivation to solider on, above the reels, you can find a list of instant prizes and how to win them. In theory, it seems easy, in practice, well it will depend on a solid helping of luck.Some say you make your own luck in life, which is true to an extent. The first step in doing so is choosing a bet where options range from 10 p/c to $/€40 per spin. RTP is slightly below average as it often is with Red Tiger, but at 95.71% it’s more disappointing than it is diabolical. The developer has rated volatility at 3/5, while the hit rate comes in at 2/5. Not sure exactly what that equates to in standard percentage terms, but the hit rate is low as tradition has it with fruit slots.Symbols are all classic / old school / generic icons of the biz, depending on how you view them. In ascending order, there are cherries, lemons, a single bar, double bars, triple bars, stars, horseshoes, bells, and sevens. As an indicator of winning potential, should you land a full line of sevens, you are looking at a payout of 15 times the stake. To be fair, you are just as likely to get returns from Cash Volt’s instant win feature so let’s check it out.Cash Volt: FeaturesCash Volt - fat tiles in actionCentral to the action are the Cash Volt symbols which may land anywhere on the grid and pay from any position. At least 6 are required for an instant reward of 5 times the stake up to a full screen of 15 Cash Volt symbols for the game’s top prize of 2,500x.Cash Volt symbols may also appear in a Super Cash Volt format. Standard Cash Volt tiles appear in 1x1 size, while the Super variety land in 2x2 or 3x3 size. Super Cash Volt symbols don’t do anything special though, other than turn into a collection of individual 1x1 sized Cash Volt tiles.Cash Volt: VerdictThe game specs hype Cash Volt up by mentioning ‘electrifying wins’ which is a term used frequently. However, with Cash Volt it is possible to have solid, one-off ‘electrifying’ wins – provided you land the right number of Volt symbols. Fifteen is the lucky number, which is worth 2,500 times the stake right there.From one spin, 2,500x isn’t bad at all, but it is the only thing Cash Volt has to offer. If you like endless spinning while waiting for the big one to strike, then you might dig the game. If you need some variety or like multiple ways of scoring decent wins, then this one-dimensional game is unlikely to cut it.Overall, potential might not be huge, but it is achievable since all that is technically required is a bunch of Volt symbols to show up. During testing, Volt symbols did appear quite regularly which helped retain a certain level of interest, albeit at rapidly diminishing levels.Cash Volt is not a game where you wait an age for the special symbol to appear. This is fortunate because aside from instant wins; there is nothing else going on. No modifiers, no bonus games, or free spins. In some ways, Cash Volt is like furiously rubbing the silver stuff off scratch cards to (hopefully) reveal the right symbols. Again and again and again.At the end of the day, perhaps old school isn’t the most accurate way of describing Cash Volt. Old fashioned might be better. It’s not so much retro styling that makes you nostalgic for the good ole days. Rather, it’s rudimentary, limited, lacking depth.Then again, this type of gameplay does have its fans, in particular in the UK where basic arcade classics such as Reel King are huge. For some players, Cash Volt might be like walking down a street they grew up in as a child where the flowers smell more fragrant, the air is cleaner, the light somehow brighter. For others, playing Cash Volt will be like trading in an iPhone for an Alcatel OT 311 featuring a burning orange display, no internet, and storage capacity for 20 messages.

Title: Respin Circus
review:
Respin Circus (ELK Studios): OverviewCircuses are rapidly becoming relics of the past as growing numbers protest against animal abuse and inhumane care. Thankfully, ELK's circus animals are not confined to live their lives in barren conditions or forced to perform humiliating stunts - in Respin Circus, they actually run the show. The idea of merging circuses and casino games is not a new one as you may know. It's, in fact, a concept that has culminated in many successful titles such as Golden Ticket (Play'n GO), Rabbit in the Hat (Microgaming), Theme Park (NetEnt) and Wicked Circus (Yggdrasil Gaming) to name just a few of the most prominent.
ELK Studios has visited many compelling places throughout the years, but they've never actually been to the circus before. That's about to change with the release of Respin Circus, a 6 reel, 64 payline slot where respins are triggered on every win and illusionist rabbits magically appear to reward multipliers and wild reels. Medium to high variance, Respin Circus can be played across all devices from 20 cents to 100€ per spin.ELK has done their homework and carried out detailed studies on how to design a circus-themed slot, not skipping a single step. Unavoidably, you'll discover bits and pieces stemming from all those other circus slots that came before it, such as the balloon shaped symbols taken straight from NetEnt's Theme Park slot (which in turn they probably found inspiration for in some other slot). Moreover, the soundtrack emulates the traditional style of circus music and both the colours and visuals are vibrant with meticulous attention to detail.Symbols on the reels include (as mentioned previously) lower value balloon shaped A, K, Q and J royals as well as medium value cannons, unicycles, and a pair of maracas. The premiums are represented by a group of animal performers - a cat acrobat, a monkey clown and strongman mouse. Symbols do not appear stacked on the reels and there are no other special symbols involved aside from the scatter and wild which we will cover in the features section below.Respin Circus (ELK Studios): FeaturesFree Spins feature screenshotAside from the standard symbol set, Respin Circus also includes a wild symbol which is represented by a rabbit with some special magical powers. Appearing on all reels but the first, it not only performs the typical substituting duties, it will also boost your wins with the help of 2x, 3x or 4x multipliers. If really in the mood to showcase his tricks, the rabbit may even turn into a fully stacked wild reel.As the title suggests, a lot of the focus in this slot is on the Respin mechanism. Triggered whenever you land a winning combination, it can come into play in both the main game and the free spins round. When activated, all triggering symbols are held in position as the remaining reels spin again. If additional symbols appear and connect with matching held symbols, they'll stick as well and another respin round is played. Moreover, if a different symbol of higher value appears on a winning payline, it will activate the Symbol Upgrade feature, thus transforming all your held symbols into the more valuable one instead. The respin feature ends when you either land a full screen of your designated symbol or if no more matching symbols appear in view.Expect to get more of the same in the Free Spins feature which is played when 3 or more scatters appear anywhere in view. Having been awarded your golden ticket to the great show, you'll see the same respin mechanism played out here as well - your triggering scatter symbols are locked in position while the remaining reels spin again. Each scatter represents a free spins, which means that if you collect all of them during the pre-bonus respin game, you could potentially kick off with a maximum of 24 spins in the actual free spins round.Once underway, every scatter symbol that hits will award an extra spin and, just like in the main game, the respin feature will activate upon any win. Furthermore, the wild rabbit can turn up in the free spins round to boost your wins by up to 4x and give you wild reels too. There's a maximum payout of 2500 times your stake to be won here, though to keep it more realistic you should expect to see wins of around 200 to 500 times your stake during a good run.Respin Circus (ELK Studios): Final VerdictRespin Circus is an entertaining and colourful slot that will cater mostly to recreational players while hardcore gamblers are more likely shy away due to the relatively low payouts on offer. One specific thing to note here is the exceptionally low bonus frequency where you can expect to trigger the bonus once every 2100 spins! It's not as bad as it sounds, however, as a large chunk of the RTP is allocated to the main game with its frequently activated respin feature to balance it all out.Either way, the free spins feature is more or less just an extension of the main game and, in our opinion at least, it could have been made a bit more exciting with the addition of a whole new feature. Kudos to ELK Studios, by the way, for being transparent with their stats. It's definitely not something most providers will share with us.Respin Circus is not a slot that will make headlines, and it's certainly not one that will kick new doors open. Though an overall decent slot of good quality that will do a good job of keeping ELK's core audience entertained, Respin Circus feels more like a run-of-the-mill when compared to Ecuador Gold and its follow up sibling Tahiti Gold.

Title: Jungle Mega Moolah
review: Jungle Mega Moolah: Slot OverviewDeveloper Microgaming has parcelled out design duties to several partner studios to bulk up the range connected to the famous Mega Moolah network. There are 4 up for grabs – the Mini, Minor, Major, and the Mega which has one solitary red segment. The next part is easy in theory - the wheel spins and what it lands on is yours. Because the jackpots are progressive, they are constantly growing players feed the pot and can reach several millions of Euros in value.Jungle Mega Moolah: Slot VerdictIt seems Microgaming has stuck to the template when designing Jungle Mega Moolah. It reads like the original, from stats to features, making it pretty much a clone. The main difference aside from the higher resolution graphics is the new herd of animals and the wetter location. For most jackpot chasers that’s good news because the main event, the tremendous stack of credits, is as alluring as ever.They might have taken the easy road yet it’s hard to knock Microgaming really. The Mega Moolah formula has suited them fine for over a decade now. On the other hand, was there much point in a reboot? Sure, the production is slicker, yet it loses some of the raggedy charm of the past. But hey, it’s hitting the million Euro prizes that count around here, the rest of the game is basically a sideshow anyway. And to be fair, despite all the other additions to the Mega Moolah network, the original (therefore Jungle Mega Moolah as well) has one of the better bonus games attached to keep players entertained when it triggers.So if you’re going to chase the dream it's better to do it on this one or the original? The choice boils down to whether you want the slapstick antics of the older one, or the more professional environment of the jungle version. Since players have the same chance of striking it rich on both, it doesn’t make much, if any, difference.

Title: Knight's Life

We'll pass on this one and save our gambling budget for Dead or Alive 2 instead.

Title: Warrior Ways
review: Warrior Ways: Slot OverviewEver seen those movies or tv shows where the hero sticks to traditional means of warfare like bows and arrows but still manages to win out over baddies packing machine guns? If that sort of entertainment gets you going, then Warrior Ways from Hacksaw Gaming might just do so as well. This is a game set in an 'alternate Japan-inspired futuristic city' where four clans battle it for supremacy over the streets. The four clans literally defeat each other in a Duel feature, winning multipliers as well as glory, while continuing the squabble into two bonus games called Clash and Conquest.Warrior Ways is a return trip to Asia for Hacksaw Gaming, having visited before in Toshi Video Club. This one is a lot different, though. Gone are the adorable sushi references, replaced with ninja-style warriors in a street scene lit by the pink and purple light of dawn or dusk. Alternatively, the 5x4, 1024 ways wins game grid might simply be bathed in the light pollution generated by a major metropolitan city. It's a cool scene, with a Warlords - Crystals of Power meets Bladerunner look and feel. An exotic soundtrack finishes things off by reinforcing the futuristic urban Asian culture approach Hacksaw has taken.Players can get to clashing on any device, where stake options range from at 10 p/c to $/€100. Overall, Hacksaw has rated the volatility 4 out of 5; however, when buying bonuses, the two options have been rated 'high' and 'medium', so players have some influence. RTP is variable, maxing at 96.33%, before dropping to 94.42%, 92.30%, or 88.39%, depending on the configuration and market. The theoretical return does change too when buying a bonus game.The current population of Tokyo, including all three prefectures, is around 35 million people, so there's no telling how many people populate the futuristic city in Warrior Ways. We know four of the inhabitants, though, as they appear on some of the symbols. The groups in Warrior Ways are the plainly named Red Clan, Blue Clan, Green Clan, and Orange Clan - each Clan has a high paying and low paying symbol. The four low pays are worth 0.5x the bet for five of a kind, doubling to 1x the bet for five high pays. There's a wild symbol, too, landing anywhere to replace all regular pays. The wild is also worth a hefty (compared to the others) 50x the bet for a five symbol winning way.Warrior Ways: Slot FeaturesFour competing Clans are bound to clash eventually, and in Warrior Ways, they actually fight quite often via a Duel feature. Duels are central to Warrior Ways as they can be found in the base game and the two bonus rounds.DuelsA Duel is activated when a VS symbol lands right between two premium warrior symbols from different Clans. VS symbols appear on reels 2, 3, or 4. When triggered, the two warriors are each given a random multiplier of x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20, x25, x50, or x100. When the Duel ends, the winning Clan's premium symbol replaces all instances of the losing Clan's symbol. This could be the lows, the highs, or the low and high losing clan symbols. Also, the VS symbol transforms into the winning Clan's high symbol. If the winning Clan's symbols result in a win, its multiplier is applied to it.ClashThis is triggered when 3 Clash symbols land anywhere on the grid. The first part of Clash is the Collect phase. During this phase, 3 spins are awarded, which are reset whenever a VS symbol or Clan Multiplier symbol lands. Reel 1, 2, 4, and 5 corresponds to a Clan and starts with an x1 multiplier above it. When a Clan multiplier symbol with a value of x2 to x100 hits, it is added to the reel multiplier. There is a chance an Epic Clan Multiplier lands on reel 3, which multiples all other reel values by x2 when it hits. When spins run out in the Collect phase, the bonus switches to the Clash phase. The number of VS symbols collected equals the number of spins awarded for the Clash, and a Duel is guaranteed on each spin. Battling Clan members take the multipliers achieved during the Collect phase.ConquestLanbding 3 Conquest symbols in the base game awards 10 free spins. Whenever a Conquest symbol lands during the feature, an extra free spin is awarded. Four Clan banners sit beside the reels for Conquest, and whenever a Clan loses a Duel, the banner takes damage. When a Banner has been destroyed by damaging it twice, the respective high and low symbols of that Clan are removed from the reels for the rest of the feature. Moreover, +1 extra free spin is also awarded when this happens.Buy BonusHitting the Buy Bonus button, if it is there, let's players buy either bonus round. Clash costs 100x the bet, is highly volatile and has a maximum RTP of 96.44%. Conquest has a price tag of 400x the bet, is medium volatile and has a max RTP of 96.51%.Warrior Ways: Slot VerdictHacksaw Gaming slots tend to be simpler than Warrior Ways, though still outrageously fiendish in their design. Often, there'll be a clever feature in the base game which gets amplified during a bonus round. Warrior Ways has a bit more depth than that, putting it on a par with games like Wanted Dead or a Wild or The Bowery Boys. The Duel feature is the central concept running through it all, tying everything together into one big Clan showdown.Warrior Ways' pace can be quite placid much of the time, despite the fairly frequent Clan Duels taking place. They're fun enough, though the base game lacks a collection/progression element of a battle slot like Yggdrasil's Vikings Go range or the variety of modifiers available in Warlords – Crystals of Power. What made this noticeable was the amount of time it took to trigger the two bonus rounds.So which bonus round to pick? Both were solid performers, starting with Clash and its Collect phase, which played out a bit like Chaos Crew, where the goal is to stack as many multipliers and VS spins as possible. Unlike Chaos Crew, you then have to put the acquired multipliers to work in the Clash phase, adding an extra layer of complexity. Conquest is the significantly more expensive buy option and generally resulted in 1 or 2 sets of Clan symbols being removed from the reels. Since Hacksaw armed the game with ways instead of paylines, symbol removals can be rather potent. Dominate these means streets, and players can walk away with wins of up to 10,000x their bet.Warrior Ways is an imaginative game, with a gang warfare in the streets story, a level of atmosphere, and a set of features that have been neatly intertwined with each other. This being a Hacksaw production, Warrior Ways can be exasperating at times, but it's also got all the parts necessary to hack and slash with the best of them on its day.

Title: Dream Destiny
review: Dream Destiny: Slot OverviewPlayers, if you've ever wanted to 'Enjoy the feeling of being excessively wealthy' or felt the need to acquire 'Mansions, yachts, and private jets to show your power', then Red Tiger may well have the slot you're looking for. Next to the game grid is a couple of fly whips of the Porsche/Ferrari variety, while on the left, nothing says class like topiary trimmed into the shape of a dollar sign. It's the sort of place perfect for snapping some envy-inducing Instagram pics as much as kicking back and unwinding after the effort it took to accrue the cash needed to pay for it all.If you're planning to take on the dream machine, prepare for a medium volatility math model - rated 3 out of 5. Slightly higher is the hit rate of 4 out of 5, while the default RTP has been clocked at 95.88% during simulated spins. None of these numbers mean much in a wealth themed slot compared to the max win figure. Here, Dream Destiny comes up short. The 4 modifiers are mystery symbols, stacked reels, random wilds, and free spins;The Private Jet feature sends a plane over the grid, dropping mystery high pay symbols onto the reels in random positions for the current spin.The Champagne Feature transforms between 2 - 5 reels into fully stacked high paying symbols for the current spin.The Credit Card feature plants credit card wilds across the grid in arbitrary positions.Lastly, hitting Free Spins on the wheel awards 10 free spins or retriggers 10 free spins if the feature is already in play. A tad disappointingly, the rules during free spins are the same as they are in regular base game spins; nothing changes.Dream Destiny: Slot VerdictDream Destiny comes across as tongue in cheek without even trying. At times, it's hard to tell if Dream Destiny is being serious or just trolling. If the former, it walks a dangerous line of becoming a parody of itself. Sure the game's all a bit of a laugh, a bit of wishful thinking, but Dream Destiny might have been more palatable if it used a dash of humour instead of being so serious about flaunting riches.The Destiny Wheel is a bit of a gip when you realise for the majority of the time, all it slings out are x1 multipliers which do nothing. Like, what's the point of teasing like that? Every so often, you get a bigger multiplier, say x5, in conjunction with a decent line win, that's alright. So are the other features when they deign to trigger. However, another disappointing realisation is scoring a full line of five trophy wife symbols, boosted by an x5 multiplier, leads to a payout of 150x the bet, which is roughly one-tenth of Dream Destiny's full potential. Max this credit card out, and you are looking at a win of 1,539 times your stake. That might be better than paying full price for a fake Rolex, yet the top win fails to live up to the game's hype.For a wealth-based slot, there just isn't enough wealth being tossed around to make dedicated gamblers or adherents to avarice take notice. Maybe if the makers turned down the cheese, cranked up the max win, and loosened the multipliers on the wheel, Dream Destiny might have been more fun to play. But hey, they didn't, so it ends up being a miserly game that is all front with little substance backing up the boast.

Title: Atlantis The Forgotten Kingdom

If you find yourself teetering on the fence, read on, and we'll see if we can convince you one way or the other.If you're doing an Atlantis themed slot, there's only one place the action can occur, which is at the bottom of the sea. As such, Atlantis The Forgotten Kingdom is played on a 5-reel, 243 win ways game grid, surrounded by bubbles, seaweed, and fish groupings floating through deep dark ocean. Atlantis can partly be made out in the distance, but more focus is given to the wild reel on the left-hand side, plus the max win and free spins potential advertised up top. A carton, almost manga, quality has been injected by the four ladies in a pleasant underwater scene that explores the Atlantis scenery further in free spins.Playable from between 20 p/c to $/€30 per spin, there's nothing untoward to note about the game's stats, except a variable RTP. So, be on the lookout for the most generous version, possessing a theoretical return of 96.19%. The volatility, meanwhile, is high, as is a hit rate of 39.24%.Scrolling down the help file to the paytable reveals eight regular pay symbols. The lower value half are J-A card ranks; the next four are premium value mermaids. Each has a name associated with their role in Atlantis, such as the warrior, the adviser, the beauty, and the queen. Lining up five high-value symbols is worth a payout of 3 to 6 times the stake. Premium symbols not only appear in 1x1 size but can also land in 1x2 or 1x3 dimensions and may become wild as covered next.Atlantis The Forgotten Kingdom: Slot FeaturesThis Atlantis is all about full reel symbols turning wild, a bit of multiplier action, then bringing everything together for a five-option bonus game for players to choose from.Have a little look-see at the 4-symbol bonus reel spinning horizontally to the side of the main grid. Wilds pay when forming combinations of themselves, so landing 5 warrior, adviser, beauty, or queen wilds is worth 15, 20, 25, or 40 times the stake.The pearl jewellery icon is the scatter - landing 3 or more in view triggers free spins. Next, players are presented with 5 options of which they must choose one:The Warrior's Free Spins – 20 free spins where the warrior symbol is wild. Wild wins are multiplied by x1 (3,600x potential).The Adviser's Free Spins – 15 free spins where the adviser symbol is wild. Wild wins are multiplied by x2 (4,800x potential).The Beauty's Free Spins – 10 free spins where the beauty symbol is wild. Wild wins are multiplied by x3 (6,000x potential).The Queen's Free Spins – 5 free spins where the queen symbol is wild. Wild wins are multiplied by x4 (7,200x potential).The 5th option picks a spin component and multiplier component at random from the above options. So, you might get 20 Queen Spins in the best-case scenario or 5 Warrior Spins at worst. During any of the bonus rounds, landing 3 scatters at once awards +5 additional free spins. The last thing to note is that scatter symbols also pay from any position, so 2, 3, 4, or 5 in view are worth a cash win of 1, 2, 10, or 100 times the stake.Atlantis The Forgotten Kingdom: Slot VerdictTaking cues from Triple Edge Studios' Sisters of Oz, Half Pixel has drenched Atlantis The Forgotten Kingdom in female allure. Cheap ploy or all a bit of fun? There's a cartoon quality about the four full reel ladies, and they do add to the Atlantis mystique, so we'll let players be the judge of that. Combine the mermaids with mysterious sound effects, and Half Pixel has crafted a half-decent underwater fantasy scene some players might well be all over.The gameplay is volatile, so not a whole lot goes on a lot of the time. Then out of nowhere, four matching symbols appear on the wild reel to cook up a win to keep you in the game. This is aided by the 243 win ways and multipliers, so landing full reel wilds alongside a few premium symbols can haul up a surprising number of coins. Free spins seemed to be even more volatile and proved extremely hard to trigger during our test run. Moreover, keep in mind that the chosen free spin wild symbol is not guaranteed to land during the feature. Since Atlantis The Forgotten Kingdom is so hit and miss, perhaps it was a clever move by Half Pixel to distract players from the downtime by the quartet of chesty mermaids.On a certain level Atlantis The Forgotten Kingdom kind of works. Its bevvy of 'babes' populate a dreamy underwater realm, and the features can technically produce satisfying results. Players into strong female leads who aren't afraid to use their assets to get what they want might appreciate it. On the other hand, Atlantis The Forgotten Kingdom does come across as a little cheesy, Hooters under the sea at times. Filling a slot with flesh might be controversial, it might not be, but it creates a talking point in an otherwise so-so game.

Title: Neon Links
review: Neon Links: Slot OverviewPlayers looking for something neon to brighten their lives have a wealth of options in the iGaming realm to choose from. Classic gaming is the order of the day on the paytable, which consists of clubs, diamonds, hearts, and spades as the low pays, worth 1.1 to 1.8x the bet for five of a kind. Moving on, we find high paying cherries, grapes, horseshoes, bells, and flaming 7s. These pay a coin reward worth 2.5 to 25 times the stake for a full line of five. There are no wild symbols; however, there are neon versions of each regular pay tile, let's see.Neon Links: Slot FeaturesNeon Links - free spinsNeon symbols possess the same value as their non-neon counterparts, but they have another redeeming quality as well. For example, neon bells on reels 1 and 3, or 2 and 5, link together to create a three of a kind, or a four of a kind win, respectively.The other feature in Neon Links is Vegas Spins, triggered when 2 Vegas Spins symbols land on the same row on reels 1 and 5. The reward for this occurrence happening is 10 Vegas Spins. Before Vegas Spins begin, one neon symbol is randomly selected. For the duration of the bonus round, chosen symbols appear as 1x3 sized neon super symbols. Super symbols always land at full size during Vegas Spins. As in the base game, if 2 neon super symbols land together, they connect all symbols in between them, changing them into the same neon super symbols type.Neon Links: Slot VerdictNeon Links is a game that has a glossy outer shell but avoids being completely all flash and no substance. The duo of features on offer sees to that. While simple, they are capable of firing off the odd adrenaline shot, more so in free spins naturally. Neon symbols often led to an extra win or two during the base game, though not usually amounting to much. Far more useful are neon super symbols in the bonus round. While all this linking up is going on, Red Tiger has made sure everything looks good, pouring a ritzy sheen over the whole production.There is an almost 'book of' feel to the free spins process when choosing a random symbol, having it land stacked, then using them to connect wins on any reel. Rewards pale in comparison to most' book of' games, however, largely because symbol values have been curbed. At best, the most you can hope to squeeze from Neon Links is the uninspiring total of 1050 times your stake.Neon Links could easily have been a more impressive game, and one which carried on the spirit of its 'book of' brothers while taking players on a new tangent, but that's not the angle Red Tiger went for. What Neon Links does is quite nifty, yet it needed to do more to really command attention. Put simply, players in the target audience should get a kick out of Neon Links; others will find its lack of oomph unattractive.

Title: Lady of Fortune Remastered
review: Lady of Fortune Remastered: Slot OverviewLady of Fortune Remastered is a do-over of a Play'n GO slot you have to go way back to 2014 to find. Hitting 3 scatters triggers the Pick-a-Prize bonus. Players select one of the tarot cards to reveal a prize of up to 1,500x the bet.Gamble RoundWhen achieving a win in the main game, players may engage in the optional gamble round. Correctly guessing the colour of a face-down card doubles the current win. Correctly guessing the suit of a face-down card quadruples the win. The Gamble round can be played up to 5 times in a row and up to a 2,500 coin limit.Lady of Fortune Remastered slot - bonus gameLady of Fortune Remastered: Slot VerdictYeah, okay, hmm. Not sure what to make of this. Presumably for ultra fans of the first Lady of Fortune slot who just can't let go, Lady of Fortune Remastered could be the fulfilment of their deepest desires. That sounds like a stretch, though, since there is little this one does, which the original didn't. After all, Lady of Fortune was released pre-pandemic, before Brexit and a certain presidency reshaped the world.On the other hand, you know something might be up when more text is spent describing a simple side Gamble round than any of the game's other features. The only comment to make about that is the biggest pick prize has mushroomed from 150x to a chunkier 1,500x. Lady of Fortune Remastered is not a monster potential game, though, hitting its maximum payout possibilities a little bit past the biggest pick win at 1,523.33x the bet.Googling 'pointless remasters' returns a bunch of results. Lady of Fortune Remastered did not appear to be on page one, and we weren't brave enough to venture into the cold wasteland of page two and beyond. At the conclusion of the review, Lady of Fortune Remastered didn't feel pointless per se, but redundant. Perhaps Play'n GO is priming players for a release of Lady of Fortune 2; perhaps it was feeling nostalgic.
