Factor in winning potential in the region of 10,000x the bet, and it was easy to whisk up some youthful exuberance and settle in to appreciate what Wild Coyote Megaways had to offer.

Title: Money Cart 4
review: Money Cart 4: Slot OverviewClear the way, folks, Money Cart 4 is gliding into town on mag tracks to give players a taste of Money Train 4-lite, as it were. At least, this is how the last three Money Cart slots have performed. Relax Gaming specifically designed the series with UK gamblers in focus, as their restrictions prevented them from purchasing bonuses. Therefore, Money Cart was developed to offer a quicker and more frequent access to the series'' infamous bonus rounds. The downside? Winning potential takes a serious knock in these sorts of games, but you can't have everything, right? Life's all about compromises. Like that joke about the couple where she wanted a cat, but hubby didn't want a cat, so they compromised and got a cat? Maybe not, anyway, get your ticket, we're climbing aboard the train once again.Money Cart 4 slot - base gameHowever, we're skipping Money Train 4's base game to reside solely in a Rogue One-like environment where there are no scatter-paying wins or base game respin features this time. Instead, hitting spin drops either blanks, bonus scatter symbols, or special symbols onto the grid. When 3 or more symbols hit, they trigger the respin hold 'n win feature. The action takes place on a 6-reel, 8-row gaming grid, but the top 2 and the bottom 2 rows are initially locked. However, these rows can be unlocked during the respins bonus round. Money Cart 4 is a highly volatile slot that accepts bets of 10 c to $/€60 per paid game round and produces an RTP value of 96%.Money Cart 4: Slot FeaturesMoney Cart 4 slot - splash screenWhen the feature is triggered by landing 3 symbols, players are awarded with 3 respins. When triggered, the triggering symbols show a numerical value. Any special symbols that trigger the feature reveal a value and play their action before the first respin. Hitting new symbols on a respin locks them to the grid and resets the spin count back to 3. When filling a row with symbols, an extra row is opened, which can happen a maximum of four times in a round. It is possible to land these symbols:Bonus Symbols – reveal a value of 1 to 10 coins.Collector – collects all visible values and adds them to its own value.Persistent Collector – collects all visible values and adds them to its own value at the end of that spin and every following spin. It does not collect its own value.Adjacent Collector – collects all the values from the 8 adjacent positions and adds them to its own value.Persistent Adjacent Collector – collects all the values from the 8 adjacent positions and adds them to its own value on that spin and every following spin.Payer – reveals a value, then adds it to all other visible symbols on the reels.Persistent Payer – reveals a value, then adds it to all other visible symbols on that spin and every following spin. Does not pay itself.Adjacent Payer – reveals a value, then adds it to all adjacent symbols.Persistent Adjacent Payer – reveals a value, then adds it to all adjacent symbols on the spin and every following spin.Sniper – doubles the values of 3 to 8 other Bonus symbols. It can act on the same symbol more than once.Persistent Sniper – doubles the values of 3 to 8 other Bonus symbols on that spin and every following spin. It can act on the same symbol more than once.Collector-Payer – selects 3 to 5 symbols as targets, adds their values to its own and then pays out the updated value to each of those targets.Persistent Collector-Payer – at the end of each spin, it selects 3 to 5 symbols as targets, adds their values to its own and then pays out the updated value to each of its targets.Arms Dealer – converts 1 to 4 symbols into a feature symbol, then after the conversion, the new feature symbol performs its action.Persistent Arms Dealer – converts 1 symbol into a feature symbol at the end of the spin and every following spin. After the conversion, the new feature symbol performs its action.Necromancer – revives 2 to 7 already used non-persistent feature symbols. The same symbol can be targeted several times.Persistent Necromancer - revives 1 to 7 already used non-persistent feature symbols at the end of the spin and each following spin. The same symbol can be targeted several times.Persistent Shapeshifter - Turns into one of these features after every spin – Collector, Payer, Sniper, Collector Payer, Arms Dealer or Unlocker.Unlocker – unlocks a locked row.Reset Plus – increases the starting value of the spin count by 1.Upgrader – Upgrades 1 to 3 feature symbols to Persistent versions.All special symbols show a value before performing their action. In this diluted version, the respin round triggers a lot more often than it does normally, meaning way more face time (theoretically) with those glorious special symbols. Of particular note is the Persistent Arms Dealer, and if you're lucky enough to get that beauty, then there is a chance good things are going to happen. No guarantees, of course. So, for instance, if you're betting €1 per spin, then 1 coin is worth 0.1x the bet. Just to make things crystal clear for those who have not tangled with any of the earlier Money Cart slots. It means the game's 150,000 coin top prize comes out at 15,000x the bet, rather than the gobsmacking 150,000x of Money Train 4.Like previous Money Cart slots, Money Cart 4 is a 'lite' version of the original, if you will. It's busy, though, and as such, some may prefer playing this way due to the more frequent showing of the respin round (without having to buy it) than the original, despite the decimated winning potential. Money Cart 4 might be a trimmed-down edition, but it's certainly eventful and a highly entertaining way of seeing those special symbols in action.

Title: Pirate Golden Age
review: Pirate Golden Age: Slot OverviewThe Golden Age of Piracy hovered around the 17th to the early part of the 18th century and focused on places like the warm yet, at times, stormy Caribbean seas. Using the powers of deduction, or induction, this appears to be the setting for Pragmatic Play's buccaneering slot Pirate Golden Age. A simple game, Pirate Golden Age comes with nothing special in its base game, but it does have a bonus round where mystery symbols are slung onto the reels and collected.Pirate Golden Age is played on a 5-reel, 4-row game grid with 20 fixed paylines. The background image is an outrageously exotic scene of steep mountains careening down into light green-blue water, with a scary skull thing on the right-hand side above scuttling crabs. It's all rather pleasant and got the game off to a promising start. Sadly, the initial goodwill disappeared faster than a swab's sobriety on their day off.Pirate Golden Age slot - base gamePlayable on mobile, tablet, or desktop devices, Pirate Golden Age, takes bets from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin. It's a highly volatile voyage, so brace for anything. As is common practice with Pragmatic Play, the game comes in three RTP settings, with 96.49% being the highest. Regular wins occur in Pirate Golden Age when matching symbols land across paylines, starting from the leftmost side, and there are 10 regular pay symbols to work with.Starting with the lows first, where we find J-A card royals, then come higher value tiles such as a bomb, an anchor, a parrot, and three pirate characters as the top-paying symbols. Royals pay 1.5-3x the bet for five of a kind, while the rest pay 6.25x to 75x the bet for a five-symbol winning line. The skeleton in the pirate hat is the game's wild, landing on any reels to substitute for all symbols except the bonus symbol. If wilds make winning lines of themselves, they are worth up to 75x the bet for a line of five.Pirate Golden Age: Slot FeaturesPirate Golden Age slot - free spinsPirate Golden Age does not have any extra in the base game, but it has a free spins bonus round, triggered when 3 or more bonus symbols appear in view. Landing exactly 3, 4, or 5 bonus symbols pays 2x, 20x, or 200x the bet, as well as the awarded free spins.In free spins, a golden skull festooned mystery symbol appears. When mystery symbols land, they all transform into the same type of pay symbols or into wilds. After a spin, all mystery symbols are collected by a meter. At the end of each free spin, the number of collected mystery symbols is added back to the screen in random positions – new mystery symbols can still land. If more than one mystery symbol ends up in the same position, the mystery symbol in that cell gets a multiplier. The multiplier is equal to the number of mystery symbols on the cell. Multipliers apply to all wins running through it, and if more than one wild multiplier is part of a win, the values are added before being used. Lastly, for every 5 mystery symbols collected by the meter, players randomly win an extra 1, 2, or 3 free spins.Pirate Golden Age slot - free spinsPirate Golden Age: Slot VerdictPirate slots, you know, they're not exactly uncommon, so it takes something special to help them pop. Slots like Relax Gaming's Dead Man's Trail stick out like a sore thumb for their innovation and build quality, blending gaming elements with the salty theme like a slot-based ode to the sea. Or something like that. Games like Pirate Golden Age stick out for other reasons. How to put this nicely? Pirate Golden Age was kinda dull. The base game felt dryer than a pirate captain's mouth after a hard night on the rum, while free spins weren't a whole lot better. Apologies for the hyperbole.Let's dig deep for some positives to balance things out. It's tough. Pirate Golden Age is just so mediocre. Even the music got annoying. At times, it felt like it was being played by a drunk accordion player in the act of falling over. Then again, maybe in another slot the tunes would be outstanding but were tainted by Pirate Golden Age's average gameplay. There are other quirks as well, such as the collection feature which seems rather pointless - why collect the coins and then add them back on every single spin? Surely they could just have been shuffled around on the board instead whilst extra spins could be added after a set number of collected coins?Oh yeah, the positives, well, the scenery is pretty, and the game is rather piratey. Players who simply cannot get enough swashbuckling in their lives might find entertainment value with all those brigands, bombs, and bones scattered around. Mystery symbol enthusiasts (is there such a thing?) might also be all over the free spins bonus round, which wasn't super difficult to trigger. It's not a massive paying slot, however, with max win capabilities of 3,000x the bet. In other words, hitting the win cap isn't exactly sacking Portobello while the Silver Train is in town.To be fair, free spins occasionally went okay, and some players might be down with Pirate Golden Age's simplicity. There just isn't much to it, and it felt underpowered and incomplete as if something was missing that might have added extra pep. Or just pep in general. Let's end with a bit more hyperbole. Imagine raising money for a voyage to the Spanish Main, rounding up a motley crew, and crossing the Atlantic; a tattered map clutched firmly in hand. Then, digging up a treasure chest only to find it's empty. That disappointingly empty feeling isn't a jillion miles away from the one experienced once the Pirate Golden Age session was done.

Title: Realm of Legends
review: Realm of Legends: Slot OverviewDeveloper Blueprint Gaming edge deeper into grid slot territory with a mythologically themed game called Realm of Legends. So far when it comes to grid slots, Blueprint seems to swing between fantasy and candy, with Realm of Legends firmly in the former category. Centered around four beasts symbolizing the game's four modifiers, Realm of Legends is played on a 7x7 sized grid, dropping 49 symbols on each new spin. The game world looks like a scene from Lord of the Rings, where misty mountains loom over valleys, woodland areas, and waterfalls. Blueprint calls it a 'realm of might and magic' which is as good a description as any. The soundtrack is certainly dramatic, made up of an orchestral piece with a bunch of chanting going on over the top.Players take on the titans in Realm of Legends on any device, picking bets from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin. Officially noted as medium volatile by Blueprint Gaming, the game was as unpredictable as it gets during testing. From metaphorically trudging through Mordor, to sleeping in Elven tree houses, Realm of Legends was all over the place while we played it. It did settle into a semi-rhythm eventually and possess a quite high RTP rating of 96.46%. In Realms of Legend, wins are paid when clusters of matching symbols land. They must connect vertically or horizontally and sit in groups of 5 or more to count. When a winning cluster forms, it is removed from the grid, allowing symbols to fall into the empty spaces, so more winners may occur. When there are no more wins in a sequence, the next spin takes place.Players make clusters out of 8 different pay symbols. Four are low pay circles coloured green, blue, red, and yellow worth the same amount when they pay. Next are four picture symbols representing the quartet of beasts – Medusa, the Minotaur, a Firefly, and the Cyclops worth 100x to 1,000x the stake for a cluster made up of 25+ symbols. The wild also pays out 1,00x the stake, but only for a 25+ size cluster so good luck with that one. It also helps form wins by substituting for anything except the scatter.Realm of Legends: Slot Features﻿In the spirit of grid slots like Reactoonz, modifiers are triggered when a certain number of winning symbols are collected. There is a difference in that free spins require bonus symbols to unlock.Whenever a cluster forms, the number of symbols involved in the win is collected in the symbol bank located to the top left of the screen. Once a specified number of symbols are collected, then a respective modifier is awarded. If enough symbols are collected to trigger more than one modifier, then they play out one at a time, in this order;20 symbols collected unleashes Medusa who removes all paying symbols except for her own from the grid which is then refilled with new symbols.40 symbols collected awards the Minotaur who places wilds on the grid. It's possible some wilds will have multipliers attached.60 symbols collected activate the Fire Sprite who burns away all low pay symbols, leaving the highs. The highs all drop to the bottom before the rest of the grid is filled only with new wilds or high pays.80 symbols in the pot lets the Cyclops loose. This guy upgrades one higher-paying symbol type to the Cyclops symbol.If 5 scatter symbols appear on the board, free spins are activated. Once triggered, 7 Legend Falls are awarded. During free spins, it takes half the amount of collected symbols to win the four beasts covered above, meaning more modifier activity on the grid. Bonus symbols continue to land, so five collected adds 7 more Legend Spins to the remaining amount.Realm of Legends: Slot VerdictRealm of Legends was a game that took a while to reveal what it could do. At first, we must have struck a rough patch where the wins were few, far between, and the game moved at a sluggish pace. It lacked the kind of flow you could just cast off and go with. Modifiers didn't trigger as often as they do in other grid slots meaning the pace was turgid at best. Dead spins, minimal wins, or getting close took up a significant chunk of the playing time which didn't add up to a bunch of fun. For a while, it chugged along in a clunky stop, start type way.Yet catch it when it's in the mood and Realm of Legends has the ability to provide a fair amount of entertainment. The modifiers can be quite useful, especially the cyclops. If you make it all the way to the one-eyed brute, something pretty decent will usually come your way. Title: The Red Queen

Title: Mental 2
review: ﻿Mental 2: Slot OverviewAnd now for something completely dreary - or not, if you're the sort of gambler who was thrilled by the online slot Mental, Nolimit City's 2021 descent into madness. Also, at random, 1 to 5 reels may turn into a Fire Reel, and any symbol landing on a Fire Reel splits into 3 parts.Dead PatientsThis feature activates when there are 2 or more Dead Patient symbols. It reveals one of the Patient symbols with a multiplier of x5 to x9,999. The multiplier value represents the symbol count on that reel.Enhancer CellsEnhancer Cells are located at the bottom of reels 2, 3, and 4. The more Fire Frames that appear, the more Enhancer Cells activate - 4 Fire Frames activate the reel 2 Enhancer Cell, 6 Fire Frames activate Reel 2 and Reel 4 Enhancer Cells, while 8 Fire Frames activate all 3 Enhancer Cells. A Fire Reel counts as 2 or 3 Fire Frames, depending on the size of the reel it is on. Each Enhancer Cell may reveal:A regular wild symbol.xSplit symbol - splits 1 symbol on each reel into 2 and splits itself into 2 wilds.xNudge wild - always nudges to become fully visible on the reel, increasing the win multiplier by +1 for each step. Several wild multipliers add to each other for a total wild multiplier, and when an xNudge is split by an xSplit, the multiplier on the Nudge Wild increases by +1.xWays symbol - reveals 3 paying symbols of the same type, expanding the reel height. If there is more than one xWays symbol, they all reveal the same symbol.xHoleActivates when an xHole symbol lands in a Fire Frame or a Fire Reel on the second position of the third reel. Regular pay symbols and wilds are pulled from the main reels and then placed in random positions while their current sizes are multiplied by x2, x4, or x8. xNudge Wild only has its win multiplier modified. The xHole converts to a wild. Winning symbols before the xHole go back to the same positions.xMentalActivated when an xMental symbol lands in a Fire Frame or Fire Reel. It triggers an extra spin where all reel positions get Fire Frames. Enhancers reveal xWays, xNudge, wild, or xSplit, and there is a possibility of triggering xHole. If an active xMental symbol lands during a bonus trigger, the xMental feature does not trigger.Mental 2 slot - God ModeMental TransformLanding a Disembodied scatter symbol on reel 2 or reel 4 triggers the Mental Transform feature. This feature transforms the Disembodied scatter into an xWays, xSplit, Dead Patient, wild, or Patient symbol.ScattersCognitive scatters appear on the leftmost, middle and rightmost reels, while Disembodied scatters appear on reels 2 and 4. Once collected, the Dead Multiplier is transferred to the respective Patient symbol based on the Count when a new Patient symbol lands on the reels. Landing a new Disembodied scatter upgrades the remaining spins to Experimental Spins and awards +1 spin.Experimental SpinsIn addition to Surgery Spins' mechanics, both Disembodied symbols are sticky and trigger Mental Transform on each spin. The Dead Multiplier count of Patient symbols does not decrease after transferring but can keep building.Nolimit BoosterCosting 1.4x the bet, the xBet guarantees a Cognitive scatter on the leftmost reel, or at 6x the bet, the Fire Frames booster guarantees Fire Frames on all positions. 99 times the bet guarantees to activate the xHole, while 3,200x guarantees to activate xMental.God ModeAt a not inconsiderable amount of 6,666x the bet, players can Chase the Max Win and attempt to land an xGOD symbol on each reel to win the max win. However, probably because this is a sequel, it didn't feel as shocking as the original game, but Mental 2 is still about as far away from leprechauns and fruit as an online slot gets. Heavy duty visuals get a heavy duty soundtrack, too, so as far as sensory assault goes, Mental 2 punches hard. It makes you wonder - do slot makers design bright and cheerful games to cushion the blow of losing money? The chaos is sharper, the mechanics are more brutal, and the win potential is off the charts. With Nolimit City's signature intensity and a max win of 99,999x, it delivers exactly what players crave in a sequel - pure, unfiltered madness. There are now 6 reels to do so which allows for bigger combos, and there can be anything from 2 to 7 rows on each reel which mixes it up further. The grid changes constantly and those 2 to 7 rows provide between 4 to 49 win ways respectively.Symbols used on the paytable are the same but vary slightly in appearance. Players get 10 – A royals in a colourful Celtic font, and three premiums - a top hat, a lucky horseshoe, and a golden shamrock. Despite the setup expansion, the potential remains about what it was before. To compensate the extra rows, reels, and win ways, Red Tiger has dropped the value of the symbols. The Golden Shamrock, the most valuable symbol, is now worth 8 times the stake for six of a kind, compared to 24 times the stake for five on the original. The wild trumps that though at 15 times the stake for six, and it also substitutes for any of the regular pay symbols.Rainbow Jackpots Power Lines: FeaturesRunning alongside Power Lines are most of the same features from the original. Many are triggered at random when the helpful leprechaun appears with his magical pipe. These are called Lucky Leprechaun features and he provides randomly triggered Symbol Swaps and Super Symbol Swaps. A Symbol Swap is activated by the leprechaun blowing a high pay symbol onto the reels from his pipe. This leads to that chosen symbol raining down onto the reels for a guaranteed win. Super Symbol Swap is the same, but instead of regular-sized symbols, it rains down super-sized symbols from 2x2 to 6x6.Just like Symbol Swaps, the Free Spins come in two forms. The first is the standard round which is triggered when 3 scatter symbols land anywhere in view. Occasionally, if 2 scatters land, then the Lucky Leprechaun’s pipe may blow an extra scatter onto the reels to trigger the feature. During free spins, there is an increased chance of Symbol Swap feature and more free spins being activated.The bonus game’s second form is as Super Free Spins. These are activated when the Lucky Leprechaun blows a Super Free Spins symbol onto the reels. The rules are the same as before, except that Super Symbol Swaps and Super Free Spins appear instead.Beer is a common icon of Irish themed slots, and here it drives two features. First is the Beer Bonus which is activated when 3 Beer Bonus symbols land in view anywhere on the reels. Like free spins, the pipe may reveal a third Beer Bonus symbol if just two land. With it, players choose one of three beer glasses to reveal a multiplier of their stake. The second is the Triple Beer Bonus and is activated when the pipe reveals a Super Beer Bonus symbol. The difference this time is that all three multipliers are combined and awarded rather than choosing just one. Neither Beer Bonuses can appear during free spins.Rainbow Jackpots Power Lines: VerdictIn some ways the Power Lines version is an enhancement, in many ways, it’s more of the same. There might be extra rows, reels, and win ways, but the result only really suits hardcore fans of the first one (if there are any left). The Power Lines version just doesn’t have much new to offer. It doesn't enhance the overall gaming experience even close to the same way Megaways manages to do for example. Having said that, if you go back and play the original it does feel a lot more restrictive and claustrophobic.Another issue is that aside from free spins and Symbol Swaps, the other features are insanely hard to trigger. This point leads to the thorny question of potential. The paytable mentions a max win potential of just 1,224 times the stake which is far too low to cater to anyone but those who are happy to play anything that may 'look fun'. Let’s take a full grid of the shamrock symbols as an interesting example. With the original, that combo is worth 480x the stake. The kicker is that only a full 6x6 grid of the Power Lines version is worth more. Every other grid configuration will return less. Sure, it might be easier to fill a 6x2 grid, but it’s just something to keep in mind if you are considering firing up the remake.All up, while the Power Lines feature adds a bit of interest, the rest of the stats and rewards have pretty much stayed static or stagnated which seriously detracts from the game’s appeal.

Title: Desert Shark

It’s more concerned with the business side of playing slots than frivolous things like being nice and charming. The result is a much more hardcore experience. A session with Desert Shark is a lot like a trip to the desert itself. You either manage to walk out safely with a story to tell. Title: Diamond Mine Megaways

Title: Cygnus
review: Cygnus Slot (ELK Studios): OverviewAt first glance, Cygnus is obviously an Egyptian themed slot. It is, however, quite different from what we usually get in this category. Let’s start with a clarification to begin the break down. Cygnus is the name of one of the stars that make up the Northern Cross in the night sky. This constellation is apparently aligned with frightening accuracy to the pyramids in Giza. The game sheet claims this is no coincidence, that the alignment creates some sort of cosmic connection. Some online theorists have taken this idea a step further and suggested that aliens from Cygnus are responsible for building the pyramids. Whatever the truth might be, Cygnus is the title of ELK Studios latest slot, and it combines Egyptian and galactic themes with a bunch of compelling features.The look and sound of the game are classically Egyptian. The game grid is set before the entrance to a pyramid, with palm trees framing the scene and a constellation in the night sky. It’s a pretty scene and one that is not completely unremoved from the Gold series of slots. What creates that impression is the 6 reels sitting between two pillars, stacked 4 rows high. It looks intriguing, and the multiplier on the right pillar is encouraging.Initially, the game has 4,096 win ways. Symbols need to land in three or more on any row from the 1st reel onwards. Cygnus uses Avalanche game mechanics, but again, this feature is a little different than before. Because the rows and reels are not aligned flush, when winning symbols are removed, the gravity mechanic lets them drop naturally. Imagine round symbols bouncing down a flight of stairs rather than dropping straight down. Usually, symbols here fall left to right, but not always. It is a nice touch and can lead to some intense moments as you watch the symbol you want slowly make its way down to the right position, or not. Another aspect is that rows can be added after winners are cleared. This can lead to 8 rows of symbols on each reel boosting win ways to 262,144.This win system integrates with the symbols well too. The highest paying symbol in the game, for whatever reason, is the lucky 7 symbol. These usually land in a bunch on the right-hand side of the grid. Through the new and highly innovative gravity mechanic, they can get pulled into play when winning symbols on the left are cleared out of the way to let them roll in. Other symbols in the game include 4 low pay gems, and 3 more high pay symbols – an ibis, camel, and cat. The symbols look like they were designed at the last minute and don’t offer spectacular value which you would expect with an avalanche feature. The exception is the 7 which returns 30 times the stake for 6 of a kind.The nuts and bolts of the game include setting bet levels from between 10 p/c and $/100 a spin across all devices. Alternatively, players can engage one of four betting strategies in combination with up to 100 auto spins. ELK has rated the volatility at 8 of 10, which is high, but it can feel even higher at times. Cygnus comes with an RTP of 96.1% and a hit rate of 23% so theoretically it is not tight when it comes to payouts.Cygnus Slot (ELK Studios): FeaturesWorking hand in hand with the game mechanics are the extra features. Up first is the ‘X’ symbol. If this symbol makes it to the bottom row, it engages the Multiplier on the right pillar. Each consecutive ‘X’ moves it higher from x2, x4, x16, x32, until x64. The golden W symbol is wild and can land anywhere to substitute for any regular pay symbols.As always, the elusive bonus game is the one you want, and it sounds easier to land than it actually is. How it works is that when the bonus symbol enters the game it needs to be moved left until it touches the left pillar. If it does so 7 Free Drops are awarded. The bonus round uses the full 8 rows on every drop, and multiplier symbols that enter the game become sticky. This feature can also be retriggered.Cygnus Slot (ELK Studios): VerdictOn paper, the features sound a lot like ELK's Gold series of slots. Even in action, you can’t deny there are similarities. But ELK has done enough alterations to make Cygnus something of a standalone slot. Sure, some elements at their core have been used before, but Cygnus does them all a little differently, and the result feels novel. It is also massively playable. The way symbols fall left or right using the new gravity mechanic makes you want to see what happens next. Cygnus has the kind of x-factor that when you say, 'just one more spin', half an hour can pass by without noticing.While entertaining, Cygnus can also be unforgiving with a lot of dead or low-value spins. You need to get on a good run where avalanche wins pull in multipliers, ideally during free spins, for any chance of significant returns. Speaking of returns, the game has a top prize of $/€500,000. You will need to bet at max level to reach that amount due to the potential of 5,000 times the stake. Again, a similar figure to what we got with slots in the Gold range, the better ones at least.Overall, ELK has come up with a pretty good game here. The soundtrack sets the mood, and it is certainly easy on the eyes. When it comes to features, the individual parts might not be completely original. But when everything is brought together the result is something fresh. It is also easy to get lost in. And once immersed, any comparison to other slots fades away by its very playable nature.

Title: Odin's Riches
review: Odin's Riches: Slot OverviewOnce again, the one-eyed divinity Odin leaves Asgard for a trip to the iGaming realm in Just For The Win's first-ever grid slot Odin's Riches. The All-Father has gone on this journey so many times by now; most players probably know all about his exploits. Such as how he gave up an eye in return for seeing everything that happens. The rest of the view is a plain burgundy wall displaying a stylish Celtic design in the upper right quadrant. It's rather plain-looking, yet some might argue it's been tastefully done. Odin's Riches is not only highly volatile but 'very highly' volatile, meaning the game needs a good push to really get going. Potential isn't enormous, though respectable enough at 5,000x, as is the RTP value of 96.07%.There are 8 pay symbols on hand to make clusters out of. Symbol values are relatively low compared to some grid slots, and you notice this too when you land a decent-sized cluster only to end up with a disappointing return. Good thing then there are several features available to augment win values.Odin's Riches: Slot FeaturesOdin's Riches - free spinsLike many grid slots, the goal of Odin's Riches is to hit as many consecutive clusters as possible to fill a collection meter to win various set-point modifiers. Collect enough wins, and you'll be rewarded with a round of free spins, which make use of a progressive win multiplier.How it works is that each winning cluster is removed via the cascading Rolling Reels feature allowing new symbols to fall into the gaps. In addition, every reaction creates a wild symbol which substitutes for all pay symbols. Rolling Reels continue to function until no new clusters form.Winning symbols are collected and tracked on a meter. For every 25 collected, a mini-feature is queued, and when no more wins appear, queued features are released onto the grid. These are:Dragon Riches – 5 or more of the same symbol form a win regardless of their position on the grid.Wolf's Hunger – all low pay symbols are removed, triggering the Rolling Reels feature.Serpent's Wisdom – 1 low symbol is randomly upgraded.Raven's Flight – diagonal rows of symbols from each corner of the grid are removed and replaced with 3-5 wilds, also triggering Rolling Reels.It takes 125 symbols to fill the meter, and when full, 7 free spins are awarded. In free spins, one random mini-feature is always put at the front of the queue. Also, a win multiplier starting at x1 is added to the round, rising by +1 whenever a mini-feature triggers. Should 125 symbols be collected on a single spin, +3 more spins are added to the remaining total, extending the round.Odin's Riches: Slot VerdictOdin's Riches follows a common Play'n GO-inspired grid slot pattern of hitting consecutive wins, filling a meter, winning modifiers, and climaxing with free spins. This sort of system has been put to good use in a number of great games and is successful in Odin's Riches as well. The game comes off a bit basic initially, but its positive aspects steadily build until you're comfortably engrossed in the flow.Music plays a key role in player immersion, which gets increasingly dramatic as consecutive clusters build on top of each other. When wins are popping and the meter is filling, the soundtrack wouldn't be out of place in a high fantasy series chase scene or when a crucial stage in a storyline has been reached. Sound is certainly a strong counterpoint to the relatively basic graphics.Odin's Riches is further evidence of the ongoing evolution taking place at Just For The Win. Not long ago, their games were usually graphically rich while being relatively light on the mathematical side. Odin's Riches is the complete opposite. The team has eased up on the visual feast to fine-tune its math model instead. There's no doubt Odin's Riches is 'very highly' volatile as the creator states, so patience is required to push through the base game.Despite an abundance of features and a high hit rate of 49.44%, your balance can take significant hits before the game gets a chance to go crazy. When it does, it's quite a sight as queued modifiers line up to do their thing. Spins that trigger bonus games tend to be quite lengthy too, piling on a decent win in their own right before free drops even begin. Mid-level potential of 5,000 times the stake prevents Odin's Riches from reaching heavyweight grid slot status, but it's not a disgraceful amount by any means.At the end of the day, Odin's Riches does enough to produce solid grid slot gaming. It doesn't do anything revolutionary, but it doesn't put a foot wrong either. Grid slot players get to enjoy some challenging, volatile gameplay, while those interested in Norse mythology can delve into a dramatic saga.

Title: Manimals

Title: Rabbit Hole Riches
review: Rabbit Hole Riches: Slot OverviewLewis Carrol’s story Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland continues to prove irresistible to slot developers, returning to the reels on a regular basis. This time, it's Play’n GO that's had a crack, setting their game Rabbit Hole Riches in the bizzaro world. We don’t often get Alice herself in these games for whatever reason and so is the case with Rabbit Hole Riches. Here the main character is the flustered rabbit, accompanied by the Red Queen, and her minions. When it comes to features, well, while tripping down this rabbit hole, there are four bonus games up for grabs in the lush world Play’n GO has crafted.Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland is a pretty complex book, containing layers of meaning which readers have been peeling back for over a hundred years. Rabbit Hole Riches is a lot more straight forward. The action takes place on a game area made up of 3 reels, 3 rows and only 5 paylines. Backgrounded in the base game by the Red Queen’s kingdom with her many spired castle sitting ominously on the horizon, Play’n GO has gone for a dark take on the world of Alice. The murky tones, gnarled trees, and cracked characters produce an ever so slightly sinister feel that bring the thoughts to filmmaker Tim Burton's style.Rabbit Hole Riches is playable across any device, offering stakes of 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin. RTP varies depending on configuration, with a default value of 96.23%, so make sure you’re getting that version. The volatility isn’t as high as it often is at Play’n GO, here rated medium, or 6/10 for those who prefer a numerical representation.Due to the layout, only combinations of three of a kind are possible on the game’s 5 fixed paylines. Symbols are divided into two groups, the low pay Queens Army (hearts, diamonds, spades, clubs), plus high pay characters – magic trees, caterpillars, Mad Hatters, and Red Queens. As to values, premiums payout from 2 to 8 times the stake. The standard wild is worth more, at 20 times the take for a line of three. It also replaces any pay symbol to form a winner. As well as this wild, four others pop up during the features.Rabbit Hole Riches: Slot FeaturesRabbit Hole Riches - free spinsFor a compact wee 3x3 game, Rabbit Hole Riches has managed to pack quite a few extras. There are five in total, one minor rabbit one and four free games. During the base game, watch out for the small pocket watch that lands overlaid on the regular symbols - 3 in view trigger the Rabbit Hole Bonus. Helping players out trigger the bonus is the Rabbit Reward feature. On any base game spin, the rabbit could turn up to toss two scatters onto the reels. The third non-scatter reel may or may not turn up the third one to trigger the Rabbit Hole Bonus.In any case, on the next screen, the rabbit is active again, where he randomly picks one of the 4 rabbit holes to determine the feature. These are:The Green rabbit hole results in the Teacup Party Pick Bonus. This starts with 1 free spin with only high paying symbols on the reels. When the spin completes, players choose one of the teacups below the reels. Doing so reveals a high pay symbol type and every instance of this particular symbol pays out a prize worth 2 to 8 times the stake. The word ‘Continue’ or ‘Collect’ then appears on the teacup. ‘Continue’ lets players make more teacup picks, repeating the process until ‘Collect’ is revealed.The blue rabbit hole leads to Cheshire Cat Respins. This feature starts with a single respin where the 1x3 size Cheshire Cat wild is active. The first spin is guaranteed to be a winner, awarding another respin. Respins continue to come until no new winning combo lands.Next is the yellow rabbit hole which takes players to the Tower Power bonus. In this one, players get 7 free spins with Red and White Tower Wilds active. Both tower wilds are stacked, covering full reels, taking the place of the standard wild. Before the game begins, you must choose the Red or the White Tower. Each time the chosen tower lands, a point is scored for each position the wild covers. At the end, if your tower scored the most, then the total winnings from the round are doubled. If the round ends in a draw, 7 more free spins are awarded to settle the score. There are no limits to how many times the feature can be retriggered.Last up, the red rabbit hole leads to the Queens Army Free Spins. This is possibly the most lucrative one of the lot. In this bonus, the Queen Wild symbol is used, while the only other symbols are the low pay Queen Army tiles. This game uses a win multiplier, which increases by +1 on each payline win. Also, if three scatters land on a spin, three spins more are added to the remaining amount. No limit has been placed on how high the multiplier can go or the number of free spins.Rabbit Hole Riches: Slot VerdictPlay’n GO has designed quite a nice slot, with a lot more positives than negatives. Few Alice in Wonderland themed slots are as good looking as Rabbit Hole Riches, or pack as many extras. The base game is pretty basic and the hit rate is likely relatively low, so don’t expect miracles to happen there, but the copious features hold promise, though some are more desirable than others.The Teacup Party Pick Bonus for one, isn’t the most exciting, or lucrative. Neither is Cheshire Cat Respins, despite the fact that respins are technically unlimited. Bigger thrills are more likely to be found during the two free spins games, where Rabbit Hole Riches’ max potential of 5,000 times the stake is more likely to be hit.Despite the decent win possibilities, Rabbit Hole Riches doesn’t feel geared to the hardcore gamers. The overall presentation, which is high, the quirky hijinks, and medium volatile feel like a better match for a more laid back approach. Add it all up and you’ve got a great looking slot with plenty of atmosphere. Rabbit Hole Riches is not exactly a lethal gambling machine, but there are entertaining moments to be had for sure.Don't MissReady for a new adventure? Be sure to try the next instalment in the series titled Agent of Hearts. It comes with 4 character features triggered by winning with corresponding high-pays, a free spins round with mega wilds, and much more.

Title: Elk Hunter
review: Elk Hunter: Slot OverviewWith a title like Elk Hunter, you can't blame us for thinking it could have been a stab at competitor ELK Studios. Somewhat disappointed (yes, we've like a bit of drama) it turns out it was anything but. Instead, Elk Hunter pivots away from industry rivalries, immersing players in wildlife-themed gaming where elk symbols offer the best returns from all the animals on offer, while payout values may be boosted by Multiplier Wild symbols, which become sticky during the free spins bonus round.NetEnt has laid on an attractively picturesque scene for Elk Hunter. Towering mountains overlook a quiet forest while an elk grazes on grass at the home screen. Click continue, and the beast gallops away, perhaps dodging bullets or arrows or whatever, to reveal Elk Hunter's 4-reel, 6-row gaming panel. It is an unorthodox setup, though one that has been used before. Yanaha's Rite is one example of this reel configuration from provider Light & Wonder. Nature lovers should be all over this as Elk Hunter captures the spirit of a forest devoid of people, and never actually sprays any four-legged creatures with bullets or displays their body parts on a wall.Elk Hunter slot - base gameElk Hunter is a medium-high volatile slot with several RTP values to be on the lookout for. The default return value players can theoretically expect is 96.05%, jumping up a notch or two to 96.1% when buying the free spins bonus round. When a winning scatter appears on the grid, the relevant payout is made, but winning symbols remain on the board. This game does not have a cascade/reaction/tumbling mechanic in either the base game or in free spins. It does have nine regular paying symbols, though; 5 are lows, and 4 are highs. The lows are 10 to A card ranks, while the highs are an eagle, a cougar, a bear, and an elk. When 6 elks or 8 of any of the others create a win, the payout equates to 0.1 to 0.5 the bet, increasing to 1.5 to 5 times the bet for a 12+ sized scatter win.Elk Hunter: Slot FeaturesElk Hunter slot - free spinsIn the spirit of decluttering in nature, Elk Hunter is not the most feature-filled scatter pay slot around. Its extras are Multiplier Wild symbols, free spins, and a bonus buy.Multiplier Wild SymbolsMultiplier Wild symbols with values of x2, x3, x5, or x10 may appear anywhere on the grid in the base game and in free spins. Multiplier Wilds substitute for any pay symbols and apply their value to the win. If more than one Multiplier Wild is used this way, the winning total is multiplied by the sum of the multiplier values. A maximum of 5 Multiplier Wilds may appear on the reels at a time.Free SpinsWhen 3 scatter symbols appear in the base game, then 7 free spins are awarded. Getting 2 or 3 scatters while the round is active awards an additional +2 or +5 free spins, respectively. What makes the free spins part of Elk Hunter more special than its base game is that when Multiplier Wild symbols land on the reels, they remain there until the end of the round.Buy FeatureThe free spins round may be activated by the bonus buy feature for 60 times the bet.Elk Hunter slot - free spinsElk Hunter: Slot VerdictElk are big animals, but the same can't really be said about Elk Hunter as an online slot. It is medium-high volatile, so that's something to keep in mind, but its list of features is limited, though not as limited as its modest max win. What's interesting is how the neatly developed game world goes with how simplistic the features are. Perhaps this was done in the spirit of getting back to nature and living a simpler existence while minimising stress, responsibilities, mental taxation, contact with humanity and all that.The weaponry Elk Hunter does have on hand is pretty nifty. Few would argue with the inclusion of wilds with multipliers in a scatter-paying slot, though the multiplier values are nothing when compared to a benchmark scatter pays slot like Gates of Olympus. They are wild, let's not forget, which adds an exciting dimension to a slot like this. The omission of a cascading wins mechanism is felt, though, and may play a part in Elk Hunter's modest max win figure of 2,035 times the bet. This figure and the overall vibe the game gave off would suggest it is aimed at the recreational segment of the gambling crowd. As such, it is tough to critically crush Elk Hunter too much if it is setting out to be a pleasant nature game with elk rather than a paradigm-shifting hot rod of a slot. This would follow the pattern NetEnt has followed of late in slots like Don't Eat the Candy, 101 Candies, or Crab Trap.If you dig the natural setting but crave a bit more grunt, then Print Studio's nature slot Huntress Wild Vengeance might be a better match. It is not so elk-focused, but it is a stunning wilderness slot with potent features and bigger winning potential. Keyboard hunters also get the chance to fire arrows at a bear in that one.

Title: Santa Express
review: Santa Express: Slot OverviewHo ho ho, hey we go, folks, it's another Christmas slot to thicken the stocking as the holiday season rolls around. This one's called Santa Express, and it comes from the team over at Stakelogic. Kind of surprisingly, Santa Express doesn't appear to be a copy, clone, or rejig of a previous slot, or if it is, apologies, as the original must have swung by without leaving a major blip on the radar. In some ways, that's a good thing because it means we can load up Santa Express, smash out a few spins, and see what makes it tick without the taint of copy-and-paste bias. If you can handle another dose of Xmas cheer, feel free to take a look.Speaking of biases, and this is something of an aside, it is kind of interesting to note the northern hemisphere preference prevalent in the Christmas slot industry. While northern parts of the world experience the colder weather of winter, the south bathes in sunshine as summer has its turn down there. We just don't get too many beach BBQ Christmas celebrations in slots; maybe there's a gap in the market just waiting to be plugged? Anyway, back to Santa Express, which is held in a part of the planet that gets its share of snow. A spindly-looking bridge spans the screen from one side to the other, while snow-covered houses and snow-covered trees make up the foreground. The midground is taken up by more snow-covered objects, hills this time. It looks cold but cosily so and should help reinforce the pleasure of being indoors next to a roaring fire while spinning Santa Express, should players choose to do so.Santa Express slot - base gameAnother choice is bet selection, and there are two elements to this conundrum. The first is picking a base bet, from 20 p/c to $/€100, and the second is whether to activate the Super Stake or not. Doing so doubles the bet while also doubling the chance of triggering free spins. In both cases, Santa Express is highly volatile no matter how you bet. Stakelogic slots are typically available in several RTP versions so, if possible, go for the 96.17% version which is the max setting.The action itself takes place on a 5-reel, 20-payline game. Three to five-of-a-kinds are possible with ten Xmas related pay symbols to work with. Leading them off are decorated 10-A card rank symbols paying 0.5 to 1 times the bet for five-of-a-kind, then baubles, gingerbread men, hot drinks, elves, and Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer as the premium symbols. Five symbol premium wins pay 1.25 to 10 times the stake. Also, wilds substitute any pay symbol or are worth up to 20x the bet for a winning line of five of themselves, but they only appear from the Collapsing Wild Symbols feature, covered next.Santa Express: Slot FeaturesSanta Express slot - free spinsOne of Santa Express' main features is its cascading wins system which is tied directly to the Collapsing Wild Symbols features. When a win hits, the winning symbols are taken off the board, and in one of the random empty spaces, a wild symbol appears. After the wild symbol has been placed, the remaining empty spaces are filled with symbols falling down from above. Cascades continue like this until no new win is formed. In addition, with consecutive wins, new wilds may be added, or the wild symbols may move, and they increase their individual multipliers from 0 up to x10 at the most.Free SpinsSanta is the scatter and landing 3, 4, or 5 them awards 1.5x, 2.5x, or 25x the bet, respectively, plus a random number of 8, 10, 12, or 15 free spins. Free spins come with a random win multiplier of x2, x3, x5, or x10, which stays for the full duration of the feature. Moreover, one random high or low pay symbol is selected to be the Chosen symbol that pays double during free spins. Also, collapsing wild symbols remain active in the bonus round. The feature can be extended by landing 3 scatters to win 2x the bet plus 5 free spins, 4 scatters to win 10xx the bet and +8 free spins, or 5 scatters to win 20x the bet plus +10 free spins.Buy BonusWhere applicable, eligible players have the choice of buying free spins. The choices are:Normal – 8 to 15 free spins with a win multiplier up to x10 for 100 times the bet.Deluxe – 15 free spins with a win multiplier up to x10 and a guaranteed high pay chosen symbol for 250 times the bet.Random – a 50/50 chance of getting the Normal or Deluxe for 175 times the bet.Santa Express slot - feature buy optionsSanta Express: Slot VerdictThere had been a bumper crop of Christmas slots the year Santa Express was reviewed, coming in all manner of shapes and forms. Even so, Santa Express did enough to poke its head out from the crowd and make itself noticed. Not in a dramatically unmissable way, mind you, but just enough to make it somewhat memorable once the snow had settled and everything had been said and done.We're certainly not insinuating Santa Express is in any way radical. Players pining for a traditional Christmas setting will still find that if they decide to give the game a whirl. Stakelogic has ensured Santa Express is chock full of the sorts of sights typically associated with the season – snow, decorations, elves, Santa, and even Rudolph is in there. Rest assured, if you want the Christmas card experience on the day, Santa Express will shovel that on in earnest.It's the gaming which kind of stuck out. Again, not in a radical way as such, but there were a few memorable moments. Cascades creating wild symbols had a faint Moon Princess 100 ring to them, with the exception that in Santa Express, they have the ability to toss multipliers into the run of things. The wild symbol itself, too, is there something a little cheerfully Grinch-ish about it? Not sure, but the wild added something unexpected to the mix in more than one way. Max win is nothing to be sniffed at either, and if all those multipliers can pop, fizz, and do their thing, Santa Express is capable of producing wins as high as 20,000x the bet.So, another Xmas slot wedges its way onto the considerably long shelf for players' consideration. Santa Express didn't come across as a Christmas classic, but there are a number of potential heart-warming things about the game to experience from both a thematic as well as gaming perspective.

Title: Shadow Raiders MultiMax
review: Shadow Raiders MultiMax: Slot OverviewTake to the seas with a band of zombie swabs in the online slot Shadow Raiders MultiMax from Yggdrasil Gaming partner Bang Bang Games. All pay symbols can be substituted by the golden skull wild symbol.Shadow Raiders MultiMax: Slot FeaturesShadow Raiders MultiMax slot - splash screenThe extras padding out Shadow Raiders MultiMax include a Dropdown feature, the MultiMax, Booty Bombs, Raiders Free Spins (with a pre-feature gamble option), and, where available, a bonus buy optionDropdown FeatureThe Dropdown feature removes winning symbols from the board whenever they land. In Raiders Free Spins, the reel multipliers do not reset until the round ends. Before going into free spins, players have the option of gambling to potentially win more spins. Gambles take place on a wheel divided into red and green segments. Successful gambles award extra free spins.Also, where available, players have the option of buying 8 free spins for 100x the bet or 14 free spins from the Super Bonus for 350x the bet.Shadow Raiders MultiMax slot - free spins gambleShadow Raiders MultiMax: Slot VerdictWhen Yggdrasil Gaming has lent its mechanics out to associate studios in the past, the results have been varied. Bang Bang Games, we're happy to say, has done a stand-up job with its turn on the MultiMax mechanic. The studio hasn't tried to be massively revolutionary with it, nor has it gone crazy and bolted on a bunch of extras. All the better for it, really, as players get a smooth MultiMax experience that, nevertheless, is quite different from those which preceded it, like Multifly!, Firekick! MultiMax, or Crystal Falls MultiMax, for example.One big point of difference is Shadow Raiders MultiMax's outer casing, and the zombie pirate idea was a fun one that the design team has pulled off well. Shambling hordes of zombies, all flesh dripping and whatnot, might be a terrifying thought, but in online slots, they can work like a charm, often in a humorous setting. Picking zombified pirates rather than regular flesh and blood buccaneers gives the game a load of personality, which not only brought Cash Truck to mind but, interestingly, slots like Florageddon! and Granny vs Zombies, as well. So, while the gameplay is similar to others in the MultiMax range, Shadow Raiders MultiMax ironically feels fresh.Another relatively fresh part is the Booty Bomb, which is good for some (hopefully multiplied) cash prizes or some matching symbol action. Not a monumental innovation, but a clever one that fits neatly with everything else Shadow Raiders MultiMax has to offer. When Shadow Raiders MultiMax is pulling everything together, it's capable of generating wins of up to 15,000x the bet - the highest in the franchise so far. Factor in the numbers, the entertaining theme and the proven mechanics, and Bang Bang Games has a potential winner on its hands.

Title: Cash in Transit
review: Cash in Transit: Slot OverviewIn slots as in life, when you hit pay dirt you gotta be hitting it again and again. And again. That would appear to be the thinking at Relax Gaming, which struck it big, really big, with its Money Train series. Spinning off of Money Train came a slew of Money Cart slots, which drastically streamlined the base game in order to launch players into the bonus round at a greater frequency. They were an option for players who didn't have access to feature buys, say, UK gamblers, to hasten the journey to the hold 'n' win. Catering even closer to home, Relax Gaming has released Cash in Transit, a version of Money Cart 3, but a crime-themed edition, set on the British streets.Cash in Transit slot - base gameCash in Transit's grid has been slapped up against the back of a van as it sits parked on the streets of London. One would presume this is the getaway vehicle, idling while accomplices perform the smash-and-grab before piling in and zipping away to a hiding spot. There's not a train in sight in this game, though London is famous for having an underground network. In saying that, less than half of the London Underground these days is actually above ground. So, instead of trains, Cash in Transit is a cops 'n' robbers game of dastardly criminals and brave lawmen.Cash in Transit is a high volatile slot that takes bets of 10 c to $/€100 per spin and comes shipped with 96% RTP. The slot is split between a base game where only blank spaces or bonus-related symbols may land on its 5x4 game area and a hold 'n' respin bonus round. During the game round, it is possible to land these symbols, which stick to the reels:Cash Bag - reveals a value of 1 to 10 coins.Bag Man - collects all values in view and adds them to its own value.Bag Man/Money Man - selects 3 to 5 symbols, adds their values to its own and pays out the updated value to each of the targeted symbols.Lock Smith - doubles the value of 3 to 8 other symbols. Can act on the same symbol more than once.Gov'Nor - brings 2 to 7 used non-persistent symbols to life again (Bag Man, Bag Man/Money Man, Lock Smith, Detective, or Constable). Can act on the same symbol more than once.Pawn Broker - gathers all cash bags and removes them from the reels, including other Pawn Brokers, freeing up space on the reels. Feature symbols remain on the reels.Detective - selects a random symbol and doubles its value 2 to 6 times.Constable - reveals a coin value of 5 to 100, then adds the revealed value 3 to 10 times to a random symbol.Persistent Bag Man - collects all values in view and adds them to its own value at the end of the spin and all following spins. Does not collect its own value.Persistent Lock Smith - doubles the value of 3 to 8 other symbols at the end of the spin and all following spins. Can act on the same symbol more than once.Persistent Bag Man/Money Man - selects 3 to 5 symbols at the end of each spin, then adds their values to its own and pays out the updated value to each of the targeted symbols.Persistent Gov'Nor - brings 1 to 7 already used non-persistent special symbols to life again (Bag Man, Bag Man/Money Man, Lock Smith, Detective, or Constable). Can act on the same symbol more than once.Persistent Attack Dog - turns into a different special symbol after every spin (Bag Man, Bag Man/Money Man, Lock Smith, Detective, or Constable).Cash in Transit slot - free spinsCash in Transit: Slot VerdictIt's funny, a while back, a new Money Train or Money Cart slot was big news; now, eh, not so much. If Relax Gaming went back to the drawing board to craft Money Train 5 it would possibly be their best shot at saving a studio that is in free fall currently. However, Relax Gaming seems more concerned with firing out Dream Drop releases in between slots that, in general, just haven't been very impressive for a while. Cash in Transit is another one which didn't generate much excitement. Having said that, it's not without its moments. The cops 'n' robbers theme has carved out its own space in the online slot biz, and it can be fun when not taken too seriously. However, Cash in Transit's presentation didn't have anywhere near the same screen presence as a 1,000-ton train covered in skulls and pipes.Ah well, a different angle it is and who knows? Maybe non-train folk will prefer the law-breaking approach as they attempt to make their way into the series' famous hold 'n' win round. Once in, well, there's just no telling what's going to happen. A round could be a cash bag only session; it might be one that drops several special symbols which play off of each other to a rising crescendo. Such is the breadth of experiences Money Train/Money Cart slots are able to pull off. Again, persistent symbols are everything; get a few of those interacting, and it's just good stuff.A quick word on winning potential. Where the game touts wins of up to 100,000, this is measured in coins. Since a coin is worth 0.1 of the stake, the max win in this slot is 10,000x the bet. All in all, Cash in Transit provides an alternative way to have the Money Cart experience, however, it just didn't have the same level of punch as its train-themed cousins.

Title: Book of Ra - Temple of Gold
review: Book of Ra – Temple of Gold (Novomatic): OverviewIf there is one slot series that needs little introduction it is the Book of Ra series. Games product. At first, it felt like Dog Days might have slipped back into copying the 9 Masks of Fire format, but a few spins in, it quickly became obvious that Nailed it! Title: Badger Miners

Badgers, though, not sure if it works, as in, maybe they're going to feel a little out of place for players in the mood for a mining slot which sticks closer to tradition. If a cute mining slot is what you're after, though, then Badger Miners could be worth a deeper inspection.As part of a deeper inspection, when the charm wore off, Badger Miners was a bit average, to be honest, and visually it kind of comes across as an Yggdrasil B-team production. Badger Miners has a lot of bright lights and moving parts, yet it seemed hard to align them and generate something interesting. The session turned into masses of Wild Respins respinning to nowhere, multipliers screaming out for operators, and badgers who could have put as much effort into being productive as they do in being cute.No doubt, good things can happen in this badger hole when everything lines up; the game does have a max win of 10,000x the bet and all. When it doesn't, though, Badger Miners might be pretty tedious. Title: Poke The Guy

Title: Coin Quest
review: Coin Quest: Slot OverviewUp for a bit of trekking through nature on a coin hunt? Software provider Slotmill is, and the team is taking interested players to the well-trod ground of Central America in an online slot titled Coin Quest. A cluster paying grid slot with an Avalanche win system, Coin Quest comes bundled with a collect system, three types of bonus rounds, and several feature buying options. So, while the theme might not be the most original, Coin Quest has plenty to get stuck into, so slap on some mosquito repellent and join us if you're up for it.Coin Quest gets off to a positive beginning by presenting a clean, pleasantly rendered, if a little clinical view of an Aztec temple setting. It's got a bit of jungle, some chunky stonework, and more than enough Aztec inspired imagery to set the mood. It didn't inflame passions right away yet is agreeable looking enough to prompt further investigation.Played on a 5x5 game grid, Coin Quest is a highly volatile slot that provides eligible players with a number of ways of approaching the game. When playing in the normal mode, the RTP can be found at two settings – 96.12% or 94.36%, while stakes range from 20 p/c to $/€40 per spin. Other modes are covered below in the features section, where players in certain jurisdictions can find three bonus buys and the unusual Burst Mode to choose from.Getting the wins rolling begins when at least five matching symbols land adjacent to each other in vertical or horizontal directions. Winning clusters trigger the Avalanche feature, and there are seven regular paying symbols to work with. These start with three lower value red, green, and blue tiles paying 0.25-0.3x for five of a kind, rising to 6-10x the bet for clusters of 12+ symbols. Then we get three animals and a skull as the four higher paying symbols, worth 0.3-1x the bet for 5 of a kind, up to 12.5-40x the bet for 12+ sized clusters.Coin Quest: Slot FeaturesA lot of the big thrills in Coin Quest begin with the Avalanche feature. This removes winning clusters from the grid to make way for a symbol drop to fill the gaps. If a new cluster is created after the symbol drop, the Avalanche feature triggers again. In addition, before symbols drop, a wild symbol is added to one of the empty spaces.Collect MeterAvalanches feed into the Collect Meter, which is available in the base and bonus game. Each symbol removed in an Avalanche progresses the Collect Meter by +1. When 25 symbols have been collected, the Sun God feature triggers, adding Coins and Wilds to the game panel. At the end of each base game spin, the meter resets.Coin ClustersAs well as normal symbols, Coin symbols can land bearing values of 1x to 500x. When Coins land in clusters of five or more, their values are added together and multiplied by the bet. The win is paid out, then the cluster explodes, and an Avalanche occurs; however, one of the empty spaces is filled with a new Coin symbol carrying the total multiplier of the Coin cluster.Coin Quest BonusCoin Quest Bonus symbols appear on reels 1 or 5, and landing 2 of them at once triggers this feature. When you do, 5 free spins are awarded, where the collect meter does not reset until the bonus round ends. During the Coin Quest, Coin symbols remain on the grid, dropping to the bottom of the reels between spins. There they can potentially accumulate into larger clusters and values. Landing a +1 Spin symbol awards one additional free spin. Landing 3 Bonus symbols on reels 2, 3, or 4 upgrades the feature to Super Free Spins and awards +4 additional free spins.Free SpinsLanding 3 Bonus symbols on reels 2, 3, or 4 in the base game awards 8 free spins. During free spins, whenever the collect meter is filled, it adds random Wilds and Coins to the grid as normal, but it also increases the win multiplier by +1, up to a maximum of x20. Landing the +1 Spin symbol awards an additional free spin, or landing Coin Quest symbols on reels 1 and 5 upgrades the bonus to Super Free Spins, whilst also awarding +4 extra free spins.Super Free SpinsAs well as the two ways mentioned above, landing Coin Quest symbols on reels 1 and 5, plus Bonus symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4 triggers 8 Super Free Spins. Super Free Spins is a mix of Coin Quest and Free Spins.Fast TrackIf this option is visible on screen in your jurisdiction, clicking it opens up three ways of playing Coin Quest. These are:Coin Quest – 40x the bet buys a Coin Quest trigger with an RTP of 96.21%.Free Spins – regular free spins trigger for 100x the bet with an RTP of 96.36%.Super Free Spins – buy the super version of free spins for the cost of 480x the bet. RTP is 96.58%.Burst ModeAnother way of possibly playing Coin Quest is in Burst Mode. This is a hyper-fast, no-frills mode that removes the grid, then lets the math model do its thing unhindered. Players select the number of spins they want, plus the stake. Then any wins simply appear on screen as bare numbers.Coin Quest: Slot VerdictSlotmill games often feel like the stereotypical nice guy at an office everyone gets along with. The dude who doesn't talk smack behind peoples' backs and always has a pencil to borrow. These are games which are also easy to get along with, yet their all-around nice disposition and lack of edge mean they tend to fall in the middle of the slot hierarchy, being neither outcast nor one of the cool crew. That's fine, though we don’t think Slotmill is aiming for average. This is a studio that turns out perfectly playable slots, with fine features and decent winning totals, but there's a feeling they could do so much more if given a little push.Coin Quest is a classic example. In Coin Quest, Slotmill has nailed the basics, given the game an attractive look, and included some interesting features. As a thought experiment, let's cast our minds to Print Studios as a comparison, which started out relatively safe with a Book slot before diving into uncharted territory. Not saying all studios have to be daring innovators every single time, but to break into the top clique, that might be the sort of spirit Slotmill will have to adopt.For now, we're fine playing games like Coin Quest. It's a well-made cluster paying slot with a fun use of symbol collections, multipliers, and coin features, capable of cranking out wins worth up to 10,000x the bet. There's not much more you could ask for, nor little that warrants a major overhaul. Slotmill has made an inoffensive game, but again, one lacking the sort of glittering star quality which would likely make it the first pick in a line-up.Perhaps, and it feels like we've said this before, Slotmill might do well to put their well-honed design chops to use in a braver theme. It doesn't have to be a psychological thriller set in a Victorian-era psychiatric institute or be too out there. However, perhaps by picking something a little bolder the team might be inspired to step up to the next level?

Title: African Elephant

Title: The Runemakers DoubleMax
review: The Runemakers DoubleMax: Slot OverviewWhen a DoubleMax slot comes along, often one of the first thoughts is how close it will be to the Raptor DoubleMax template - a wannabe, mildly similar, or, gasp, something more original? Especially when the slot has been designed by one of Yggdrasil Gaming's partners, in this case, Bang Bang Games, which tinkered with the features in its previous DoubleMax slot, Pharaoh's Gaze. However, today's game in question, The Runemakers DoubleMax, is something different altogether as Bang Bang Games has made the first cluster paying grid slot that also happens to have the multiplying power of DoubleMax on board.The mechanical side of The Runemakers DoubleMax is pretty inventive, which is more than can be said for the storyline side. Okay, it's a slot, not an MMORPG, but the call to action for players here inviting them to 'Journey into a mysterious realm set against a dark forest ruled by THE RUNEMAKERS' is a little thin. No matter, The Runemakers DoubleMax makes up for it by looking and sounding pretty decent when in action. A 6x6 gaming grid is where the activity occurs, bordered by creeping ivy, and is transparent, too, so players get a clear view of the cold blues and pastel purples of the fantasy world. Hitting a 5-matching symbol cluster pays 0.2 to 1.5 times the bet, whereas the most valuable 14+ clusters are worth 5 to 10 times the bet. Not much for a cluster pays slot, so DoubleMax is useful for stepping in to pep the payouts. Wilds help, too, by substituting for all regular pay symbols.The Runemakers DoubleMax: Slot FeaturesThe Runemakers DoubleMax slot - free spins gambleCascading wins, or as they're called here Dropdowns, are critical in a DoubleMax game due to the way they increase the win multiplier and are joined by Mystic Mysteries, free spins, a free spins gamble, as well as a bonus buy.Dropdown FeatureThe Dropdown feature means winning symbols disappear from the reels, making room for other symbols to drop down, providing another chance to win. Each time players get a Dropdown win, 1 to 5 wild symbols are added to empty positions before the rest of the spaces are filled. Dropdown win chains continue until there are no more wins.DoubleMaxEach Dropdown win doubles the total win multiplier. In the base game, the multiplier resets after a losing spin or Dropdown, whereas in free spins, the multiplier which starts at x1 does not reset until the bonus session ends.Mystic MysteriesDuring symbol replacements, Mystic symbols may appear. After a win, all new symbols may drop in as Mystery symbols. When in view on the reels, all Mystery symbols reveal the same matching symbol – this excludes scatters or wilds.Runemaker's Free SpinsIn the base game, landing at least 3 scatter symbols awards 7 free spins. Before the round begins, players have the chance to gamble for more free spins on a wheel. When successful, the number of free spins goes from 7 to 9 on the first gamble, then 9 to 11 on the second gamble, with 11 free spins being the most you can win. If the gamble is lost, players lose their free spins and go back to the base game.Buy BonusIt is possible to buy 7 free spins for 125x the bet. After buying free spins, players are able to gamble for more if they would like to try.The Runemakers DoubleMax slot - free spinsThe Runemakers DoubleMax: Slot VerdictWell, that was an unexpected bolt out of the blue. You get so used to something being done a certain way that any deviation from the normal run of things comes as quite a jolt. DoubleMax games till now have tended to be quite technically similar, generally played out on a 5x3 gaming grid with 20 or so paylines up to 243 ways to win, broadly speaking. So, to see the mechanic stretched to perform on a larger gaming space with cluster pays rather than lines or ways was a breath of fresh air.Putting the cluster element to the side for a moment, The Runemakers DoubleMax does function very closely to a lot of other DoubleMax slots - namely, hit cascades, add wilds, double the multiplier. Repeat and win, hopefully. The Runemakers DoubleMax mixes things up by dropping in mystery symbols and, of course, cluster pays, but in a certain sense, it's a familiar formula by now. A solid formula, though, if slightly brute force, which relies on repeat cascading wins to rip through the multiplier to potentially obscene levels rarely found outside a DoubleMax game. Moreover, since cluster pay slots tend to rely on chains of cascading wins to provide their bigger entertainments anyway, pairing cascades with a doubling-up multiplier makes perfect sense.As a result, The Runemakers DoubleMax presents an interesting proposal for both cluster pay players and DoubleMax fans to try out. It might be hard to wind the game up at times, but get it on a roll, and the Dropdown/DoubleMax multiplier combo might be quite a ride. With a 15,000x the bet max win figure, there's plenty to play for, too, in a game that charges the DoubleMax range into brand-new territory.

Title: Ms Robin Hood
review: Ms Robin Hood: Slot OverviewYou might have seen Robin Hood hit the reels on numerous occasions, but have you ever seen a Ms Robin Hood before? Robin Wilds and scatters cannot be transformed into normal wilds.Symbol Split - When triggered, up to 6 arrows land on the reels, transforming the symbols they hit into 2 halves of the same type. When a scatter symbol and a Robin Wild symbol land together on a free spin, players win +5 free spins.Ms Robin Hood slot - free spinsMs Robin Hood: Slot VerdictA certain mood or frame of mind, or both, might have to be cultivated for some to enjoy what Ms Robin Hood has to offer, thought the relatively high max win potential of 12,574x the bet is certainly a solid incentive to give it a shot. Charming looks can be deceiving in a slot, but Ms Robin Hood isn't really one of those. What you see is more or less what you get. Next to the reels is the player's car, humming away, ready to roll. Adding to the immersion factor, Drive: Multiplier Mayhem is played through a character called Jette, a rough racer, with plenty of ‘tude. Jette is up against three opponents she appears keen to grind into the proverbial dust.Playable on mobile, tablet, or desktop device, racers enter the fray by selecting bets from 15 p/c to $/€75 per spin. NetEnt has dropped a medium volatile engine into this machine, producing a generously high RTP rating of 96.7%. Players won't be waiting around long in between wins which occur more frequently than one in four spins (28.72%). However a bit more patience is required to enter the bonus game battle, theoretically triggered every 209 spins. It's not all sitting around waiting for the race to occur though. A juicy wild multiplier feature in the main game keeps things interesting.The paytable builds on the futuristic racing theme by splitting pay symbols into low pay metallic 9-A royals, and characters for the highs. In this latter category, you'll find the three racers; Twitch, Hamaki, and Bruiser as well as Jette's car, and Jette herself. At least three of a kind triggers a payout, while at the upper end, five premiums on a payline are worth from 4x to 10x the bet.Drive Multiplier Mayhem: Slot Features﻿NetEnt has used two features to pad the game out with. There are 4 levels in total, where Jette races a different driver on each one, and the modifiers steadily improve:Level 1 – The racing opponent is Twitch and comes with no overlay multiplier wilds.Level 2 – The racing opponent is Hamaki, 4 spins are awarded, and 1 overlay multiplier wild appears on the reels.Level 3 – The racing opponent is Bruiser, 3 spins are awarded, and 2 overlay multiplier wilds appear on the reels.Level 4 – The racing opponent is Bruiser, 2 spins are awarded, and 3 overlay multiplier wilds appear on the reels.Overlay wilds are multiplier wilds which remain on the reels, moving positions in between spins. There is plenty of adrenaline popping during all phases of the game, due to an abundance of wild multipliers which rear up like squashed bugs on the windshield to boost wins. Free spins are where the major event takes place, yet even the base game is capable of wins up to 1,200x the bet. The key is those wild multipliers that can reach epic proportions at times. Okay, you won't get them on every reel to trigger the 120x very often, but the capabilities are there and can appear at any time, adding a little thrill whenever they appear.Play gets a nitrous injection when free spins are triggered. It might take a bit of time for them to hit, yet the wait can be worth it. For one thing, if you rack up a bunch of nitro symbols to reach the later stages of the competition, the round drags on nicely. Of course, players won't win every race they enter, but there is potential here for when they do, or at least, get close. The action seriously heats up despite Drive Multiplier not being the most volatile slot out there. Manage to pull in a bunch of the right symbols at the later stage of the bonus and wins of up to 5,109 times the total bet are possible.NetEnt has put together a great package where every element plays its part, resulting in a slick, fast-paced whole. It seems like the studio had a load of fun developing the theme and that enthusiasm translates to the gaming experience. Motor heads or anyone after a bit of high-speed action will enjoy the competitive atmosphere during both phases of the game, while free spins become an all-out race for coins.

Title: Piñata Popper Dream Drop

Though, keep in mind, when playing Piñata Popper Dream Drop, the bigger the bet, the greater the chance of getting a jackpot one is. The actual popping occurs on a 7x7 gaming panel, where wins are created when clusters of 5 or more matching symbols land. Winning symbols must be connected vertically or horizontally to each other.Heading over to the paytable, margarita in hand naturally, we find 8 matching pay symbols. On the lower side are card suits – clubs, spades, diamonds, and hearts, then on the high side is a taco, a bottle of tequila, a sombrero, and a flaming chilli pepper.
